5byu /7khya

a mdo'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig dpe tshogs/gnyen bshad thos pa kun dga'/ston bshad skyid g.yang dga' 'khyil/gna' rgya'i tshe lo/dmangs glu snyan dbang bdud rtsi/glu shags srid pa'i dar lce/rogs 'then rdo rje'i tshe mdud/byis sgrung dga' ba'i rtsed 'jo/gna' gtam mthong ba dga' skyed/la gzhas mthun pa drug skor/la shags khrom chen dgu rdzogs/
༄/ / gna' gtam mthong ba dga' skyed/kurma mkha' 'bum gyis bdams te bsgrigs/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

sgrig pu pozhi gtan /bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa dang rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi re ba bskang phyir/nga tsho mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis〈〈a mdo'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig dpe tshogs〉〉shig bsgrigs te bstud mar dpe skrun byed pa'i 'char gzhi bzos shing / dpe tshogs 'dir a mdo'i dmangs khrod kyi ston bshad dang /gnyen bshad/ 'bel gtam/ rogs 'then/ gna' gtam/ glu/ la gzhas/ gtam dpe/ byis sgrung sogs kyi deb sna bcu lhag bkod sgrig byas yod/ dus yun ring bo'i spyi tshogs 'pho 'gyur gyi go rim khrod du/ las la brtson zhing shes rig bkra ba/ ngang rgyud drang zhing brtse semasache ba/ spobs pas phyug cing gsar gtod la mkhas pa'i bod mi rigs kyang mi rigs gzhan dag dang 'dra bar rang nyid kyi spyi tshogs dang / khor yug1

thon skyed sogs phyi rol rang byung khams kyi snang tshul sna / /tshogs la ngos 'dzin dang 'brel 'dris byas pa brgyud de/rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i blo gros kyi rtsal la brten nas ngag thog rtsom rig rab dang rim pa gsar rtsom dang khyab spel byas pa yin zhing / rtsom rigs 'di rnams brjod bya gsal zhing go sla la/ rjod byed gnad du things shing dpe mtshon gsal ba/ tshig 'bru legs shing zor yang ba tshig nyams che zhing bab chags pa sogs mi rigs gzhan la ldan dka' ba'i rtsom gyi khyad chos ngo mtshar ba mang bo ldan/'di dag ni bod mi rigs rang gi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dngos las byung bas skyid sdug 'dres ma'i mi tshe'i 'tsho ba mngon par mtshon zhing / mar rtsam 'o ma'i dri bsung ches cher ldang ba yin la/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi spyi tshogs gnas bab dang / bsam pa'i 'du shes/ mi tshe'i lta tshul/ yul srol goms gshis/ mdzes dpyod rin thang gi tshad gzhi dag kyang gsal bor mtshon pas/ ljang lo'i mtsho rlabs g.yo ba'i zhing kha nas 'don rta dbyangs su gyer ba dang /ljon shing tshang tshing dkrigs pa'i rdza 'dabs nas sing sing ngag la 'dren pa/ bde 'jam drod rlangs khol ba'i tsha thab las 'bel gtam phreng bar 'byin pa/ 'du 'dzi'i 2

ltad mo rdzogs pa'i khrom tshogs su shags 'gyed rgyugs bzhin sprod pa'i rig rtsal byed sgo med du mi rung ba zhig tu gyur/ 'dis kyang nga tsho'i lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i lo rgyus kyi bshul lam ring mor mi tshe la mtshar sdug dang tshe srog la gson shugs sbyin myong zhing / nga tsho'i 'tsho gzhi la don dam gyi bden dpang yang dang yang du byas pa yin na 'di ni nga tsho'i 'tsho ba'i snang tshul zhig yin la nga tsho'i rig gnas kyang yin par ma zad/ bod mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas kyi grub cha zhig kyang yin no/ /nga tshos dpe tshogs 'di sgrig pa'i go rim khrod/ a mdo'i yul skad kyi skad cha'i sgyu rtsal dang khyad chos mi 'dor ba'i phyir du/ nges par dag bcos byed dgos pa rnams phud gzhan byings ni yul skad ltar rang sor bzhag yod cing / nga tshor nyams myong dang chu tshad zhan pa'i dbang gis dpe tshogs 'di'i sgrig stangs dang tshig sbyor sogs kyi thad la nor skyon ci mchis klog pa po rnams kyis dgongs 'char dang skyon brjod lhug stsol yod pa zhu zhu/ /dpe sgrig pas/3

dkar chagasgrig da pozhi gtan/ ( 1 )sgon po sgo brnad gi gtan rgyud/ ( 1 )'u glen puska sgana' na smrod zha/ (18)nana' na nig pu can/ (23〉zho brgyazhi dus chen/ (30〉sku drag gi dud rged gsun gyiska ku re rtsed sgo bstan pu/(32)gaphu sngon lha naces/ (46)gager nag gi gdu du/ (65)byi ska dad /blo gu/ (77〉skod pu dad cigs puzhi gnyen don/ (80〉sgrelu nachod krog rdod kha'i gtan rgyud/ (85〉sprud sgo lha spyid/ (92〉1

thod du da dad dkar zhon byud dazhi gtarna rgyud/ (106〉spun gagurna zhag skyalu bsgazha du srod bra/ (1 1 1)nya bra dad gager nya/ (13 1)dan genas can nyu bran sge/ (163)sa khu do gdazhi gtan rgyud/ (168〉khu ta dad ni khrod puzhi myod sked / (170)rgya zha thozhi phyugs nai dad 'o chen rin zhardad / (176)gnyan po gagu myezhi gtan rgyud/ (180)ska gan gagu natshozhi gtan rgyud/ (184〉sgyu na nakhan gyi gtan rgyud/ (186)stag skyeska dad gzhig skyeska/ (192〉nagasra sgom chen tsha lgo/ (203〉datsun rgo natsho lha brnad sgo/ (223〉ge ku bya khyud dad stag zhud gi gtan rgyud/ (232〉lha zhug na zhu gsun/ (243〉2

rngon pu spun gnyeska/ (248)'u rgo spun gnyisra/ (254)khri rgor rgyazha sgo dad gun chud lha sgo/ (257)nyi sko nyag ga dad rgya bza' kod rdo/ (267)zhu rgo gnyig kyi waska skalu/ (282〉tshod ba/ rdod du/ rkun na/ (291)rnana' na dud tho zhatsho (293〉du sgo gshisra zharnad na (297)byizhu chud rdo nee zhaphruwa ldan/ (305)drezhu rta rkad gagun/ (320)lha rta nagrin danar pozhi skye ba/ (3 34)stobasu chen stodasra chud / (36 1)zhade bde zhadazhi zhadan/ (369)3

tnan paṃ ske bzad gi gtan rgyud/dang po tsa na/ yul gsing thang zhes bya ba sa la dge bcu tshang zhing / rta nor lug gsum gyi phyugs zog ni nam mkha'i skar tshogs ji bzhin bgrang gis mi lang ba lo rer 'bras bzang gi lo legs la chad pa med pas/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad na gnas pa'i skye bo kun kyang ngang ba pad mtshor zhugs pa bzhin da ga' smon gyi ngang nas der 'dus te bde skyid rdzogs ldan lha yi longs spyod kyang zol la 'god par byed pas/ snyan grags kyi me tog ni dus rtag tu phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna ba'i 'phyang 'phrul du mi gtong bar 'dzin/ bsngags brjod kyi sbrang char 'thor ba'i yul dam pa de'i rgyal po'i ming la stobs ldan zer zhing / der rig pa can gyi blon po bzhi yod pa'i nang blo gros mchog tu gsal zhing rig pa rno myur ldan pa ni blon po blo bzang yin/blo bzang gis rgyal khab kyi mnga' thang dang 'bangs kyi bde sdug gi don du gnyid bcag zas brjed kyis bya ba mang po 1

sgrub pas rgyal po'i blo 'dri sar gyur par ma zad/ 'bangs mi kun gyi sems su'ang khong gi go sa de blon po gzhan dag las mtho ba dang / snyan pa'i grags pa yang rgyal po dang mnyam du srid pa gsum la khyab bzhin 'dug tshul der blon po gzhan gsum gyis phrag dog gis snying nas ma bzod par/ nyin zhig gi phyi dro kho gsum mnyam du 'dus nas rgyal po la phra ma brgyab ste rig pa can gyi blon po blo bzang gi thob thang de blangs te rgyang 'bud gtong rgyu'i gros thabs legs po byas rjes/ blon po zla ba zer ba de rgyal po'i drung du phyin nas rgyal po la bdag cag gi blon po blo bzang 'di khyed kyis da lta nyid nas med par ma bzos na/ 'di la kun gyi 'gran zla bral zhing thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa dang drag rtsal ldan pas mtha' ma rgyal po'i rgyal srid kyang 'di'i lag tu 'chor ba'i nyen kha yod/ ltos dang / da lta blon po 'di'i grags pa ni yul ljongs dang sa phyogs kun tu mtsho 'phyur 'phyur dang me 'bar 'bar byed bzhin yod/ rgyal po'i stobs 'byor rgyas pa dang kun la bde skyid ldan pa 'di yang 'bangs rnams kyis blon po blo bzang gi drin du bsam gyin 'dug pas/ 6 me lce chung dus bsad na bzang zhes 'ji ga rten gyi 'gro lugs ltar song na mi legs sam/2

bdag gis bshad pa thams cad rgyal po la blo dkar ba las phrag dog dang phra ma'i ngan sems shig bcangs te bshad pa yim na nga'i mgo blangs kyang 'gyod pa med’’ces sha tsha mdog dang snying nye khul gyis lag pa'i sor mo snying gar zum nas de ltar brjod pa na/ yin min gyi mtha' la dpyad stobs phra ba'i rgyal po des mno bsam zhig kyang mi gtong bar bshad tshad rang la glo ba dkar ba dang bden par rlom ste/ 6 khyod kyis brjod pa'i gtam la gya gyu dang 'khyog tshig gtan nas med/ btsun mo dang nged gnyis kyis kyang snga mo nas de ltar dgongs bzhin yod pas/ de ring nas blon po de smyugs thabs gyis shig’’ces bshad rjes blon po zla ba rang gi rig pa la khengs rlom skyes te snying dga' ba'i ngang dal gyis rang yul du bzhud song /nyin de'i dgung mo rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis gzim khang gi mal khri la zhugs te bde bar nyal rjes rgyal pos skad gdangs dma' mo'i ngang btsun mo'i rna ba la gtad de de ring blon po zla ba yang nga'i mdun du yong ste blon po blo bzang 'di ma bsad na/ 'di la rig pa che bas mtha' ma rgyal srid kyang de'i lag tu 'chor nyen yod ces zer ’zhes bshad rjes g.yo 'phrul che ba'i btsun mo la sngar nas 3

blon po blo bzang gsod 'dod kyi kun slong yod pas da ni glags rnyed byung bsams te gdong la 'dzum mdangs shig rgyas te mos shing snying dung ba'i zol gyis rgyal po la blon po zla ba ni rang bzhin bzang zhing lhag bsam ldan pa/ lhag par du rgyal po khyed nyid la glo ba dkar ba zhig yin pas/khos bshad pa'i skad cha'i nang du'ang rdzun gyi dri tsam yang yod mi srid/ dgra ngan de bsad rjes rgyal po'i blo 'dri sa blon po zla ba byas kyang ngas bltas na der blo rig ldan par ma zad/ da dung gzhung rgyud drang la g.yo sems med ’’ces bshad pa'i dmigs yul ni blon po zla ba de rang dang bar thag je nyer gtong ba'i don yin pa kho thag red/ ma gzhi blon po zla ba ni lo na gzhon zhingashes rig ldan pa/lang tsho'i skyes gzugs ni lha rigs gzhon nu zhig sa gzhir babs pa bzhin kun gyis 'gran zla bral zhing / bud med rnams kyis mthong 'phral yid brtan dbang med du 'phrog ste snying myos par byed pa zhig yin pa dang / lhag par du nyin shas kyi sngon rgyal po stobs ldan ri dwags rngon du song ste zla phyed cig 'gor ba'i ring la mos dus rgyun du blon po zla ba bos te nyin dkar me tog ra ba'i nang kho gnyis lus 'dres te nyal ba dang / mtshan mo rang gi gzim khrir bos 4

nas mnyam du 'dod pa'i dga' ston la rol ba sogs byas/ tshul de blon po blo bzang gis shes 'gro bar dogs nas rgyal po la blon po blo bzang gsod dgos tshul dang blon po zla ba la bstod pa de dag byas pa red/ de nas rgyal pos tshig mtshams bcad de 'o na blon po gsod par thabs bzang bo ci zhig mchis’’zhes dris tshe mos yud tsam la bsam blo zhig btang ste glo bur khong dgod cig byed bzhin4'o/ khyed kyis gson dang ngas thabs shig rnyed byung /nangs ka snga mor nged gnyis kyis kho rang bsngags ston gyi mgron la 'bod khul byas te/ sha chang ka ra sil tog sogs g.yos sbyor gyi sder skal rgya cher bshams te kho la yid tshims pa zhig za ru bcug rjes/ nged tshang gi bcu drug lang tsho rdzogs pa'i bu mo gzhon nu ma sgrol mas kho la dga' ba'i gtam sna tshogs bshad bzhin chang gang 'dod du lag la drangs na kho shin tu dga' ba'i ngang zas tshod med par zos te yar langs yang mi thub par 'gyur/ skabs der/ sgo ru mi mang pos skad chen pos 'ur rgyag tu bcug tshe/ sgrol mas skabs de dang bstun nas sgo ru ci zhig byung ngam zhes sgo la rgyug na/ kho yang rang dbang med par sgo'i ltad mo la blta ru 'gro 'dod pas yar langs te 'gro nges yin/5

stabs stabs po'i ngang glo bur du yar langs na g.yag 'chor ba la the tshom med pas/ de'i dus su nged gnyis kyis kho la sdigs mo byas te/ nged gnyis kyis khyed rang 'dir bos te ston mo byas na khyed kyis nged gnyis la yar 'jog mi byed par mdun du g.yag btang ste dma' 'bebs byas pas khrims la sbyor rgyu zhes bshad tshe kho la lan gyis dbul bas/ mgo gcod pa'i khrims bcad na mi bzang ngam’’zhes bshad pa na/ rgyal po de nyid rang gi btsun mo'i blo gros la ngo mtshar nas‘ khyed ni ji 'dra'i btsun mo rig pa can zhig red ang / khyed kyis brjod pa'i gtam thog tu 'jog’’zer/phyi nyin nyi ma'i 'od zer mdun gyi ri rtser 'phros pa dang mnyam du btsun mo mal las langs te bu mo sgrol ma la mdzes sdug mchor sgeg ldan pa'i rgyan cha sna tshogs kyis legs par spras su bcug ste/ khang ba sogs phyi nang kun la byi dor legs po byed du bcug rjes/ sha dang tshod ma ka ra sil tog chang sogs mdun cog steng du mdzes par bshams/ skabs der/ nyi ma yang a sngon gyi dbyings su thag tshad gcig tsam 'phags/ de nas bu mo sgrol ma song nas blon po blo bzang rgyal po'i pho brang du gdan drangs pa 6

na/ rgyal pos kho la khri rang dang ma tho dma' med pa zhig brgyab ste de'i steng du bzhugs su bcug ste 'dzum gyi bzhin ras skad cig tsam yang mi gtong bar zas lag tu drangs pa dang / btsun mos kyang khyed kyis rang re'i rgyal khab 'di la sha tsha tshul dang snying nye tshul gyi kha yag dang ngo dga'i gtam sna tshogs bshad nas zas drangs pa na/ blon pos rgyal po la ngan thabs de 'dra zhig mchis pa blo yul du ma shar bar ha cang yid tshims par zos/ rgyal pos blon po blo bzang 'grangs nas zas za thub kyin med pa'i skabs der/ sras mo sgrol ma la rnam 'gyur byas nas chang dang zas stobs zhes pa'i brda zhig bstan ma thag sgrol ma yang gdong la 'dzum gyis khengs bzhin blon po'i mdun du dengs te chang dang sha sogs lag la drangs nas/ nan tan gyis za dgos tshul gyi 'dod gtam sna tshogs lab pa na blon po yang dga' ba'i ngang nas chang bag med du btung ste cung bzi bar gyur rjes/ sgrol ma'i lang tsho'i mdzes sdug gi ngo ma chod par lag la bstabs pa'i zas thams cad kha nang la zos/ de nas kho'i lto ba 'grangs drags nas rgyab kyi khri la sngag te dbugs 'tshang bzhin pa'i skabs der/ sgo'i phyi rol na ngo mtshar ba'i ltad mo zhig byung ba bzhin mi mang 7

bo'i rkang sgra dang dgod sgra dus gcig tu grags pa na/ sgrol mas a ya mtshan ltad mo chen po 'dug ces sgo la brgyugs song / blon pos ci yin 'di yin ma nges par yar langs nas sgo la 'gro grabs shig byas pa na/ dbang med du g.yag cig shor song / de nas rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis thugs shin tu khros te blon po'i gnya' bar bzung nas nged gnyis kyis khyod la rig pa rno zhing rgyal srid skyong ba'i phyogs la rogs ram che zhes bzang bor brtsis te rgyal po'i pho brang du gdan drangs nas ston mo byas na/ khyod kyis nged gnyis rkang zhabs gyi lham mthil tsam la'ang mi ma thong bar zas kyis ngoms na mdun du g.yag gtong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/ drin chen la drin log byed pa'i mi ngan khyod lta bu da lta nyid du bsad na bzang / rgyal po nga'i drin min na khyod rang blon ོ/ra ci ltar 'dug’ ces blon po gzhan rnams bos nas gsal shing la skyon pa'i khrims thag bcad de gsod rtsis byed pa'i skabs der/ blon po blo bzang gis skad gcom chung ngu'i ngang rgyal po la khyed kyis nga bsad na chog mod/ ngas nyams thag pa'i 'bangs mi thams cad dang lhag par du rgyal po khyed kyi dpal 'byor gyi thad la rogs ram byed rgyu'i 'char gzhi zhig yod pa de yang 8

nyams 'gro7zhes bshad pa na/ rgyal pos dmangs dang nged rgyal srid la sman pa'i 'char gzhi ci zhig yod ’ces dris/ blon pos nga'i lag na dngul gyi sa bon zhig yod/ngas da lo 'debs 'dod mod da 'debs ma thub pa red/ mi’rgyal pos khyed la ngo ma'i dngul gyi sa bon zhig yod na khyod mi gsod/ da lo 'debs par gyis’’zer/ blon pos de ni g.yag shor ma myong ba'i mi zhig gis 'debs dgos/ da lta ngas kyang g.yag shor song bas btab kyang mi skyes/ rgyal po lags/ khyed kyis sang nyin 'bangs rnams gcig kyang ma lus par phyogs gcig tu bsdus dang de'i khrod du g.yag shor ma myong ba'i mi yod na ngas dngul gyi sa bon de la ster/des btab tshe lo gcig gi nang sa cha thams cad dngul gyis bkang bar 'gyur’ zhes bshad pa na rgyal po shin tu ngo mtshar nas de ltar byed/ de ltar byed’ ces blon po blo bzang btang nas rang gi 'dug gnas su skyel du bcugaphyi nyin rgyal pos yul phyogs kun gyi 'bangs rnams gnas gcig tu bsdus te mi re re la dris te g.yag shor ma myong ba'i 'bangs mi zhig btsal mod gcig kyang rnyed ma byung / de nas blon po blo bzang gis a khu rgyal po lags/khyed rang gis g.yag shor myong ngam ma myong / gal te ma 9

myong na dngul gyi sa bon khyod la ster’ zhes pas/ rgyalapos ngas g.yag shor myong ’’zer/ yang blon pos btsun mo dam pa lags/ khyed kyis g.yag shor myong ngam ma myong /gal te ma myong na dngul gyi sa bon khyed la ster ’zhes pas/btsun mos gdong dmar bo'i ngang 6 ngas kyang g.yag gcig shor ba dran’’zer/ de nas blon po blo bzang gis mi mang bo'i gas su tsham tshom med par langs te skad gseng mthon pos bshad rgyur kha sang ngas rgyal po'i mdun du g.yag cig shor ba na tshe srog gi chad pa yod zer/ des na 'dir tshogs 'bangs mi kun la tshe srog gi chad pa gcod rgyu yin nam/ tha na khrims gcod mkhan gyi rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis kyis kyang g.yag shor myong bas/ srog gcod kyi chad pa babs 'dug 'di ni ji 'dra'i 'jig rten gyi lugs dang mi mthun pa'i khrims lugs shig red ang / ’’ de nas rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis la ldon rgyu'i lan ci yang med par gyur nas pho brang tu phyir log go /'bangs mi rnams kyis kyang mgo bo 'phred du g.yug cing shab shub kyi smre ngag cig 'don bzhin rang rang gi khyim tu bzhud/de'i dgung mor ngan sems can gyi blon po gzhan gsum rgyal po'i gzim khang la song nas rgyal po la blon po 10

blo bzang gis rig pa tshad nas de ring 'bangs mi kun gyi mdun sar rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis la ngo tsha nyo ru bcug nas/ rgyal po la brtsi bkur ma byas pas/ srog gi chad pa mi gcod rung / blon po'i go gnas blangs te gnas dbyung byed pa'i bsam 'char bton pa na langs phyogs med pa'i rgyal po de'i gdong la 'dzum mdangs kyis khengs/phyi nyin nyi ma shar ba dang mnyam du rgyal pos blon po blo bzang bos nas spyir khyod la srog gi chad pa 'bab mod/sngon khyed kyis kyang rgyal srid bskyangs pa'i phyogs la rogs ram cung zad byas rkyen/ nged rgyal blon rnams bgros nas dus de ring nas bzung blon po'i go gnas blang sa te rang yul la rgyang 'bud btang ba yin’’zhes bshad pa na blon pos cang mi smra bar phyir song nas rang yul la chas pa'i sta gon byas/dus tshod ni ri gzar gyi rbab chu ji bzhin gnas gcig tu skad cig tsam yang mi sdod par zla ba re re bzhin lo du ma 'gor song / de'i ring la rgyal khab 'di'i chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas sogs phyogs gang gi thad nas kyang mar ngo'i zla ba bzhin 'grib ste 'bangs thams cad la 'tsho ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar nas nyam thag par 11

gyur/ rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis kyis kyang da lta rang re'i rgyal khab 'di 'di 'dra'i dbul zhing nyams rul du gyur pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni sngar gyi blon po blo bzang bda' ba'i nyes dmigs yin pa yid la wa ler 'char yang / da ni thams cad 'phyis song bas rang rang sa na 'gyod pa'i shugs ring glal la brten bzhin gnas pa las thabs med/phrag dog gi dug chu snying na 'khol ba'i blon po gzhan rnams ni kho tsho'i 'dod don yongs su 'grub snyam nas yid tshims shing phan tshun dga' ba'i 'dzum phreng ston bzhin mchis/rgyal po stobs ldan la mtshon na lo re'i dpyid zla ra ba'i nang rang gi khyim mches rgyal khab gyi rgyal po skal bzang dang mnyam du rang gi skyes skar la thon tshe ston mo byas te dga' ston la rol ba'i srol zhig chags pas/ dpyid dpal rab tu rgyas te nor 'dzin bu mo'i lus yongs la sngo ljang rtswa 'jam gyi gos dang me tog sna tshogs kyi rgyan chas mdzes par spras pa'i nyin zhig la/ rgyal po skal bzang dngargyal po stobs ldan gnyis kyis zhim mngar ro brgya ldan pa'i skyes skar gyi ston zas la tshims par spyad rjes/ kho gnyis mnyam du 'grogs te khams bsang gi phyir du dgu thog gi rtse ru phyin nas rang rang gi 'dod gtam sna tshogs smra bzhin 12

dgu thog gi rtse nas mar bltas tshe/ rgyal po stobs ldan tshang gi rta ra'i nang gi rta zhig gi rgyab na me tog cig yod pa mthong / stobs ldan gyis nged tshang gi rta'i rgyab na me tog rang skyes yod tshul dang / rta 'di gzhan las khyad par du 'phags tshul sogs sems la gang dran bshad de rgyal po skal bzang la ya mtshan skye ru 'jug 'dod kyang / rgyal po skal bzang de la yid ma ches par‘ gal te khyod tshang gi rta'i rgyab kyi me tog de rang skyes shig yin na nga'i rgyal srid phyed ka khyed la ster zhes bshad/ de nas rgyal po stobs ldan gyis me tog rang skyes shig min na rta'i rgyab la ji ltar 'gro 'dod nas nged tshang gi rta'i rgyab kyi me tog de rang skyes shig min na/ nga'i rgyal srid phyed ka khyed la ster ba'i khar da dung rgyal po khyod kyis nged gnyis kyi 'bangs thams cad bsdus pa'i mdun sar nga'i kha nang la skyag pa btang na choganya ces zer/ de nas khong gnyis kyis de ltar byed rgyu'i mna' bcad rjes pho brang gi rtse nas mar babs te rta rar song ste lta dus rta'i rgyab kyi me tog de ni rta me tog ldum ra'i nang la song nas 'gre log brgyab ste sgal bar 'byar song ba zhig yin/ de nas rgyal po stobs ldan gyis rgyal shor bas/kho gnyis kyis nyi bcad bsgos te nyin der rgyal srid phyed ka 13

khyer rgyu dang rgyal po stobs ldan gyi kha nang la skyag pa gtong rgyu byas rjes bud song / nyin de'i dgung mor rgyal po stobs ldan 'gyod gdung drag po skyes te blo pham zhing gdong ba dmar ba'i ngang btsun mo la gnas tshul de rigs gsal bor brjod pa na/ btsun mo rig pa can de yang da ni nyi ma'i tsha zer gyis gdung ba'i pad ma ji bzhin mgo bo brang la dud nas 'dug pa las lan gyis dbul song / kho bza' zla gnyis ni de ltar ri mor bris pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhin smra ba med par yud tsam 'gor rjes/ btsun mos rgyal po la skad dma' mo'i ngang nas da ni bya ba thams cad 'phyis song / sngar blo gros can gyi blon po blo bzang de rgyang 'bud du btang med rgyu na kho la rig thabs sna tshogs mchis pas don 'di'i phyogs la blo thabs re yod srid mod/ da mi/ bya ba thams cad 'phyis song ’ zer bzhin rgyal po'i gdong la ce re bltas nas bsdad/ de nas rgyal pos kyang blon po blo bzang la rig pa shin tu rno bas 'di lta bu'i gnas tshul sla mo zhig sgrub thub pa dang / kho rang ma nyes skyon 'gel gyis sa mthar smyugs tshul sogs sems la shar te 'gyod gdung drag po skyes bzhin rang gis rang la khu tshur gyis snun bzhin 'dug de nas khos slar blo bzang gi blo 14

gros dang byas rjes rnams la phyir dran re byas tshe/ da dung dus tshod ring bas blon po blo bzang btsal ba'i khom long yod snyam na sa btsun mo la blon po blo bzang btsal ba'i thabs yod med dris pa na/ btsun mo ni rgyal po las rig pa cung myur bas/ mno bsam cung tsam btang rjes rgyal po la bdag gis go tshor ltar na blon po blo bzang gi go sa blangs te gnas dbyung byas pa nas bzung kho rang yul la ma song bar gnas nges med du 'khyams zer/ 'on kyang de btsal thabs la skyon mi 'dug sang nyin chab 'og gi 'bangs mi khyim tshang re re la lu gu re byin te/ lu gu ster skabs lug re re'i rgya ma'i kha grangs bris te phyir sprod skabs kyang yang lci cung tsam yang shor mi chog par rgya ma sor na gnas dgos pa'i bka' phab tshe/ blon po blo bzang gang na yod pa shes thub’ zer bar/ rgyal po shin tu mtshar nas phyi nyin de ltar du byas so/ /nyin bco lnga tsam 'gor rjes rgyal pos 'bangs mi rnams la lu gu phyir sprod dgos pa'i bka' phab/ re re bzhin rgya ma tshad na la la lci song ba dang la la yang song ba/ya nga la la'i lu gu shi song nas phyir sprod rgyu med pa sna tshogs yod/ blon po blo bzang sbas yod pa'i khyim tshang der blo 15

bzang gi rig pas lu gu dang spyang ke gnyis phan tshun 'phrad mi thub pa'i phyogs gnyis su btags nas bar la rtswa nyung ngu re 'phangs pas lu gu spyang ki la skrag nas shi yang ma thub la shed kyang 'bud ma thub par sor na gnas so/ /de bas khyim tshang des lu gu phyir sprod skabs kyang sngar rgya ljid tshad las ma 'das/ de nas rgyal pos de'i rgyu mtshan dris pa na/khyim bdag gis rang gi yul na blon po blo bzang skung yod tshul sogs ma gsang drang por zhu ba na/ rgyal po sems gting nas dga' spro chen po skyes te khyod song ste blon po kho rang da lta rgyal po'i pho brang du gdan drongs shog’ ces bshad pas khyim bdag de myur du rang yul la brda rgyag tu bzhud do/ /shul nas rgyal pos rang gi chung ma'i blo rig la bstod bsngags byed bzhin phyir rang gi pho brang du log nas cang ma 'gor bar blon po blo bzang yang nang la slebs byung / de nas rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis gnong 'gyod dang ngo tsha'i 'dzum zheg phyir mngon bzhin khams 'dri dang zas rigs sna tshogs mdun la spungs nas rang gi sngar gyi bya ba rnams la 'gyod bshags dang blon po gzhan gsum gyi blo rig rtul bo yin tshul sogs brjod de phan tshun gnyis ka 'grig mthun 'cham po byung ste dga' ba'i ba/tam sna tshogs 16

gling nas kha brda byas /nyin de'i dgung mo blon po blo bzang slar yang rgyal po'i gzim khang du bslebs te nga song nas thabs shig bkol de khyed kyi kha nang la skyag pa mi gtong bar ma zad/rgyal srid phyed ka yang mi shor bar bya ’zhes bshad/ de ltar rgyal po stobs ldan la blon po blo bzang gi drin gyis skyag pa za mi dgos par ma zad rgyal srid kyang shor ma dgos pas/kho la sngar bas kyang brtse 'dang che bar gyur nas blon gyi gtso bor gyur/ dus de nas bzung blon po ngan pa gsum gyis kyang phrag dog gis blon po blo bzang la gnod mi thub pa shes te sems su zhe sdang skyes na'ang kha nas rang sor mi 'jog thabs med byung / rgyal khab kyi stobs 'byor dang mnga' 'bangs kyi 'tsho ba/ srid kyi bya ba sogs kyang nyin re bzhin je bzang dang phun sum je tshogs su song nas bkra shis bde skyid kyi nyin byed 'char ba'i skya rengs shar mgo brtsams so/ /(rin chen sgrol mas bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1990lo'i deb gsum pa las bdams/ )11

zhu glen puska nanazha mā smrod zha/gna' snga mor rgan mo zhig la bu glen pa zhig yod/ bu glen pa nar son pa dang khyim tshang phyug po zhig gi bu mo mna' mar bslangs kyang / kho tshang med po yin pa dang bu'i glen rtags yul mi rnams la grags che bas/ bu mo de ma 'thad par phyug po gzhan zhig tshang la mna' mar song /phyug po tshang gis ston mor gra sgrig byed bzhin yod pa bu glen pas thos rjes rang gi a mar nga la snam bu 'dom lnga byin dang skad cha slob tu 'gro rgyu yin’’zhes snam bu 'dom lnga khyer nas song ste mi mang po tshogs pa'i sngon nas bla ma zhig phebs par 'phrad/ skabs der mi mang po yar ma langs pas/ zhabs phyi ba zhig mi mang po'i mdun la byon nas glen pa rnams/ yar longs shig ’ces bka' bkyon mdzad pa bu glen pas thos/ der snam bu 'dom gang byin nas skad cha de nga la stsol zhes zhus so/ /de nas yang song song bas byis pa skor zhig gis byi'u tshang slog bzhin da sngon cag cag cag byas kyang da lta grags 18

rgyu mid par song zhes pa thos nas snam bu 'dom gang yang de tshor byin nas skad cha de bslabs/ de nas yang chu kha zhig la thon dus rgan po zhig zam pa'i thog tu 'gro bzhin zam zhig gi steng nas mi zhig 'gro kha dka' mo red ces pa thos/ yang snam bu 'dom gang der byin nas skad cha de bslabs/ de nas yang mu mthud du song song bas/ sde ba zhig gi nang du sde dpon gyis nangs kha ya mon dus thog yin zhes brda gtong ba thos nas/ yang snam bu 'dom gang byin nas skad cha de bslabs/ de nas yang sngar bzhin mdun du song song bas rngon pa 'ga' nags nas lag stong ngang phyir log 'ong bzhin/ rang nga bsdad na rang nga log ka zhes lab pa thos pa dang yang snam bu 'dom gang byin nas skad cha de bslabs/ skad cha'i tshig lnga bo la snam bu 'dom lnga byin nas bslabs rjes/ bu glen pa rang yul du log nas/ rang gi a mar cad nga bud med cig gi ston thog la 'gro rgyu yin ’zer nas song / khyim tshang de'i sgo khar thon pa dang mi gzhan tshang mas kho la mthong chung gis yar ma langs/ khos de mthong nas glen pa rnams/yar longs shig’’ces pas/ mi thams cad rang dgar yar langs/ de nas kho khang ba'i nang la song nas da 19

sngo na cag cag cag la cag cag cag byas kyang da kha grags rgyu med par song zhes pas mi rnams ya mtshar/ de nas khos za ma za skabs kho la thur ma rkang gcig las bzhag med par zam zhig gi steng nas mi zhig 'gro kha dka' mo red ces pas mi thams cad ha las song / yang ston thog nas phyir log skabs khos e nangs kha ya mon dus thog yin zhes zer rjes rang yul la log de nas khyim de'i bza' mi dang ston thog tu gnas pa'i mi thams cad kyis bu 'di glen pa phar zhog de la spobs pa dang sems rgya che bar 'dug nangs ka bu mo kho'i drung du ma bskyal na bya ba ci 'byung mi shes zhes gros byas so/ /phyi nyin phyug po de tshang gis bu mo kho tshang la mna' mar bskyal yong / khos mthong ma thag ha ha rang nga bsdad na rang nga log nas yong ka zhes pas/ mang tshogs kyis bu 'di glen pa ma yin par mkhas pa zhig red ces phyogs thams cad la bsgrags so/ /de nas khos bu mo de dang mnyam du lo 'gar 'tsho ba rol rjes/ re zhig la chung ma'i yul nas mdzo mo zhig shi song bas/ chung mas kho'i khyo bor‘ khyod nga'i yul la song nas mi la na tsha ma yong na phyug la god kha byung rgyu los yod/20

na tsha phyed ka nga byin la rogs byed ces bshad dgos/ de nas khyod song la mdun du cog rtse zhig 'jog nges yin/khyod kyis a tsan dan gyi cog rtse bzang bo zhes shod/ yang dgong mor thon na khyod sgor bud la bco lnga'i lha zla dkar bo'i dkar tshul la ltos dang zhes zer dgos/ tshig de dag las 'das pa'i skad cha tshig gcig kyang ma bshad ’ces bshad rjes/ kho chung ma'i yul la song nas de ltar byas pas yul mi rnams kyi bstod bsngags thob/ yang de nas nyin 'ga'i rjes su chung ma'i a ma tshe las 'das song bas/ chung ma dang mnyam du mya ngan la 'gro ba'i lam kha nas bud med kyis khyod khyim la thon na mi'i sdug bsngal 'di 'dra yin pa red’ ces shod zer ba la/ khos ma nyan par ngas shes song ’zer/ de nas kho bza' zla gnyis mi mang pos mya ngan zhu pa'i khrod la thon nas/ khos phyugs la god kha ma byung na mi la shi chad byung na'ang skyon med’’ces zer/ de'i dgong mor byi la zhig mdun du 'dug par bltas nas‘ tsan dan gyi byi la bzang bo 'di ’’zer bas mi tshang ma ha las song yang nang sgo'i phyir thon pa dang tshes nyi shu'i zla ba la bltas nas 6 a bco lnga'i lha zla dkar bo dkar ku ’zhes zer bas mi tshad mas mag pa 'dis glen rtags kho na las mi ston pas /2/

dngos gnas glen pa glen nag cig red zer nas phyogs mtshams kun du grags/ kho'i chung mas kyang glen pa'i bya byed ma bzod par phyir rang gi yul la log song ngo / /(tshe skal gyis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1991lo'i deb gsum pa las bdams/ )

nanazha na nig pu can/de yang khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge /gam 'brog rgyang 'brog rtswa yi dge /'thung chu yur chu chu yi dge /khang shing bud shing shing gi dge /rtsig rdo gter rdo rdo yi dge /’’zhes pa ltar sa la dge bcu rdzogs pa'i grong sde ga ge mo zhig na/pha bu gnyis yod par pha'i ring la ga sa gar rgyu nor zas bcud gyis gtams nas skyid pa'i glu len pa dang / zhim pa'i zas za rgyu ma gtogs bsam rgyu ci yang med par 'das/ yin na'ang / da lta/ pha yi pasam par bu 'di'i ring la 'tsho ba ni ji ltar rol snyam nas/ bu la snga mo nas sbyong brdar zhig thob ched las ka 'os 'tshams re lag tu bzhag par ma zad/ da dung phyi rol tu tshong rgyag tu'ang mngags/nyin zhig la/ pha rgan gyis bu la4khyod kyis rang khyim gyi lug brgya lhag yod pa ded de phyi la song nas tshong rgyob la/ lug ci tsam phyi la ded pa der khal bka/'a/ te phyir thed shog ’ces bshad de tshong rgyag par mngags/ bus 23

phas bshad pa ltar khyim gyi lug brgya lhag yod pa ded de tshong la song / bu nus med des phas bshad pa la bsam blo ci yang ma btang bar lug rnams ded nas song song bas mthar grong sde gzhan pa zhig la thon/ de nas khos lug gi tshong rgyag bsam yang lug btsong na sgor bdun cu'am brgyad bcu re ster mkhan mang mod/ 'on kyang phyir yul du log na pha la sprod rgyu'i dngos po yod kyang lug ni med pas sems khur gyi duḥ khas ngu ngag 'don bzhin mchis/ skabs der/ ngu bzhin pa'i bu de bu mo zhig gis mthong nas/ 'phral du bu de'i logs su 'ongs nas bu la/ 6 khyod rang ci'i don du ngu ba yin/ don ci yod nga dang gros byed chog ’ces bshad pas/ bu des rang gi gdong gi mchi ma 'byid bzhin du bu mor nga'i a phas nga la lug brgya lhag yod pa 'di dag phyir song nas tshong brgyab ste/ lug re'i rgyab tu dngos po re bkal nas shog zer bas/ bdag la de sgrub thabs shig med pas ngu ba yin zhes zer/ bu mo de 'phral du phar 'khor tshur 'khor zhig byas rjes bu der khyod kyis lus rkyab kyi bal thams cad bregs te gzhan la btsongs nas rin gong gis dngos po nyos nas song na mi legs sam ’zhes thabs shig bstsal bar/ bus dga' spro'i ngang de ltar 24

lug bal bregs te btsongs pa dang de'i rin gyis dngos po nyos nas lug rnams ded de pha yul du log pha ni cung zad dga' ste slar yang bu la mdzo brgya lhag yod pa ded nas tshong rgyag par mngags/ bu'ang sngon ltar song nas grong sde der thon/ bu'i bsam par sngon du lug bal bregs nas/ phyir yul la dgal rgyu'i dngos po yod pa red/da lta mdzo la 'breg rgyu'i bal med par ci zhig bya snyam nas ngu ngag 'don bzhin bsdad/ de nas bu mo de yang bskyar thon nas bu der4khyod kyis mdzo de dag la khal yar 'gel mar 'gel byas nas gzhan la gla byas na dngos po phyir dgal rgyu yod pa ma yin nam’’zhes bshad pas/ bu des de ltar bsgrubs te phyir yul du song / pha rgan ni lhag par dga' ste/ bu la khyod la thabs 'di dag sus bstsal ba yin zhes dris par/ bus phran yul sde ga ge mo zhig la song nas sde de'i bu mo chung chung zhig gis kho bor bstsal’’zhes bshad/ pha'i sems la da ni bu nus med nyams chung 'di'i chung mar bu mo 'di blangs na/ bu'i ring la 'tsho ba'ang legs po zhig rol thub rgyu red snyam nas mna' ma —len rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/ ma 'gor bar phas bar ba mngags nas bu mo de rang khyim du mna' mar blangs so / /25

things shig la/ mna' ma zhing nang du song nas spo tho rdung gin yod par/ sgyug po yang zhing khar 'ongs nas mna' mar khyod kyis de ring zhing thog tu spo tho ci tsam brdungs sam’’zhes dris par mna' mas‘ sgyug po lags/'o na/ khyed rang rang khyim nas zhing kha'i dbar du gom pa ci tsam gyis thon ’zhes phyir dris par sgyug po la lan 'debs rgyu med par btang / yang nyin zhig la/ sgyug pos mna' mar khyod kyis ko ba mnyes pa dang / 'o ma dkrugs pa/ rtsam pa'i lag skor bskor ba bcas kyi las ka byed zhor du ngal gso byos shig’ ces zer bar/ mna' mas 'phral du 'o ma bzhos nas rkyal ba'i nang du blug nas rgyab tu khur/ko ba rkang 'og tu mnan/ lag zung gis lag skor bskor ba bcas byas par sgyug po yang ci bshad 'di bshad med par btang /da rung thengs shig la/ sgyug pos mna' ma la ‘khyod kyis thal ba'i thag pa zhig sgril zhig nya zer bar/ mna' mas rtswa yi thag pa zhig bsgril nas me la bsgron te thal bar btang ba de sgyug po khyed kyis do dam byos dang ’nya zhes bshad par/ sgyug po ni ci bya gtol med du gyur/de ltar khyim de'i sgyug po dang mna' ma gnyis lag 26

las ka gang la'ang shin tu mkhas pas/ rem pa gong ma'i blo dang ma mthun par mi mngags nas khyim de'i pha rgan bzung nas khrid song / de nas nyin zhig la/ chung mas bu de rang gi pha rgan la blta bar mngags/ bu pha la blta bar song nas pha la lto ba e rgyags sogs kyi bde sdug dris par/ phas khyod bza' zla zung gis pha rgan la sems khur ma byed cig da lta nga shin tu skyid de snga mor hub ring brgya dang / phyi dror hub thung brgya 'thung rgyu yod pas legs la/da dung bsam rgyu zhig yod pa ni nangs mor rang khyim du ra dkar po zhig yong ba de 'dzin par gyis/ ra rgya rgya zhig yod pa de bsha' bar gyis/ ra nag nag cig yong ba de gtong bar gyis/ gris mi chod na thab ku'i rdar la ngar longs ’zhes bshad pa dang mnyam du bu rang yul du log go/bu des pha'i snga mor hub ring brgya dang / phyi dror hub thung brgya 'thung rgyu yod pas/ bza' zla zung gis nga la sems khur byed mi dgos shing / nga rang lhag par skyid ces zer’ zhes chung mar bshad pa dang mnyam du ra khang nang gi ra nag nag dang / ra rgya rgya sogs phas bshad pa ltar bsha' grabs byas te gris ma chod par thab ku'i rdar la 27

ngar lin skabs/ chung mas khyo bor khyod kyis blo la ma shar ba ci zhig sgrub kyin yod dam/ phas dngos gnas ci gsungs yod pa shod dang zhes dris par/ bu des sngar phas bshad pa ra dkar po de 'dzin par gyis/ ra rgya rgya de bsha' bar gyis/ ra nag nag de gtong bar gyis’’zhes bshad pas/ chung mas hab dgod cig byas te/ ra khyod ni ngo ma blun por 'dug de ni don de 'dra min par phas snga mor hub ring brgya 'thung gin yod zer ba ne snga mor dbyug pa ring bo brgya re pa'i lus steng du 'bebs kyin yod pa dang / phyi dror hub thung brgya 'thung ba yang pha'i lus steng du dbyug thung brgya re rgyag gin yod pa de bstan yod la/da dung ra dkar po ni mi dkar po dang / ra rgya rgya bo ni mi sma ra can/ ra nag nag ni mi gdong nag bcas yin pas nangs ro/ra rang khyim du 'ong rgyu yin pas/ de dag ni da gzod phas bshad pa ltar lag len byas na 'os shing / da dung gris mi chod na thab ku'i rdar la ngar longs zhes pa ni thabs bkod mi shes na chung mar 'dri dgos zhes pa'i don red’ ces bshad nas 'phral du lan len bya bar gros byas so phyi nyin gyi nangs mor phas bshad pa ltar ngo ma mi de 28

dag 'ongs pa red/ bu dang chung ma gnyis kyis pha'i mngags bcol ltar mi de dag gsod rgyu bsad pa dang 'dzin rgyu bzung ba/ gtong rgyu btang ba bcas byas rjes/ma 'gyangs par pha rgan btson las btang nas khyim du sle bas yo nga ngo / /(bsod nams 'bum gyis bsdus pa〈〈ma/tsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1990lo'i deb gsum pa las bdams/ )

zho zhargyazhi dus chen/ri sde zhig na shing bzo zhig yod la/ des lopa'i ca lag rnams de 'dra sra mo min par tshang ma 'thor la khad dang chag la khad tag tag yin/ nyin zhig khos rang gi khyim la cog rtse gru bzhi zhig las/ cog rtse de'ang 'thor la khad dang chag la khad du 'dug pas/ shing bzo'i bus mthong nas a pha lags/ cog rtse 'di ngo mas sra mo zhig ma red’ ces bshad mod/ 'on kyang shing bzo des gdengs tshod chen po yod pa'i sgo nas‘ a pha'i gces lo/'di ni lo brgya'i jus chen zhes pa de yin ’zer/lo gnyis gsum zhig gi rjes su/ bu gnyis ka lo drug gsum bco brgyad la slebs te/ re rer mna' ma btsan po rgya stag 'dra ba re blangs/ yin na'ang / sde bshig gi sna 'dren bud med yin zer ba ltar/ mna' ma gnyis ka rgyun du gleng rgyu rtsod rgyu mang zhing / rang rang khyim tshang rang rang dang / rang rang zangs nga rang rang byed zer bzhin 'thab res 'dzang res kyis mgo rting slog du gnyis kyi a 30

ma drin chen ma la bya thabs bca' thabs gzhan ci yang med par shing bzo 'tshol du song shul du/ thabs dang blo gros ldan pa'i mna' ma gnyis kyis khyim gyi rgyu rdzas ca lag rnams rang rang sa nas 'phrog res kyis bgos tshar zhing / a phas las pa'i cog rtse de'ang kho mo gnyis kyi rtsod gzhir gyur/ mna' ma che ba lag pa myur bas cog rtse'i ngos bzung zhing / chung ba thabs la mkhas pas sug bzhi dam por bzung ste phyogs gnyis kyis rang rang sa nas rtsal shugs 'don bzhin yod/ mna' ma che chung gnyis kyis thengs 'gar nus rtsal 'gran re byas rjes/ mna' ma che bar thob pa ni cog rtse'i ngos te shing leb gru bzhi ma zhig yin la/ chung bor sug bzhi kho na lhag pas 'bud shing tsam yin/ skabs der shing bzo'i sems la skyo sdug gis khengs bzhin gal te bdag gi lo brgya'i jus chen 'di lta bu zhig med na khyim tshang 'di ngo mas ci ltar bgo'am’ zer ro//(sgrol ma don 'grub kyis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1990lo'i deb gsum pa las bdams )31

sku drag gi zhud sged gaskun gyis ku re myed rgo bstan pu/nyin zhig la/ rgyal bo'i btsun mos blon po'i lcam mo dang khrims dpon gyi lcam mo gnyis gdan drangs nas skyed tshal ra ba'i nang du 'cham 'cham byed du dengs/ kho mo gsum po nyin gang bor spro gseng du 'cham nas phyir log pa'i lam bar du/ 'od lam lam 'tsher ba'i mu tig chen po zhig mthong ste mu tig de su la dbang bar rtsod pa brgyab/skabs der khrims dpon gyi lcam mos tshang mas rtsod gleng byed mi dgos/ ngas thabs shes bzang bo zhig rnyed yod/da ni tshang ma rang rang gi yul du phyir log nas rang gi khyo gar ku re byed pa'i rtsed mo re ston dang sus ku re rtsed mo bstan pa don dang ldan na de la mu tig 'di sprod chog’ ces bshad par tshang ma 'thad pa byung /rgyal bo'i btsun mo phyir pho brang du log nas 'khor g.yog zhig la 'di dang de byed dgos zhes phyi nyin gyi bya ba re re bzhin gsal bor bka' bstsal rjes phyi nyin gyi khyad 32

mtshar ba'i rtsed mo la bsgugs nas bsdad/ nam langs pa na btsun mos rgyal bo la skyed tshal du spro gseng byed du 'gro zhes bshad/ rgyal bos kyang de bzhin 'gro rgyu byas/kho gnyis dal mor skyed tshal nang du 'cham 'cham byas nas dus tshod ring bo zhig 'gor song / de nas sdong rgan chen po zhig gi rtsar slebs skabs su btsun mos sdong bo 'di ke rer langs nas gnam la reg pa ltar 'dug rgyal mchog chen po/ 'di'i steng du 'dzeg thub pa'i mi 'jig rten 'di na yod srid dam’ zhes ya mtshar khul gyis dris pas/rgyal bo nga rgyal skyes te khyod kyi bdag po sdong rgan 'di'i steng du 'dzeg thub’ ces bshad nas 'dzeg par brtsams pa na btsun mos min/ nga'i sems mi bde/ khyed ma 'dzeg rgyal mchog 'dzeg mi thub pa ga la srid’ ces bshad par/rgyal bos nga rang 'di'i rtser ma 'dzeg tshe khyod nga la yid ches rgyu ma red/ khyed rang sems bde mo byos’ zhes bshad nas sdong rtser 'dzegs song /skabs der/ btsun mos kha sang bkod pa 'then pa bzhin rtswa gseb tu yib yod pa'i g.yog po tshur yong nas btsun mo dang g.yog po gnyis kyis bsam bzhin du mdza' brtse'i snying gtam dang phan tshun mchu sbyor ba'i tshul kyi 33

nyams ston khul byas pa red/ rgyal bos sdong rgan gyi rtse mo nas tshul de mthong bas khro ba langs nas skad cor chen po rgyag bzhin sems chung gis sdong rtse nas mar shud nas sar babs te btsun mor bkyon 'dri byed rgyur/ 6 khyod shi rgyur mi skrag gam/ nyin dkar nga'i logs nas gzhan dang 'grogs/ da rung 'thams 'khyud kyang byed’’ces bshad ma tshar gong la btsun mos khyed kyis sdong rtse nas gzhan zhig mthong ba yin srid/ sdong rtsar nga gcig pu ma gtogs mi gzhan pa su yang mthong ma byung / da lta khyed nyid sdong rtsa ru bzhugs dang nga sdong mgor 'dzeg nas blta/ phal cher ngas kyang don dag ya mtshan can zhig mthong sridanya’ces bshad nas sdong mgor 'dzegs/rgyal bo the tshom gyi dra ba las phyir ma bud gong btsun mo sdong rtser 'dzegs zin/ de nas mos mar lta skabs ngo ma spo langs te ngo mdog kyang 'gyur nas ‘rgyal bo chen po lags/ khyed dgung lo 'di 'dra'i mthon por son reg bar du khyed gyi sems na nga ma gtogs med kyang / de ring khyed dang su zhig 'thams 'khyud byed kyin yod/ bu mo de rigs gang zhig red/ de min na nga las mo'i skyes 'bras mtshar ba red dam/ rgyal bo lags/ khyed kyis nga gcig 34

pu ma btogs gzhan la mi 'grogs zhes dam bca' bzhag yod pa mi dran nam/ yin na'ang khyed kyis lkog tu 'gab mthun mnyam sdod byed rogs shig btsal 'dug a gnam rgan ma ya’ zhes skad chen pos bshad kyin 'dugargyal bos mgo yar bkyagayonas sdong rtsar nga gcig pu ma gtogs gzhan su yangamed’’ces bshad kyang btsun mos de nyams snang du'ang mi 'jog par sdong mgo nas mar shud yong nas rgyal bor bshad rgyur/ 6‘sdong rgan 'dir bltas na 'dre sdong mi legs pa zhig yin nges red/ 'di nas bsdad na 'dre sdong 'dis gnas tshul tshang ma shes nges pas/ sa 'di dang myur bar kha bral nas song na dga'/khyed kyis nga'i snying grogs ma mthong khul byos dang ngas kyang khyed kyi mdza' mo ma mthong ba ltar byed ’ces par rgyal bos kyang 6 de ltar byed/ 'u gnyis kyis mthong ba tshang ma mig 'phrul zhig yin par 'dug ’ces bshad nas phyir pho brang du phebs song /btsun mos 'di ltar spyang grung 'dzoms pa'i thabs bkol nas rgyal por ku re zhig rtses pa'i dgod bro ba'i don 'di dga' spro'i ngang nas blon po'i lcam mo la bshad pa dang mnyam du da lta khyed kyis ku re rtsed mo slong ba'i res la 3 5

‘babs so zhes bshad/mtshan mor slebs skabs/ blon po'i lcam mos blon po gnyid kyi zhing khams su ltad mor song ba'i dus der bstun te 'khor na yod pa'i g.yog po yod tshad bsdus nas 'di ltar bka' phab ste/ 6 phyi nyin nam langs reg bar du sa 'og gi dong lam zhig brkos te ches thag nye ba'i khyim mtshes de tshang gi ra skor nang du thon par byed dgos shing sus kyang blon pos mi tshor ba byed dgos/ mi’de nas yang lcam mos rang gi blo khel ba'i g.yog po zhig la khyim mtshes de tshang gi bu mo slong rogs zhes blon por zhu ba byed du bcug par blon pos kyang de ltar bsgrub rgyur 'thad pa byung /phyi nyin/ blon po dga' dga' spro spro'i ngang 'khor g.yog gis bskor nas khyim mtshes de tshang la g.yog po'i ched du gnyen slong du song / blon po ni rang gi khyim dang bral ma thag tu/ kho'i lcam mos skabs de dang bstun nas sa 'og gi dong lam brgyud nas khyim mtshes tshang la song nas de tshang gi bu mo der yong don bshad pa dang mo gnyis kyis gon pa brjes nas blon po'i lcam mos khyim mtshes tshang gi bu mo ltar mdzes rgyan spras nas bsdad/ khyim mtshes 'di tshang 36

gi bdag pos mgron po khyim du bsus nas ja sogs bza' btung drangs/ blon pos gnyen slong du yong ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad zhor du rang gi g.yog por bstod ra mang po byas la/ khyim tshang de tshang gi gza' dponagyis kyang rang gi bu mo bzang tshul rgyan tshul sogs mang po bshad nas phan tshun bar gyi don thod mi thug la khad cig byas mod/ rjes nas slar yang 'grigs mthun byung bas blon po'i sems la'ang dga' ba skyes nas bdag po la‘ khyod kyi bu mo khrid shog dang / ngas de'i mdzes gzugs la lta 'dod yod ces bshad par bdag pos kyang rang gi bu mo bos nas mgron por bdud rtsi drongs shig ces bshad pa na/ gon pa brjes pa'i blon po'i lcam mos bdud rtsi lag gi bum pa'i nang du blugs nas nang du phyin te re re bzhin bdud rtsi drangs/ blon pos bltas ma thag sems su bu mo 'di nga'i lcam mo ji bzhin 'dug ste rna'i zho'/ du rme ba zhig yod pa de'ang yod/ nga'i lcam mo yin na'ang thang snyam nas myur du yar langs te khyim bdag de la dgongs pa zhu rgyur nga'i dbang tsha①yul du lus 'dug pas nga myur bar song nas de —(kyedabang tsha/ du ba 'then byed kyi yo byad cig yin/ rgyu chas ni gtsod kyi rwa dang dngul gyis bzos pa yin/da dung zangs ma dang rus pas bzos pa yang yod/37

khyer yong / de min na gzhan pa'i dbang tsha'e nang du du ba 'then par lobs med lags’’zhes bshad nas 'tshab 'tshub ngang rang khyim du song nas bltas tshe/ kho'i lcam mo nang du 'dug la da dung kho la dbu zhwa bzo bzhin yod pas da gzod sems bde bar gyur nas phyir song / kho khyim mtshes tshang la thon pa dang bu mo'i pha la khyed gyis bu mo 'dir khrid shog dang ngas gnyen rtags kyi sor gdub bskon rgyu yin’ zhes bshad/ bu mo de yang phyir tshoms khang du slebs byung / skabs 'dir blon po'i snying yang stig stig tu lding 'dug khos bu mo der bltas kyin bltas kyin rang gi lcam mo dang gnyis su med par 'dug rkyen khos sems la yang dogs pa skyes nas phyir yul la so nga ste/ slar yang rtog dpyod cig byed dgos bsams nas bu mo tshang gi mi rnams la gus par 'os pa'i sku zhabs dang lcam mo rnam pa lags/ ngas gnyen rtags gser gyi sor gdub de yul du lus 'dug pas/ khyed rnam pa thugs mi sun par cung zad sgugs dang nga yul du song nas sor gdub khyer te myur bar log yong zhes bshad nas myur bar rang gi yul la brgyugs song /kho rgyug rgyug nas khyim du thon nas bltas tshe/ rang 38

nyid kyi lcam mos sngar gyi 'dug gnas na dbu zhwa bzo bzhin 'dug lcam mos blon po phyir yong ba mthong ba na blon po la ‘ khyed yang yang khyim du yong nas ci byed/ de ltar byas na khong tshang gi mi rnams dga' srid kyi ma red’’ces bshad par blon pos ngas gnyen rtags rgyag byed kyi sor gdub de yul du lus song bas de len du yong ba yin ’zhes bshad par lcam mos 6‘de 'dra yin mi srid/ 'di'i nang du gsang ba'i bya ba zhig yod kho thag red/ gnyen rtags yul du bzhag nas gnyen slong du 'gro ba'i dpe zhig gang na yod’’ ces bshad par blon pos/ smyo ngas dkon mchog gsum po dpang du btsugs nas khyod la don dngos bshad na de tshang gi bu mo de khyed dang ha cang mtshungs pas/ ngas khyod yin par dogs te phyir yul du khyed yod med la blta bar yong ba yin/ red ya/ 'jig rten byed pos 'di lta bu byas rkyen nga'i mig 'phrul yin 'dug nga 'phyugs 'dug ces ya nga yang bshad/ yang lcam mos khyod nga la yid ches med pa ngas shes yod’’ces yin pa min par bsgrubs nas bshad par blon pos de lta bu min pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po bshad kyang lcam mos tshig mtshams bcad nas‘ 'o na 'di 39

ltar byed/ khyod phyir 'gro ba'i dus su ngas mgo la dar srab dkar bo zhig dkris nas sdong bo 'di'i 'og tu 'dugade ltar byas na khyim mtshes tshang gi sgo 'gram nas kyang nga mthong thub rgyu red’’ces bshad tshe blon po yang der 'thad pa byung / de nas kho gnyis mnyam du sgor bud pa dang lcam mos mgo la dar srab dkar bo zhig dkris te sdong rtsar langs nas bsdad/ blon po sgo chen gyi phyi tshor song nas phyir bltas pa na/ ra skor nang gi dar dkar gsal le ra 'dug blon pos ga la shes/ kho sgo chen khar slebs skabs lcam mos mgor dkris pa'i dar dkar de sdong bo'i yal ga'i mgor bkal rjes/ dong lam brgyud nas khyim mtshes tshang la song ste kho yong bar bsgugs nas bsdad 'dug blon po khyim mtshes kyi sgo chen khar slebs nas/yang phyir bltas tshe/ dar srab dkar bo de da rung sdong bo'i 'og tu yod pa mthong nas da gzod sems bde ba'i ngang nas nang du song nas bu mo der gnyen rtags kyi sor gdub bskon pa dang de gnyis la bkra shis pa'i smon lam sogs btab/ blon po phyir rang gi yul tu slebs skabs lcam mo yul du med pa mthong nas da gzod gnyid las sad pa ltar gyur nas bsam par lcam mo g.yog po de'i tshe grogs su byin 40

tshar song snyam bzhin bsdad/ skabs 'dir lcam mo khyim du slebs pa dang blon por‘ ngas khyod nga la ngo ma mos kyin yod med nyams brtag pa'i phyir ku re rtsed mo 'di byas pa yin ’zhes bshad/ de nas blon po'i lcam mos khrim sa dpon gyi lcam mo la ku re rtsed mo 'di'i mgo nas mjug bar chad lhag med par gsal bor bshad pa na/ khrims dpon gyi lcam mos da ngas ku re rtsed mo ston pa'i res la babs zhes bshad do/ /sa rub la nye ba'i dus der khrims dpon phyi la bya ba sgrub par song nas slebs byung / khos rang gi lcam mor dgung zas la sha tshod las shig ces par lcam mos sha tshod las na dus tshod cung ring bo zhig 'gor bas khyed rang gis nyin gang bor bya ba bsgrubs nas thang chad yod pas/ sngon la cung tsam nyol dang sha tshod bcos nas tshos rjes ngas khyed rang 'bod’’ces bshad par khrims dpon ngo ma thang chad yod pas gon pa phud nas nyal khri'i steng du nyal ba na gnyid du 'khor song / skabs 'dir mos khyo ga'i sngas 'og tu gnyid 'byung ba'i me tog cig yod pa de bzhag nas g.yog po 'ga' bos te hur hur ngang gnyid du yur ba'i khyo ga yar btegs te ra skor nang du bzhag pa dang kha spu yongs 41

rdzogs bzhar du bcugaganyid 'byung du 'jug pa'i me tog gi mthu nus cung nyams pa'i tshe/ khrims dpon gnyid las sad byung / mgo yar dgye nas bltas tshe rang nyid ra ba'i nang du nyal yod pa mthong bas sems la ya mtshar ba'i ngang nga 'dir ji ltar yong ba yin snyam bzhin kha ngor lag pas reg pa na/ kha spu cung tsam zhig kyang mi 'dug e ma mi 'di nga min 'dugangs sgo brdungs nas tshod blta zhig bya/ gal te nga nang la yong tu bcug tshe nga da gzod khrims dpon yin nges/ gal te sgo ma phyes na da skabs kyi nga rang ngo ma min rtags red snyam nas yar langs te sgo brdung bar song /nang nas ‘phyi rol gyi sgo rdung mkhan su yin’’zhes smras pa dang / khrims dpon gyis‘‘nga yin/ khrims dpon yin’’zhes bshad par nang nas khyod su tshang gi khrims dpon yin/ nged tshang gi khrims dpon khang ba'i nang du sngar nas gnyid du yur song ’’zhes bshad pa thos kyang khrims dpon skad cha 'di dag la yid mi ches par da dung sgor rdung tshe nang nas sgo gtad blangs nas khrims dpon khyod ngo ma mi 'gro'am/ mi 'gro na nged tshang gi khrims dpon gnyid las sad na khyod kyis rig nges yin/ de bas snga tsam phyir log 42

dang de las bzang ba mi 'dug’ ces bshad zhor du khrims dpon la bltas nas ‘nged tshang gi khrims dpon la kha spu yod pa sus kyang shes nges red’ ces zur za'i tshig cig bshad nas sgo gtad brgyab pa red/khrims dpon thabs zad pa'i ngang ra skor gyi phyi la 'gro zhor du rang gis rang la da lta nga yid ches song nga rang khrims dpon min 'dug pas ngo ma 'di nas u tshugs kyis 'dug thabs med ces kher bshad byas pa dang sems su gzhan gyis kho la 'phya smod byed par skrag pas rang nyid la ha cang cha rgyus yod pa'i pha yul dang kha bral nas gzhan yul du 'gro rgyu thag bcad/ gom gang re gang re spos nas mthar grong khyer chen po zhig tu slebs/ de nas nyin gcig la zas kham gang reg pa tsam las ma rnyed par rang nyid gcig pur bsdad/ dka' sdug chen po myangs pas nyi ma lo ltar 'khyol dka' bar gyur/de ltar lo gcig 'gor rjes khrims dpon la slar yang kha spu skyes byung / de nas khos lam bro cung tsam zhig yar mar la bslangs nas phyir rang gi yul du log rgyu byas/khrims dpon rang gi khyim sgor slebs pa dang rkang 'jab lag 'jab kyis ra skor nang du song / skabs der kho 43

thang chad pa dang rkang ba'ang na bas cung tsam gnyid rjes khyim du 'gro bsams nas rdo leb cig gi steng du gnyid log song / skabs 'dir g.yog mo zhig ra skor nang du yong ba na khrims dpon de na gnyid 'dug pa mthong nas lcam mor yar zhu byas/ lcam mos myur du khyim gyi las ka bkod sgrig byas rjes khrims dpon gyi mdun du yong nas yang gnyid 'byung nus pa'i me tog de khrims dpon gyi brang khar bzhag ste khyim du khur nas sngar kho gnyid pa'i shul der bzhag ste sha tshod las nas tshos rjes khrims dpon gnyid las sad par sgug bzhin bsdad/ cung tsam 'gor rjes khrims dpon gnyid las sad de yaralta mar lta 'ga' byas nas ci yin 'di yin ma shes par tsang da so ma ra skor nang du yod kyang 'dir ji ltar thon pa yin ’’zhes lcam mo la dris pas/lcam mos ha cang drang bo'i tshul gyis khyed rang mgo thoms pa yin nam/ 'di'i sngon tag tag la phyir log pa ma yin nam/ da dung nga la sha tshod las zhes bshad tshe ngas khyed la cung tsam gnyid log ces bshad pa ma yin nam/ da ni sha tshod tshos 'dug myur bar bzhes shig ’ces zer/khrims dpon ha cang ya mtshar bar gyur nas‘ ya mtshan/ nga lo gcig la yul du ma 'ongs/ grong khyer de 44

'dra mang po zhig la 'khyams nyul dang sa cha de 'dra'i thag ring du song ba yin/ de'i phyir nga ji ltar yul du thon zhes ldab ldib smras par/ lcam mos 'di ltar na khyed kyis rmi lam ring bo zhig rmis pa yin nam ’zhes bshad/ khrims dpon gyis sha tshod za bzhin yid la 'di phal cher rmi lam ring bo zhig yin shos che snyam/khrims dpon gyi lcam mos rang nyid kyis ku re rtsed mo 'di mgo nas mjug bar rgyal bo'i btsun mo dang blon po'i lcam mo gnyis la bshad/ de nas kho mo gsum po sngar mu tig mthong ba'i sa der yong nas rgyal bo'i btsun mos mu tig thang nas yar bsgrugs te khrims dpon gyi lcam mor bshad rgyur nga tshos ku re rtsed mo bstan pa 'di phyir dran zhig byas na tshang mar don snying yod kyang lhag par du khyod kyi ku re rtsed mo ngo ma bzang ste/ khyod kyis khrims dpon thengs gcig la rgyal khams 'grims su bcug nas mi ser gyi bde sdug rtogs par byas pas mu tig 'di khyod la ster 'os ’zhes bshad do//(byams pa tshe ring gis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1987lo'i deb dang po las bdams/ )45

’gasku sngon lha natsho/sngon g.yu sngon lha mtsho zhes bya ba'i mtsho zhig yod cing mtsho mo de ni dus rgyun du sngo ljang nger mngon/ mtsho 'gram gyi khor yug tu nags/ tshal dang me tog rnam par bkra zhing khu byug dang bye'u 'jol mo bcas kyis mgrin snyan lhang lhang du sgrog cing rna ba'i bcud len pa dang / yid dbang 'phrog par gyur/ mtsho mo de'i g.yas g.yon na brag tho dmar bo gnyis yod pa de ni rab tu che ba'i seng gis gcig gis gcig la bltas pa ltar yin/ nam mkha'i dbyings su bsnyegs pa'i brag ri de gnyis kyi dkyil na mtsho mo 'di 'khyil 'dugadwangs shing gsal ba'i mtsho mo de'i 'gram ngogs su de ga'i mi rnams lo re re'i zla drug pa'i nang der tshogs nas glu len gar rtsed byas nas lha klu rnams la mchod pa phul nas rol chas sna tshogs dkrol zhing nyams dga' bar gyur/de nas lo zhig gi dbyar khar/ dbyar gsum gyi me tog bzhad pa dang / dri bsung phyogs kun tu khyab cing sgra ma ༵༵ mgrin snyan sgrog bzhin sbrang rtsi'i bcud la rol ba

rnams ni yul gzhan dor nas phyogs der 'dus pa ltar red/ sa de'i pho mo rgan gzhon rnams kyis sbra gur dang /bza' btung rol chas sogs khyer nas mtsho mo de'i 'gram du yong te lha klu rnams la gsol gtor dang mchod pa 'bul ba dang / glu len gar rtsed byed pa/ rol chas dkrol nas nyams dga' ba'i tshul du gnas 'dugadus der sprang bo rgan gon gnyis 'khyams nas sa der slebs te nyams su dga' ba'i mtsho mo de'i nye 'gram nas spyil bu zhig bzos te 'tsho ba skyel thabs byas/de ltar lo gcig 'gor rjes/ rgan rgon gnyis la bu mo zhig btsas/ 'on kyang bu mo de ni bltas na mi mdzes pa dang / mgo na skra med cing smin ma yang med/ mig 'bur zhing sna leb pa/ ma'i mngal nas skyes ma thag ngo na sre thig mang bo yod pas/ pha ma gnyis la sdug bsngal skyes nas/kho mor ming zhig kyang 'dogs par ma 'dod mod/ yin na'ang / rang gi sha dang khrag las byung ba'i bu phrug cig yin stabs/ a mas bsam par/ 'di ni snga ltas mi legs pa zhig red ces sems kyi gting nas dogs pa zos shing /snying mi rje la sha yang mi tsha ba'i ngang nas gso skyong byas/ sa de ga'i mi rnams kyis kyang bu mo der mdze ro myo/7 zhes 47

'phya dmod byed bzhin 'dugayin na'ang / bu mo de lo na cung tsam rgyas pa'i dus nas sems shin tu zhi zhing dul ba/ byams dang snying rje ldan pa/ pha ma la gus shing bkur ba/ lag las kyi rtsal la mkhas shing chung lo bcu'i thog nas ma la rogs ram byas nas/ khyim gyi bya ba thams cad sgrub pa dang blo rig gsal zhing thabs dang shes rab ldan pa zhig yin/ de nas bu mo lo bcu drug la son pa'i dus de'i nyin zhig la/ kho mos pha ma gnyis la phyag 'tshal te/ 6‘bka' drin bla na med pa'i pha ma lags/ de ring bu mo nga la zhu rgyu'i don zhig yod pas/ pha ma gnyis kyis nga'i don chung 'di bsgrub par mdzod’ ces zhu ba zhus/ ma'i sems la nga'i bu mo 'di/ chung snyom lag rgyas nas da bar du/ pha ma la brtsi bkur dang gus pa mi lhod pa/ gzhan gyi bu mo mdzes ma las kho mo lhag par lag las kur mkhas shing mi dge ba'i bya ba ci yang mi byed/ pha mas ci gsung na de bzhin sgrub pa'i bu mo go chod cig yin ste/ pha ma'i drin lan gzo ba ci thub gang thub byed pa las/ dgos mkho 'di zer ba'i skad cha tshig gcig kyang go ma myong mod/ 'on kyang de ring kho mos zhu ba ci zhig yin zhes snyam nas zhal la 'dzum 46

zhig langs nas bu mo la/ 46a ma'i snying lo gcig pu/de ring khyod kyis zhu rgyu ci zhig yod pa shod dang / a ma khyod kyi pha la zhu ru 'gro’’zhes bshad pa na/ bu mo'i yid shin tu spro bar gyur nas a ma la ‘ a ma lo lo drin chen ma/ nga yis zhu don de ni 'os min bya ba zhig yin mod/ 'on te mi zhu thabs med yin pas/ a ma thugs rgyal ma bzhengs/ bu mo nga' gdong mi mdzes mod/de ring nga la me long zhig dgos nges yin/ de min skra med bu mo nga la da rung skra shad cig kyang dgosanya’zhes zhus pas/a ma ha las te rgyug song nas khyo bo la bu mo'i zhus don de ji ma ji bzhin du bshad/ pha rgan khong khro langs nas ngo gnag bzhin du/ 6‘bu mo 'di de ring spyos pa min nam/mo'i mgo na skra med la bzhin ras kyang mi legs pas/ skra shad dang me long gis ci bya’’zhes sdigs pa la/ rgan mos ‘ khyo bo lags/ de skad ma zer/ bu mo 'di la snying re rje/ skye ba nas 'jig rten khams 'dir yong ste dgos pa dang mkho ba'i zhu ba tshig gcig kyang thos ma myong bas/ de ring kho mo'i re ba tshim par gyis shig ’ces zhus par/ pha rgan kyis kyang ci yang mi smra bar grong sde ru phyin no/de nas phye dror pha rgan kyis me long dang skra shad dag 49

btsal nas phyir log ste bu mo la sprod bzhin‘‘khyod la 'di dag gis ci zhig bya/ bdag la dka' las bskol ba las dge ba ci yod’’ces sdigs sdigs byed bzhin khang ba'i nang la song nas nyal 'dug go/mtshan mo pha ma gnyis nyal ba'i rjes su/ bu mo de rang gi nyal khang nas dal mor yar langs nas sgron me bsgron te bzhin ras dang lus yongs su khrus byed pa dang lhan du rdzu 'phrul bstan nas klu'i bu mo zhig tu gyur te me long nang la lta bzhin par skra gnag snum shad cing rgyan cha sna tshogs kyis rang nyid brgyan/de yang pha ma gnyis nyal nas cang ma 'gor la bu mo'i nyal khang nang na sgron me gsal bor yod pa mthong nas de ring bu mo 'di'i rnam 'gyur shin tu ya mtshar ba yin pas/ nam gung zhig la sgron me bkar nas ci zhig byed kyin yod dam snyam nas kho gnyis ka 'jab nas bu mo'i nyal khang gi sge'u khung nas bltas tshe/ a ya mtshar/ rgan rgon gnyis ka ha las par gyur/ kho gnyis kyi mig lam du shar 'dug pa ni bu mo de 'dra mdzes ma zhig yin te/ mkhur tshos mdangs ni rab tu dmar/ rgyan cha sna tshogs kyis rnam par brgyan pa dang gyon gos bzang bo 50

gyon zhing shin tu mardzis par 'ardu rgade mthong nas rgan rgon gnyis 'jigs skrag skyes nas 'di lha mo yin nam 'dre mo yin/ srin po'i bu mo yin nam mi'i bu mo yin snyam nas 'dar ma 'dar gyis sgo phyes nas nang la song tshe/ bu mos rang gi rdzu 'phrul mthong song ba shes nas myur du pha ma gnyis kur phyag 'tshal te ‘‘bka' drin dpag tu med pa'i pha ma lags/ de ring bu mo ngas gsang bya mngon sum du bstan pa ni/ nga 'dre mo min la bdud mo'ang min/ lha'i bu mo min la dri za'i bu mo'ang min te/ dri med g.yu sngon lha mtsho nang gi klu'i rgyal bo'i tha chung bu mo yin/ khyed pha ma gnyis ka skrag mi dgos shing thugs bde bar mdzod/ lo ngo bco brgyad kyi ring la mi mdzes pa'i mdze pags gyon nas 'tsho ba skyel ba dang pha ma gnyis la'ang lan chags bgrang las 'das pa myong du bcug pha ma gnyis kyi bka' drin bsam kyis mi khyab mod/ 'on kyang nga yis khyed pha ma gnyis la drin gzo ba'i bsam pa de ni/ de ring nas bzung stong bar gyur/ mdang dgung ma tshan gyi rmi lam la/ klu'i rgyal bo pho brang chen mo nas/ btsan pho nya 'ga' zhig mngags nas slebs/ de ma thag tu bka' btsan po gnang ba ni 51

'di ltar/ / khyod de ring nangs khar phyir phebs shog ces pa de yin/ de bas nga rang 'di ru mi sdod phyir log dgos pa byung / pha ma'i thugs sems ma sdug bde bar bzhugs7zhes zhu ba zhus/ rgan rgon gnyis ngag sgo 'dar ma 'dar gyis/ ‘ khyod klu'i bu mo yin na nged bdag med rgan rgon gnyis kyi mdun du yong nas ci bya ’zhes dris pa la/ mdzes ma des/ smyo‘nu zhos rgyun du gsos ba'i bka' drin bla na med pa'i a ma lags/ nga klu'i bu mo yin yang khyed gnyis kyi drung du yong don ni/ lo bcu bdun sngon gyi dbyar khar/ mi rnams g.yu sngon lha mtsho'i 'gram du slebs nas bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol ba'i dus der/ rigs rgyud dang 'byor ba med pa'i khyed rgan rgon gnyis kyang de ru phebs/ ngas mtsho nang nas khyed gnyis kyi nyam thag pa dang ya nga ba'i tshul de mthong tshe/ sems kyis ma bzod par yab chen klu'i rgyal bo la zhu ba yang yang zhus pas/yab rgyal bos kyang khyed gnyis kyi sdug bsngal gzigs nas thugs dmigs te nga mi lus su sprul bar gnang ba mdzad de a ma khyed kyi lhums su zhugs pa yin/ 'on kyang mgo nag mi ni 'dod chags kyi bya ba'i steng la rang srog la'ang mi 'dzem par ma rabs kyi bya spyod la dga' zhing sred/ de'i 52

phyir bu mo mdzes ma zhig yin na/ 'jig rten du bde bar 'dug dka' zhing rang nyid dang khyim mi la'ang lan chags dpag med yong ba snyam pa'i phyir/ skye ma thag tu mi mdzes pa'i sha pags kyis g.yog pa yin/ de bas khyed rgan gon gnyis la phan thog pa'i bya ba cung tsam sgrub thub pa dang bu mo nga'ang gnas thub pa red’ ces zer ba la rgan rgon gnyis sems bde bar gyur pa dang / lhag par du rang khyim gyi bu mo 'di klu'i bu mo yin pa'i lo rgyus de dag thos te rgan rgon gnyis kyis sngon bu mo skyong tshul dang gso tshul yid la shar nas ngo tsha zhing mgo bo sgur ba las ci yang mi smra mod/ 'on kyang bu mo de ring nangs kha phyir log rgyu yin pas/ kho gnyis kyi sems la skyo ba chen po skyes nas na re/‘ e ma klu yi bu mo rab mdzes ma/ khyed kyi lo rgyus gsal bor yid la babs/ nged cag gnyis kyi sdug bsngal khyed kyis bsal/ bu mo khyod la bka' drin yang yang zhu/ sdug dang lan chags myong mkhan nged gnyis la/ khyod klu'i rgyal bo'i bu mo byang sems can gyis bdag gnyer 'di 'dra byas/khyed kyi lo rgyus gsal bor ma rtogs pa'i gong la/ nged rgan rgon gnyis kyis bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol ma shes/ dus da lta khyod rang phyir phebs na dus phyi ma nged gnyis kyis ji ltar 53

bya/ ’’ bu mo'i sems kyang ha cang sdug nas ngu ngag gis/rjo kye ma kyi hud sdug sems kyis mnar ba'i pha ma lags/dus da lta'i bar du dka' spyad kyis skyong ba'i drin de nga yis nam yang brjed mi srid/ da lta drin lan 'jal ba'i go skabs med na'ang / dus mi 'gyang bar myur du 'jal bar smon’’zhes gsol ba btab nas a ma'i mgrin la 'khyud nas rgan rgon gnyis la sems gso byed pa dang phyin chad rgan rgon gnyis la dka' khag yod tshe phyir phebs nas bdag gnyer byed pa'i dam bca' sogs byas pas/ pha ma gnyis kyi sems kyang cung zad bde bar gyur nas rang gnas su log nas nyal/ nyin zhig gi nam gung la bu mo dal gyis yar langs nas 'jab nas sgo'i phyi tshor bud nas phyir 'khor te pha ma'i gzim khang la phyaku 'ga' 'tshal nas spyan chab 'don bzhin du g.yu sngon lha mtsho'i phyogs su chas/de yang kho mo mtsho nang du phebs kha mor/ mo'i sems la nga kha rog tu bros song ba dang pha ma la brda zhig kyang ma brgyab pas/ kho gnyis kyi sems 'khrugs nges yin snyam zhing kho rgan rgo na gnyis ka snying re rje/ da nges par du kho gnyis la drin gzo ba'i dngos po zhig 'jog dgos 54

snyam nas rang gi lham cha gcig dang rin thang gzhal du med pa'i mgul rgyan mu tig phreng mdzes dang bcas pa blangs nas mtsho 'gram gyi rdo leb chen po zhig gi steng du bzhag nas kho mo mtsho nang gi klu rgyal yab chen gyi drung du song ngo //de nas rgan rgon gnyis phyi nyin yar langs nas yun ring 'gor na'ang / bu mo da rung mig lam du mthong rgyu med pas/ kho gnyis kyi sems la ma legs so/ /bu mo glu yul du log pa red snyam nas 'tshab 'tshub kyis bu mo'i nyal khang nang la song nas bltas tshe/ ca lag yo byad thams cad gtsang mar phyis nas legs por bsgrigs yod kyang /bu mo rang nyid gar song 'dir song med cing mig lam du mthong rgyu med pas/ rgan rgon gnyis kyis skyo sems chen pos ngu 'bod byas kyang tshig lan ga la yo da/ de nas rgad po brel 'tshub kyis mtsho 'gram la btsal du song yang bu mo mthong rgyu med/ rgad po'i sems lhag par du skyo bzhin spyos pa ltar mtsho 'gram du phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas tshe/ mthar bu mos bzhag pa'i dngos po dag mthong nas sngar las kyang ngu skad lhang lhang du 'don bzhin smre sngags bton/ zu kye ma kyi hud lha bla ma dkon mchog gsum pos mkhyen/ /mtsho g.yu sngon lha mtsho gnas bdag klu rgyal lags/ /khyed thugs 55

sems ma g.yeng thugs/ rjes nga la gzigs/ /nga rgan rgon bdag med gnyis la snying rje sgoms/ /nga'i khog gi snying dang 'dra ba'i bu mo de/ /khyed klu yi rgyal bo'i bu mo yin na yang / /dus da lta gnas mchog gang du bzhugs pa yin/ /nga mgo dkar rgan po gang la btsal du 'gro/ /a shu re rgan rgon las ngan gnyis/ /bde skyid kyi nyi ma da nas nub/re bzhag kyi sems thag da nas chad// ces ngu 'bod byas nas mgo bo mtsho 'gram gyi rdo leb thog tu yang dang yang du brgyab/ dus der mtsho ngos su rba rlabs 'khrugs shing drag shugs chen po'i sgra ni gnam gyi 'brug sgra grag pa dang mtshungs par ma zad/ mtsho mo de'i dkyil nas mtsho de dum bu gnyes su gyur nas chu lam chen mo zhig phye/ de nas klu'i rgyal bos mngags pa'i pho nya gnyis kyis 'di skad do/ 6‘tshur la nyon dang klu mo'i nges min mi lus ster ba'i rgan po lags/ klu'i rgyal bo chen pos khyed kyi sdug bsngal dang skyo ba'i tshul de mthong nas khyed rang klu'i pho brang la gdan 'dren byed pa'i bka' phab/ da lta myur du nged gnyis kye rjes su ded nas phebs rogs gnang ’ zhes klu'i rgyal bo'i bka' rgan po la smras/ der rgan po skabs shig tsam la ha las pa dang skrag 56

snang chin po skyes na'ang / gnyid las sad pa ltar pho nya de gnyis kyi rjes su 'brangs nas mtsho nang la song ma thagargyab phyogs kyi mtsho mo der rba rlabs mi g.yo zhing sngon gyi tshul ltar du snang ngo / /de nas rgan po de nywa sutha/ 'dar ma 'dar gyis pho nya'i rjes ded nas cung tsam song ba na mig mdun du mtshar du bkra zhing mu tig dang byu ru sogs rin thang gzhal du med pa'i rin po che yis grub pa'i pho brang chen po de ni rab tu mdzes shing lta na sdug cing yid 'phrog par gyur pa brjod mi nus shing / bsam kyis mi khyab pa'i pho brang 'di 'dra lha'i zhing khams na'ang med pa red/ gzi brjid dang rngams shugs ldan pa'i pho brang 'di mi'i yul nas thon pa'i rgan pos mthong tshe ngo mtshar zhing gom pa'ang spo mi shes par gyur pas/ pus mo sa la btsugs te phyag 'tshal nas rgyal bo'i mdun du slebs so/ /—de ltar pho nya dang rgan po klu'i rgyal bo'i drung du phyin pa na/ klu'i rgyal bo'i g.yas g.yon du klu yul gyi bdag gnyer chen po rnams rim pa ltar gral gyi mgo nas mjug bar du tshar du dngar zhing lta mi phod pa'i tshul ni rnam par bkra la/ lhag par du klu'i rgyal bo de'ang srid pa'i steng gi 57

ri rgyal lhun po ltar khri mthon po'i steng du mar phibs nyi rgan po'i lag par phyag 'ju byas nas zhal gyi 'dzum ni me tog pad ma bzhad pa ltar dga' spro'i ngang nas zhal gsung gnang ngo / 6 e ma sdug bsngal gyur pa'i rgan po bdag gi grogs/ /khyed rang 'di ru phebs pa shin tu legs/ /sems nas dga' bas pho brang nang du bsu/ /thugs sems ma g.yeng khri yi steng du bzhugs/ / ’ zhes gsung ma thag klu'i bu mo rab tu mdzes pa zhig rgan po'i mdun du yong nas phyag 'tshal ba na rgan pos rang gi bu mo yin par mthong ste yid la dga' spro skyes nas bu mo'i lag par 'jus te mgo dkar tsha ru 'dra bo de ldem ldem du byed pa las tshig gcig kyang bshad ma nus so/ /de nas klu mos pha rgan rgyal bo'i khri'i mdun du bsus nas yab rgyal bo la gleng mo byed pa dang pha rgan gyis kyang klu'i rgyal bo la bka' drin yang yang zhus/ kho'i bu mo byang sems can de la'ang bstod pa dpag tu med pa byas/ klu'i rgyal bos kyang bka' phab nas pho brang chen mo nas pha rgan la dga' bsu byed pa'i dga' ston bsam yul las 'das pa zhig byas/ 'on kyang de'i dus su pha rgan gyi sems la nga ci 'dra las can zhig red/ rang gi bu mo mthong thub par 58

ma zad/ klu'i rgyal po la'arnga mjal ba dang mdzis sdug ldan pa'i klu'i pho brang 'di 'dra mig gis mthong / zas sna mang bo longs su spyad/ nga rgan po bsod nams che mod/ 'on te mi yul du lus pa'i rgan mo snying re rje/ mos 'di lta bu'i skyid dang 'di 'dra'i 'tsho ba mthong mi thub par ma zad/ da lta yang bu mo dang khyo bo med pas/ sems sdug ci 'dra byung ngam/ skyo ba ci 'dra chen po skye bzhin yod dam/ de bas nga myur du phyir log na 'os snyam nas klu'i rgyal bo dang bu mo la‘ klu'i rgyal bo chen po lags/ khyed kyi bka' drin bsam kyis mi khyab pa yin/ khyed kyi byang sems rab tu ldan pa'i bu mo mdzes ma'i drin yang nged rgan rgon gnyis kyi sems na yod/ shi dmyal ba'i yul la lhung na yang / /dpon chos rgyal mdun nas khyed la bsngags/ /dbugs rta rnga 'dra bo chad na yang / /yul dag pa'i zhing la 'gro thub na/ /lha chen po'i drung nas khyed la bstod/ /klu'i rgyal bo'i pho brang chen mo 'di/ /gzhal med pa'i rin thang bral nas grub/ /skyid 'tsho ba'i skyid tshod su yis shes/ /nor longs spyod dpag med lhun gyis grub/ /nga rgan po bso/da nams che bas red/ /khyed rgyal bos nga la mthong chen byas/ /ro bcud ldan zas rigs longs su 59

spyod/ /'di'i bka' drin nam yang brjod mi lang / /nga klu yul 'di nas 'dug 'dod kyang / /tshe gcig gi gtan grogs rgan mo de/ /sa 'jig rten khams nas skyur mi phod/ /dus da lta phyir la log na snyam/ /khyed rgyal bo'i sku khams bde bar smon/ /khyod bu mo bde zhing skyid por shog /mi ces gsol ba dang bcas rgyal bo la phyag byas nas phyir log bsam tshe/ klu'i rgyal bos grogs mchog khyed kyis sdug bsngal ma byed cig skyo ba'i sems kyang bde bar ca/dzod/bdag gis khyed rang pho brang 'di ru nyin 'gar 'dug tu 'jug bsams rung / khyed kyis tshe gcig gi gtan grogs la sems khur byed na/ ngas kyang khyed rang nan gyis 'dir sdod du bcug na mi rigs mod/ 'on kyang ngas bu mo phyir klu yul du yong du bcug pas khyed rgan rgon gnyis kyi 'tsho ba la gnod pa cung zad thebs 'dug pas/ da lta khyed rang klu'i pho brang nang du phebs nas klu'i bang mdzod thams cad nas rang la gang mkho ba dang ci 'dod pa tshang ma blangs nas khyer chog ces gsungs pa la rgan pos kyang rgyal bo la phyag 'ga' 'tshal nas bka' drin yang yang zhus nas klu'i bang mdzod chen po'i nang du song tshe/ klu'i bu mo tha chung ma de 'jig rten mi yul gyi pha'i rjes su bsnyegs nas pha 60

rgan la e ma bka' drin dpag tu med pa'i drin gyis bskyangs pa'i pha rgan lags/ de ring klu'i pho brang chen mo 'di ru phebs pa shin tu legs/ khyed nyid nyin 'gar 'di ru bzhugs bsam mod/ ma rgan mi yul khams nas sems 'khrugs pas/ bzhugs par 'dod kyang bde bar bzhugs mi nus/ de bas da lta phyir la log na bzang / nga yis pha ma'i drin lan 'jal ma thub/drin chen pha rgan khyed kyis rgyal bo'i bka' bzhin khyed gnyis la gang mkho ba'i rin chen nor bu khyer chog mod/'on te nga yis bshad pa sems la zungs/ klu'i rgyal bo'i bang mdzod rab tu che/ /de na rin chen nor bu bgrang las 'das/ /gcig las gcig lhag thams cad khyad du 'phags/ /'on kyang khyed rang de la mi zhen par/ /mdzod kyi thang du bye phung 'ga' spungs yod/ /khyed kyis bye ma'i phung bo de'i nang nas/ /bye ma khug ma gang tsam khyer na legs/ /mdzod 'di rin chen gzhal med yin na yang //'jis rten mi yi yul du rdul dang 'dra/ /bye ma 'di ni rin thang gzhal du med/ /mi'i yul la thon tshe gzhal med rin chen yin/ /de bas khyed kyis thugs la de ltar zungs//mi’zhes bshad nas pha'i lag par 'jus nas mchi ma 6 /

'don bzhin du pha dang bral nas phyir la log go /de nas pha rgan de ni ham pa can gyi rgan po zhig yin pas/ klu'i rgyal bo'i pho brang chen mo nas gzhal du med pa'i rin po che de dag mthong nas ham sems skyes te/bang mdzod nang nas khug ma ches che ba gnyis blangs nas gcig gi nang du bu mos bshad pa ltar du bye ma gang bsdus/gcig gi nang la mig lam du mtshar zhing bkra la skyur mi phod pa'i gzhal du med pa'i nor bu rin chen gang bsdus nas phrag pa gnyis la theg mi theg bzhin du khur nas mtsho khar thon/de yang rgan po des bu mo'i bshad pa de yid la dran nas myur du khug ma gnyis kyi kha phyes nas bltas tshe/ nor bu dang bye ma ni ji ma ji bzhin du sngar bzhin 'dug pas/ rgan po khros pas bu mo la sdigs dmod byed pa 'di lta ste/ 6 e ma kha 'jam khog nag bu mo des/ /drang gtam min pa'i khog sdig nga la skor/ /dang bor nga yis skyong tshul mi bzang stabs/ /de yi lan ni nga la da lta 'jal/ /g.yo sgyu'i thabs kyis nga la rdzun gtam bshad/ /gnag sems ldan pa da lta nga yis rtogs/ /sems ngan can gyi ltas ngan mdze ro ma ’zhes kha nas gang shor 'di shor med pa'i sdigs dmod byed 6ཿ

bzhin du bye rma khug ma gang bo de mtsho nang du phyir dor ba dang mnyam du mchil zhags shig btab nas phyir log go /de ya nga rgad po rang khyim la phyir thon dus sde ba'i mi mang tsam zhig rang gi sgo khar 'dus nas skad cha gtam gleng sna tshogs bshad de skya ku'i tshang nang la rdo yis brgyab pa ltar 'dug pas/ rgad po ya mtshar nas rgyug yong ste bltas tshe/ bud med 'ga' zhig gis sa la 'gyel 'dug pa'i rgan mo'i brang khar bsil chu gtor nas dran pa gso bar byed bzhin yod pa mthong / rgad po myur du de'i gam du phyin nas rgan mo bos tshe/ rgan mo de'i dran pa phyir 'khor nas mig cung tsam phye nas rang gi khyo bo mthong bas dga' ba dang sdug pa lhan du skyes nas mchi ma 'gog med du bzhur nas 'o dod 'bod bzhin 'dug de la rgad pos khyod ma ngu nga la nyon dang / da lta dga' dgos pa'i bya ba bsam kyis mi khyab la sdug bsngal byed dgos pa'i bya ba spu tsam yang med/ 'u cag rgan rgon gnyis ni bsod nams che’ zhes bshad nas lo rgyus snga mo thams cad ma lus par bshad pas/ mo yang dga' ba dpag tu med pa skyes nas khyo bo la/ 6 khyod kyi rin po che gang ma/ yod/ 'phral du khyer shog ngas gsal bo zhig lta ’zhes bshad tshe/ rgad pos de ma thag rgan mo bskyor 63

nas gzim khang la song nas khug ma'i kha phye nas bltas tshe/kye ma ho/ sngon gyi rin po che rin thang dpag tu med pa thams cad da lta sa rdul dang bye mar gyur 'dug de nas rgad pos myur du khug ma gzhan pa de blangs nas bltas tshe/de'i zhabs na bye rdul 'phro ma tsam zhig yod pa ni 'od 'phro ba dang mtshar du bkra ba'i nor bu dang mu tig 'ga' zhig tu gyur 'dug mod/ 'on kyang sngon bu mo'i gtam bshad la ma nyan pas/ 'gyod pa chen po da lta skyes dgos byung /ham sems can gyi rgad po des/ /tshad med skyo sdug 'khur ba las/ /nor bu phyir len thabs bzang ni/ /gang nas 'tshol ba khyed kyis soms//('jigs byed skyabasi kyis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1985lo'i deb bzhi ba las bdams/ )464

gager nag gi gdu 'u/gna' dang por khyo shug zung yod la/ kho gnyis kyi dgung lo rim bzhin cher son na yang / da dung bu zhig ma skyes stabs khyo shug de gnyis kyis rgas tshe skyong snyor byed mkhan med na ci bya ’snyam nas nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu sems khral byed bzhin 'dugabasam yul las 'das pa la/ dus yun ring mo zhig phyin tsa na/ chung mar mngal sbrum ste zla dgu zhag bcu 'gor nas phru gu btsa' la nye skabs/ khyo ga la glo bur du na tsha ljid mo zhig phog ste 'chi bdag gi bdud kyis myur mor 'jig rten phyi mar skyel grabs byas pas/ khos chung ma la kha chems bzhag don/ 6 mngal gyi phru gu gal te bu mo yin na/ nar son rjes khyim tshang phyug po zhig gi mna' mar 'gro e thub ltos/ gal te bu zhig btsas na ya rabs zhe drang zhig e 'khyongs la slob gso thongs/ de min nged khyo shug gnyis la rgyu nom pa med/ tshe gang bor bsags nga/'i dngul sgor bzhi bo de kho la 'phrod thabs gyis/ ’’ zhes 65

gdams te 'das so/ /cang ma 'gor bar bu zhig btsas/ khyo mo des kha bza' btung dang rgyab gon chas kyi don du nyin rgyun phyug po'i khyim la gla byed du song / de ltar nyin thog zla brtsegs nas lo 'khor mang po 'das pa na/ kho mo'i skra 'dabs dkar bor gyur cing bu yang rim bzhin nar son nas dar mar gyur/ nyin zhig kho mos bu la re/ 6 'u ma bu gnyis kyi 'tsho ba'i ched du a mas dus da lta'i bar du phyug po tshang la las bong las dang zas phag lto ltar dka' sdug gang mang myangs nas gla byas/ da lta khyod rang nar son te rang mgo 'khyongs pa'i tshod la bslebs/ da nas bzung drin can pha dge ldan gyi ring nas nyar tshags byas yod pa'i dngul sgor bzhi bo de bzung ste sgo phyir rang kha rang ba/so byed par skyod cig’’ces bshad/ bu des a ma'i skad cha nyan rjes yid skyo nas ngus te/ 6 a ma lags/ khyod kyis phran chung nga rang nar son reg bar du skyong snyor byas pas/ nga rang ji ltar khyod dang 'bral lam/ khyod da lta na tshod bgres shing lta skyong byed mkhan yang med stabs phran gyis ma rgan khyod bskyur te yul gzhan du skyod mi phod ’ces lan btab/66

bu 'di ni a ma'i lus las chad pa'i sha yin tsa na/gces phrug gis zhu ba yang yang zhus par brten/ a mas kyang bu gcig pu sgor gtong ma phod par gam nas 'dug tu bcugaphyi nyin a mas bu nye logs su bos te na re/ ‘‘'u tshang ge sgye mo stong bar gyur 'dug khyod song nas 'bru rigs nyo sa zhig yod med la ltos dang ’ zhes sgor gcig bu'i lag tu gtad/bus skyo ba zhig bzung nas khrom rar song lam khar shan pa zhig gis byi la zhig 'dzin bzung byas te mgo rnga med par lhug phran gyis 'brab kyin 'dug pa mthong nas gam du bcar te khyod kyis ci'i phyir byi lar gcar ba yin’ zhes dris/shan pas 'dis kho bo'i tshong sha lkog za byas pas da lta gsod nges yin ’zer/bu na re/ khyod kyis ma gcar bar nga la tshongs shig zer bar/ shan pas des na rin pa sgor gcig byin/ ’ zer/bu des sgor gcig pu der byin te phyir khyim du loga.a mas khyod kyis nyos yod pa'i 'bru rigs gang na yod’’67

ces drica/ tshe/ bu yis byi la nyos pa'i brgyud rim lhug por zhus pa na a mas zhe sdang gis khyod 'bru rigs nyo bar mngags na/ khyod kyis 'chi ma gson gyi byi la zhig nyos nas ci bya/ sang nyin yang sgor gcig khyer te 'bru nyo bar song / gang ltar dngos po gzhan pa gtan nas nyo mi chog ces bshad/phyi nyin yang sgor gcig bzung nas khrom 'dus susnyegasha tshong khang gi sgo khar brgyud tshe shan pas yang khyi zhig tha gus bsdams te 'brab kyin 'dug kho gam du bcar te6‘khyod kyis ci'i phyir khyi la rdung ba yin mizhes dris/ shan pas nga'i tshong sha 'dis lkog za byas pas da lta shun lpags bshu rgyu yin 〉zer/ khos 'chi la khad pa'i khyi de mthong ba'i mod snying rje'i spu long g.yos te bza' 'bru nyo ba'i bya ba rtsa ba nas brjed de shan par khyod kyis ma rdung / nga la tshongs shig ’ces bkagashan pas de chog gi rin pa sgor gcig sprod/ ces bshad/khyim du log pa na a mas ‘khyod kyi tshong rdzas gang na yod’’ces dris/ khos yang khyi gu nyos pa'i rgyu mtshan mgo nas mjug bar du thengs shig brjod skabs a ma khong khro me 66

ltar 'bar bzhin bu la/ ‘khyod rang bza' 'bru nyo bar mngags na yang khyi ldom zhig nyos nas yong / dus de ring gi khri gdugs nyi ma'i phyin chad khyod khyi dang byi la bcas pa khyim 'di nas bzhud tseg ces sdigs pa na/khos sems skyo ba'i nga nga byi la dang khyi gu khrid de yul 'khyam du phyin/nyin zhig bu dang byi la/ khyi gu gsum lung shur zhig la slebs tsa na/ rgyang ring na nags tshal mer 'bar ba mthong / 'khris su brgyugs pa na rgya rdzong nags nas bu mo zhig gis ngu 'bod byed pa'i sgra thos byung / kho de ma thag mar mchongs te bu mo de'i srog bskyabs/ de dang chabs cig lta na sdug pa'i bu mo mdzes ma mig gi dga' ston du gyur nas tshe gcig gi gtan grogs su bsgyur na ci ma rung snyam ste/ spobs pa gcig sgril gyis snying gtam lhug por brjod pa na/ bu mo na re/ 6 kho mo ni sbrul rgyal gyi bu mo yin pas phu bo khyod dang gnyen sgrig bya mi nyan/ khos bu mo'i skad cha gsan rjes tshig pa zos nas smras don/ 6 khyod kyis nga rang blor mi 'bab pa los yin/ ’’ bu mos kha ma grag par 'phral du sbrul nag cig tu sprul nas kho'i 'khris su nyal ba dang kho skrag nas hong thor te thang la 'gyel/ kho 69

brgyal ba las bsang dus sbrul nag de slar yang bu mor gyur/ bu mos kho la ‘khyod ma skrag dang / khyod kho mo'i srog byol mkhan yin pas gnod 'tshe mi gtong / da phu bo khyod phran chung bu mo'i khyim la phebs dang / khyod la pha rgan gyis drin gzo byed nges lags ’zer/kho bu mo dang 'grogs nas sa cha nyams dga' ba zhig tu phyin te bu mo na re/ ‘ a phas khyed la gser byin na gtan nas len mi nyan/ ci nus kyis a pha'i gdu bu len thabs bya dgos/ byi la dang khyi gu 'di gar sdod du chug khyed kyis mig btsum ste nga'i rjes la thed/ ngas khyed la mig phye zer dus da gzod khyed kyis mig 'byed dgos’’zhes bshad/khos bu mo'i ngag bzhin byas shing bu mos kho'i mig phye ru bcug pa na/ mig mdun du dbu skra dung ltar dkar ba'i rgad po zhig tsog pur bsdad 'dug bu mos rgad por/6‘a pha lags/ de ring phran chung kho mo nags la rtsed 'jor g.yeng skabs nags mer shor nas 'jigs snang ltar mi bzod/ stabs legs te phu bo 'dis kho mo'i srog bskyabs/ des na phu bo la drin lan legs po 'jal bar 'os’’zer ba a phas gsan rjes nye logs su nyal ba'i sbrul nag la shab shub tu lab pa dang sbrul nag de dag nur nas 70
