mi rig sar song / cang ma 'gor bar sbrul tshang mas khe la gser rdog po re khyer te rgad po'i mdun la thon/ rgad pos bu de la/ zu khyed gser rdog po 'di dag bzhes rogs mdzod’’zer/ khos gser la lta yag byas rjes slar rgad po la/ 6 phran chung la gser 'di 'dra mod po mi dgos/ gal te khyod la ster 'dod yod na/ khyed kyi lag mgo'i gdu bu gnang rogs mdzod’ ces zhus/ rgad po ma 'thad par mgo bo 'phred du g.yug bu des ha go ste kha phyir 'khor te sgo phyir skyod grabs byed ca na/ bu mo 'tshab 'tshub ngang pha rgan gyi gam du gtugs te/ 6‘phu bo 'di kho mo'i srog byol mkhan yin pas/ gal te kho yong med rgyu na kho mo snga mo nas mes bsregs tshar song / gdu bu ster mi phod na sku drin 'jal thub pa ma red ces bshad/rgad pos blos mi thongs rung bu mo'i ngo ldog ma nus par gdu bu lag mgo nas phud de ster zhor du na re/ smyo khyod la don dag tshabs chen 'dra byung ba'am yang na bgegs bar chad 'dra byung tshe/ gdu bu bos na mgon skyob byed thub/ ’bu des skad cha de dag yid la 'chang zhing bu mos kho'i mig btsum du bcug ste sgo phyir bskyal/ bu de dang khyi gu/ byi la sa de dang bral te song song ba na bkres ltogs 71

kyis thang chad cing gom pa gang yang spo ma nus par bu des gdu bu la/ 6 kye kye gdu bu lags/ nga'i pho ba ltogs pas nga la bro kha ster bar 'tshal’’zhes bshad tshar ma thag kho'i mdun du dngos gnas rab dkar kha ba'i mdangs la 'khu ba'i zas bcud mang po bshams 'dug pa las lto ba 'grang reg tu zos rjes yang mdun du song /sa rub song na'ang gnas khang zhig ma rnyed par yod dus/ khos yang gdu bu la kye gdu bu lags/ sa rub nas 'gro lam mi rnyed/ khyod khang ba zhig tu sprul shig’ ces bshad rjes kho'i mdun du yang khang ba zhig ga ler mngon/ kho dang byi la/ khyi gu gsum de gar zhag 'dug byas/ phyi nyin zhogs pa'i skya rengs ma shar gong yang lam du chas/ song song ba na sde chen mtsho lta bu zhig dang 'phrad/sde ba'i rgan dar gzhon gsum gyis kho ni log sa'i khyim med pa'i dwa phrug cig yin pa tshor bar brten snying rje tshad med skyes te sde bar sdod sa'i gnas tshang btsal/ kho'i gshis rgyud mda' ltar drang bas nyin mang po ma song bar sde ba'i mi tshang mar cha med nas rgyus yod dang rgyus yod nas 'dris par gyur/nyin zhig rgyal po tshang gi lta bas chog mi shes pa'i sras 72

mo gnas la brdzang rgyu'i gtam de thos/ yin na'ang sus rgyal po'i sras mo chung mar len na/ rgyal po tshang gi bza' mi tshang ma dang 'khor g.yog bcas la gser gyi gdu bu gcig re ster ba dang / rgyal po tshang gi sgo kha nas gnyen mag pa tshang gi sgo drung bar du gdan dkar gdan dmar gnyis gshibs kyi gdan cha 'ding ba/ da dung rgya lam 'gram du gser gyi me tog dang dngul gyi yal 'dabs can gyi lcags nag gi sdong bo star phreng bsgrig dgos/ cha rkyen de longs na bu mo ster/ mi longs na mi ster zer/ bu des skad cha bu ram lta bu de thos 'phral myur mor sde ba'i mi rnams la/ ‘ sang nyin khyed cag rgyal bo tshang la gnyen slong du song / rgyal bo'i cha rkyen de dag kho bos khas len nges yin7zhes bshad/sde ba'i mi tshang mas gsar bu'i gtam thos pa na gsar bu spyos pa los yin snyam nas gcig kyang 'gro kha ma nyan/ thabs zad de kho tshor gdu bu'i gsang ba rnam gca/la bor brjod/ phyi nyin sde ba'i kha rje dbang thang can gyi rgan pa gsum bzhi tsam rgyal bo tshang la da gzod gnyen slong du song nas gnyen chang 'thung / gnyen sgrig gi dga' ston dus chen la khoca/ rgyal bo tshang gi sha nye ring tshang ma dang 73

'khor g.yog bcas la gser gyi gdu bu re byin pa dang / rgyal bo'i pho brang bar du gdan dkar gdan dmar nyis gshibs btings/ lam 'gram gyi logs gnyis su gser gyi me tog dang dngul gyi lo 'dab can gyi lcags nag gi sdong bo star phreng du bsgrigs nas bsus/yin na'ang nyin zhig la gsar bus gdu bu 'dogs rgyu brjed de thag ring sar lug 'tsho skyong du song / dgong mo khyim la log dus chung ma med cing gdu bu'ang mi mthong /kho myur du rgyal bo tshang la rtsad gcod du song tsa na/ rgyal bo'i blon po gdug rtsub kyi las la rnam par 'jug pa zhig gis kho khang chung mun nag cig tu bcug bza' btung ci yang mi ldud par bkres ltogs kyis 'chi bar nye skabs/stabs legs te byi la dang khyi gus shes shing kho la lo gcig la 'dang ba'i za ma brkus te khyer yong rjes gang sar chung ma gar song brtsad bcad do/ /nyin zhig rgan rgon du ma srang mdo zhig tu 'dus te kha brda byed bzhin pa byi la dang khyi gus thos/ de las gcig gis na re/ 6 kha sang de ring la sde ba'i pha gi lung shur du khang gsar ha cang yid du 'ong ba zhig bzhengs te/ nang na bu mo mdzes ma zhig 'dug go tshul ltar na rgyal bo'i sras 74 —

mo yin zhes grags/ ’ de gnyis kyis skad cha de gsal bor thos par brten khang gsar de nyid rnyed thabs byed rgyu'i dam bca' yid la 'chang —5de gnyis kyis btsal btsal bas bkres ltogs kyis gdung bas thang la ngal gso byas/ glo bur du byi ba zhig lding nas mig mdun du mngon pa na byi las shed shugs kyis spar stob byas te bzung zhing za rtsis byed tshe byi bas skyabs 'jug zhus don/ 6 phu bo byi la lags/ kho bo ma za dang nyam chung kho bos khyed sku mgron rnam gnyis sha yod sar 'khrid chog ’zer/ byi la dang khyi gus skad cha de go rjes byi ba'i rjes su 'brangs shing ha cang yid du 'ong ba'i khang gsar zhig tu slebs/ de gnyis kyis mi med sa stong zhig na 'di lta bu'i khang bzang zhig phub yod par ngo mtshar te/ khang ba 'di'i khang bdag su yin snyam ste byi bar dris/ byi bas ‘‘khang bdag rgyal bo'i sras mo red’’ces gsal 'debs byas/ kho gnyis dga' drags te nang du 'gro rtsis byed tshe khang sgo sra gtan byas yod pas 'gro ma thub/ de nas byi ba gnam khung nas mar bsnar te gdu bu rku ru bcugabyi ba khang gsar du thon dus bu mo mal khrir gnyid du yur/ byi bas gang sar gdu bu btsal btsal rung ma rnyed/75

gzhug nas gdu bu bu mo'i kha ru bcug yod pa da gzod shes byung / byi ba bu mo'i gdong la dal gyis 'dzeg bu mo'i sna khung du byi bas rnga ma btsangs ma thag bu mos sna sbrid cig brgyab pa dang gdu bu kho mo'i kha nas sa la lhung / byi ba myur mor mdun du myo/chong ste gdu bu bzung nas bros/byi bas gdu bu gcen po byi lar sprad/ byi la dang khyi gus thugs rje che zhus rjes dga' dga' spro spro'i ngang rgyal po'i pho brang du song ste gdu bu gsar bur byin/ gsar bus gdu bur phur phur byas te/ 6 kwa ye gdu bu lags/ ngas da gzod khyod rnyed byung / da nga rgyal bo'i mkhar las bud de a ma'i mchan la log 'dod pas/ khyod kyis nga la rogs ram bya dgos/ mi’ zhes bshad tshar rjes khos byi la dang khyi gu khrid de rgyal bo'i mkhar las thon te drin can a ma'i gam du logade nas kho tshos rang lus rang dbang gi skyid pa'i 'tsho bar longs spyad de dus 'da' 'o/ /(rin chen rgyal gyis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1992lo'i deb dang po las bdams/ )76

byi lu dad tsi gu/sngon gyi dus zhig la byi la dang tsi gu gnyis khyim mtshes yin zhing / kho gnyis kyis dus rgyun par sdug gi khur bo mnyam 'khur dang skyid pa'i 'tsho ba mnyam rol byed kyin yod/dus nam zhig gi tshe na mi rnams kyi lo rtags rtsi byed la lo skor bcu gnyis gtan la pha ba dgos byung bas/ srog chags kyi rgyal bo g.yu ral can gyis gshin rje chos kyi rgyal bo'i bka' lung ltar rang gi mnga' khongs su gtogs pa'i thag nye ring gi srog chags thams cad la/ ‘ nyi ma sang dang gcig gnangs dang gnyis/ gzhes kyi lha nyin dkar bo la/ 'du ra rma bya thang nas srog chags rnams thon pa'i snga rjes ltar lo rtags bcu gnyis po gtan khel bya rgyu yin pas/ chung ba byi ba'i yan chad dang che ba rnga mong man chad tshang ma snga ci thub byas nas thon par gyis ’zhes thag ring ba la yi ge dang nye ba la pho nya mngags pa na/ byi la dang tsi gu gnyis kyis kyang brda de thos pas/ byi las tsi 77

spu la ‘nga rang gnyid lci bas/ gnyid la shor nyen che/ de bas khyed rang sad ma thag nga rang bos dang 'u gnyis mnyam du song na ci 'dra red’ ces pa na/ tsi gus khyod kyis mi 'thung na nga yis mi za ba'i grogs po zhig gis de lta bu'i phan yang 'dogs mi thub na de la grogs po zer ram ’zhes zer nas/ kho gnyis ka gros 'chams byung /nyin gsum pa'i snga mor tsi gu gnyid las sad dus mkha' mtha' nas skya rengs bkyags zin pas tsi gu'i sems la cad ma 'grig de ring langs 'phyi song mi 'dod de dngangs ma 'dzub kyis khyim mtshes byi la 'bod rgyu brjed nas mchong ma lding gis 'du ra rma bya thang la thon pa na glang rgan ma gtogs gcig kyang thon med/de nas kho'i sems lhod la babs nas ngal cung tsam gsos rjes rang nyid snga mo nas thon pa'i brda zhig rgyag dgos snyam ste/ g.yas zur na rtsi 'bur zhig yod pa de'i steng du bud nas phar 'khor tshur 'khor byed zhor du u nyin/ ag’ ces skad bsal rung / kho'i lus kyi bongs tshad chung drags pas/ chung na mig la mi thogs/ che na sgo la mi shong zhes pa ltar ri dwags rgyal bo'i mig la ma thogs/de nas kho glang rgan gyi brla thog gyen la 'bo/sa nas rwa rtser —78

bud pas/ ri dwags rgyal bos phar lta tshur lta 'ga' byas tshod la glang rgan gyi rwa rtse na byi ba zhig yod pa mthong bas/‘ 'o/ ngas nyams ma bzhag pa ma gtogs byi ba glang rgan las kyang thon pa snga 'dug bsams nas byi ba ang dang por brtsis pas/ lo mgo byi ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin par grags/phyir log pa'i lam bar du byi bas sngar nyin gyi gros tshig rnams dran pas/ da thengs grogs mchog la khrel med bcos song / kho rang thugs khros yod pa thag chod yin/da song nas 'gyod bshags re byas na gu yangs gtong ngam snyam bzhin/ nongs zhum gyis byi la'i khyim du song ba na/byi lar bshad rgyu gtam rgyu ci yang med par mchong thengs gcig gis kho bza' bar brtsams/ de nas bzung byi la dang tsi gu gnyi ga da lta da rung mi 'grig pa'ang rgyu mtshan der thug yod zer ro/ /(mgon tshe yis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgru rtsal〉〉1994lo'i deb dang po las bdams/ ) —79

zhod pu dad skugs puzhi gnyen don/de yang gna' snga mo'i dus shig la/ tsho ba chen po gong zhol gnyis yod par/ tsho ba gong ma na rgan po zhig la bu mig ya gcig long pa zhig yod de/ dus nam zhig gi tshe/ bu long pa de pho lo drug gsum bco brgyad la slebs shing / na tshod smin te gnyen don sgrub pa'i dus la babs 'duganam rgyun/ rgan pos kyang sems khrel byed bzhin rang nyid gzhon so dkar gyi dus las 'das te rgan skra dkar gyi dus la slebs shing / tshe mjug gi re ba mtha' dag bu long pa 'dir bcol dgos la/ bu 'di'i tshe gcig gi bde skyid kyi ched du skya ya zhig nges par btsal dgos snyam/ nyin zhig la/ rgan pos rang gi grogs po bkra shis blo ldan zhes mi blo rig ldan pa zhig yod pa de bos nas bu long par mna' ma btsal bar btang / bkra shis blo ldan sa cha gang mang 'grims kyangabu long par 'os shing 'tsham pa'i mna' ma zhig ma mthong bas/ yid pham ste tsho ba zhol 80

ma'i chu mig gi 'gram du rta la chu ldud zhor du ngal gso byed skabs/ bu mo zhig chu len du 'ongs pa dang 'phrad/ khos bu mo'i ming dang pha ma sogs kyi skor dris tshe/ bu mos mgo bo sgur te 'dug pa las skad cha ci yang ma bshad/ yang bskyar —thengs kha shas la dris kyang bu mos lag brda ston pa las skad cha tshig gcig kyang ngag nas ma thon pas da gzod kho mo lkugs pa zhig yin pa gzhi nas rtogs/de'i rjes su/ bkra shis blo ldan bu mo de'i khyim du song ste bu mo'i pha ma gnyis la bu mo gnas la byin yod med dris tshe/ lan du mgo bo ḍa ru g.yug g.yug byas te gnas la ma byin pa'i brda bstan/ bkra shis blo ldan gyis tshul de dag mthong rjes/ myur du ta len las chang dang kha btags sogs gnyen slong byed kyi ca lag rnams mdun du spungs te gus gus zhum zhum gyi sgo nas bu mo tsho ba gong ma la mna' mar ster dgos tshul bshad pas/ bu mo lkugs pa'i pha ma gnyis kyis yun ring zhig la bsam blo btang mthar 'di skad du bu mo 'gro sa'i gnyen ya'i khyim tshang dang / mag pa ji 'dra red’’ces dris pa la/ lan du bkra shis blo ldan gyis gnyen ya'i khyim tshang dang rgyu 'byor ba sogs gang gi thad nas kyang shin tu legs/ lhag par du mag par 81

blta rgyu zhig med ’zer bas/ bu mo lkugs pa'i pha ma gnyis kyi bsam par mag par blta rgyu zhig med na dngos gnas bzang bar 'dug bsam ste mna' mar ster rgyu khas blangs pa dang / gnyen sgrig gi dus tshod kyang gtan la phab rjes da gzod bkra shis blo ldan phyir logabakra shis blo ldan bu long pa tshang la 'ongs te mna' ma tsho ba zhol ma nas btsal yod tshul rnams zhib tu bshad pas/ bu long pa'i pha rgan yang dga' spro'i snang ba 'bum gyis myos te mna' ma gang 'dra 'duganyanyaces dris/ bkra shis blo ldan gyis‘‘mna' mar bshad rgyu medami’ces brjod pas rgan po yang dga' spros myos zhing sems bde la phab nas bsdad/bu long par mna' ma len pa'i nyin mo der/ bu long pa tshang gi ston mo rgya chen po zhig bshams shing / ston thog tu mi mang bos glu gar gyi dga' ston la rol nas yun ring zhig 'gor ba'i tshe/ a zhang dang mna' ma bcas pa tsho ba gong mar 'byor la/ dus yun thung ngu'i nang du bu long pa'i pha rgan dang bu mo lkugs pa'i pha rgan sogs phan tshun cha rgyus yod par gyur/nyin zhig la/ bu mo lkugs pa'i pha rgan gyis bkra82

shis blo ldan la lkog tu dris pa/ ‘khyid kyis mag paro blta rgyu med zer ba min nam/ mag pa'i mig ya gcig long pa zhig red’’ces bu mo gnas la ster mi 'dod pa'i tshul ston dus/ bkra shis blo ldan gyis myur du gsal bshad byas par/ ‘ ngas sngon nas bshad yod pa min nam/ mag pa'i mig ya gcig long ba yin pas kho la blta byed kyi mig gcig las med/ de bas ngas khyed la blta rgyu zhig med ces brjod pa yin’’zhes lan btab pas bu mo skugs pa'i pha rgan kha grag rgyu med par gyur song /nyin shas ma 'gor bar/ yang bu long pa'i pha rgan gyis bkra shis blo ldan la khyed kyis mna' mar bshad rgyu med zer ba min nam/ mna' ma ni ngag mi 'khrol ba'i lkugs pa zhig red/ ’ces sdug gtam rjod skabs/ bkra shis blo ldan gyis sngon ltar gsal bshad byed rgyur/ tsa‘ngas sngon nas khyed la bshad yod pa min nam/ mna' ma'i ngag las sgra mi thon pas kho mor bshad rgyu med ces brjod pa yin’’zhes smras pas bu long pa'i pha rgan la'ang kha grag rgyu med par gyur/dus de nas bzung bu long pa dang bu mo lkugs pa gnyis kyis 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi las la longs spyad 83
de dus 'da' 'o/ /(phag mo don grub gyis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1992lo'i deb bzhi ba las bdams/ )

sprelwa nachod grog rdod khazhi gtan rgyud/gna' dang bor yul ho ra zhes pa'i sa cha zhig tu/nags klung stug po nyi zla'i 'od zer yang sgrib par byed pa zhig yod pa de'i dkyil na sprel mchong grog rong zer ba'i grog shur zhig yod pa red/nyin zhig la spre'u mang bo zhig grog rong de'i kha na phar mchong tshur mchong byas te rtsed mo la rol ba'i skabs su rlom sems dang nga rgyal che ba'i glang bo che zhig der slebs shing / des spre'u rnams la ‘we/ sprel phrug rnam sa nyon cig sa 'di'i ming la ci zhig zer/ khyod tshos 'dir ci— zhig byed kyin yod’’ces dris par/ de'i lan du sprel phrug cig girme/ 6 yul 'di'i ming la ho ra zer zhing / nged cag gis rtsed mo rtse sa 'dir sprel mchong grog rong zhes bya'o/ nged cag gis 'dir mchong rgyug lding gsum gyi rtsal sbyong gin yodami’ces lan btab/glang chen gyi sems la nga glang bo che zhes pa ni shi na dngul srang stong dang gson na dngul srang stong du brin pa'i 65

rin po che yin pas nga mi shes pa'i sems can su zhig yod/ der ma zad khyod spu ser spre'u rnams lding thub sar nga glang bo che lding mi thub pa ci yod snyam ste rlom sems dang bcas sprel mchong grog rong la mchongs pas kho'i sgal tshigs chad de de ma thag shi song ngo / /de nas re zhig 'gor tsa na/ sprel mchong grog rong khar rngom pa bdun slebs shing / kho tshos glang chen shi ba mthong ma thag dga' spro dpag med skyes te dga' ba'i gtam gleng sna tshogs byas/ der mi gnyis chu len du song zhing mi lngas shul du ras gur phub bzhin glang chen gyi sha bgo bsha' ci ltar byed par gros mol byas/de'i nang du ham sems dang g.yo sgyu che ba'i rngon pa gon pa zhig yod pa des gros mgo bton par/ ‘ nged cag mi bdun gyis glang chen gyi sha bgos na rgyu dang nom pa nyung ngu las mi thob pas nga tshos bya thabs gzhan zhig spyad na mi bzang ngam’’zhes bshad/ der rngon pa lnga bo'i nang gi kha yag dang ngo bstod la mkhas pa zhig yod pa des/ ‘‘gzhan pa'i bya thabs ci zhig spyad na bzang mi’zhes dris par/ yang rngon pa rgan pa des chu len mi gnyis po'i bro kha'i nang la dug btab ste bsad na ci 'dra 'dug mices 86

skad cha'i mjug rdzogs ma thag ngo bstod dang sprel lad 'khrab par goms pa'i mi des/ 6 legs po 'dug ngo ma legs po 'dug de ltar byas na dngul srang stong gi glang bo che'i sha dang rus pa nga tsho mi lnga la thems pa ma yin nam’’zhes smras so/ /der gzhan rnams ni de 'dra'i 'thad pa zhig min yang / gcig na gros mgo 'don mkhan de lo na rgan pa dang dbang shed che/ gnyis na sprel lad 'khrab par dga' ba'i mi de yang de'i rjes la ka langs langs byed pas bsam 'char gzhan pa ci yang bshad ma nus par de ltar byed rgyu thag bcad de chu len mi gnyis po'i bro kha'i nang la dug bsres pa red/chu len du song ba'i mi de gnyis las gcig kyang gong gi mi rgan pa de dang 'dra bar g.yo sgyu dang ham sems che bar ma zad za rgyu rig na 'chi rgyu mi dran pa'i mi tha shal ba zhig red/ kho'i sems la'ang gong gi de lta bu'i g.yo sgyu zhig dran te rogs pa de'i mi tshor bar byas nas chu'i nang la dug 'debs thub song bas/ da ni 'grig song / glang chen gyi sha rus nga la dbang song snyam ste dga' spro dang bcas kho tsho gnas pa'i phyogs su gom stabs myur du bsgyur/67

der kho tsho mnyam gcig tu 'dus te ja bskol zhor du glang chen gyi sha dang rus pa ci ltar bgo bar rang rang gi lta tshul re bshad byung / tshang mas mdor bsdus na cha snyoms byas te bgos na bzang zhes zer/ kho tsho'i ngo la bcos ma'i 'dzum mdangs re mngon yod kyang sems su dkrol mi nus pa'i mdud log re yod pas/ snying ni steg snyig tu lding zhing phal cher ya chung las mgrin pa'i khar yar ba dang 'dra/dug rlangs 'phyur ba'i ja de ba ma'i nang na lhog lhog tu 'khol byung / rngon pa bdun pos kyang rang rang gi bro kha blangs te bza' mgo brtsams/ chu'i nang la dug 'debs mkhan gnag sems can des rngon pa rnams la dug ja mngar mo dkar yol gang re blugs rjes/ rang gis dug bro zhim po de kham bu gang re gang re byas te zos/ rngon pa gzhan rnams kyis kyang dug ja dron mo de hub gang re gang re byas nas btungs/ cang ma 'gor bar rngon pa bdun po'i kha nas khrag skyug cing pho ba'i nang la zug gzer drag po bzod bsran mi nus pa re skyes te mi ro bdun du gyur —song ngo / /yang re zhig song tsa na sa der ser sna dang g.yo sgyu che 68

ba'i wa mo zhig slebs shing / wa mos mi ro bdun dang gladza chen gyi ro mthong ma thag dga' spro bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig skyes te yar mchong dang mar lding / yar nyul dang mar nyul byed cing nyin gang bor gzan kham bu gang yang ma rnyed par pho ba ha cang ltogs bzhin yod pa'ang brjed song ba 'dra/ wa mo'i bsam par/ mi ro bdun dang glang chen gyi ro 'di ngas lo gcig la zas kyang mi tshar/ da ni la dang lung ba brgyud de gzan 'tshol ba'i sdug bsngal yang myang mi dgos/ yin na'ang za shes dang 'thung shes byed dgos snyam ste/ gzhu thig cig la so btab ste bcad pa na rwa gzhu de bkugs yod pas gzhu'i yar mchog wa mo'i thod pa'i dkyil la phog ste mig lam du me stag 'char ba dang chabs ci / wa ro dmar bo me lta bu zhig thang der 'gyel 'dug go /sprel rnams kyis gong gsal gyi gnas tshul tha mas cad chad lus med par mthong zhing / kho tshos 'gyod pa'i shugs ring nar nar du 'byin bzhin yod/ skabs der de'i nang sprel rgan blo khog yangs shing shes rgya che ba zhig yod pa des sprel phrug rnams la bslab bya 'di byas so//chen pos chung rtab/sa btod de//89

rlom sems nga rgyal chi na//sprel mchong grog shur mchongs pa'i//glang chen shi ba'i ror ltos//rgyu dang nom pa bsams nas//g.yo sgyu khram la mkhas na//phan tshun dug nag drangs pa'i//rngon pa bdun po'i ror ltos//g.yo dang ser sna che na//shi ro brgyad pos ma tshims//gzhu thig phra mo 'cha' ba'i//gra yag wa mo'i ror ltos//nged cag spre'u rnams kyis//don de sems la bzung nas//yod dus ser sna ma byed//longs spyod sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi//grogs po phan tshun bar la//phu nu lta bu'i 'dang dgos//g.yo sgyu khram gsum spang dgos//rlom sems nga rgyal med dgos//zhes smras so//90

de nas bzung ste spre'u rnams kyis rgan bkur chung gces byed pa dang / phan tshun bar la sngar las kyang 'dang brtse che bar gyur te sprel mchong grog rong khar bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba la longs su spyod cing gnas so//(tsho hor rdza kos bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1992lo'i deb bzhi ba las bdams/ )

sprud sna lha skyid /gna' dang por yul zhig na dgung lo la kha'i nyi ma yin pa'i mo hreng zhig yod cing / de la gzugs byad kha sgo skyes 'bras lta bas chog mi shes pa'i bu mo blangs ma zhig yod pa de'i ming la lha skyid zer/ ma 'di'i byang khog ma brgyud pa'i bu mo ma smad gnyis kyis rang 'thag cig bsrungs nas nyi ma chod thabs byed kyin gda'/ 'jig rten kha dpe la/ 6 rang lus las mched pa'i sha rdog min na dral yang mi tsha’ zer ba ci ma bden/ ma g.yar 'dis bu mo lha skyid la gtan nas/ sha mi tsha bar rang 'thag bsrung du bcug pa las sgo phyir skyod du mi 'jug rang nyid nyin ltar shar 'gro shar dang lho 'gro lho byas te rtswa mgo'i chur mi bsgro bar rnam g.yeng du 'khyams/nyin zhig la/ ma g.yar nam rgyun ltar khyim 'dzul byed par song zhing lha skyid kyis rang 'thag btags nas yu la srung byed bzhin gda'/ skabs der snam bu'i stod thung zhig lus la gyon zhing / khog stod mi dgye bar mgo bo 92

dud pa/ ngo gdong sha rus bag skam du gyur nas spre'u dang mtshungs pa/ g.yon lag tu 'khar ba sne chag cig thogs pa/ g.yas kyi mchan khung du rtsam khug btsir ba'i so nam pa rgad po nyam thag pa zhig sgo drung du slebs byung / der bro rtsam tog tsam ster bar brtsams te gang sar btsal yang za 'phro 'thung 'phro ma rnyed par brten 'khor mtha' las gro phye spar gang bcus nas rgad por byin/ las lam du ma song nas/ kho'i bro khug gi zhabs rdol yod pas/ gro phye khyor ba gang bo lam la gcol yod pa ma g.yar gyis rig song / kho mos bu mo lha skyid dang phyi mi lkog 'brel byas te gro phye brkus pa los yin snyam nas khong khro chen po gting nas langs te/ a tsha zer dbang dang a ma 'bod dbang ma byin par bu mor gcar rdung byas/ gcar rdung gis snying nad ma sangs par lag pa gcod grabs byed/ lha skyid kyis mchil ma'i rdog phreng khram khrum du bzhur zhor du zhu ba nan gyis zhus kyang go ma chod par lag pa bsrings nas gcod du bcug des mi tshad lha skyid gcig pu sgo phyir bskrad/ lag pa med pa'i bu mo lha skyid drag char khrod kyi mar me bzhin du sems skya mo thang 'a lhung nas rkang ba'i 'degs 'jog mi brtan par khyar khyor du gang sar 9 3

'grim/ ‘ kye ma/ kho mor lag pa yod dus 'tsho ba rol rgyu gnam la 'dzegs pa las kyang dka'/ da lta lag rdum ngas ngal rtsol ci yang bya mi thub pas lto ba ji ltar phud dam/ 'di la bltas na shi nis dga'/ ’’zhes kho mos bsam zhing yid rmus te/ zhen chags pa'i 'jig rten khams la 'bral mi phod mod/ sdug lan chags zad mi thub pa'i las dbang la zhe gting nas kho thag chad de rma g.yang dal mo'i ngogs su phyin/ srid pa'i kha dpe la/ 6 'chi bdag pho nya ma thon na//rang srog bcad kyang chod mi srid//’’zer ba ltar/ bu mo lha skyid rma chu g.yas 'khor gyi dkyil dbus su mchong ba na/tag tag 'byor phyug ldan pa'i rong ba khyim tshang zhig gis rma chu 'obs rkar drangs te sil rar chu gtong ba'i sgang red/bu mo lha skyid yeng yeng yeng sil rar khur yong / kho mo brgyal las sangs tshe da gzod yal 'dab stug cing grib bsil can gyi sil sdong chen po zhig gi 'og tu nyal yod pa tshor ba dang / mgo bo yar bkyags te sdong mgor bltas 'phral sdong bo'i yal gar 'bras bu khur gyis dud de rnam par smin par 'gram chu ldang nas thogs rtsis byas mod/lag pa med rkyen kha yis rmug dgos byung / lha snyid kyis sil 94

tog 'cha' ba'i sgang la sil ra'i bdag po tshang gi gzhon nus mthong / blo rig rnam par bkra ba'i gzhon nus lha skyid la tshor du ma bcug par kha rog gis phyir log ste a ma ra gsal bor lab/a mas thos rjes yid la the tshom skye bzhin mgyogs por sil rar phyin tshe/ ngo ma yag mo sgo bco lnga'i lha zla dang gzugs skyes lus smyug ma tshigs drug rang 'dug snyam pa'i blo zhig bcos min du ster zhing lag pa med par phu rung rlung gis skyod cing mig gis rig rig gang sar bltas nas sems 'tshab kyin gda'/ a ma ga ler bu mo'i gam du bcar te gnas tshul dris pa na bu mo'i sdug bsngal da gzod rtogs song / thog mar bza' bca' btung gsum gyi mthun rkyen gya nom pa sbyar te sgo phyir brdzang grabs byas kyang gzhon nus gtan nas mi gtong khar/ gzhon nur ji ltar kha ta byas kyang bong bur chos bshad pa ltar 'bras bu med cing chung mar len dgos zer/ a ma dngos gnas skrag tu bcug yang 'dang zhig brgyab pa na gzhon nus dgod kha bslangs par khriṭa khriṭa med/ de nas yang bskyar thengs shig dris pa na lan du gzhon nus/ ‘ kho mor lag pa med pa lta ci/ rkang ba med song rung chung mar len nges 95

lags ’ zer/gzhon nu 'di chung byis pa'i dus nas pha rgan tshe las 'das nas dwa phrug tu gyur pa dang a ma'i mchan las nar son par brten/ gcig bshad na gcig dang gnyis bshad na gnyis yin pa las gzhan sus kyang blo kha bsgyur mi thub/ a mar bya thabs zad de gzhon nu'i 'dod blo bskang ched gza' skar 'phrod sbyor kun nas legs pa'i bkra shis don 'grub kyi nyin mo zhig la/ sde lung stod smad bar gsum gyi mgron brgya tshogs su bsdus shing sha mar thud gsum gyi sder kha bshams te/ dga' ba'i bro/ skyid pa'i glu/ snyan mo'i gtam gyi gre ba yongs su phyes nas ston mo nyin zhag bco brgyad la byas te 'jig rten khyim thab kyi bgo skal dang po rol nas dga' bde'i dpal la spyod cing /bza' mi gsum po gcig sems gcig la 'dris shing byams la/ gzhon nus brtson 'grus kyis slob gnyer dang mna' ma lha skyid kyis a ner skyong snyor byas/lo zhig la/ gzhon nus ma rgan dang chung ma bskyur te grong khyer la slob gnyer 'grim pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig tu gzhol ba na ma rgan gyis bkag kyang ma khog par skyod grabs byas/ gcig song na lo ngo dgu'i ring la phyir yong mi thub/96

zhe 'khring sa ni lag rdum chung ma yin/ chung mas khyo bo 'bral mi phod par sems khong du chud yod pa rtogs naca/ khyo bo la/ 6 khyo bo sems bde bar skyod dang / yul na byams brtse ldan pa'i a ne yod na kho mor chag lhung mi thub/ ’’ces zer/ gzhon nus chung ma lha skyid kyi ngag sgo las tshig snyan mo khu byug gi mgrin glu lta bu byung bar yid sems rab tu spro bar gyur/ rjes su kha rog gis yang bskyar a mar bcol yag byas te lam la chas/dga' bar 'os pa zhig la khyo bo 'gro khar chung ma lha skyid mngal sbrum yod pa sus kyang ga la shes/ zla gsum 'gor rjes pha shul bus non pa'i gdung rgyud 'dzin mkhan zhig skyes par brten/ a ne rgad mo dga' nas dgod cing spro bas glu chung len par 'dug myur mor yig mkhan la 'phrin yig 'bri ru bcug ste mngag gzhug pa shar gtong byas/ yig skyel pas dge legs 'phrin bzang myur mor 'phrod phyir rgya lam gtubs te rkang lam du bzhud/ lam bar nas sa rub pa dang rang 'thag cig la gnas tshang g.yar/ dgod bro ba la/ rang 'thag de gzhan gyi ma yin par chung ma lha skyid kyi ma g.yar gyi red/ dgong mo gnyid ldog khar ma g.yar dang yig skyel ba gnyis gtam mgo rnga 97

med pa'i lab gleng gang mang byas mthar bu mo lha skyid gnas la song ste bu zhig btsas yod pa shes song / ma g.yar gyi sems la sprang mo des nga las lhag pa'i 'tsho bar rol 'dug snyam nas phrag dog gi me lce drag tu 'bar/ de ma thag tu bsam ngan yid la shar te mtshan phyed tsam la yig skyel ba gnyid khug pa'i skabs dang bstun nas lkog lkog sud sud kyis yig shub brkus nas bklags pa na/ra dpral ba'i mig ltar gces pa'i bu chung la/ mna' ma lha skyid kyis nged ma smad gnyis la bu zhig btsas yod/khyod rang myur mor yul la chas shog’’ces bris yod/ ma bltas na sems khams mi dkrigs/ gcig rig na snying rlung stod la 'tshangs te 'jags thabs bral/ yig mkhan zhig btsal nas khrel med kyi rdzun yig cig bkod de kha rog ges yig skyel ba'i khug mar bcug go /mngag gzhug pas reb thengs 'dir rkang tshegs ma blangs/ brda gla dong tse sum cu de mar sgam nang gi mar khrog ril zhig gi rin tsam red snyam nas khog skyid langs bzhin grong khyer de la thon/ yi ge bdag po gzhon nur gtad pa dang 'di ltar bkod don/ ca bu nyon cig mis mi sbrum la/'dres 'dre khur ba lags/ khyod kyi chung mas phag phrug 98

cig btsas pas myur mor bza' kha thor ba'i 'phrin zhig skur zhig ’nyagazhon nu'i snying khong du me bzhin 'bar ba'i re smon la mi 'dod chu khyag gtor ba ltar khyags si se btang /kye yul lha gzhi bdag phran gyi pha mes yang mes tshang ma dkar phyogs dbee don kho na sgrub mkhan te/ 'bu srin grog ma tsam gyi srog la mi 'tshe bar gzur nas 'gro bar skad/ kho bo'ang gnyom chung zhig yin pas lha skyid lag rdum yin par snying rje nas chung mar blangs mod/ bsam yul las 'das pa la kho mos phag phrug btsas pa lags/ 'di ni las lan chags bsags pa ma yin nam/ yang zhib 'dang brgyab na/chung ma'i mngal gyi phru gu ji zhig btsa' rgyu rang lag tu yod pa ga la yin/ de mi nyan/ de gtan nas bsam mi phod/a ma'i ngag bzhin bsgrub mi bya/ chung ma ni lag rdum yin stabs/ gal srid sgo phyir bskrad na kho mo gang la 'gro rgyu/ sems la myur du pha yul la log ste bden rdzun gyi phu thag gcod par bsam mod/ slob sbyong gi brel ba ha cang che phyir log khom ma byung / snga 'dang phyi 'dang brgyab brgyab kyang a ma'i zhe sems rab tu gnag pas lan par tshor te/ dus 'phral du yig lan bkod de mngag gzhug pa'i lag la bzhag99

mngag gzhug pa phyir log khar slar yang sngar gyi rang 'thag la gnas tshang g.yar te zhag 'dug byas/ ma g.yar gyi gdong la g.yo sgyu'i 'dzum mdangs mngon zhing / kha zas zhim mngar gyis sne len gang legs bgyis mthar kha yag la bskor te wa nags la 'ded pa'i sbyor ba la brten nas kha bsgul ba na gzhon nu'i yi ge khyer yod pa rtogs byung / nam gung gi tshod la mngag gzhug pa gnyid stug po khug par bstun/ yi ge brkus nas bklags pa na 'di ltar bkod don/ 6 lus rten khang bzang gi bdag nyid chen mo ma yu ma mchog gi drung du/ bskur ba'i 'phrin yig gis sems khams sdug la sbyor te nyin mtshan khor yug du bza' btung gi yi ga chad/ mig mthar mchi ma khol zhing snying rtsa chu ser gyis khengs pas dus mi chod mod/ spyir 'jig rten na rang gi 'dod pa kho na tsam don gnyer byas te/ gzhan pa'i nor longs spyod dang bde skyid tshang ma phongs par 'gyur zhing sdug la bskul ba'i khrel med tha shal gyi las 'ba' zhig bsgrub rung ngam/ sdon chad chung mar ran na/ da ltar ci phyir mi ran/ khyed rang gis chung ma lha skyid la lta skyong gzab nan gyica/ dang / mi ring bar log rjes da gzod gnas tshul la blta chog ’ ma g.yar gyis ma phyi yi ge'i tshab la rdzus ma 100

zhig btums te mngag gzhug pa'i khug mar bcugamangag gzhug pa slar khyim la log rjes gzhon nu'i 'phrin yig a mar gtad pa dang 'di ltar bkod don/‘‘byams ldan ma rgan rin po che lags/ phran rang yul la mi log chung mas bu zhig btsas par lta ci/ gser rdog po zhig btsas kyang spro sems skye mi srid/ yi ge 'a ri bza' kha thor ba'i dpang rtags su mtshon par bgyid/ ’’ drin can ma los gzhon nu'i brtse sems bral ba'i 'phrin yig bklags pa na sems skyo gdung gis rab tu mnar bzhin du/ gzhon nu kho rang sgor bud pa nas bzung / snying lag chags pa dang mig khral khrul du gyur te chung ma blor ma babs pa los yin snyam nas mna' ma'i gam du gtugs shing yig lan gyi brjod don kha yag la bskor te go brda 'phrod thabs byas/chung ma lha skyid kyis nyan rjes mgo thog la sdong gtun gyis bsnun pa ltar yam yom du 'khyor zhing mid pa 'gag nas bshad rgyu'ang ma rnyed/ ngus kyang mchi ma skam par gyur/ yin yang a ne sems sdug par dogs te mnar sems khog la bcings nas kha rog gis byis pa khrid de sgor bud/ gna' mi'i kha dpe la/ 66khyim gyi phyug po/ sgor 101

bud kyi sprang bo ’zer ba ltar/ gnas tshang gi sgo phyir bud pa nas snying rtsar chu ser 'khyil te mchi ma'i rdog phreng gis gyon pa bangs song / mo rang gi las dbang btsog pa kho na las 'khang ra byed sa med cing / nyam thag pa'i lha skyid 'jig rten gyi shul lam ring mo'i mthar son te byis pa pang la bzung nas yang bskyar rma chu la mchongs/srid pa'i chos nyid ni ston kha'i gnam gshis ltar dpog dka' ba zhig ste/ 'chi bar mos na gson pa dang gson par spro na rnam par 'chi ba smos ci dgos/ lha skyid rma chur lcebs pa nas rba rlabs chal chil g.yo bzhin ma bu gnyis ka chu ngogs su bskyal yong / dus yun ga tshod 'das pa ma shes mod lha skyid brgyal ba las sad de pang gi byis par bltas tshe ma shi bar gson 'dug kho mos brag char sdeb pa'i skad ngan gyis/ 6 kye gnam rgan lags/ ci zhig byed na legs sam/ ’ zhes 'o dod bos/ chu khar 'greng nas ngus/ shugs ring ngus nas brgyal/ mchi ma bskams/mid pa'ang 'gag mya ngan gyi gzhung la pang gi byis pa ngus shing 'phag 'tshag byas/ khong khro byis par pho ste mnar sems dwangs thabs bya dgos snyam nas/ dpung ba shed kyis yar bkyags tshe bcad shul lag ngar las lag pa — 102

gnyis ga ler skyes byung / kho mo ma rlom par slar yang tshod lta jig byas tshe/ lag pa ngo ma zhig thogs 'dug dga' bas byis pa lag mgor gsor zhing / zhig ral du gyur pa'i rtswa'i spyil bur gnas bcas te byis pa nar son par blo rtse btsag sgrica/ gyis lta skyong byed bzhin gda'/lo 'khor gyi 'gros dang bstun nas byis pa lag chags nas bsam shes su gyur/ nyin zhig gi nyi ma nub khar sgo khar skya mi gnyis 'byor byung / gcig nad pa yin pa dang cig shos nad pa min/ skya mi gnyis ka rta las babs ma thag zhu ba byas nas gnas tshang g.yar/ lha skyid gyis ngal dub kyis gdung ba'i 'grul ba gnyis ka khyi ma la bsnyen nas tsha thab thog tu 'dug bcugam gzhi nad pa de lha skyid kyi skyes pa lags/ kho 'dzin grwa mthar phyin te yul la log tshe chung ma mig gi dga' ston du ma gyur/ rgyu mtshan gsal bor dris pa na da gzod yig skyel gyi lam khar gol log byung ste chung ma ma bu gnyis sgor bskrad pa shes song / dus de nas sems sdug gis spyo la khad du gyur pa dang khams sangs pa'i phyir de ring grogs dang bcas ri dwags rngon du skyod pa red/lha skyid kyis rngon pa rnam gnyis mthong 'phral nad pa 103

de rang gi khyo bo yin pa gsal thag chod kyang kha ci yang ma grags par kha rog par bsdad/ sems la byis pa lag chags 'dug dka' ngal yang ldog tshar zin/ khyo bo yod med khyad par med snyam/ der brten sgron me 'od la brten nas skud phang rmel te phang 'khal zhing byis pa rang gi logs su bzhag dgong mor nad pa'i grogs po gnyid gtan nas khug gin med/ nam phyed tsam yol tsa na nad pa'i nyal thul shud de thang la lhung song / a mas byis par na re/ 6 khyod kyi a pha'i nyal gos shud thar/ khyod song nas kho la khob cig’ zer/ byis pas nyal thul 'gebs yag byas/ skad cha 'di nad pa'i grogs po des tshor bas ngo mtshar skyes/ kho'i bsam par/ chung ma 'di'i ngag ltar na/ nad pa'i chung ma yin par 'dug yin yang chung ma 'dir lag pa thogs stabs lag rdum chung ma dang thod mi thug don 'di sems la dam por bcangs nas bsdad/phyi nyin gyi zhogs par/ grogs pos mdang nub ma bu gnyis kyi bya spyod nad par smos pa dang da dung zhag cig bsdad de bden rdzun gyi dbye ba 'byed dgos par gdams/phyi dgong mor kho gnyis yang tsha thab thog tu nyal/ ma bu 104

gnyis kyi/ sa sgro 7/ me'i 'og tu phang 'khal bzhin mchis/ nam phyed yol tshe nad pas bsam bzhin du nyal thul rkang shed kyis thang la dbyugs byung / a mas byis par ‘ khyod kyi a pha'i nyal thul lhung thal/ khyod song nas khob cig’nyaces bshad tshar rjes byis pas nyal gos legs par bkab/skabs der nad pa glo bur du gog langs byas pa na/ma bu gnyis ka skrag nas snying 'gad nye ru bcug dkar me 'og gi bud med la lta yag cig byas pa na dngos gnas rang gi chung ma lha skyid dang a na ma na red/ de nas byis pa'i lo tshod rang gi byis pa dang bsdur na khyad par mi 'dugakhos ngag las tshig gcig kyang ma bud par ma shi gson bral du song ba'i chung mar dam por 'tham zhing mchi ma chu mig gi khung bu brdol ba ltar thon nas brang gzhung rlon par gyur/ khos sa mthar nyul nas lo dgu'i ring gi skyid sdug ma lus par chung ma lha skyid ma bu genyis la smras pa dang ma bu gnyis khrid de mgyogs por ma rgan gyi drung du log nas bza' mi lhan 'dzoms byung / dus de nas bzung kho bza' mi tshos bde skyid kyi 'tsho bar longs spyod bzhin gda'o/ /(rin chen rgyal gyis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1992lo'i deb bzhi ba las bdams/ )105

god du rda dad dkar gozha byung zhazhi gtan rgyud/de yang rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal bo ni chu mo bya'i lor 'khrungs te dgung lo nyer dgu'i bar la rgyal srid bzung /dus nam zhig gi tshe/ rgyal bor snyung drag po zhig 'thebs pa'i tshe/ bod na sman spyad gzhung bzhin shes pa ni dkon/ zas dang / spyod lam la brten pa tsam yod pas/ sku 'tshams por bzhugs yod pa'i skabs der/ pho brang gi pu shu'i zur na/ bya yid du 'ong zhing sngar ma mthong ba gcig gis kha la shing bu lo 'dab dang bcas pa nyung shos shig khyer nas/ skad snyan sgrog gin 'dug pa rgyal bos gzigs/ sang nangs nyi shar gyi mtshams su'ang de bzhin 'dug par/ rgyal bo'ang the tshom skyes te gzigs nas shing de rnams bzhugs mal du bcug pas/ sngar med kyi shing du 'dug cing / shing de yi sne mo gcig zhal du bcug nas bro bar myangs pas/ des zhal skom pa sos/btung ba'i mchog tu mngon nas/ 6 da khyed blon 'bangs rnams nyon cig nga na ba'i skabs 'dir/ gang zhim gyi 106

bza' btung ci yang mi 'dod/ byas khyer ba'i shing bu 'di btung ba'i mchog dang / lus kyi gsos/ nad kyi sman du 'dug pas/ nga la glo ba nye ba rnams kyis shing 'di lta bu gang na 'dug pa btsal du song zhig sus rnyed na der bya dga' chen po ster nges yin/ zhes gsungs pa dang /blon 'bangs thams cad kyis bod yul gyi sa cha stod smad bar gsum kun tu btsal yang ma rnyed/ gzhan blon po rgyal bo gcig pu las bsam rgyu med pa zhig bod kyi sa mthar 'khyams 'khyams pas/ nyin mo'ang smug long gis nyi 'od g.yogs pa'i nags klong stug po zhig yod pa mthong de/nags gseb gan na shing bu de nges par yod rgyu red snyam nas phyin pas/ nags de'i tshur rol na chu chen po zhig 'dug pas/ chu la brgal ma nus/ shing de ni nags gseb na yod pa rig ste rgyal bo yid la 'khor te/ thabs zad 'u thug pa'i skabs der/ nya chen po zhig kho'i thad por nas chu der zhugs song bas/ chu kha zheng che ba ma gtogs gting la mi nub par 'dug pa shes te sems dga' nas de'i rjes la brgal te/ nags gseb tu slebs pa dang / nags tshal de phal che ba bya des 'khyer yong ba'i shing bu de yin pas/ shing de rgyab la khur bo gcig khur/107

yang bsam blo phyi ma la/ rgyal bo'i sku snyung drag par shing bu 'di phan/ 'di sa thag ring bas da lan 'khur ba'i grogs sam khal ma gcig yod na ci ma rung snyam pa'i skabs der /sha ba zhig mi 'dzems par gam du slebs byung bas/ 'di la khal 'gel rung ngam snyam nas 'gel grabs byas pa na/ ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'grub nas/ shing bu de sha bar khal gcig bkal ba dang / khos khur bo gcig khur nas lam bar du nyin zhag zla ba'i bar la song na'ang sha bas kyang khur nas/ bod rgyal bo'i pho brang mthong sar bskyal lo/ /de nas shing bu rgyal bo'i spyan sngar phul bas/ rgyal bo shin tu dgyes nas bya dga' rgya chen po bstsal te/ sku snyu nga sos pa la'ang phan thogs byung ngo / /der 'thud nas rgyal bo'i zhal nas 'di ni btung ba'i mchog tu 'dug pas/ 'di 'thung ba'i snod kyang sngar yod kyi gzi mchong dang gser dngul la sogs rin po che'i skyogs 'di rnams ma yin pa'i sngar med kyi snod cig btsal dgos par 'dug pas/ de'ang rgya nag rgyal bo la dkar yol zer ba zhi ga yod 'dug pa nyos la shog cig rigasungs —te gser yig pa btang bas/ rgya nag rgyal bos/ 6‘rgya bod gnyis 'thab mthun lan mang / bod la phan gdags pa'i ched 108

du nged kyis sman rtsis bzo gnas rol mo mkhan rim par btang na'ang / bod kyis de dag mi bsams pas/ dkar yol mi bskur/ bod rang la bzo spyad kyi rgyu yod na/ bzo mkhan btang yong ’gsungs nas/ rgya'i dkar yol bzo mkhan khrid yong ste/ bod rgyal bo'i mdun du rgyu rma tshan bsnyad pas/ des na/ rang red/ bzo bar tsasngon la rgyu dang cha rkyen ga 'dra dgos pa shod cig ’gsungs pa la/khos rgyu'i rab ni rin po che'i 'ching bu/ 'bring ni 'dzeng / tha ma rdo bo yang rung ngo’’zhes zer bas/ mdzod nas rgyu gsum po gang dgos sprad/ 6 dkar yol la rigs rnam pa mang bas/ ji ltar bzo’’zer ba la/ 6 bzo gnas kyi rigs ni sngar rgya nag du'ang ma dar ba zhig bzo dgos/dbyibs ni/ kha yangs pa/ srab pa/ zhabs dma' ba/mdog dkar la 'jam pa/ sngo mdangs ldan pa zhig dgos/ming ni/ bod na sngar med pa dar bas dar/ snod der brten pa tsam gyis tshe dang dpal 'byor 'phel bar byed pas na tshe zhes dar tshe thogs shig de dang ri mo'i rnam pa ni/ dang po 'dab chags byos/ shing khyer byung ba'i rkyen yin/ rab de'i nang du/ bya kha'i nang la shing khyer ba re phris/'bring la/ mtsho nya dang bcas pa re phris/ tha mar spang 109

ri sha bo dang bcas pa re phris/ de rnams las zhan pa byung na ri mo dang rnam grangs gang 'os bzo bos blos bcol la gyis shig rigasungs/ der bzo bas/ rgyu'i bzang ngan dwangs snyigs phyes nas/ dar tshe la rigs rnam pa drug tu bgos te/ rgyal bos bka' gnang ba gsum po la/ dar tshe/ shab tshe/ rdor tshe zhes ming btags/ phal ba gsum la/ theg tshe/ nges tshe/ brdo tshe zhes btags te/ bod dkar dar tshe'i rigs rnams 'di ni de gong rgya nag na'ang med par bshad cing / bod du ja dang dkar yol byung ba'i sngon ma 'di yin skad/ /(gser ljongs phag mo rdo rjes bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs —sgyu rtsal〉〉1988lo'i deb dang po las bdams/ )110

spun gsum wag skyawa bslud tu zhod da/dang po tsa na/ sa chu nags gsum gyi mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa'i yul zhig na/ pha kun dga' bzang bo dang / ma mtsho mo ngang yag ma gnyis phan tshun mdza' zhing brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis 'jig rten khyim thab la rol nas mi lo lnga bcu lhag song ba dang / rgan rgon gnyis la chu len me 'bud dang bza' btung g.yo sbyor la mdzangs pa'i bu mo zhig gi las dbang med na'ang / 'jig rten gyi bya ba thaca/sa cad la spobs pa che zhing blo rig yag pa'i bu mtshar sdug dang ldan pa gsum rim par rigs kyi las skal du thob pa'i bu che ba'i ming la stobs ldan dang / 'bring ba'i ming la nor ldan/ chung ba'i ming la rig ldan zhes zer zhing / bu gsum po'i khrod kyi ches chung ba rig ldan yang da lta pho lo drug gsu ma bco brgyad la son 'dug pa dang /'jig rten kha dpe nang gi bro ma la mi slong / blo pha la mi 'dri zhes pa'i na tshod la slebs 'dug mod/ don du da dung gshog 'og gi bya phrug bzhin yin pas/ pha kun 111

dga' bzang bo'i sems la da ni mi ser khyim pa ba'i 'gro lugs ltar na bu gsum po'ang 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi lam la bkod nas 'jig rten gyi bya ba dbang ba'i dus su bab 'dug kyang / bu gsum pos go kha ma gtogs pa'i sa dang pha ma ma gtogs pa'i mi mi shes par ma zad/ kho tsho gang rung la nus rtsal khyad par ba gang yang mi mnga' bas phyin chad 'tsho ba legs po zhig rol rgyu dka' thag chod red/ de bas da lta rang gi lus po da dung 'tshams shing bde ba'i go skabs 'di bzung nas bu gsum rgyal khams 'grim du bcug na mthong thos kyi rgya cher skyed zhor la lag rtsal zhig bslab na 'phyis med snyam ste/ bza' zla mtsho mo ngang yag ma dang gros bsdur gor mo rnga 'dra ba zhig byas te/bu gsum po rgyal khams la ltad mo dang sems can la mig dpe lta ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i 'tsho ba'i ched du lag rtsal zhig bslab par gtong bar kha 'chams pa red/de ltar nam mkha' la sprin byis pa'i lag mthil tsam yang med pa dang sa gzhi la mkha' dbugs gsar bas mi sems gso ba'i bkra shis shing don 'grub pa'i nyin zhig gi nam langaso kyi dang po/ nyi shar gyi rtse mo la zhogs zas zos tshar rjes/ rgan gon gnyis kyis gdong la 'dzum gyi 11 2

mtsho mo bskyil zhing ngag nas byams brtse'i glu dbyangs gyer ba'i skad rnya na gyis bu gsum po khong gnyis kyi mdun sar bos pa dang lhan du pha kun dga' bza' bos phu rung brdzes brdzes dang lag pa phur phur byed bzhin bu gsum po la 6‘khyod tsho da lta nar son nas mi che bar gyur yod na'ang / da dung mi tshe bde blag ngang skyel ba'i nus rtsal zhig mi mnga' ba red/ de ring ngas khyod tsho mi re la dngul srang brgya re ster/ khyod tshos de lam rgyags su khyer nas lag rtsal zhig bslab phyir rgyal khams nyul grabs byos/ lo gsum gyi rjes su lag rtsal yag po zhig bslabs nas phyir rang yul la shog dang / mna' ma blangs nas khyim gzhi bca'’ zhes zer/bu gsum pos a pha'i skad cha bden par go ste nyin der gra sgrig gang 'tsham 'ig byas shing sang zhogs sgo phyir bud pa dang / rgan rgon gnyis kyis bskyal nas sgo khar 'ongs te kho tshor 'bad pas lag rtsal zhig bslab dgos zhes pa'i mngag bcol gyi gtam rab dang rim par bshad cing / lhag par du a ma rgan mo bu rig ldan la sems 'phreng ba'i tshul gyis bu che 'bring gnyis la (spun chung ba da dung lo chung bas/ phyir bud rjes lta skyong byed rgyu yid la 113

zungs7zhes yang yang bshad/ skabs der pha ma gnyis dang bu gsum gyi sems 'bral ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir na'ang tshang mas so ma mgal du bcangs nas mig chu phyir khog pa'i nang bzhur du bcug pa las phyir ma phud pa red/bu spun gsum gyis pha yul rgyab tu bskyur zhing rgyal khams pang du blangs nas nyin gsum gyi ring la gom 'gros kyi rgyun bsrings pa dang / 'jig rten kha dper rang yul gad pa yin rung skyid ces pa ci ma bden/ da lta kho tshos lus la dngul srang brgya re thogs yod na'ang kha lce skom na ja hub gang dang / pho ba ltogs na zas kham gang yang rnyed mi thub pa'i gnas su lhung 'dug de nas yang dka' sdug khyad du gsod pa'i snying stobs grogs su 'then nas skom pa gram pa'i chu dang ltogs pa sgo kha'i khyi la bcol nas nyin gsum gyi ring song zhing / dpyid kyi nyi ma ring bo yang nub la nye ba'i skabs/ shar phyogs dang lho phyogs/ byang phyogs bcas su bsrings yod pa'i bgrod lam dar dkar gyi sne mo gsum 'dus pa'i mdo khar slebs pa dang / re zhig lam gang la zhugs dgos pa blo yis thag ma chod pas sa de nas mi lus ka med byung / nub mor bu spun gsum gyis nged gsum 'di ltar phyin na lag rtsal slob dka' zhing 114

bslabs kyang sna gcig ma gartogs mid pas/ so sor gyes nas rang gi 'dun ma rang gis btsal na legs zhes phan tshun gleng slong ba dang mthar mi re lam rer zhugs rgyu'i gros thag chod/ lo gsum gyi rjes su sa 'dir gdong thug brgyag pa'i phyir du/ spun gsum pos lo yi che chung ltar sa der sdong phrug che chung gsum btsugs pa dang / lo gsum 'gor rjes kyi de ring gi nyin 'dir nged spun gsum slar sa 'dir 'dus nas mnyam gcig tu yul la log par byed/ gal srid/ mi su zhig sngon du slebs na/ 'dir nyin gsum la bsgug rgyu dang / de ltar da dung gzhan pa thon ma byu nga na rang gis btsugs pa'i sdong phrug bcad de yul la log chog rjes nas 'ongs pa'i mi des khyod kyis btsugs pa'i sdong phrug de med pa mthong tshe khyod rang yul du log zin pa shes thub pas bsgug mi dgos zhes gros thog gcig la bzhag ste ngal gso byas pa red/phyi nyin nyi ma ri rtser shar dus/ mi re lam rer zhugs shing yang nyin gsum gyi yun la song ba'e mtshams der/ bu che ba stobs ldan bar snang du dud sprin nag po tha rlabs bzhin 'phyur zhing mi'i rna bar gzon pa'i sing sgra dang chom sgras gnam sa kha brdabs pa ltar byed pa'i mgar 115

bzo'i las rigs ha cang dar chi ba'i grong khyer chen po zhis tu slebs/ grong khyer 'di'i dbus nas mtha' bar du rin po che gser dang dngul/ zangs/ lcags bcas las grub pa'i mgar khang che ma chung gsum gzhung lam gyi g.yas g.yon gnyis su gral phreng bsgrigs pa dang /mgar ba rnams kyi lag rtsal gcig las gcig mtho ba'i yon tan gyis legs par spras pa'i gser dngul zangs lcags kyi spus dag cing ngo mtshar ba'i snod chas dang rgyan cha sna tshogs chu shel gyi sgrom du bshams yod pa des lta byed mig gi dbang bor rang bzhin du grub pa'i 'khrul ba yang yang ster/ bu stobs ldan yul 'di'i bzo rtsal la ha las shing kha gdangs pa dang rang nyid kyis pho lo nyi shu'i bar du 'di lta bu'i bzo rtsal gyi yon tan la bag chags tsam 'jog pa'i bsod nams shin tu dman par tshig pa za ba'am khong khro langs pa/ yang na sems phangs pa gang yin mi shes pa'i snang ba zhig shar ba dang / lam sang khos dngul srang brgya tham pa de phyir bton nas mig gis ce rer bltas/ yud tsam na/ gdong la 'dzum zhig langs bzhin sems su dngul srang brgya tham pa 'di ma rtsa byas nas dngul mgar lag rtsal can zhig da ge rgan du bsten rgyu'i dam 116

bca' bzhag pa dang / nyin 'gar rtsad gcod byas pa las/ grong khyer de na dngul mgar dpal mgon zhes snyan grags can zhig yod pa shes byung zhing / grong khyer de'i shar phyogs kyi cha na/ bzo bkod kyi rnam pa rgya mi che rung 'grul ba 'tshang kha 'khrigs se yod pa'i tshong khang zhig mthong zhing phyin pa na/ tan tan dngul mgar dpal mgon gyis gnyer ba'i tshong khang yin pa dang / khong gis brdungs pa'i thon rdzas rnams gcig las gcig spus dag cing ngo mtshar bas bu stobs ldan gyi yid drangs shing / de mur lo drug cu lhag la son yang sha mdangs rgyas yod pa'i dngul mgar dpal mgon gyi mdun sar pus mo'i lha nga sar btsugs nas 'ong don dang 'dod pa lhug par brjod de dge rgan du bkur ba red/ de nas bzung bu stobs ldan gyis dngul mgar gyi lag rtsal la slob sbyong byas pa dang / lo gsum 'gor rjes kho rang dngul mgar lag rtsal can zhig tu gyur par ma zad/ dngul yang mang po zhig gsog thub pa byung bas khos rta pho grug zheng che la mgo sna mtho ba zhig nyos nas sga chas legs par brgyan zhing /de'i steng du 'chib te phyir pha yul du log grabs byas/bu 'bring ba nor ldan yang rngam che zhing brjid chags //7

pa'i bzo bkod shel dkar gyi brag ri du ma gyen du bslangs pa'i yang steng na kha dog sna lnga bkra ba'i dar dang ba dan gyi lda ldi rlung gi rgyal mtshan ltar g.yo zhing / tshong zong gi tshogs sna 'dzoms pa'i khang brtsegs rnams bstud mar gzhung lam gyi 'gram gnyis su krong nger 'gying ba'i zil shugs kyis par 'gro tshur 'ong byed pa'i tshong 'grul shwa 'od brdol ba gcong rong zab mo'i gting ring du drangs pa ltar byed cing / mtshams mtshams su bshams pa'i khrom dang tshong ra so sor tshong rdzas khra chil ler snang ba me tog sna tshogs bkra ba'i dbyar kha'i spang gzhung zhig dang mtshungs/mi re'i lag na tshong re dang phan tshun nyo tshong gi 'du 'dzi grog tshang kha yi rdo leb bkog pa ltar byed pa'i tshong las ha cang dar che ba'i grong khyer 'khrug po zhig tu slebs/ grong khyer der sdod pa'i khyim tshang rnams gcig la bltas na gcig phyug pa dang bu nor ldan gyis 'gram chu ldang bzhin dngul srang brgya tham pa de ma rtsa byas nas tshong ba'i shes bya slob pa'i sems thag bcad/ cang ma 'gor bar tshong la mkhas pa'i dge rgan zhig kyang ngo shes thub pa byung bas/lo gsum 'gor rjes/ tshong ba chen po zhig tu gyur par ma zad/ dngul mang po bsags pa red/ khos sha shed rgyas 116

pa'i drel zhig dang sga srab cha tshang zhig nyos te legs par brgyan nas drel la 'chib te phyir yul du log grabs byas/sngar kha gyes sar slebs tshe/ spun che ba'ang der slebs nas nyin gcig 'gor 'dug khong gnyis phan tshun ngo 'phrad tshe dga' spro dpag tu med pa skyes shing / spun chung ba yong bar nyin gcig bsgugs kyang kho'i grib ma tsam yang mthong rgyu med gshis/ sun sna nga skyes pa'i khar yul la log 'dod kyi zhen pa'ang shub/sa drag stabs/ rang rang gi sdong phrug bcad de dga' lhang lhang gi nyams kyis rta drel gnyis kyi 'gros 'gran bzhin yul du log pa red/bu chung ba rig ldan yang phu bo gnyis dang kha bral rjes/nyin gsum song ba'i mtshams der/ pi wang dang gling bu/rgyud mangs/ sil snyan/ rnga sbug sogs rol mo'i bye brag bco brgyad dkrol ba dang rdung ba'i sgra dbyangs kyis rna ba bdud rtsi'i bang mdzod du byed pa'i rol chas dang zlos gar ha cang dar ba'i grong khyer chen po dri za'i 'jig rten dang gnyis su ma mchis pa zhig la slebs shing / skabs der/grong khyer de 'i gzhi mdo rnams su phul du byung ba'i 'chor sgeg can rgyan gos kyi khyad par rmad du byung ba klubs pa'i snyes phran dang / gzhon nu ma la sogs pas glu gar rtsed 1

'jo'i bye brag sna tshogs pa 'khrab cing ston pa des bu rig ldan gyi yid kyi dbang bo ma lus par 'phrog cing lta byed zung ni bris pa'i ri mo ltar yun ring du bkod 'dug pa lta bur gyur pas/ kho'i sems su 'jig rten gyi khams chen po 'dir mi'i rigs kyi ches phul du byung ba'i shes bya'i grogs po zhig ni glu gar yin pa yang dag tu go zhing / de'i yon tan yun ring du longs spyod thub pa'i skal ba zhig ldan na ci 'dra'i bde skyid cig red ang snyam bzhin rol mo slob pa'i sems thag bcad pa red/ de nas rig ldan gyis dge rgan zhig btsal bsams te khrom srang nyul ba dang / shing yo 'bag gi sdong chen zhig mnga' ba'i 'og tu mi tshogs rgya mtsho bzhi na du 'dus shing / de'i dbus su lo na bgres shing dbu skra dung ltar dkar ba'i rgan po zhig gis rin po che'i rgyud las grub pa'i rgyud mangs sbreng ba'i sgra snyan zhing 'jebs pa des mi rnams kyi goms 'gros spo mtshams 'jog pa dang / 'dab chags bya yi rigs kyang ma bos bzhin du sdong 'gor 'dus shing la la zhig sgra dbyangs kyis myos nas thang la lhung ba'i cho ga ngo mtshar ba mthong ba dang / myur du rgyud mangs shig nyos nas rgan po de dge rgan du bsten pa red/120

de nas bzung / bu rig ldan gyis lo gsum gyi ring rol mo slob sbyong byed pa'i brtun pa bskyed cing / da lta rol mo rdung tshe sdong 'go'i bya'ang thang la lhung bar byed/kho dge rgan dang kha bral skabs lam rgyags tshar nas dngul srang gang yang med par rkang ba gnyis kyi 'gros la brten nas phyir yul du log bu rig ldan sngon phu bo gnyis dang kha bral ba'i sa der slebs tshe/ phu bo gnyis kyis rang rang gis btsugs pa'i sdong phrug bcad de log song ba dang / rig ldan gyis tshul 'di mthong nas sems ha cang sdug cing gnyen mi rnams dran byung / myur bar rang yul bsnyeg 'dod kyi bsam blos ltogs skom dang dka' ngal khyad du bsad nas nyin mtshan med par lam du skyod/de ltar rig ldan gyis ltogs skom bsran te yul gyi sgo khar slebs pa dang nang du bltas pa na/ rta drel gnyis btags yod pa mthong zhing phu bo gnyis rgyu thog la bud nas log 'ongs pa rtogs pa red/ sgo nang nas yar 'dzul tsam du pha ma gnyis da dung sku lus bde bar bzhugs pa mthong bas kho dga' spro chen po skyes mod/ yin na'ang /kho tshos bu rig ldan lag pa gnyis stong bar gzhan sgo nyul 121

ba'i sprang bo zhig gi bzo lta ston bzhin log 'ongs par sna shu rgyag pa dang / lhag par du pha rgan khong khro me ltar 'bar te/ skad dwag chen pos‘ ngo tsha med pa'i khyi phrug gan/ngas khyod song la lag rtsal zhig slob shog ces pa ma gtogs/sus khyod sprang bo'i bya ba slob par btang ba yin/ mar song / sprang bo'i rjes mi 'ded par yul la yong nas ci byedanya ces gshe gshe btang zhing / phu bo gnyis kyis kyang de dang bstun nas mthong chung gi mig 'od 'phangs/lo na rgan pa'i a ma ngus shing spyan chab 'don pa las skad cha gcig kyang bshad ma thub/ de nas snying rje ba'i rig ldan yang rang yul dang kha bral ba dang / 'gro sa yul med du gyur gshis/ 'u thug pa'i sems su da ni chu'am brag la lding nas rang srog gcod pa las 'dun lam gang yang med ces bsams shing song bar/ nam zhig mtsho chen po zhig gi khar slebs/ skabs der/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nam mkhar 'phags shing 'od dkar 'phros pa'i 'og mtsho mo sngo ting nge / khu sum mer 'dugabu rig ldan mtsho 'gram gyi rdo pha bong zhig la bsdad de/ sems la nga ma shi ba'i sngon du lo gsum la dka' sdug gis sbyangs pa'i rol mo mgo nas mjug bar sbreng rjes mtsho 121

la lding bsams nas phrab/ nas rgyud ra/ngas blangs nyi ngabyangs gcig las gcig skyo ba'i ngang sbreng bas mtsho nang du zla ba'i bu mor gsol ston sgrig bzhin pa'i klu'i rgyal bo'ang skyo snang gis gzir nas sdod ma bzod par/ bu mo gsum yod pa las che bar khyod song la ltos dang / phyi nas rgyud mangs sbreng mkhan de su yin 'dug kho'i sems na gleng mi tshar ba'i sdig gtam zhig shod rgyu yod pa kho thag red/ de ltar min na 'di lta bu'i yid skyo ba zhig ci phyir sbreng srid’ ces smras/ bu mo che ba mtsho khar yong nas bltas tshe/ sprang phrug zhig gis rgyud mangs sbreng bzhin pa mthong / kho mos kha ya ma byas par phyir log par/ klu rgyal cung mi dga' ba'i tshul gyis khyod kyis sgra tsam ma gtogs dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug la nyan mi shes/ bu mo 'bring ba khyod song la ltos shog’’ces smras/ bu mo 'bring ba mtsho khar phyin nas bltas pa na/ sprang phrug zhig gis der rgyud mangs sbreng bzhin gda'/ kho mos kyang kha ya ma byas par phyir log de nas klu rgyal gyis yang bu mo chung ba khyod song la ltos shog’nyaces bshad pa ltar bu mo chung ba yang mtsho khar song nas blta sa pa na/ sngon gyi las 'phro'i dbang gis bu rig ldan gyi yid du 'ong ba'i sku'i yon tan gyis kho mo'i lus 123

kyi ba spu'i bu ga re rer dga' ba'i snang ba byin par ma zad/snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i rgyud mangs sbreng ba'i dbyangs kyis re zhig kho mo mtsho khar ci byed du 'ong ba yang brjed bcug pa red/ 6 bdag gi pha ma gnyis kyis khyod pho brang du 'bod kyin yod/ gal srid khyod la 'gel log gi gnas tshul yod na/ kho tshos rogs ram byed srid’’ces kho mos gdung sems chen pos smras shing / bu rig ldan gyis thos 'phral dga' ba dang mtshar ba dus gcig la skyes byung ba ste/ bu mo 'di ltar gzugs mdzes lang tsho dang ldan pa zhig gang nas 'ong bar ya mtshar ba dang rang la gdung sems byed pa'i mi yod pas shi lam du 'gro ma dgos par dga' spro skyes pa red/ kho bu mo'i rjes 'brangs te klu'i rgyal bo'i mdun du slebs pa dang rgyal bos 'dzum dmul dmul gyis ya/degasar bu/ rgyud mangs sbreng ba ngo ma snyan mo yin 'dug yin na'ang yid de 'dra skyo ba'i rgyu mtshan ci’’zhes dris par/ bu rig ldan gyis tshungs lo gsum la sdug myangs nas rgyud mang sa bslabs pa dang dngul srang brgya tham pa bkol/ yin na'ang 'tsho ba rol byed kyi lag rtsal zhig slob ma thub par sprang bo'i las ka 'di bslabs pas//bo bo'i a pha dang phu bo rnams kyis dma' 'bebs dang 124

mthong chung gis phyir phud de 'gro sa med pa'i phyir/ nga'i yid mi skyo na su'i yid skyo’’zhes bshad rjes mig gnyis las mchi ma mu tig gi phreng ba chad pa ltar lhung / klu rgyal gyis bu rig ldan la sne len yag po byas shing /nyin gsum la khos bslabs tshad kyi rgyud mangs sbreng du bcug dga' snang gis khengs pa'i rol dbyangs sbreng tshe mtsho nang du gnas pa'i srog chags rnams rang dbang med par gar la 'jug cing / skyo snang gis khengs pa'i rol mo sbreng tshe kun gyis yid skyo ba'i mig chu sham sham du bzhur/klu'i rgyal bo dang bu mo rnams kyi gdong la'ang de bzhin du skabs rer dga' skyid kyi dgod 'dzum grol zhing skabs rer sdug nag gi mdud pa rgyaganyin bzhi bar slebs tshe/ bu mo chung bas rig ldan la zunga'i a phas khyod la ston mo bsgrigs te rin po che gser dngul tshim par sbyin pa dang phyir mi yul du log nas 'byor phyug gi 'tsho ba rol du 'jug mod/ nga'i bsam par khyod kyis de rnams ma len par bdag gi pha ma gnyis kyis lkog tu sbas yod pa'i g.yu yi bum pa zhig yod pa de slongs shigakhyod kyis gang 'dod de las thon srid kyi red’ ces blo rig bslabs/ bu rig ldan gyis bu mo chung bas bshad pa 125

ltar gser dang dngul/ mu men sogs rin po che gang yang ma blangs par g.yu yi bum pa de bslangs pa na/ klu rgyal yab yum zung ya mtshar zhing ha las pa/ blo 'phreng zhing gtong mi phod pa'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs bstan na yang / gsang gros shig byas rjes bu rig ldan gyi 'dod pa bskangs pa red/ bu rig ldan gyis rgyud mangs dang g.yu'i bum pa gnyis thogs te mtsho khar phyin pa dang lam chen zhig la zhugs te yun ring du song bar me tog rnam par bkra ba'i spang ljongs shig la slebs shing ngal dub dang ltogs skom kyis mnar nas gom kha je dal je lci la song bas bu mo chung ba'i skad cha rna lam du grags shing tshod lta zhig bya snyam ste/ 6 g.yu'i bum pa’’zhes thengs gsum brjod de sems su nga la za ma g.yos sbyor la mkhas pa'i chung ma zhig yod na ci ma rung zhes dran ma thag tu g.yu'i bum pa'i nang nas bu mo chung ba de phyir thon nas khong la zas chu skol ba'i bya ba rdzogs par byas rjes/ slar bum pa'i nang du 'dzul grabs byed skabs/ bu rig ldan gyis 'phral du bum pa'i kha bcad cing 'dzul du ma bcug bu mo'i gdong dmar bor gyur cing ngag sgo dma' mos khyod kyis zas la spyod 'dod pa min nam’ zhes smras na yang / re zhig kho bu mo'i mdzes /26

sdug la had de lus pa red/de nas bu mo chung ba'i blo bkod ltar khong gnyis kus mtshan brgyab nas rig ldan gyi yul dang mi ring ba'i sar bde thang zhig yod pa der phyin pa na/ chung mas rig ldan khyod kyis ngal gso byos dang / ngas gzhi brdungs nas khang ba 'gebs/ khyod kyis nga'i ming nas gtan nas 'bod mi rung zhes bshad pa dang / yud tsam na mun pa'i gling la slebs pa ltar ci yang mi mthong zhing de nas rim bzhin je gsal la song ba dang mnyam du brjid chags pa'i khyim gzhis shig mig lam du shar byung /bu rig ldan gyis tshul de mthong ste kha yang zum mi thub par gyur/nam langs rjes/ chung mas rig ldan la khyod de ring phu bo gnyis mgron por 'bod du songanya’zhes par/ rig ldan khong khro langs bzhin kha sang kho gnyis kyis nga phyir phud pa dang de ring nga'i khyim du mgron la 'bod par ngo mi tsha'am ’zhes khro gtam bshad par/ chung ma dgod zhor du ra khyod sgo phyir bud nas lo gsum 'gor song ba red/nged tshang nas nyin zhag gsum bsdad pa de mi yul gyi lo gsum yin/ phu bo gnyis kyis khyim thab bcos nas lo 127

gcig lhag song bas khyod da dung khong khro langs 'dug pa ga la rung ’zhes kha ta byas/ rig ldan gyis kho mo 'i skad cha dang mdun gyi 'gyur ldog rnams la lta bzhin sems su 'di thams cad sgyu ma mkhan gyi rdzu 'phrul zhig gam/ yang na rmi lam yin snyam yang brjod ma nus par phu bo gnyis 'bod du song /phu bo gnyis kyis rig ldan sgo phyir phud rjes/ rgyu stobs la brten nas gzugs skyes 'bras yag cing lag las ka med pa'i sru mo sdod la dga' ba gnyis bsus yod/sru mo de gnyis kyis pha ma gnyis la zhabs tog sgrub rgyu phar zhog de las ldog ste khag khur du gyur 'dugaphu bo gnyis mgron du phebs pa'i lam thog tu/ ha cang the tshom gyi sgos khyod kyis nged gnyis gang la khrid bsam pa yin zhes par/ rig ldan gyis dal brel med par 6‘nga'i khyim du mgron por bos pa yin’’zhes lan btab pa dang / thag ring du ma song bar khyim gzhis gsar ba zhig mthong bas khong gnyis kyis mig che cher bgrad de sems su kha sang 'di da dung sa stong yin/ zhag gcig gis 'di 'dra'i khyim gzhis shig ji ltar chags pa yin/ 'di rmi lam mam/ yang na 'dre'i cho 'phrul yin zhes yin min 128

bco brgyad dran bzhin pa'i skabs su/ khebs rgya yangs shing brjid chags pa'i khyim gzhis gsar ba zhig gi nang du slebs pa dang / yid du 'ong zhing lang tsho dar ba'i bu mo zhig gis ldem ldem 'khyug 'khyug gi zhabs bro rdung ba'i brtul zhugs dang du blangs te skad cig nyid la zas kyi sder kha sna tshogs bsgrigs shing 'grul rtsis byas par/ phu bo gnyis mdzangs ma de'i lang tsho'i gzhon sha chags pa'i mdzes sdug dang lag las ka sogs la kha gdangs shing lce snar bzhin tshig gcig kyang smra ma nus/za ma zos rjes/ phu bo gnyis kyis gom gsum gcig tu bsdus nas phyir yul du log ste pha ma gnyis dang chung ma rnams la rgyu mtshan ma lus pa zhus par/ pha kun dga' bzang bo dang mna' ma gnyis kyis yid ches byed pa las ldog ste‘ khyod gnyis kyis rmi lam rmis pa'am/ yang na 'dres bzung ba red ces 'phya smod dang gshe gshe btang na'ang / ma mtsho mo ngang yag ma mig mdun gyi 'tsho bar yid pham pa'i khar de ring glo bur du bu rig ldan gyi gnas tshul thos byung bas dga' skyo'i mig chu lo ma/'i zil ba sprugs pa ltar lhung /skabs der/ rig ldan khyo shug zung phebs pa dang pha 12 9

ma gnyis mthong 'phral pus mo sa la btsugs te spun zla kha gyes nas khyim thab 'dzugs skabs/ pha ma gnyis kyis bu chung ba dang mnyam gcig tu 'tsho ba rol rgyu de nga tsho'i mi rigs kyi goms srol zhig yin gshis/ da lta pha ma gnyis kho bo'i khyim du gdan drangs pa phu bo dang sru mo rnams la 'khang ra med par zhu’ zhes smras shing pha ma gnyis skyor nas kho'i khyim du log pa red/de nas bzung / rig ldan khyo shug pha ma la bzang zhing / pha ma gnyis kyis kyang bu dang mna' mar sems 'phreng ba'i tshul gyis kho tshos bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol ba yin no//(rnam sras kyis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1986lo'i deb bzhi ba las bdams/ )— 130

nya zha dad gager nya/gna' snga mo zhig gi dus na/ klu 'bum g.yu mtsho zhes dgung a sngon thang la bting 'dra'i mtsho mo zhig gi 'gram ngogs su/ lo gang zhig gi ring la zhig ral du gyur pa'i ra chag gru bzhi ma zhig yod pa'i nang du/ dbyar gsum char ba dang dgun gsum bu yug mi khog pa'i khang chag phag tshang 'dra ba zhig yod la/ de'i nang na mi lo bzhi bcu'i them skas thog tu rkang ba spos 'dug pa'i nya ba bza' mi gnyis yod de/ kho bza' mi gnyis la sha las chad pa'i bu phrug gcig gi ming dang / sgo la 'dogs pa'i phyugs zog gcig gi spu tsam yang med par/ nam yang bkres ltogs sdug bsngal gyi 'tsho ba'i nang du nyin thog zla dang zla thog lo brtsegs nas mi lo bzhi bcu ring gi nyin zhag re rer 'gro thabs 'dug thabs byas/nyin zhig nya bas dus rgyun ltar klu 'bum g.yu mtsho nang la nya rgya 'phangs te yar mtsho khar 'then pa na/ nya rgyu'i nang du sbal ba mthe bong tsam zhig ma gtogs nya phrug 131

gcig kyang zin med pas/ nya bas ‘nged bza' mi gnyis la sbal ba mthe bong khyod 'dra zhig gis ci bya’’zhes sbal ba de phyir mtsho nang la btang ste nya rgya thengs gnyis pa mtsho nang la 'phangs nas yar 'then rjes/ nya rgya'i nang du yang dung dkar sen mo tsam zhig las gzhan ci yang med pas/nya bas sngar bzhin dung dkar de phyir mtsho nang la btang ste nya rgya thengs gsum pa mtsho nang la 'a phangs nas yar mtsho kha la 'then skabs/ glo bur du ci yin 'di yin ma shes par nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu'i gser mdog gi 'od stong zhig lam lam 'phro ba dang mnyam du/ nya rgya'i nang du gser 'od 'khyug 'khyug dang / lta ba mig gis mi bzod pa'i khyad par can gyi gser nya zhig yod pas/ nya bas sems nas 'di ni dkon mchog gsum phos nged bza' mi gnyis la gnang ba'i kha bsod red bsams te lcags kyu'i khab gzung len skabs/ gser nya des mig gnyis las mchi ma bzhur bzhin 'di ltar mi skad bshad byung /ra kwa ye bdag la gson dang //nya ba rin chen don grub//khyod kyi yid sems nyid ni//dkar bo dung dang 'dra ba'i//132

mgo nag mi zhig yin na//las dman nya mo bdag la//snying rje'i spyan gyis gzigs nas// lcags kyu'i khab gzung gis ni//nya mo'i srog la ma gnod//las dang bsod nams dbang gis//mtsho mo 'di la gnas pa'i//lto dkar nya mo nga nyid//de ring nya ba khyod kyi//nya rgya'i dol la 'khor song //'jig rten gnam 'og 'di na//sa la mtho dma' shor nas//ri dang la lung chags 'dug /dus la khyad par yod pas/ / dbyar dgun ston dpyid mi 'dra//mi la dbul phyug shor nas//phyug po med po'i dpon po//med po phyug po'i g.yog po//ma gyur sems can thams cad//srog la sbom phra yod pas//133

btsan pos gnyom chung gtses shing //che bas chung ba bsad de//gcig gi lus kyi sha khrag /gcig gis kha zas byas te//sdug dang 'jigs skrag sna tshogaca///rlung 'tshub ji bzhin 'das rjes//slar yang drag char 'byung ba'i//lugs dang srol gyi dpe 'di//ma lus sems can 'gro ba'i//'gyur med chos nyid yin na//'jig rten gnam 'og 'di ru//las dang rgyu 'bras zhes pa'i//snyan 'jebs sgrung gtam 'dra zhig /sgra 'dzin rna bas thos kyang //don du rgyu 'bras brtsi ba'i//gnas tshul ri bong ra co//'dren byed mig gis ma mthong //yang gcig bdag la gson dang //nya ba rin chen don grub//khyo / kyang las dbang dman pas//134

'jig rten mi yul 'di na//dal 'byor mi lus rin chen//thob kyang mtsho kha 'di ru//nya ba'i skye ba langs nas//dbyar dgun ston dpyid med par//'khyag grang bkres ltogs myangs pa//lto dkar nya mo bdag gis// gangs dkar sems nas shes mod//'on te nya mo nga yis//nya ba rin chen don grub//khyod la snying rje skyes te//nya mo'i lus kyi sha khrag /ma lus khyod la byin rung //khyod dang chung ma'i 'tsho ba//sngar bzhin sdug bsngal nang du//'gro thabs 'dug thabs yin phyir//nya ba rin chen don grub//mgo nag mi yi khrod na//byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje//yod pa'i mi zhig dkon rung // 135

stobs 'byor rgyu dang dbang cha//'dod pa'i mi ni mang bas//nya ba rin chen don grub//khyod rang de 'dra yin na//lcags kyu'i khab gzung gis ni//nya mo'i lus la ma gnod//mtsho mo 'di la thongs dang //gser gyi rma bya dgos kyang //mtsho 'di'i nang na yod stabs//nya ba khyod la byin chog /g.yu yi ne tso dgos kyang //mtsho 'di'i gting na yod gshis//nya ba khyod la byin chog /byu ru'i sdong bo dgos kyang //mtsho 'di'i nang na yod phyir//nya ba khyod la byin chog /gon pa gos dang tsha ru//btung ba dgun chang mngar mo//bza' ba sbrang rtsi ka ra//rgyu zog rta nor lug gsum//136

nya ba khyod la byin chog /nya mo mtsho la gtong rogs//’ nya mos de skad bshad rjes/ nya bas sems la 'di ni khyad par can gyi gser nya zhig yin shas che bas tshe thar la gtong ba las gsod nyan rgyu ma red bsams te 'di skad bshad byung /6 e ma ya mtshan can gyi//klu rigs gser gyi nya mo//khyod la sgra 'dzin rna ba//yod na gzhan la ma/ g.yeng //las dman nya ba bdag gis//bshad pa'i gtam la nyon dang //'jig rten mi yul 'di na//las dang bsod namasadaman pas//bdag gi pha mes yang mes /thams cad mtsho kha 'di ru//nya ba'i skye ba langs nas//mi rabs du ma 'gor song //nya ba rin chen don grub//nga yang mtsho kha 'di nas//137

mi lo bzhi bcu'i ring la//nya mo khri ma 'bum stong //nya rgya'i dol la bzung rung // khyod 'dra'i ya mtshan can gyi//nya zhig mig gis ma mthong //lo chung byis pa'i dus su//drin chen pha ma'i ngag las//ya mtshan can gyi gser nya//yod pa'i gtam rgyud sna tshogs//thos 'dzin rna bas go rung //snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i ngag las//yid 'phrog mi skad shes pa'i//khyod 'dra'i rin chen gser nya//mtsho mo 'di na gnas pa//las dman nya ba kho bos// de ring ma gtogs ma shes//ya nga gcig bdag la gson dang //yid 'ongs gser gyi nya mo//mdzes sdug bzhin ras steng nas//sems sdug nyams 'gyur ma ston//—1 38

smra shes mgrin pa'i lam las//skrag 'dar ngu skad ma shor//'dren byed mig gi mtha' ru//skyo gdung mchi ma ma 'khyil//las dman nya ba bdag gi /yid sems dran pa skyo byung //las dang bsod nams dbang gis//bdag kyang mtsho kha 'di ru//nya ba'i skye ba langs pas//byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i//snying rje'i dpal gyi 'bras bu//nya ba rin chen don grub// bdag yid zhing sa'i steng du//'di zhes mthong rgyu med kyang //las dang rgyu 'bras brtsi ba'i//cha rgyus can gyi grogs shig /bdag yid mgron khang nang du//nam yang mnyam 'dug yin gshis//lcags kyu'i khab gzung gis ni//gser gyi nya mo'i srog la//139

mi 'dod gnod pa mi byed//nya rgya'i phyi la blangs nas//mtsho mo 'di la btang chog /da dung sprang rgan bdag la//gson dang gser gyi nya mo//'jig rten gnam 'og 'di yi//mgo nag mi lus rin chen//ha lam rgyu dang dbang la//dga' ba'i bsam pa yod kyang //las dman nya ba bdag la//de 'dra'i ham pa med do//bdag 'dra'i sprang khyim zhig la//gser gyi rma bya yod kyang //'tsho ba'i skyid la mi 'gro//mtha' mjug dpon pos 'phrog 'gro//bdag 'dra'i sprang khyim zhig la//byu ru'i sdong bo'i mgo na//g.yu yi ne tso yod kyang //mdzes pa'i rgyan la mi 'gro//mtha' mjug btsan pos 'phrog 'gro//140

gon pa gos dang tsha ru//btung ba dgun chang zhim po//bza' ba ka ra sprang rtsi//rgyu zog rta nor lug gsum//mtsho mo 'di na yod pa'i//ma lus rgyu nor thams cad//bdag la gcig kyang mi dgos//las dman nya ba bdag la//nad kyis bar chad med par//sgyu lus bde bar gnas na//rgyu dang dbang cha med kyang //nya ba bdag la skyon med//'jig rten gnam 'og 'di na//rgyu yod rgyu med gnyis las//rgyu med sprang rgan bdag 'dra//khri ma 'bum stong yod pas//dbang la 'dod pa nga med//rgyu la ham pa nga med//de phyir ya mtshan can gyi// yid 'ongs gser gyi nya mos//141

sems nas sdug bsngal ma byed//rang 'dod 'khyug 'gros byed bzhin//mtsho mo'i gting la song chog /mi nya bas de skad bshad bzhin gser 'od lam lam 'khyug pa'i nya mo de mtsho mo'i nang la btang ba na/ mdzes sdug yid du 'ongs pa'i gser nya des/ dga' spro'i ngang nas 'khyug 'khyug byed bzhin nya ba la skor gsum brgyab rjes 'di skad du/6 e ma las dman nya mo//bdag gi gtam la nyon dang //nya ba rin chen don grub//khyod la byang chub sems dpa'i//snying rje'i yid sems ldan pas//de ring nyi ma'i phyin chad//lto dkar nya mo kho bos//nya ba khyod kyi bka' drin//nam yang brjed thabs mi 'dug /nam zhig nya mo nga rang //nya ba khyod la mkho dus//klu 'bum g.yu mtshor 'bod pa'i//142

mtsho mo 'di yi kha nas//nya mo bde skyid sgrol ma//zer bzhin thengs gsum bos tshe//lto dkar nya mo nga nyid//mtsho kha 'di la slebs yong //’’nya mos de skad bshad rjes/ gser 'od 'khyug 'khyug byed bzhin mtsho mo'i gting la 'dzul song / de nas nya ba phyir rang khyim la yong nas de ring gi gnas tshul thams cad ji ma ji bzhin chung ma lha mo chos mtsho la bshad pa na/ chung ma'i 'dzum ma dgod kyi gdong mdog glo bur du dmar nag tu gyur nas kho la 'di skad bshad byung /smyo‘kwa ye sprang rgan rin chen don grub khyod//rna ba gzhan la ma g.yeng bdag la gson//'jig rten mgo nag mi yi yul 'di na//khyod las blun pa'i mi zhig gang na yod//kha ba can gyi gna' mi'i gtam dpe la//blun po zog dang 'dra ba'i sprang bo yis//rin chen gser dngul rnyed kyang rdo la snang //zer ba'i dpe de khyod 'dra'i mi la bshad//yar bltas a sngon mthon po'i 'og 'di na//143

sa la mtho dma' med pa'i 'jig rten med//mi la dbul phyug med pa'i yul gru med//srid la btsan gnyom med pa'i rgyal bo med//dbang la che chung med pa'i dpon po med//'gro ba kho na bsam pa'i sangs rgyas med//rgyu la ham pa med pa'i bla ma med//las dang rgyu 'bras 'jal ba'i rgya ma med//rgyal blon bla chen sku drag thams cad kyang //dbang dang rgyu la ham pa yod pas na//sgo na rgyu zog ra ma'i spu tsam dang //nang na rgyu nor khab rtse tsam med pa'i //sprang bo'i rgyud pa rin chen don grub khyod//rgyu dang dbang la ham pa med don ci//las dman bud med lha mo chos mtsho bdag /khyod kyi sprang khyim 'di la yong nas bzung //nangs snga dgong 'phyi med par dka' sdug myangs//kha zas zhim mngar can zhig zos ni med//rgyab gos drod 'jam can zhig gon ni med//rgyu zog ra ma'i spu zhig mthong ma myong //rgyu nor zhig gi ming tsam thos ma myong //144

nang nas bltas na sgo yi skar mda' rig /sgo nas bltas na nang gi me mda' mthong //dgong mor thab me 'bar yang mgo skyon med//nangs mor chu khol gdus kyang 'jib ya med//de 'dra yin rung blun po sprang rgan khyos//rgyu dang dbang cha mi dgos zer don ci//gser gyi rma bya byu ru'i sdong bo dang //rta nor lug dang dbang thang longs spyod sogs//khyod kyi sprang khyim 'di la mi 'os shing //char dang kha ba 'gog pa'i shing khang zhig /mkho ba'i skad cha bshad na mi chog gam//kwa ye gson dang blun po sprang bo'i rgyud//nangs mor shar phyogs ri bo'i rtse mo nas//nyi ma'i 'od zer sa la 'phro ba'i skabs//khyod nyid klu 'bum ma tsho mo'i khar song ste//char dang kha ba 'gog pa'i shing khang zhig /mkho ba'i rgyu mtshan gser nya'i rna bar shod// ’de'i phyi nyin nyi ma'i 'od zer sa la 'phro skabs/ chung ma lha mo chos mtshos bshad pa ltar nya ba mtsho khar song ste/nya mo bde skyid sgrol ma zhes lan gsum bos pa na/ mtsho nang 145

du gsir 'od lam lam 'khyug pa dang mnyam du/ mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i gser nya de nya ba'i mdun du slebs byung /nya bas chung mas bshad pa thams cad gsang ba med pa'i sgo nas gser nya la bshad rjes/ gser nya des gshog zung gis zlos gar 'khyug bzhin nya ba la 'di skad bshad byung / 6 e ma bdag la gson dang bka' drin can gyi nya ba//khyod kyis sems sdug ma byed//dga' dga' skyid skyid byos dang //gang gis bshad pa thams cad//nya mo nga yis shes song //nya mo bdag gi mgrin las//bkra shis thengs gsum bos na//khyod dang chung ma'i re ba//tshegs med lhun gyis grub 'ong //yang gcig bdag la gson dang //nya ba rin chen don grub//ta la'i shing gi lo ma//'di go lag tu bzung nas//sems sdug skyo snang med par// 146

rang gi khyim du song rjes// do dgong khyod dang chung ma/// skyid po'i mal la nyal skabs// ta la'i shing gi lo ma// ོ 'di go sngas mgor zhog dang //phyi nyin shar gyi phyogs su//gser 'od stong ldan 'phro dus//khyod dang chung ma'i bsam don//'dren byed mig gis mthong thub//’’nya bas ta la'i shing gi lo ma de bzung nas phyir rang khyim la yong rjes/ gser nyas bshad pa thams cad go rim ltar gcig gcig gnyis gnyis byas te rang gi chung mar bshad pa dang / dgong mo mal du nyal skabs ta la'i shing gi lo ma de kho bza' mi gnyis kyi sngas mgor bzhag ste/rang rang sa nas yid la 'char snang sna tshogs shig dran bzhin bde mo gnyid kyi 'jig rten du shor song / de'i phyi nyin dgung nyi ma'i 'od zer sa la 'phro skabs/ nya ba bza' mi gnyis kyi mig lam du/ kho tshang gi khang chag phag tshang 'dra ba de glo bur du ha cang che zhing yid du 'ongs pa'i shing khang gsar ba zhig tu gyur 'dug pas/ kho bza' mi 147

gnyis kyis phan tshun gyi gdong la lta bzhin dga' spro chin mo skyes byung / de nas bde skyid ngang nyin lnga drug tsam zhig 'gor rjes chupam lha mo chos mtshos nya ba rin chen don grub la 'di skad du/‘‘kwa ye bdag la gson dang //sprang rgan rin chen don grub// 'jig rten gnam 'og 'di na//khyod las blun pa'i mi zhig /btsal rung rnyed rgyu mi 'dug /pha mes yang mes ring nas//sprang rgan khyod kyi ring la//khyim gyi rgyu nom 'di dang //sgo yi rgyu zog 'di zhes//ming tsam ston rgyu med pas//char dang kha ba 'gog pa'i/ /shing khang 'di go yod kyang //khyim 'a di'i skyid la mi 'gro//ltos dang phyug po'i sgo na//rgyu zog khri ma 'bum stong //gson dang yod po'i khyim du//148

dar gos 'bru yi mdzod khang //gzigs dang dpon po'i 'og tu//g.yog 'khor lnga brgya drug brgya//'byor ldan phyug po'i chung ma'i//gon pa lug chung tsha ru//btung ba 'o ma dkar go/bza' ba sha mar thud gsum//nyin zhag gsum gyi ring la//las ka ljid mo rang med// mi rabs gsum gyi ring la// ༷rgyu dang 'byor ba 'dzad med// phun sum tshogs pa'i 'tsho ba//nam yang longs su spyod 'dug /dbang chen dpon po'i chung ma'i//gon pa gos chen 'brug ma//btung ba zhim po dgun chang //bza' ba mngar mo sbrang rtsi//thun gsum 'tsho ba'i nang du//bkres ltogs gdung ba myangs med//dbang dang stobs la 'dzad med//141

bde zhing skyid po'i 'tsho ba//nam yang longs su spyod 'dug /yang gcig bdag la ltos dang //sprang rgan rin chen don grub//dbang med lha mo chos mtsho//rgyu med sprang khyim 'di nas//mo lo bzhi bcu'i ring la//gon pa spu med ra lpags// btung ba ja med chu nag /bza' ba snum med ldum tshod//bkres skom ltogs sdug nang gi /sdug 'tsho'i nyi ma thams cad//las dman lha mo chos mtshos//ji ltar 'gro thabs 'dug thabs//byas tshul khyod kyis los shes//'jig rten mi yul 'di na//rgyu med sprang bo thams cad//'dug sa'i yul zhig med pas//0/ra bltas gnam rgan ma khyod//rgyu 'bras yod pa gshob red///50

dog mo sa khod yangs rung //dbang med 'gro ba thams cad//'gro sa'i lam zhig med pas//bslu med dkon mchog gsum pos//mgon skyob byed pa lab red//de ring dus nas bzung ste//las dman lha mo chos mtshos//mo lo bzhi bcu'i ring gi /rgyu med sprang mo'i ming 'di//phyug bdag a ma lha mo'i //ming la gsar du bsgyur rgyu//mo lo bzhi bcu'i nang du//las dman sprang mo bdag la//'jam po gos chen 'brug ma//yang 'jam lug chung tsha ru//gon pa'i cha rkyen med kyang //de ring nyi ma'i phyin chad//mdzes sdug g.yu dang byu ru//yang mdzes gser nag sgrog gu /bdag gis rgyab la 'dogs rgyu//ri /5/

'jam po lug chung tsha ru//rab mdzes gos chen 'brug ma//bdag gi lus la gon rgyu//da dung bdag gi sgo na//phyugs zog khri ma 'bum stong //yod pa'i mtshan dang snyan grags//yul gru 'di la khyab dgos//de phyir bdag la nyon dang //sprang rgan rin chen don grub//phyi nyin shar gyi phyogs su//gser mdog nyi ma'i 'od zer//lam lam 'phros nas yong dus//khyod rang mtsho khar song nas//bdag gi bshad pa thams cad//gser gyi nya mo'i rna bar//ma gsang drang mor bshad dgos//’’de'i phyi nyin dgung nyi ma ser bo tshang nas 'bud skabs/ nya ba rin chen don grub klu 'bum g.yu mtsho'i khar song nas chung ma lha mo chos mtshos bshad pa thams cad gsang ba med par nya mo bde skyid sgrol ma la bshad pa na/152

nya mo bde skyid sgrol mas bal lce dkar nag gnyis dang gos lag mthil tsam zhig nya ba'i lag tu 'jog bzhin sngar ltar sngas mgo la 'jog dgos tshul sogs bshad rjes/ gser 'od 'khyug 'khyug byas te nya ba la bde mo ston pa'i tshul gyis ma tsho nang du 'dzul song / de nas nya ba phyir rang khyim du log cing / dgong mo nyal dus bal lce dkar nag gnyis dang gos lag mthil tsam de gnyis nya mos bshad pa ltar sngas mgor bzhag pa yin/ de'i phyi nyin nyi ma'i 'od zer sa la 'phro skabs/ nya ba tshang gi mkhar mtha' ru rta nor lug gsum gyis khebs 'dug la/ khyim du dar mdzod 'bru mdzod kyis bkang yod par ma zad/ chung ma lha mo chos mtsho'i lus la gos dang tsha rus brgyan yod pa'i thog tu/ g.yu byu ru dang gser dngul gyi rgyan cha rnams 'od 'tsher 'tsher 'dug pas/ kho mo'i gdong la sngar med kyi 'dzum mdangs shig shar 'dug de nas bzung chung ma lha mo chos mtshos nya ba rin chen don grub g.yog la bkol nas rta rdzi lug rdzi byed du bcug ste nyin bcu lhag tsam zhig 'gor rjes/ kho mos yang nya ba rin chen don grub la 'di skad bshad byung /‘ e ma thos 'dzin rna ba//gzhan gyi phyogs la ma ga/yeng //153

bdag gi gtam la hon dang //sprang rgan rin chen don grub//'jig rten mi yul 'di na//khyod las blun pa'i mi zhig /yod pa rna bas ma thos /rin chen rgyu dang dbang la//ham pa med pa'i mi de//blun po nor gyi rgyud dang //khyad par med pa'i dpe'o //mgo nag mi yi nang na//phrag dog med pa khyod 'dra//sa steng gor mo rdo dang //bsdur na khyad par ci yod//pha mes dus kyi blun po//yang mes dus kyi sprang bo//sprang blun gnyis ka tshang ba'i//nya ba rin chen don grub//phyug bdag a ma lha mo//bdag yid sems kyi 'dod pa//gting mtha' med pa'i rgya mtsho//154

chin po zhig dang 'dra bas//khyim tshang 'di yi sgo na//phyugs zog rta nor lug gsum//grangs ka med pa yod kyang //bdag gi 'dren byed mig gis//lan brgyar bltas kyang nyung gi /khyim tshang 'di yi nang gi / dar gyi mdzod dang 'bru mdzod// rgyu nom ri ltar spungs kyang //bdag gi sems na nyung snyam//gon pa gos dang tsha ru//sgam dang dang zhes yod kyang //dus rgyun gon na 'dod pa'i//lwa zhig mig gis ma mthong //g.yu dang byu ru'i rgyan char//bltas na mdzes sdug che yang //don du rtsa ba chung song //nyin gcig ja kha gsum por//zho dang 'o ma 'thungs kyang //nga yi sems na mi zhim//155

thun gsum ja kha re rer//sha mar thud gsum zos rung //de la bro ba med do//phyug po'i mtshan dang snyan grags//yul phyogs 'di la khyab kyang //'dzam gling yongs kyis go med//bkres ltogs sdug bsngal med par//phun sum tshogs pa'i 'tsho ba//nyin bzhin longs su spyad kyang //bdag yid gangs dkar sems la//skyid po'i snang ba mi shar//yang gcig bdag la gson dang //sprang rgan rin chen don grub//rgyu nor 'di tsam nyung song //dbang cha 'di go chung song //rgyu dang dbang gi don du//de ring nyi ma nas bzung //a ma lha mo nga rang //'jig rten mi yul 'di yi//gong ma rgyal bor 'dug rgyu//156
