de phyir rgyal mo bdag la//lha yul khams las skyid pa'i//mdzes sdug ldan pa'i grong khyer//chen po zhig gi steng du//nyin mtshan phyogs ris med par//'od stong lam lam 'bar ba'i//gser gyi nyi zla cha gcig /mgo thog 'di na yod dgos//kho ra khor yug kun tu//skye dgu'i yid kyi dga' ba//dbang med yongs su 'phrog pa'i//yid 'ongs mtsho rdzing nang du//gser nya ngang ngur la sogs//rang 'dod 'khyug dang 'gros kyis//skyid po'i gar la rol dgos//gur kum sbrang rtsi'i dri zhim//yul gru kun la thul ba'i//skyed mos dga' tshal dag tu//dkar ser dmar mdangs bkra ba'i//sna tshogs me tog mgo na///57

rkang drug bung ba gzhon nus//snyan mo glu dbyangs blangs tshe//phye leb bu mo rnams kyis//skyid po'i bro gar 'khrab ste//'jig rten 'di yi mdzes sdug /thams cad 'di la tshang dgos//da rung tsan dan a gar//shing gi nags tshal khrod du/ /khu byug 'jol mo la sogs//snyan 'jebs 'dab chags bya yis//phan tshun mdza' glu len dgos//shwa ba rkyang dkar dgo 'brong //rmig can ri dwags rnams kyis//yid 'ongs rkang bro 'khrab bzhin//rwa yis rtsed 'jor rol dgos//da dung pho brang nang la//gser gyi rma bya 'gro shes//dngul gyi ne tso smra shes//g.yu yi bya pho grag shes//mu tig lha mo 'phur shes//158

shel dkar bu mo dgod shes//dung gi gzhon nu mdza' shes//mdzes sdug byu ru'i sdong bo//yang mdzes byu dkar patra//'jam mnyen gos dang tsha ru//yang 'jam wa thul spu thul//zhim po a rag dgun chang //yang zhim ka ra sil tog /snyan 'jebs sgra dbyangs sna tshogs//yang snyan dri za'i rol mo//'di dag bdag la mkho bas//de ring nyi ma'i dus 'dir//sprang rgan rin chen don grub//khyod rang mtsho khar song nas//bdag gis bshad pa thams cad//nya mo bde skyid sgrol mar//ma gsang drang mor bshad rjes//blo dang thabs la bskor nas//rin chen gser gyi nya mo//nya rgya'i dol la bzung ste//4 159

mgo nag mi yi rgyal bo// bdag la lag rtags 'bul dgos//ya mtshan gser gyi nya mo//bdag gi lag tu 'byor rjes//btson khang nang du bcug ste//steng phyogs lha yul khams kyi//'chi med ril bu len rgyu//'og phyogs klu rje'i mdzod du//rgas med nor bu len rgyu//rin chen nor bu de gnyis//bdag gi lag tu thob rjes//mgo nag mi yi rgyal bo//lha mo chos mtsho bdag la//na rgas 'chi ba med pas//nam mkha'i skar ma yin rung //bdag gis mdzod la len rgyu//klu rje'i bang mdzod yin rung //gang gis nom la 'jog rgyu//rgyal mo bdag la mkho na//'jig rten mi yul 'ari yi//160

yid 'ongs pho gsar thams cad//pho brang nang du bsdus te//bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i//'tsho ba longs su spyad rgyu//yang gcig bdag la gson dang //sprang rgan rin chen don grub//'jig rten mi yul 'di na//dbang dang 'byor ba'i cha nas//bdag la 'gran zla med pas//khyod 'dra'i mgo nag mi rnams//tshe dang mi rabs med par//bdag gis g.yog tu bkol rgyu//’’chung ma lha mo chos mtshos de ltar bshad rjes/ nya bas sems sdug byed bzhin mtsho khar song nas sems la/ gser nya 'di ni mi yul gyi bde sdug thams cad mkhyen pa'i khyad 'phags can gyi nya mo zhig yin pas/ ham pa me ltar 'bar ba'i chung ma'i lag tu bzhag nas btson du bcug na rgyu 'bras min/ de las nga rang nyid tshe phyi ma'i yul la song na dga' zhes lcags kyu'i khab gzung blangs te rang srog rang gis bcad na bzang sems skabs/ glo bur du nya mo 161

bde spyid sgrol ma nya ba'i ra dun du yong nas 'di skad du/‘ bka' drin can gyi nya ba lags/ 'jig rten 'di'i mi phal cher dbang dang rgyu'i ched du rgyu 'bras mi brtsi ba ni mi'i rigs kyi chos nyid cig yin pas/ khyod kyis rang srog bcad kyang chos nyid 'di bsgyur ga la thub/ de las khyod kyis sems sdug mi byed par phyir rang yul la song dang chung mas khyod la ci yang mi bshad’ zer rjes/ gser gyi nya mo de sngar bzhin 'od 'khyug 'khyug mtsho nang la 'dzul song / de nas nya bas chung ma la ci ltar bshad ces sems sdug byed bzhin yul la song ba na/ sngar gyi khang chag phag tshang 'dra ba de'i nang du/ chung ma'i ngo la sems sdug dang blo 'gyod kyi nyams 'gyur zhig bcos min du shar 'dug pa las/ phyugs zog rta nor lug gsum dang gon pa gos dang tsha ru la sogs stobs 'byor mnga' thang thams cad glo bur du gar song cha med du gyur 'dug de nas bzung bod rigs dmangs khrod du/ 66dbang mi rtag mtshan mo'i rmi lam 'dra/ rgyu mi rtag rtswa mgo'i zil ba 'dra’nyazhes pa'i kha dpe zhig mi rabs nas mi rabs la khyab pa yin no/ /(chab 'gag rdo rje tshe ring gis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1986lo'i deb bzhi ba las bdams/ )/62

dan genas can hūṃ dran zhe/ dang po tsa na/ yul 'brong thang zhes pa'i sa cha zhig na/ lo drug cur bsleb la nye ba'i rgan rgon gnyis yod pa la bu mo gcig las med mod/ bu mo de ni skyes gzugs mdzes/ pa nam mkha'i lha la 'gran zhing / blo rig nyi zla'i 'od las gsal ba/ rang bzhin bzang zhing kun la 'dzum gyis bsu ba zhig yin pas/ skyes pho mo thams cad kyis de la bsngags brjod kyi me tog stor bar 'dug su mo de lo drug gsum bco brgyad du son pa'i lo der/ rgan rgon gnyis kyi sems la/ nged gnyis 'jig rten 'dir yod dus su bu mo gcig pur 'tsho ba legs po zhig bkod sgrig byed dgos bsams nas/ rgyun par 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku zhig yod pa de la phyag 'tshal nas/ 6 kye kye sku mchog rin po che 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs lags/bdag gnyis shi ba'i rjes su bu mo 'di/ skyid cing bde ba'i gnas shig la 'byor rgyu ni khyed kyis mkhyen mkhyenanyanyazhes zhu bzhin yod/ don de ngan dgu tshang ba'i bram ze zhig gis 163

shes rjes/ sems la 'dod chags kyi ngan sems me ltar 'bar nas/ nyin zhig gi dgong mor kho sku'i rgyab tu gzha' nas bsdad/ yang rgan rgon gnyis kyis sngar bzhin gsol ba 'debs pa'i dus der/ khos sku yis gsung 'byon pa'i tshul gyis khyed gnyis kyis rgyun du bdag la gsol ba btab pa shin tu legs/ da ni bu mos skyid cing bde ba'i gnas mchog cig rnyed 'ong gi sang nyin nyi ma shar ba'i dus su/mi su zhig khyed rgan rgon gnyis kyi khyim la yong na bu mo de la gnang dgos/ mi de lha mi'i sprul ba yin pas/ nor longs spyod sogs la sdug mi dgos’’zhes smras/ de nas rgan rgon gnyis yid ches te dga' spro chen po skyes/ sang nyin nyi ma shar ba dang mnyam du mi ngan bram ze de gcan gzan sha la rngam pa ltar brgyugs nas rgan po tshang gi sgo khar yong nas zas bslangs/ rgan rgon gnyis kyis mthong nas/ rang khyim la bos nas sne len bzang bo byas/ de nas rgan pos/ 6 mdang dgong nged tshang gi sku yis gsung 'byon pa ltar da lta bu mo 'di dang rgyan gos la sogs khyed la gtad pa yin/ rjes su bu mo 'di'i skyid sdug khyed la rag las yod pas/ khyed kyis bdag skyong gnang rgyu zhu ’zhes bshad par/ mi ngan de'i ngo la 'dzum zhig langs 164

nas/ ‘ lha'i bu mo dang 'dra ba 'di bdag la gnang ba ni bka' drin che/ khyed gnyis kyis sems khur byed mi dgos zhes gtam snyan mang bo bshad/ de nas bu mo dang mnyam du 'gro ba'i gra sgrig byed skabs/ bram ze'i sems la bu mo dang mnyam du song na/ mi kun gyis shes nges yin snyam nas/ bshad rgyur/ 6 bu mo dang nged gnyis mnyam gcig tu song na/ lam skabs su jag rkun yod pas/ bdag la dbang mi thub/ de bas bu mo dang rgyan cha sogs sgam chen po zhig gi nang la bzhag ste bdag gis khur nas song na bsang zer/ rgan rgon gnyis kyis de ltar byas nas /sgam chen po zhig gi nang la bzhag nas khur du bcug bram zes sgam khur nas thag ring bo zhig la song nas/ sems la bu mo 'di ma bsad na nam zhig 'dis rang gi mtshang brtol nges yin bsams nas/ bye thang chen po zhig tu sgam de bye ma'i nang la sbas nas bzhag ste yul la log de nas yul mi rnams la/ smyo do dgong ngas gos lwa dang rgyan cha sogs kyi gter chen zhig len rgyu yin pas/ bdag nyal— sa'i khang ba'i nang du skad sgra gang mang zhig 'byung nges yin/ khyed rnams kyis skad sgra ci zhig thos rung yong mi chog ’zer/ de'i tshe sa de'i blon po'i bu dang rgyal bo'i bu 165

gnyis kyis mda' gzhu bzung nas spro bsang lta skor byed du yong nas bye thang der slebs/ rgyal bo'i bus bdag gis pha gi'i bye thang chen po'i bye spungs la mda' zhig 'phen’’zer/ de nas mda' der phog nas drang bor lang 'dugablon po'i bus de ya mtshan red/ bye thang nas mda' drang bor 'dug ga la thub/ nged gnyis lta ru 'gro ’zhes zer nas kho gnyis song nas bltas tshe sgam chen po zhig yod pa mthong / kha phyes pa'i tshe nang na gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i bu mo mdzes ma zhig yod/ rgyal bo'i bus/ 6 khyod 'di 'dra'i ya mtshar ba'i bu mo zhig sgam nang du 'dug don ci yin ’’zhes dris par/ bu mos sngon pha ma gnyis kyis 'phags pa spyan ras tha9gigs kyi sku la gsol ba btab pa'i gnas tshul sogs zhib mor bshad/ de nas blon po'i bus rgyal bo'i bu la/6 bu mo 'di ni gzhan dang mi 'dra bar gzugs mdzes shing byad legs pas/ khyed kyi btsun mo byas na bzang’’zhes zhus/rgyal bo'i bu yang mdzes ma des yid 'phrog ste/ bu mo dang gos rgyan sogs phyir blangs nas rgyal bo'i pho brang du 'gro grabs byed skabs/ bu mos/ ‘‘bram ze de ham sems che ba'i khyi spyang lta bu zhig yin pas rtsa med du ma btang na/rjes su spyi 'bangs rnams la gnod byed nges yin’ zhes zhus 166

par/ rgyal bo'i bus‘ de yang bden par 'dug nged tshang gi sgo khar stag khyi dang gzig khyi gnyis yod pa de khrid 'ongs te sgam nang du bcug nas bzhag na bram ze de gson por za nges yin ’zhes bshad/ de nas blon po'i bus de ltar bsgrubs nas sngon ltar bye ma'i nang du sbas te bzhag bram ze de dgong mo nam gung 'dzur ba'i dus su dga' sgro khog la ma shong bar brgyugs nas yong ste/ sgam khur nas rang 'dug sa'i khang ba'i nang du song / sgam kha phye ba'i tshe/stag khyi dang gzig khyi gnyis phyir kho'i steng la mchongs kho 'jigs skug chen po skyes nas ji ltar skad brgyab kyang / yul mi rnams gcig kyang ma 'ong / nang mo bza' tshang kun snga mor langs nas/ kho 'dug sa'i khang ba'i nang la bltas tshe/ rkang mgo dang lag mgo ma gtogs med pa mthong nas mya ngan byas/ bu mo de rgyal bo'i pho brang du song nas mi tshe gang bor bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba longs su spyad nas gnas mchog de ru bzhugs so/ / (gcod kho tshe ring gis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1986lo'i deb dang po las bdams/ )167

sa khyi do gdazhi gtan rgyud/de yang nga ga rgyun du sa khu do gda' ni /de'u zla yang zer) a myes rma chen gyi tsha bo dang / a ma lha lcam gyi sras yin zer/ a ma lha lcam la mngal sbrum nas byis pa btsa' la nye ba'i mtshan mo zhig la wa lung rdza dmar gyis a ma lha lcam khrid nas bros/ de nas a myes rma chen gyis rtogs rjes ra mdar mngags shing / a myes rma chen gyi dmag ho ri thang la thon dus nam langs pas/ de nas ja thab bzung nas bsdad pa yin/ da lta ho ri thang na ri chung 'ba' 'bur mang bo yod pa a snyes rma chen gyi dmag yin zer — da dung sa cha gzhan zhig tu ri chung 'ba' 'bur yod pa de a ma lha lcam gyi rjes su ra mdar yong ba'i dmag la phyir 'thab pa'i ched thu ba'i nang la btus pa'i rdo 'thor song ba yin zer/ de nas sa khu'i lung bar thon tshe a ma lha lcam la na zug je cher song nas 'gro ma thub pas byis pa skyes byung / a ma lha lcam gyis kho mo'i bu bsrungs/ nas168

'dug 'dod mod/ 'on kyang / a myes rma chen gyi ra mda'i dmag rjes chod par skrag nas kho mo'i sras sa khu'i dpon la bcol rjes wa lung rdza dmar dang mnyam du wa lung mgor song nas bzhugs pa yin/ de nas bzung kho mo'i sras pha med ma med du lus pas sa khu'i do gda'(dwa phrug gi don)zhes ming thogs pa yin/sa khu'i do gda' ni 'ba' stod kyi mthon po bcu gsum gyi gral yin par bshad do/ /(bsod nams 'bum gyis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1994lo'i deb gsum pa las bdams/ )/69

drag zer/ khra tas/ 6‘a lags/ a lags/ thugs rgyal ma bzhengs/ nyon dang tshig gsum zhu/ gzan ser gyon nas bzod pa bzhes dgos mod/ /khā ta gyang khar grag pa mi bzod na/ /phung bo btson du bcug pa 'o brgyal red/ /kha las mi dge khra ta las ngan no/ /a lags ri khrod pas kyang rig sa med/ /srog chags bsad pa'i lpags shun lus la gyon/ /lus la grub pa'i shig rnams btsag la 'phangs/ /smad g.yogs dbral ba'i lan du tshig rtsub shor/ /phyi mar dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu yin no/ / ’zhes zer ba la/ ri khrod pas/ tsa ha ha/ khā ta zer ba'i bya ngan skyug bro khyod/ /kha khog mi gtsang rdzas kyis bkang bzhin du/ /khā tas mi skad smra ba ltas ngan yin/ /kha rog sdod dang kha mchu chag sgo chung / /’ zhes smras pa'i lan du khra tas/ 6‘a wa a wa / khyod tsho 'gro la snying rje sgom mkhan red/ /nyayos chung nga tshor de 'dra bsdigs don ci/ /kha khog mi gtsang rdzas kyis bkang na yang / /za ma ngan ngon zos la nyes pa chung / /khyed kyi dkor zas gshin zas log 'tsho'i zas/ /kha la zhim yang phyi mar rnam smin che/ /’’zhes zer/ skya gas/ ra de red de red/bdag 'dzin blos btang a lags ri khrod pas/ /bdag 171

tu bzung ba'i smad g.yogs dbral na'ang / /bdag med sems ngan khu ta ma bskangs par/ /bdag gis bzhengs pa'i 'dul bar e mthun ltos/ /’ zhes khu ta la 'gro zer ba la/ ri khrod pas/ 6‘dal ba'i rten thob rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs/ /mtshan ldan dam par mjal nas gdams ngag mnos/ /gdams don bsgrub pa'i nyams su len khul byas/ /de'i phyir nyes pa chung snyam kha don rnams/ /'don du chug cig khwa ta phyogs gzhan song / / :zhes pa'i lan du khra tas/ 6 ka wa ka wa/ dal 'byor thob dus mi khom brjed mi rnams/ /ci red zer na 'dod sred me ltar 'bar/ /za chog grong chog sogs la khom skabs med/ /nged cag dud 'gro rnams kyang des ma khoms/ /mtshan mo ro nyal byas na khom skabs med/ /de na khyod kyi chos de nam sgrub lags/ / /zhes zer ba la/ ri khrod pas/ 6‘chung nas da bar kha don bzlas brjod rem/ /'jig rten bya ba thams cad blo yis btang / /rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub pa'i bya btang na/ /nged cag tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub mkhan yin/ /ma ṇi zhig kyang mi shes dud 'gro khyod/ /kha lan mi dgos yid smon dad pa gyis/ /mi’zhes smras/ skya kus/ 6 a tsi sa tsi kha ta 172

khu ta / glen gtam 'di la/ phrag dog ma byed/ ’zer ba'i 'phror/ / bu tas spu gzengs shing gshog pa rdeb deb byas te‘ a ka a ka gna' bo'i dus kyi mi la ras chen dang / /skal ldan rgya mtsho lta bu khyod ma red/ /nga yang de tsho mnyam du lo mang bsdad/ /bzhes pa zwa khyug rtsam pa srog 'tsho tsam/ /ras rkyang phying ser mnabs nas rdza brag 'grim/ /nyin mtshan g.yeng ba med par nyams len gnang / /khyed kyi kha zas pha ma'i sha khrag rang / /ja mar thud sogs tha na tshwa sgog tsong / /la tsi yan chad 'di med bya ba med/ /rgyab tu sems can bsad pa'i ko lpags gyon/ /gal la thug tshe dkon mchog blo yis 'dor/ /gzhan don zer yang rang don kho na sgrub/ /sems la 'dzin rgyu'i nyams len sna gcig med/ /khong rang khyed tsho'i bya spyod mi mthun gi /khā tas khyed kyi de nyid mi shes kyang / /yang na mi la skal ldan la sogs 'phyug /min na deng sang dus kyi bya btang nor/ /khyed cag 'phyug na phyi mar gar 'gro soms/ /khra ta mi gtsang zas shig 'dzoms song na/ /rgyab gos mi dgos phyi mar 'gro rkyang yin/ / ’’zer ba la/ skya nas‘‘grogs po lags/ 'u cag dud 'gros sdom gsum ma blangs/ ngan sems brnab sems ma 173

skyes/ dkon mchog gsum po rgyab skyur ma byas/ de'i phyir phyi mar 'gro rkyang yin no/ /bden bden da song songanya’zer ba la khra nas/ ‘ kha dog phyi nang go 'dzol ri khrod pas/ /gzhan la chos bshad chos khu thig thig thig /chos dang sems gnyis ma 'dres kha khar song / /gan tsho'i bya bar bltas na dgod bro 'o/ /’ zhes zer/ ri khrod pa ngo tsha ste cang zer rgyu ma rnyed par khā ta'i gdong la ce re bltas pa na/ khu ta la nyams shig skyes nas/ slar ri khrod pa la 6 a wa a wa deng sang tshe blos btang ba'i ri khrod pas/ /bzhugs sa rdza brag bor nas khang chen phub/ /da lta'i sgrub phug rnams ni grong las lhag /tha na khab skud yan chad gsog 'jog byed/ /'gro ba'i bsod rnams snyoms pa'i ri khrod pas/ /dbyar dus mar bsogs ston kha 'bru rigs bsogs/ /dgun kha g.yis bsogs la sogs byed pas 'tshub/ /tha na ba yan tshun chad thugs la bsnams/ /'gro la byams sems sgom pa'i ri khrod pas/ /kha nas pha mar ma gyur med zer bzhin/ /zan chang tsam yang sbyin pa mi gtong bar/ /gnyom chung shig mang gsod cing khā tar bsdigs/ /gzhan la chos bshad gnang ba'i ri khrod pas/ /ba/zhan ngor sgur sgur zhum zhum byed mod 174

kyang / /nang na dug gsum me ltar 'bar bzhin du/ /bsnyen bkur kho na thugs kyi dkyil du bcangs/ /bsnyen mtshams dam por bzhugs pa'i ri khrod pas/ /ting 'dzin gsal snang bzlas brjod brtson pa las/ /sems kyis stong gsum bskor zhing brnab sems bsags/ /yang naganyid nas shi min gson min 'dug /lam gyi rim pa bsgom pa'i ri khrod pas/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bshad na snying 'gas pa'i/ /'jigs pa byin nas thog tu bab pa'i tshe/ /bzod glags e 'dug khyod sems bde re ltos/ /des mtshon da dung zhu rgyu mang yod kyang / /khā ta'i tshod kyi kha ta 'grub khul byos/ /phyin chad khra skyag tsho la ma sdigs par/ /rang gi rlung khams de la bdag re byos/ /khas blangs dam sdom de tshor mnyam re zhog /mi zer ba la/ skya gas/ zu grogs po khā ta khyos bshad rgyu mang thal/a lags 'di tshos chos ngo shes kyang / nyams len med na 'u cag dud 'gro dang khyad ci 'dug ngo tsha ma gtod 'u gnyis 'gro'o ’zer nas 'phur song ba la/ ri khrod pa nyin de nas bzung ha las te 'dang rgyag gi nang du lhung song ngo /(tshe dbang rdo rjes bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1994lo'i deb gnyis pa las bdams/ )175

rgyaska thozhi phyugs ni dad zho chen nin brdad /sngon sa cha zhig na/ rgyal bo zhig la gzhung drang gshis bzang gi phyugs rdzi gzhon nu zhig yod/ rgyal bo'i pho brang gi shar phyogs na ri sum brtsegs rgyang nas bltas na sder ma'i nang la mchod pa phul ba lta bu/ 'dabs na glang rgan 'phred du nyal 'dra'i pha bong zhig yod pa der rtsa chu ha cang 'dzoms po yin pas phyugs rdzi gzhon nus dus rgyun phyugs zog ded nas der 'tsho skyong byed bzhin yod/ nam rgyun nyi ma ri rtser shar ba na phyugs rdzi gzhon nus phyugs zog ded nas ri sum brtsegs de'i 'dabs kyi pha bong gi 'gram du thon pa dang / rum nas lam bro blangs te zas skal phran bu re pha bong gi steng la bzhag nas/4 pha bong lags/ khyed kyis bzhes rogs’ zhes gus gus zhum zhum gyis bshad rjes da gzod pha bong de'i 'gram du tsog pur bsdad nas za ma za bzhin yod/ nyin zhig la/ phyugs rdzi gzhon nus sngon ltar gus gus zhum zhum gyis zas skal phran bu tsam pha bong pog la bzhag nas pha bong lags/ khyed kyis bzhes rogs ’/76

zhes bshad ska bas pha bong gi rgyab phyogs nas bcu drub/ lang tsho rdzogs pa'i bu mo gzhon nu ma mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba lha'i bu mo lta bu zhig tshur 'ongs nas bshad rgyur‘‘gzhon nu lags/ khyod kyis nga la rgyun par zas skal ster ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/ khyod la mkho ba'i dngos po zhig dgos sam/ yang na gzhan pa'i dngos grub cig thob 'dod dam’’zer ba la phyugs rdzi gzhon nus ci yin cha ma 'tshal bar re zhig hon thor nas bsdad/ phar lta tshur lta byas pa na cung tsam thag ring ba'i sa na bla ma zhig chibs pa la bcibs nas grwa ser mang bos bskor te phebs bzhin pa mthong /de ma thag phyugs rdzi gzhon nu'i sems la nga rang yang 'di lta bu'i thams cad kyi gtsug tu bkur ba'i bla ma zhig yin na ci ma rung snyam nas gzhon nu ma lags/ nga la gzhan ci yang mi dgos/ chos kyi dngos grub cig yod na de ster rogs’’zhes lan btab/ de ma thag gzhon nu ma de gar song cha med du gyur/ ma 'gyangs par phyugs rdzi gzhon nu la thun cho/nga gi dngos grub thob/ de nas bzung ste phyugs rdzi gzhon nus phyogs gang sar myul zhing 'gro ba mang bo la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ ya mtshar ba zhig la khos 'gro ba mang bo la lung gnang skabs khri las 'phags te bar 177

snang nas skyil krung du 'dug thub par byung / der brten phyugs rdzi gzhon nu'i snyan grags kyi ba dan phyogs bzhir g.yos pas/ a mdo nas lha sa'i jo bor mjal du 'gro ba'i mjal ba'i rgyun chad/ yun ring ma 'gor bar gnas tshul de lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang bo'i rna lam du son/ lo chen rin bzang gi thugs la gnas tshul 'di ngo ma yin nam rdzun ma yin/ gang ltar kyang thengs gcig blta ru 'gro dgongs nas chos gos mnabs shing dbu zhwa gsol te phebs pa la/ 'gro ba brgya phrag mang bo 'dus pa'i dkyil na gzhon nu zhig gis bar snang nas skyil krung du bsdad de lung gnang bzhin pa spyan gyis gzigs/ der lo chen khong gis ‘'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bar ma chad par snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i lung rnal ma zhig yin na nga'i phyag dang bo 'tshal dus bar snang la 'doms gang 'phags par shog phyag gnyis pa 'tshal dus 'doms do 'phags par shog phyag gsum pa 'tshal dus 'doms gsum 'phags par shog de ltar ma yin tshe de las ldog ste sa la lhung bar shog’nyaces gsol ba nan gyis btab nas phyag dang bo 'tshal dus gzhon nu de 'doms gang gis mar lhung / phyag gnyis pa 'tshal dus 'doms do lhung / phyag 178

gisum pa 'tshal dus gzhon nu de sa la lhung nas gnyid las sad pa ltar tshung la ci byung ngam / nga'i phyugs zog tshang ma — ’ zhes pa na rdir 'dus pa'i 'gro ba rnams rang nyid rang gi mig dang rna bar yid mi ches par gyur/ yin rgyu ni dang bo gzhon nu kho'i byugs 'tsho sa'i ri gsum po de klu bdud btsan gsum gyi 'dug gnas yin la khos nyin ltar zas skal byin pas klu bdud btsan gsum gyis cho 'phrul red skad do/ /(gcod pa skyabs kyis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉1994lo'i de ba gnyis pa las bdams/ )179

gnyan po gci gyezhi gtarme rgyud/gnyan po g.yu rtse ni mgo log gi khongs na gnas pa'i ri bo zhig yin zhing / ngag rgyun du ri bo de'i shar lho nub byang dang mdun sgo g.yas g.yon sogs na gnas srung re yod/ mdun sgo g.yon phyogs ni lha g.yag dkar bo dang /g.yas phyogs ni rgya stag dmar bo/ gzhan rnams re re la ming re yod pa dang / mgo log sa khul gyis gzhi bdag la bkur ba'i gnas ri zhig yin no/ /de yang gna' snga mo zhig la/ dpa' zhing rtul phod pa'i rngon pa zhig gis gzhan gyi brnyas gtses las thar ched/ khams phyogs nas ri che ba go dgu dang chu phran go dgu brgal te/ gnyan po g.yu rtse'i 'dabs na yid du 'ong zhing / lta na sdug pa'i mtsho zhig yod pa'i 'gram der 'byor/de nas rngon pa'i 'tsho ba rol bzhin gzhi bcos te bsdad/nyin zhig khos mtsho 'gram nas ri dwags rngon skabs/ glo bur du bar snang nas glag rgod cig gis kha nang la sbrul dkar chung ba zhig bzung nas 'phur nas 'gro bzhin pa 180

mthong bas/ de ma thag gzhu rgyud glag rgod la gtad de mda' gcig 'phangs pa na/ glag rgod kyis kha nang gi sbrul dkar chung ba de sar 'phangs te thag ring sar 'phur/sbrul dkar chung ba de na zug dang bcas te rngon pa la mgo bo g.yug g.yug byed bzhin mtsho nang la 'dzul/ dgong mo der rngon pa gnyid du yur skabs/ rmi lam na gzab 'phyor spros pa'i rgan mo zhig kho'i spra gur gyi nang la 'ongs te/ kho ni gnyan po g.yu rtse'i btsun mo yin pa dang / de ring glag rgod kyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa'i sbrul dkar chung ba de ni kho'i sras yin/ srog skyob kyi drin lan 'jal ched/ da lta kho mo gnyan po g.yu rtse'i bkas mngags ltar khyod rang gdan 'dren du 'ong ba yin zer/ rngon pa myur du yar langs te rgan mo der bdag la rgyu nor khab skud tsam yang mi dgos pas srog skyob kyi drin lan 'jal ba snying bo ci yang med’ zer/ rgan mos mgo bo g.yug g.yug byed bzhin/‘‘'o na/ khyod kyi mda' rtsal thal drags pas bya ba gzhan zhig kyang khyod la zhu rgyu yod ’zer/ rngon pa yid 'thad byung ste rgan mo dang mnyam du klu'i pho brang du 'byor/ gnyan po g.yu rtse dang rngon pa gnyis kyis gleng mol gang mang byas mthar/ gnyan po g.yu rtses slar yang bshad don/ ‘ sa /81

khul 'di na mthu nus che ba'i gdon 'dre zhig yod cing /des rgyun par sa khul 'di ham bzung byed 'dod pas/bdag gi srung dmag rnams kyis de thub thabs mi 'dugs khul 'di'i bde 'jags kyi ched du khyed kyis rogs shig byed dgos zhes re ba yang yang zhus pa dang / rngon pas der rogs byed rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag gnyan po g.yu rtses bshad don/ ‘6sang nyin gdon 'dre de 'di gar 'ong ba'i dus yin/ de dus bdag ni g.yag dkar bo zhig tu sprul ba dang / gdon 'dre g.yami/ nag por sprul yod/ nged kanyis mtsho thog nas 'thab skabs khyed kyis gdon 'dre la gtad de gser mda' zhig 'phangs na chog7zer/ rngon pas ci ltar bshad pa yid la bzung ste/ rang sa'i sbra gur du gasgri ga byed du song /phyi nyin gyi dros ja'i skabs la/ bar snang nas glog dmar 'khyugs pa dang / sa steng nas rlung 'tshub langs pa sogs kyi khrod nas de gnyis khyod shi nga gson gyi dmar 'dzing byas shing / rngon pas shar lho'i dbye ba mi shes khar/gang ni gnyan po g.yu rtse dang / gang ni gdon 'dre yin pa dbye 'byed dka' bas rogs byed thabs bral/ dgong mo der rgan mo slar yang 'ong ste‘casang nyin 'thab skabs//8nyu

gnyan po g.yu rtse'i mgul na me long zhig btags yod pas khyed kyis me long med pa de la gtad de mda' phongs shig’’zer/ phyi nyin rngon pas de ltar byas pas gnyan po g.yu rtse rgyal ba dang / gdon 'dre pham par byas/nyin gsum par/ gnyan po g.yu rtse sku dngos su rngon pa'i sbra gur la byon te/ rngon par drin lan 'jal ched rang la sras mo gsum yod pa khyed kyis chung ma gyis shig zer/ phyi nyin lta bas chog mi shes pa'i mdzes ma gsum mtsho khar phebs te/ rngon pa dang mnyam du 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi las la rol to/ /ma 'gyangs par sras gsum btsas pa ste/ dbang chen 'bum dang / a skyong 'bum/ pad ma 'bum gsum yin la kho tsho re re las la brtson zhing / dpa' ngar ldan pa/ mi rabs nas mi rabs bar sa khul 'di nas phyugs 'tsho skyong gi las la 'bad de gnas bcas pas/ mgo log 'bum pa khag gsum zhes pa 'di nas grol bar bshad do/ /(kha bas bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1994lo'i deb dang po las bdams/ ) 183

na phun gasku mtshozhi gtan rgyud/gna' snga mo zhig la/ mtha' bzhi gangs ri dkar bos bskor zhing rtswa rtsi shing lo 'dab kyis dbul yang / nam mkha'i g.ya' dag cing sa gzhi'i rdul dag ger 'dug pa'i sa cha zhig yod/ sa de na yid sems 'gug pa'i bshad rgyun mang bar ma zad brtse sems 'o mtsho lta bu dang gzhung rgyud smyug ma 'dra ba'i rgyal sras gzi brjid kyis khengs pa zhig kyang 'duganyin zhig la/ rgyal sras des thag nye ring gi bka' blon thams cad pho brang du bsdus te/ ston mo gzab cing rgya che ba zhig byas nas bka' blon zhig khrid de pho brang phyi rol du 'cham 'cham la phyin/ de nas khong rgyal blon gnyi ga phyin sa nas rgyal sras kyis 'khyag ltogs kyis mnar nas ma bzod par lam 'gram du g.yas log g.yon log gis dbugs kyi rgyu ba mthud thabs tsam byed bzhin pa'i sprang bo mang bo mthong ste/ phyir log pa'i lam du yid sems ha cang sdug nas mig mthar mchi mas bskor te blon po la khyed kyis bltas na/ thabs ci zhig spyad tshe da gzod 164

mi 'de dag gi sdug bsngal sel thub ces dris par/ blon pos‘‘mi'i 'tsho gzhi zas la brten dgos pas/ kho tshor sbyin pa btang na rigs zhes pa rgyal sras kyis gsan rjes/de nas gdong gangs rin po che'i phyogs su gtad de rgyal khab yongs kyi dbul bo rnams lo bcu gnyis la kho rang nyid kyis gso skyong byed rgyu'i dam bca' bzhagade'i phyi nyin nas bzung / rgyal sras kyis/ blon thams cad sa cha so sor mngags nas sprang bo dang 'tsho bar brten gzhi med pa'i mi rnams gangs rin po che'i 'dabs la bsdus te/ kho tshor zas gos longs su spyod pa dang nyin rer 'bras bkrus pa'i 'bras chu gangs rin po che'i 'dabs la 'pho ru bcug de nas lo bcu gnyis kyi rjes su/ 'bras chu dwangs shing gsal la zhabs kyi rde'u yang mthong ba'i mtsho zhig tu gyur/ mtsho chu des lus kyi tshil rag 'khru chog par ma zad sems kyi sdug bsngal yang bkru thub / 'thung na nad yams mang bo 'jom pa'i mtsho khyad 'phags can 'di ni/dus da lta'i bar du bod mis bshad bzhin pa'i mtsho chen bzhi'i ya gyal/ ma pham g.yu mtsho zer ba de'o/ / (khri gong gis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1995lo'i deb gsum pa las bdams/ )185

sgyu na nakhan gyi gtan rgyud/de yang sngon 'das pa'i dus shig na/ grong khyer yangs pa can zhes bya ba'i grong tsho zhig la lo gcig gi ring than pa byung bas mi ser yongs kyi bza' 'bru chad de bkres ltogs kyis srog gi nyen kha byung / yin na'ang grong tsho de'i dpon po bse yi tog can tshang la sngar bzhin bang ba yongs rdzogs 'bru rigs kyis phyur bur gtams te yod pas grong tsho 'di'i mi ser yongs la bu lon btang yang 'dang tshod yin/ de bas mi ser yongs kyis khong la snanged cag la bu lon gtong rogs’ zhes thengs mang zhus kyang kha ya ma byas par 'u thug thabs zad kyi gnas su gyur/nyin zhig dpon pos rang gi rta rgan der sga bstad nas grong khyer la myul du phyin pa yul de'i sgyu ma mkhan legs pa'i blo gros kyis mthong ste de ma thag dpon po'i chas su sprul nas rta rgan khrid de dpon po'i khyim du song ba na dpon po'i chung ma g.yang mtshos khyed rang ma song ngam ’zer bar sgyu ma mkhan gyis dpon po yin khul gyis de ring 186

rta rgan 'der yob sdug ci 'dra byas kyang 'gro rgyu med pas nga rang grong khyer du thon dka'/ phyi nyin rta chas gang bzang byin dang nga rang snga mor lam la chas 'gro zer bar chung mas bden snyam pa'i brda la mgo bo gug gug byed/phyi nyin dpon po bse yi tog can dngos su rang khyim la thon pas ya mtshar te a ltas ngan/ 'di ci yin zer/khong gnyis kyis nyin lnga'i ring la khyim de'i bdag po su yin gyi rtsod pa byas kyang rgyal pham gyi dbye ba 'byed ma thub pas sa de'i khrims dpon gyi gam du mi 'gro ka med byung / khrims dpon gyis‘ don dag 'di thag gcod byed pa la khyod gnyis kyis rang gi pha mes yang mes kyi ming dang mi rabs ma nor bar brtsi thub na de la bden kha ster ’zer bas kho gnyis kyang de la mos mthun byung / thog mar grong tsho de'i dpon po bse yi tog can gyis rang gi pha mes yang mes kyi mi rabs bdun gyi ming ma nor bar khrims dpon gyi mdun nas thogs pa med par bshad mthar yid tshim pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas te khrims dpon gyi zur zhig tu bsdad/de nas sgyu ma mkhan gyis pha mes yang mes kyi mi rabs dgu dang de'i ming gong dang mthun par bshad pas sgyu ma mkhan rgyal bar gyur/ de bas dpon po bse yi tog can pham 187

par rgyur nas rang khyim gyi khang ba'i zur zhig tu mi sdod thabs med byung / sgyu ma mkhan legs pa'i blo gros khyim 'di'i bdag por gyur pas khos mi ser yongs bsdus te bza' 'bru yongs rdzogs bu lon du btang /phyi lor grong tsho 'dir lo legs byung bas khos bu lon btang ba sngar bzhin bsdus te bza' 'bru'i bang ba sngar lo bzhin bkang bar byas mthar dpon po bse yi tog can la sprad/ yin na'ang bse yi tog can gyis khyed kyis nga la sdug po 'di 'dra btang bas sngar bzhin khrims dpon gyi sar gtugs gsher du 'gronya’zhes sgyu ma mkhan khrims dpon gyi mdun sar khrid/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis sngon gyi don dag thams cad ma lus par khrims dpon la bshad pas khrims dpon yang ya mtshar te ‘ de 'dra yin na nangs kha nged dpon blon kun 'dzoms kyi sar khyed kyis sgyu ma'i sprul ba ston dgos’’zhes bshad pas khos kyang khas blangs/ phyi nyin nyi shar gyi dus su dpon blon kun tshogs rar 'dus nas sgyu ma mkhan legs pa'i blo gros la sgug bsdad kyang ma yong bar khrims dpon gyis rang gi dkar yol las ja 'thung mtshams bzhag ste khong khro'i rdzig nyams ston pa'i sgang der mdun phyogs su gsar bu zhig gis rta rgod rkyang 'dra ba zhig 188

khrid de tshur yong ba mthong bas khrims dpon gyis rta de blor babs nas khong la btsong rgyu'i re ba bshad pa na/ rta nyo ba la goms 'gros yod med blta dgos pas nga rang zhon la tshod lta zhig byed ’zer nas kho rta la zhon/ rta rgod kyis kho rang de ma thag khur te skad cig tsam la dpag tshad stong phrag yod pa'i lung stong zhig tu bskyal bas kho rang yid pham/ pho ba yang ltogs la phyir 'gro 'dod kyang rta rgan sngar nas thang chad de 'gro rgyu med/ de bas kho rang mtshan mo der sa de nas mi sdod thabs med byung / nam gung gi dus su kho yang gnyid du shor/ phyi nyin nyi ma shar ma thag tu kho phyir 'gro rtsis byas kyang rta rgan sngar nas rkun mas khyer song / kho rang 'u thug thabs zad du gyur te ci byed 'di byed med pa'i skabs der mdun phyogs su rgan mo zhig gis sgyed pu btsugs te ja skol bzhin pa mthong bas kho rang yang der song ste ja 'thung zhor du kho rang rta zhig gis 'dir khur yong tshul dang / rta rgan rkun mas 'khyer tshul sogs gsal bor bshad mthar rgan mos‘ de 'dra zhig yin na khyed rang phyir 'gro rgyu'i re ba med’ zer zhing kho la khyim thab bya dgos pa'i re 'dun zhus/ kho rgan mo 'di lta bu zhig dang khrim thab bya 'dod ye nas med mod/ 'on kyang phyir 'gro /nyu9

bar yang dka'/ mi 'gro bar rang gcig pu 'dug pa de las kyang dka' bas ya lan mi ster ka med byung / lung stong 'di nas bza' tsho 'di gnyis kyis lo lnga'i ring la 'tsho ba rol mthar kho gnyis la bu zhig kyang skyes/ kho gnyis dga' ste bu'i ming la nor bu zhes btags/ de nas lo shas song rjes bus kyang pha ma'i lag rogs byed thub par gyur/ nyin zhig nor bu nags su bud shing 'thu ru song bar shing sdong zhig gi rtsa ru gcan gzan 'jigs su rung ba/ mche sder bgrad pa zhig la thug pas skrag ste sta re dang thag pa so sor bskyur te bros kyang snying rje bral ba'i gcan gzan gyis nyam thag pa'i nor bu kha zas su byas/gnas tshul de pha ma gnyis kyis shes rjes a ma rgan mos lag pa brang khar rdung zhor du nga'i nor bu/ nga'i nor bu/khyod med na nga yang 'jig rten 'dir ci la 'dug’’zer bzhin mdun phyogs kyi g.yang du mchongs/ shul du lus pa ni khrims dpon gcig pu yin la kho'i sems la rang gi 6 nor bu’’yang gcan gzan gyi kha zas su gyur/ bza' zla yang g.yang du mchongs pas nga rang yang 'jig rten 'dir 'dug don med bsams nas g.yang du mchong rtsis byed pa'i skabs der sgyu ma mkhan gyi sprul bsgyur zhig pas kho 190

rang sngar gyi sa na 'dug pa la khrims dpon khong khro langs te khyed kyis nga lo 'di 'dra mang bo zhig gi ring la sdug po 'di 'dra btang bas khrims la sbyor dgos’’zer bas sgyu ma mkhan gyis ngas khyed la sprul ba bstan nas chu tshod gcig kyang 'gor med par ma zad/ khyed kyi dkar yol nang gi ja da dung tshan de redanya’zer bar dngos gnas dkar yol nang gi ja da dung 'khyags med pas khrims dpon la bya thabs bral song / /(sdong skam bkra shis kyis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1995lo'i deb gsum pa las bdams/ ra191

stag skyeg dad gnig skyesra/sngon g.yu lung gser mo ljongs zhes bya ba'i grong khyer mdzes shing lta na sdug pa zhig gi 'dabs su/ mtshe'u zhig yod pa la/ lo rer dbyar zla drug pa tshes ma thag bu stag lo can re de la mchod dgos byung bas/ sa de'i bu stag lo can rnams mchod tshar song / de tsa na rgyal bo'i bu ming la stag skyes zer ba dang g.yog po'i bu ming la gzig skyes zer ba gnyis las med pas/ rgyal bos gzig skyes mtshe'u der mchod grabs byed skabs/ stag skyes na re/ 6 gzig skyes mchod mi nyan/ gzig skyes mchod tshe/ rjes su rgyal bo'i g.yog por shul 'dzin med pas/ de las bdag mchod na bzang’’zer ba na/ gzig skyes na re/ 66de ga la nyan/stag skyes mchod tshe/ rjes su rgyal bo'i rgya'/ srid skyong mkhan med pas/ de las bdag mchod na bzanganya zer bzhin dbugs thengs gcig gis mtshe'u de'i 'gram du brgyugs te/ brag tho dma' mo zhig gi steng nas tsog bsdad tshe/ glo bur du mtshe'u de je cher gyur nas brag khung zhig gi nang 192

nas shag7sgra dang bcas te/ tha rlabs shig 'phyur 'ong nas brag tho de'i steng la brgyab ma thag rim bzhin mtshe'u de bri bar gyur pas khong brag khung de'i nang du 'dzul nas song ba na/ lam du smyug ma tshigs dgu can zhig rnyed de sems su 'di snyam byung / da thengs bdag la phyir 'ong ni med mod/ gal te yod tshe 'di ni stag skyes dang nged gnyis kyi rtsed spyad du bzang zer nas lag tu bzung ste skyod skabs/yang rde'u dkar bo ma mo'i khog tshil 'dra ba zhig rnyed de sngon ltar bsams te 'gro skabs su/ lam bar du sbrul nag zhig dang sbal ba zhig 'dzing res rgyag bzhin pa 'di ltar/ sbrul na re/ 6 a 4/ sbal ba phyal leb/ khyod la ci byung ngam/ g.yog po'i bu thon rjes/ khyod la rde'u dkar bo ma mo'i khog tshil 'dra ba des brgyab na khyed rang gser nag gi sgrog gu zhig tu gyur 'gro ba e shes/ sgrog gu de rgyal bo'i bu stag skyes kyis mid tshe rjes su kha chu bzhur ba thams cad gser yin pa shes sam’’zer ba na/ sbal ba na re/ ra a / nag ring ma/ khyod la ci byung ngam/g.yog po'i bu thon tshe khyed la smyug ma tshigs dgu can des brgyab tshe/ mchong zhig tu gyur 'gro ba e shes/ mchong zhig tu gyur tshe de g.yog po'i bu yis ske la btags na/ 193

sang phyin chad nas mtshe'u 'di 'phyur rung / rgyal bo'i rgyal sar 'jigs nyen ster mi thub pa e shes/ ’’ g.yog po'i bus de rnams thos rjes lag tu yod pa 'i smyug ma tshigs dgu can dang rde'u dkar gyis re rer gcig brgyab ste mchong zhig dang gser nag gi sgrog gu zhig tu gyur pa khyer nas phyir log pa na/ rgyal bo dang 'bangs mi tshos khong la gnas tshul ma lus pa dris pa dang stag skyes kyis mthong ma thag smra mi shes par lus 'a4 'khyud de/ dga' ba'i mig chu bzhur/ skabs der rgyal bos gzig skyes la bshad rgyur/ 6 de ring nas bzung ste khyod stag skyes dang khyad par med pas/ sang nyin nyi ma yang bzang bo zhig yin rkyen/ stag skyes dang khyed gnyis kyis glang bo che bcu la khal bkal te rgyal khams la lta skor du song ’ zer nas de bzhin du byas so/ / lo gnyis kyi dus tshod ni ngo ma mig rdeb dbang tsam zhig red ang / ri klung mdzes sa dang rgyal khab skyid sa tag tag la 'grims nas sngar ma mthong ba'i ltad mo mang bo mthong ste/ phyir log khar lam bar du a ye rgan mo ma smad gnyis yod pa la gnas tshang g.yar nas/ rgan mos stag skyes kyis 'phangs pa'i kha chu thams cad gser yin pa shes/ /94

te khong gnyis la chang drangs te/ tha mar gnyis ka rgan mo de'i g.yo 'og tu tshud de/ stag skyes kyi gser nag gi sgrog gu de yang rgan mo'i lag tu shor song / phyi nyin langs nas rgan mo la zhu ba nan gyis byas kyang rdo la phur ba brdabs pa ji bzhin du gyur pas khong gnyis la bya thabs ni zad do/ /de nas kho gnyis gser ldan grong khyer zhes bya /ba'i mi tshogs ni rgya mtsho'i rlabs dang 'dra bar 'du 'dzi shin tu che ba'i khrom srang zhig tu thon nas/ stag skyes na re/ phagazig skyes lags/ khyed kyis ltos dang /pha gi na mi tshogs ni phyi bskor dang nang bskor byas pod pas/ dbus su glang bo che zhig gi rgyab tu gser nag gi bum pa zhig bzhag ste/ tshang ma de'i mthar bskor nas ha ha’ dang‘ he he yis gad mo 'chor gyin 'dug pas 'u gnyis ku'ang 'gro bar blta’’zer nas 'tshang kha brgyab ste song nas bltas/ mtshams shig la/ gzig skyes ya mtshar te/ ‘ a la la/ stag skyes lags/ glang bo che gan yag re ltos dang’’zer te kha phyir 'khor nas bltas tshe/ stag skyes kyi grib ma tsam yang mthong rgyu mi 'dug pas/ gzig skyes kyi bsam par/ ngas kho mi tshogs kyi gras nas bor song ba los yin snyam ste ji ltar btsal yang rnyed ma byung bas sems 195

'tshab nas me 'bar ba ltar gyur/ mtshams der ltad mor lta mkhan rnams kyis‘ ho ho’’zer bzhin grol song bas/a tsi/ stag skyes gang du song ngam/ da ni yul la log thabs bral 'dug snyam ste/ grong khyer de'i nye 'dabs kyi lung ba chen po de ded de song ba na/ byis pa pra tshags bstan bshig 'gas zhwa mo zhig 'phrog res byed pa dang phrad de/ kho na re/ 6 zhwa mo 'di'i ming la ci zer/ ci zhig la phan pa yin/ khyod tshos rtsod pa brgyab nas ci bya’’zhes dris tshe/ byis pa zhig gis zhwa mo 'di'i ming la mi rig gi zhwa mo zer ba dang mi su zhig gis mgor gyon tshe lha 'dre mi su yin yang mthong bar mi nus’’zhes lan btab pas/ kho'i bsam par/ 'di ni rang la mkho bar 'dug snyam nas byis pa tshor/ ‘‘zhwa mo 'di nga'i lag tu zhog la khyod tsho pha gi na brag tho zhig yod sar rgyugs shig sus 'go bzung ba yin na ngas de la ster rgyu yin ’zer ba na/ tshang ma 'thad pa byung ste brgyugs 'gro ba'i skabs der khos mgo la gyon nas gar song gi rjes mi rnyed par gyur to/ /de nas yang lung ba de ded nas song ba na/ yang byis pa 'gas lham zhig 'phrog res byed pa dang phrad pas sngar bzhin du dris tshe/ lham 'di'i ming la mgyogs pa'i lham zer ba dang /196

'di gyon tshe lo gcig gi lam zla gcig gis chod pa dang /zla gcig gi lam nyin gcig gis chod thub’’zer bas/ sngon ltar blo dang bkod pa 'then nas gar song gi rjes ma rnyed do/ /yang de nas gom pa brgya lhag tsam song ba na byis pa 'gas rdza ma chung chung zhig 'phrog res byed pa dang phrad de sngon ltar dris pa na/ zu rdza ma 'di'i ming la ci 'dod rdza ma nag ril zer ba dang / mi rang nyid la ci dgos thams cad bstsal nges te rdza ma'i kha gnam la gtad na de bzhin du yong bar 'gyur’’zhes bshad pas/ kho'i sems su/ 'di ni rang la mkho 'dug snyam nas sngon ltar blo dang bkod pa 'then nas gar song gi rjes ma rnyed do/ /de nas khong nags tshal stug cing / me tog sna tshogs lham mer bzhad pa'i nags gseb cig tu song nas gsom sdong mthon po mkha' la zug pa zhig gi rtsar tsog ste ngal gso byas nas bsdad pa na/ bu mo mdzes ma zhig yong ste dogs snang ci yang med pa'i ngang nas sa 'bur zhig gi steng na bzhad pa'i me tog ljang khu de btog nas zhal la byugs bzhin du kha nas u dum wa ra'i me tog sngo hā’’zer sngags de zlo ba na/mdzes ma de skad cig de nyid la sprel rgan zhig tu gyur/yang cung tsam 'gor rjes me tog dmar bo zhig sa nas 197

btog ste sngar bzhin du gdong la byugs bzhin sngags de bskyar bzlas byas pa na/ sngon ltar gyur to/ /kho ya mtshar te/ 'di ni legs par 'dug snyam nas me tog de gnyis re re btog ste skad cig de nyid la sngon stag skyes kyi gser nag gi sgrog gu ster kha ma nyan pa'i a ye rgan mo de tshang la song nas a ye'i bu mo'i gdong la byugs bzhin sngags de bzlas pa na/ bu mo de sbrul rgan zhig tu gyur song bas a ye rgan mos bltas kyin bltas kyin dngangs skrag tshad med skyes bzhin na re/ nga'i bu mo 'di sngon ltar 'gyur thub na/ gser nag gi sgrog gu ster rgyu khas blangs pas/ khong gis sngon ltar 'gyur du bcug ste gser nag gi sgrog gu de khyer nas chu mig dwangs shing gtsang ba zhig gi 'gram du thon pa na/ bu mo chu 'khur gsum gyis kha brda byed bzhin pa 'di ltar/ gcig na re/ 6 sngon yin na rgyal bo'i mag pa de nyin gsum las mi 'dug mod/ da thengs kyi stag skyes zer ba'i mag pa der rgyal srid thob song ba los yin/ ma shi thal’’zhes zer ba/ khos thos nas bu mo de la dris tshe/ rgyal bo'i mag pa de shel gyi khang ba dgu thog nang du yod tshul dang sngar gyi gnas tshul sogs gtam lung ba gang bshad pas kho skad cig de nyid la shel 198

gyi khang ba dgu thog tu song ste stag skyes dang ngo phrad pas dga' ba'i nam langs pa ni smos ci/ skabs der/ dgong kha'i nyi ma yang ser lam lam byed bzhin 'dug pas stag skyes ma gtogs btsun mo ni mthong rgyu mi 'dug pas/gzig skyes na re/ ra stag skyes lags/ btsun mo ni gang du song ngam/ khyed kyis dgong ja e 'thung’’zhes dris tshe/stag skyes na re/ 6 'dre rgan ma de rgyun du nyi ma nub kha'i mtshams 'dir gang du song ba'ang mi shes/ dgong ja ni da rung 'thung med’ zer bas/ gzig skyes kyi bsam par/de dgong ngas 'dre rgan ma de yong na/ za ma ci zhig bzo bar blta dgos snyam nas dgong mo der bltas tshe/ a tsi/stag skyes kyi zas nang la dug sre bzhin du g.yol skol byed bzhin 'dug pa mthong nas/ stag skyes la zhib tu bshad pas zas de rnams kha yang ma reg par bsdad/ de'i phyi nyin gyi dgong kha'i nyi ma ser lam lam byed dus/ gzig skyes kyis btsun mo de sgo phyir la 'gro ba mthong nas rjes ded de song tshe sngon gyi lung ba de'i nang gi brag dmar bo zhig la phu thung gis rgyag bzhin/ a rogs brag rgan sgo med sgo cig phyes dang zer tsa na/ de'i nang nas bdud rgan lo lon mgo skra tsha ru ltar yin zhing kha na so mu tig tsam 199

las med pa zhig yong nas na re/ 6 sras mo khyod kyi da thengs kyi mag pa de 'u gnyis kyis gsod mi thub snyam/ nyin 'ga'i sngon du 'u tshang gi byis pa tshang ma'i mi rig gi zhwa mo dang mgyogs pa'i lham/ rdza ma nag ril/ da dung de'i mi tshad 'u tshang gi bu mo'i u dum wa ra'i me tog gnyis ka yang khyer song / de tshang ma mag pa de los yin 'dod/gang ltar sang nyin ni 'u gnyis kyi nyi ma bzang bo zhig yin pas/ mag pa des khyod la dra ma phye zhes bsgo na phye mi nyan/thab khung nang du me bus zer na/ 'bud mi nyan/ gser gyi zla ba cha brgyad khor byin zer na/ ster mi nyan/ mar khu bzhus zer na/ bzhu mi nyan/ de byos dang sang nyin nyi ma lhod la 'bab dus bdag bya ka la ping ka zhig tu sprul nas khyed tshang gi sgo kha'i lha shing steng du babs nas lhang lhang’’thengs gsum la grag dus khyed kyis rgyal bo la/ a/dergyal bo lags/ khyod kyis bya yag pa ci 'dra'i mang bo zhig mthong myong yang / de ring gi bya yag pa gan 'dra mthong myong med’’ces shod dang / gal te rgyal bos bltas tshe ngas kho yi glo snying gnyis ka e lon bltas chog’’zer/ gzig skyes kyis gtam de rnams thos te ma lus par stag skyes la bshad pas sang nyin snga mo nas stag skyes kyis khyim 200

pyags/ dra ma phye/ mar khu bzhus/ me bus/ gser gyi zla ba cha brgyad lag tu bzung ste bsdad pa na’ bdud rgan sngon ltar sprul nas yong zhing sngon bshad pa ltar byas kyang rgyal bos mgo tsam yang ma dgye/ de dus bya de 'phur thengs gcig gis yong nas rgyal bo'i mgo la rgyag la khad cig byed skabs/ rgyal bos gser gyi zla ba cha brgyad kyis brgyab ste g.yug thengs gcig gis mar khu'i nang du 'phangs shing sgrog rus bcag pas 'phur thabs bral nas gyol ma lding gis sgo phyir bros so/nga / nyin de'i dgong mor yang btsun mo sgo phyi la 'gro ba gzig skyes kyis mthong ste sngar bzhin rjes ded de song ba na btsun mos brag dmar bo de la phu thung gis yang yang rgyag bzhin bos pa na sngon gyi bdud rgan de shi ma gson zhig byas te yong nas sgo dal gyis phye byung bas sras mo nang la 'dzul ma thag a pha zer zhor du bdud rgan der 'thams pa na/ bdud rgan de na re/ ‘ da thengs kyi mag pa de rang ga ba zhig min pas gsod thabs med la bdag kyang da ni gson pa'i re ba mi 'dug pas/ khyod kyis phyi nyin ltos dang gal te bdag shi song na brag gi sgo gnyis kha gtugs te nang du mun nag cig 'thibs nges/ de 'dra zhig yin tshe khyod rang nang du ma 201

yong dang ngas khyed la byin pa'i dug rnams sa la gtor te sang phyin chad nas bzung bza' tshang la mthun zhing /'bangs mi la byams pa'i mi bzang bo zhig byed rgyu gal che'o’’zer de'i phyi nyin dgong kha'i nyi ma ser lam lam byed skabs/ sras mo lung ba de'i nang du song ba na/ bdud rgan gyi kha ta ltar brag gnyis kha gtugs shing / nang du mun nag 'thibs 'dug pas/ sras mo ngu zhor du dug rnams sa la gtor te phyir 'ong nas stag skyes dang mthun zhing rgyal srid skyong rogs mdzad la gzig skyes kyis sngon rang yul gyi rgyal srid bskyangs pas gnyis kus bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol lo/ /(jo rje thar los bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1992lo'i deb gsum pa las bdams/ )202

nags sgon chen tsha sgo/dang po tsa na/ stod gangs dkar gangs ris bskor ba/ bar rdza ri spang ris brjid pa/ smad rtsi shing nags kyis brgyan pa/ ri mtho zhing sa gtsang ba/ yan lag brgyad ldan gyi rdza chu bsil ma 'bab pa'i bkra shis mtshan mas brtas pa'i mdzes ljongs shig yod pa de'i smad kyi char/ rtsi shing sna tshogs kyi dri bsung gang sar 'thul ba/khu byug dang ne tso sogs 'dab chags ci rigs kyis ca co'i skad snyan bar med du sgrog cing / ri dwags shwa ba dang dgo ba/ gna' ba sogs gang dgar rgyu ba'i skyed mos tshal sdug gur bkra ba mtho ris/ yul dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i gnas mtshar du dngar ba zhig yod pa der brag dkar gyi mchod rten ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa/ rtse mo a sngon dbyings la zug 'dra'i shod du gna' bo'i dben gnas sgru ba phug cig ma chis/ sgrub phug de na skye ba yang rgyud la bzhugs pa'i nags sbom chen zhes bya ba/ dbu skra dung ltar dkar la kha na so mu tig tsam med pa/ ngo mtshar rdzu 203

'phrul bsalagyis mi khyab cing snyan pa'i grags pa sa steng du rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor ba zhig gda' 'o/ /sngon gyi sku phreng rim byon rnams gnas mchog dam pa 'dir dgongs pa rdzogs pa yin la/ khong yang gzhon so dkar nas rgan mgo dkar gyi bar du gnas 'dir zla thog zla dang / lo nas lo bar/ dbyar dgun ston dpyid med par bsam blo rtse gcig tu sgrub pa nyams len la brtson zhing bzhugs so/ /ngo mtshar ba zhig la khong gis dus rtag tu sgrub phug mdun gyi gom pa bcu phrag 'ga' chod pa'i sar shug sdong chen po zhig 'dug pa de'i rtsar kha ma gcig tu chab bsang byed pa la rgyun par yu mo dkar bo zhig 'ongs nas khong chab bsang la phebs shul gyi gtsang chab de ldag gin yod pa red/ gtsang chab dbyar khar sar 'thims pa'am dgun khar 'khyag rom du gyur kyang bar ma chad par de ltar byed/mtshams g.yog gis tshul de mthong nas khong la zhus kyang khong gis ci yang mi gsung bar 'dug go /de nas yang lo zla du ma 'das pa'i nyin zhig gi snga dror nags sgom chen yar bzhe4ngas te mtshams g.yog la ngas mdang dgong rmi lam ya mtshar ba zhig rmis byung / steng gong ma lha yi yul nas lha dang lha mo mang du phebs/ rgyab ri'i rtse nas 'ja' 204

tshon sna lnga'i gur khang phub pa'i dbus su sgrol ma dkar mo dngos su bzhugs/ chos kyi sbyin pa dpag tu med pa gnang / bdag cag brtse ba'i thugs kyis rjes su bzung ste phreng ba dkar bo zhig dang me tog tshom bu zhig gnang byung bar phreng ba dkar bo de thad kur nga'i sngas mgor babs pa dang / me tog tshom bu de sgrub phug mdun gyi nags gseb tu lhung / nam mkha' nas me tog gi char ba babs/ sa gzhir sbyar spos kyi dri bzang ldang / da ni bdag gi sgrub pa la rtags thon 'dug’’gsungs te sngas mgo yar bkyags pa na ba so'i phreng ba rin po che baiḍūryas phreng dpon byas pa zhig 'dug mtshams g.yog sgo'i phyi rol du blta bar mngags/ kho rang thad kur nags sgom chen rgyun par chab bsang du phebs sar song ste bltas tsa na/der me tog padma'i tshom bu chen po zhig skyes 'dug cing /dkyil dbus su bu mo zhal ha cang dkar la dbu skra gnag pa/ phar bltas tshod la dgung lo gsum tsam du son pa zhig 'dug kho mos mtshams g.yog 'ong bzhin pa snga sa nas mthong ste rang gi pha mar phrad pa ltar dga' ba skyes cing /'dzum dmul dmul ngang rang gi lag pa chung ba gnyis bsrings nas kho mo myur bar pang ba'i re smon zhu ba dang 205

'dra/ mtshams g.yog la snying rje tshad med pa zhig skyes pa dang rtab rtab por yar pang nas phyir sgom chen gyi drung du phyin/ sku g.yog gnyis kyis zhib tu brtag pa na bu mo de'i mtshan dang dpe byad legs shing lhag par du mdun so gnyis kyi steng du oṃ yig rang byon du babs 'dug pas nags sgom chen gyis (nal nas ltas ha cang legs/ bu mo 'di 'jig rten skye bo rang ga ba zhig min pa rtags dang mtshan ma gang las kyang rtogs nus/ kho mo ni bdag gi las bsod nams dang sgrub pa'i mthu las skyes pa yin gshis/ nged cag gis legs par bskyong dgos’’zhes gsungs shing / de'i mtshan la'ang nags sgom chen tsha mor gsol ba dang / khong sku g.yog gnyis kyis rang gi khog pa'i snying dang ya thod kyi mig ltar gces shing brtse bas bskyangs pas rim bzhin nar son/ kho mo dgung lo bco lngar slebs pa'i dbyar kha'i nyin zhig la/ dgos dbang gis mtshams g.yog de sa cha zhig tu 'gro dgos byung /de'i shul du kho mo gcig pu chu len du song / lam rked du rta btsal du 'gro ba'i rgyal bo tshang gi rta rdzi dang phrad/ rta rdzis bu mo de'i mdzes pa mthong nas re zhig had de lus/kho mo'i lo na phra yang lang tsho'i dpal gyis sgeg cing / mi'i 206

bu mo dang mi 'dra bar lha'i sras mo dang 'dra zhing / lta ba'i chog mi shes pa/ mdzes sdug yid du 'ong bas mthong ba tsam gyis rta rdzi'i yid kyi brtan pa cig car 'phrog nas phar 'gro rgyu'ang brjed 'dug cha med rgyus med kyi mi zhig gis kho mor bltas 'dug pa mthong ste mo rang dogs mi bde bar gyur cing mgo bo cung smad nas myur mor bshol te chu len par phyin/ rta rdzi'i kho mo song ba'i rjes la bltas nas yud tsam bsdad cing de nas phyir rgyal bo'i pho brang du log rgyal bo'i drung du phyin nas rta 'tshol ba'i lam rked du bu mo zhig dang phrad tshul/ de ji 'dra'i mdzes tshul sogs zhus rjes/rgyal bor‘ ngo ma bshad na/ khyed kyi btsun mo'i gras na de lta bu gcig kyang mi 'dug ngas srid pa sa chags/ ba so kha skyes pa nas de lta bu'i mdzes ma zhig gtan nas mthong ma myong’’zer bas rgyalabo 'dod rngam gyis myos nas mtshan der gnyid kyang ma khug rkam chags can gyi rgyal bo des phyi nyin pho nya ba mang bo bsdus nas rta rdzi dang mnyam du bu mo de'i gnas tshul rgyus lon byed sar mngags/ kho tsho rta rdzi dang bu mo phrad sa'i nye 'dabs kyi nags gseb tu gab nas nyin 'gar bsdad kyang mi yi grib ma tsam yang ma mthong bas phyir pho brang du log rgyal bo khros nas bu mo de ma rnyed na 207

phyir log mi chog pa'i bka' btsan po gnam lcags thog 'dra ba zhig phab pas kho tsho phyir 'ongs te gab nas bsdad/nyin zhig sgom pa'i mtshams g.yog der 'ong ba dang phrad ma nyid du bzung nas/ rgyu mtshan dris pas ma bshad par kho rang sdong bo la bcings/ gcar rdung drag po byas pas ma bzod par sgom pa'i tsha mo zer ba zhig yod tshul/ ji ltar rnyed tshul dang mtshan ltas legs tshul sogs kho tshor bshad/mtshams g.yog bkrol nas phyir log ste kho tsho rgyal bo'i pho brang du slebs nas snyan zhu phul bas rgyal bor dga' tshor chen po byung nas kho tshor bya dga' gnang / blon po gros la dbang ba rnams bsdus nas sgom chen tsha mo btsun mor mnga' gsol ba'i gros byas/ nyin 'ga'i rjes su mi mngags nas nags sgom tshang la gnyen slong du song /'jig rten gtam dper ri chen rbab la yar ldog med/rgyal bo'i bka' la gyen ldog med ’ ces pa ltar/ nags sgom chen gyis bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis btang yang thabs gzhan ma rnyed/ bu mo lo na phra bas blos chod dka' mod kyang rgyal bo'i bka' bzhin ma bsgrubs na chad pa 'ong bar dgongs nas bu mo gnas la ster rgyu zhal gyis bzhes so/ /khong gis pho nya dar ngas rgyal bo'i bka' ltar bu 208

mo gnas la ster rgyu byas pa yin kyang nga la da dung re 'dod cig yod pas de khyod tshos khas 'che nus sam/ mi nus na rgyal bor dris la shog’’ces par pho nya bas der skyon med/khyod kyis tsha mo rgyal bo'i btsun mor phul lags na/ khyod la gos chen za 'og ther ma la sogs pa'i rgyan gos kyi rigs sam gser dngul rin po che'i rigs/ gzhan 'dod pa ci yod na bskang chog ’ces zer/ che‘de ltar lags na ngo ma bzang / yin na'ang / nga ni tshe 'di blos btang / phyi ma don du gnyer ba'i ri khrod pa zhig yin pa na rgyu dang nom pa'i dgos pa ye nas yod ma yin/ 'on kyang nga'i tsha mo 'di pha med ma med sha stag yin/ nga las bdag po mi 'dug kho bo ni la mgo'i nyi ma/ la rting gi grib ma lta bu yin pas 'jig rten 'dir ci tsam 'tsho ba mi shes/ de'i slad khyod rnam pas lta skyong legs po byed dgos/ de min da dung re ba nyag gcig yod pa ni/ khyod tsho bsu bar yong dus 'di ga nas phar brtsis pa'i nyag ga gsum pa'i tshun du 'ong mi chog de'i bar du nga tshos skyel ma byed rgyu yin’ zhes par pho nya ba'ang yid 'thad/ khobaganyis kyis gnyen skar legs pa zhig gtan la phab rjes pho nya ba phyir brdzangs/209

sgom chen tsha mo gnas la 'gro ba'i nyin der nab/sa sgom chen gyis kho mor las bsod nams kyi dbang gis nga tsho ngo phrad/ khyod la bdag po kho bo nyid las med na'ang khyod kyi rdzongs bar gzhan gya nom pa ci yang mi 'dug bdag la yod tshad las phreng ba 'di las rtsis che ba ni med na'ang ngas mi 'dzin khyod la byin pa yin/ khyod kyis phreng ba 'di mi tshe gang bor lus dang mi 'bral bar gyis dang de bas phan pa ci yang medanya’gsungs nas khong gi ba so'i phreng ba de kho mor gnang ba dang / yang khong gis nged cag da thengs kha bral rjes deng byin mjal thub min mi shes/ tshe 'dir mjal bar ma gyur na dag pa'i zhing du mjal bar smon/tshe 'dir khyod nga'i tsha mo ru skyes pa yin pas/ khyod kyis nges par du mdun phyogs kyi nyag ga gsum pa'i bar gyi nyag ga re nas phyag gsum re 'tshol la song / de mi brjed par gyis dang dgos pa shin tu che gsungs/ kho mo'ang tshe 'dir skyes pa nas pha ma gnyis kyi tshab tu khong las med cing rgas kyang drags pas nam 'chi mi shes sems te skyo nas mchi ma sham sham du bzhur/ sgom chen la 'thams nas zungs mi tshe gang bor khyod la zhabs zhu byed rgyu yin/ nga gang la'ang mi 'gro zer bar sgom chen gyis ‘khyod kyis de 210

skad ma zer cis kyang 'gro dgos/ gal te ma song na rgyal bo de drag spyod la dga' bas nga bsad/ khyod 'phrog yul khams thams cad kyang med par bzo nges/ de ltar byas tshe 'di phyi gang la'ang mi phan/ de bas khyod song dang don chen 'grub yong bas nges par 'gro dgos’migasungs/ kho mo 'gro mi 'dod kyang skul lcag nan gyis btab pas bya thabs med par lam du chas/ mdun lam gyi nyag ga dang por slebs dus kha phyir 'khor nas phyag gsum btsal te phyin/ nyag ga gnyis par sngar ltar byas/ nyag ga gsum par slebs dus gnyen bsu rta ba brgya phrag du ma sngar nas der lhags 'dug la/ kho mo nyag khar bud ma thag mdun bsu rgya chen po byas/ sgar du bsus nas sgom chen tsha mor sku khrus gsol cing gzab 'phyor spras/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis rnam par brgyan pa dang shing rta'i byams la bzhugs nas lam du chas/ yin na'ang kho mo brel 'tshub gyis nyag ga gsum pa nas phyag 'tshal rgyu brjed song /rgyal bo'i pho brang du 'byor nas gsol ston rgya chen po bsgrigs/ nyin zhag du ma'i ring la glu dang gar la rol/rgyal po'i btsun mo'i khrod du nags sgom chen tsha mo las mdzes pa med pas skye bo yongs kyis bsngags parjod kyi me 211

rtog 'thor/ snyan pa'i grags pa rgyas shing rgyal po rim bzhin du btsun mo gzhan gang la'ang chags zhen med par gyur cing / sgom chen tsha mo kho na'i gam du sdod pas btsun mo'i tshogs la phrag dogs skyes te thabs brgya jus stong gis gnod skyel ci thub byas/ g.yog mo rnams la ngan skul btang ste lkog tu chang la dug btab nas drangs/ blo yul las 'das pa zhig la kho mor dug gis gnod mi tshugs par ma zad/ dug sbyar ba'i chang ci tsam btung na de tsam gyis lus khams je dwangs dang byad gzugs je mdzes su 'gro bas bya thabs bral/ yin na'ang ra ma brag la 'gos kyin mgo 'phangs je mtho/ khyi skyag ma/chod mjal bzhag gin dri ma je thu zer ba'i dpe ltar/ kho tshos ngan sems ngal ba 'bras med du gyur na'ang mtshams med par gnod skyel ci thub byas/ chen ma kun dga' lha mo bya ba des btsun mo rnams bsdus nas gsang gros byas/ thabs/ ngan sna tshogs bton/ 'on kyang nags sgom chen tsha mor rdzu 'phrul che la gnod thebs dka' bas ci byed gang drag zer ba la kun dga' lha mos kho mor de 'dra'i rdzu 'phrul zhig ga nas yod/ gtso bo kho mo'i lag mgo'i phreng ba de rang ga ba zhig min la de ni nags sgom chen gyis gnang ske212

ba yin las che/ nga tshos cis kyang ba so'i phreng ba len thabs byed dgos ’zer nas de'i skor la gros bsdur tshags dam pa zhig byas/ nyin zhig rgyal bo dgos don gyis sa cha gzhan zhig tu phebs pa'i shul du kun dga' lha mos btsun mo rnams khrid/ khog la ngan sems bcings/nags sgom chen tsha mo'i gam du phyin nas kho mor tshung tsho rgyal bo'i btsun mo yin yang pho brang du gos gang yag gyon zas gang zhim zos nas sdod pa las/ las ka cung tsam yang ma las na 'bangs kyis 'phya 'ong la/ nam zhig gi tshe na rgyal bo'ang dga' mi srid/ de ring nyi ma'ang dron po 'dug pas/ nga tsho lci ba 'phud du song na ga 'dra red’ zer/kho mo gshis rgyud drang zhing las la brtson pa zhig yin gshis/ pho brang gi 'tsho bar snga sa nas sun snang skyes yod pas/ de skad thos 'phral dga' spro'i ngang de ga rang red/ de bzhin du bya'o zer nas btsun mo rnams dang lhan du las kur zhugs/ las ka tshar rjes chen ma kun dga' lha mo dang mnyam du chu khar song ste lag pa bkrus/kun dga' lha mos khyod kyi lag mgo'i phreng ba lci bas sbags yod tshod 'dug’’zer/ sgom chen tsha mos lta dus phreng ba de sngar bzhin dri mas ma gos par 'dug pas skyon 2/3

mi 'dug’’zer/ kun dga' lha mos ‘khyod kyi phreng ba de dngos gnas yag po 'dug ngas cig blta’ zer bar kho mor bshol thabs med par lag mgo'i phreng ba byin nas mu mthud du lag pa 'khrud bzhin bsdad/ kun dga' lha mos ba so'i phreng ba de sngar nas phu thung nang du sbas yod pa'i rus pa'i phreng ba dang brjes nas phyir byin/ phreng ba de gnyis kyi dbyibs dang kha dog sogs ha cang mtshungs pas nags sgom chen tsha mos ye nas ma shes/ de nas bzung sgom chen tsha mor skabs dang bstun nas dug 'dren ci thub byas/ ji tsam drangs na de tsam gyis byad bzhin je btsog tu gyur la/ tha mar bzhin mi sdug pa'i mi min 'dre min lta bur gyur pas rgyal bo'ang kho mor dga' ba med par gyur/chen ma kun dga' lha mos gtsor byas pa'i btsun mo rnams kyis gzhan la ngan skul byas te lkog tu rgyal bo'i lha rta dang / lha g.yag lha lug sogs rim bzhin bsad rjes rgyal bo'i drung du phyin nas rgyal bo rin po che lags/ sgom chen tsha mo btsun mor mnga' gsol rjes ltas mi legs pa 'ba' zhig byung / khyed kyi lha rta sogs kyang rim gyis shi/khyed kyis ltos dang / da lta 'dre mo des ngo gdong lhang la 'bud kyin 'dug snga sa nas med par ma btang na rjes ཿ/4

su ci 'ong ba sus kyang mi shes/ gal te khyed kyi sku tshe la bar chad re byung na nga tshos ci bya’’zer nas gdong la g.yo sgyu'i mchi mas sngag bzhin ngus so/ /rgyal bos bsam blo btang btang mthar kha spo kha nas langs/ zhe spo gting nas skyes shing ral gri shubs nas phyung ste‘ ngas 'dre mo de tshar ma bcad na nga skyes bu dam pa min rtags yin zer ba'i skabs der/ khong gi gsos bya mi skad smra shes pa'i ne tsos 'di skad do/ /‘‘rgyal po rgyal po khri la bzhugs/ /ral gri ral gri shubs la bsdus/ /mi rtag bya bar brtag na legs/ /’’zhes bshad pas rgyal bo re zhig som nyi'i rgyar tshud de 'dang rgyag gi nang du lhung / smra mkhan ne tso'i skad cha dang nags sgom chen gyi snyan grags/ nags sgom chen tsha mo skyes tshul sogs la brtags na kho mo rang ga zhig min pa thag gis chod/ 'ol tshod kyis kho mo bsad na ni rjes su nga la ci 'ong mi shes/ yin na'ang / kho mos nga la gnod pa 'di tsam bzos pas cis kyang rgyang phud gtong dgos snyam te/ khor g.yog po tha shal gzhung drang ba zhig yod pa bos nas sgom chen tsha mos bdag la bzod dka' ba'i gnod pa tshab chen bzos/ da ni rgyang phud gtong bar bya yi/ khyed kyis kho mo glang rgan rog po der bskyon la de'i rwa 215

co dang rmig pa ser por 'gyur reg bar song la de'i bar phyir log mi chog’’ces gsungs/ g.yog pos de bzhin du zas gos nyung tsam nyar nas sgom chen tsha mo dang lhan du phyogs nges med du 'phyan/ zla gcig tsam 'gor rjes bro zad/ g.yog po sems sdug gis mnar/ yin na'ang ya mtshar ba zhig la gar 'ong mi shes par zas gos rnams rgyun chad med par dngos grub char du 'bebs/ yul mi med lung stong gang du slebs kyang gcan gzan gdug pa can rnams kyis mi 'tshe bar ma zad/ gcan gzan dang 'dab chags sna tshogs/ ri dwags sogs kyis phyag dang bskor ba byed/ g.yog po sems gting nas dad pa skyes/ bkur bsti dang zhabs tog tshad med pa bsgrubs/ yin na'ang khos dus rgyun par glang rgan gyi rwa dang rmig pa ser por 'gyur bar re sgug byas mod kyang / glang rgan gyi rwa dang rmig pa sngar bzhin nag shad ler 'dug thengs shig la sgom chen tsha mor de'i skor gleng / kho mos‘ de ni rgyal bos nga tshor dka' ba bzo phyir yin pa las don dngos thog glang bo rgas drags na ma gtogs de ltar 'gyur rgyu ga na yod/'on kyang de las sla mo zhig red de/ 'dam rtswas rmig pa dang chu dug gis rwa co phur tsa na ser bor 'gyuranya zer/216

g.yog pos de bzhin byas/ phyi nyin lta dus glang rgan gyi ra dang rmig pa ser thag chod du gyur 'dug pas kho la dga' tshor chen po skyes nas sgom chen tsha mor ngas khyed kyi bka' bzhin byas pas glang rgan gyi rwa dang rmig pa ser bor gyur 'dug rgyal bo'i bka' yang 'grub 'dug pas da ni nga tsho phyir log na dga'’’zer/ rjo khyod brel dgos don mi 'dugad lta nyid du phyir song yang yag po rang mi 'ong bas/ da ni nged gnyis yul gru so sor 'grim la sems can thams cad la phan pa zhig bsgrub na don chen 'grub 'ong zer nas khong gnyis sa cha so sor 'grims nas bgrang bya du ma 'gor/nam zhig gi tshe na sngar nags sgom chen bzhugs sa'i brag rtsar slebs/ sgrub phug zhig ral du gyur 'dug la mi yi grib ma tsam yang mthong rgyu mi 'dug mtshams khang gi sgo kha'i phyi nang kun tu rtswa dang 'jag mas khengs 'dug zhib tu bltas pas sgrub phug gi sgo khar sgom chen gyi na bza'i dra ras sham bu zhig bsnar 'dug pa las gzhan ci yang med/sgom chen tsha mos na bza'i dra ras de lag tu blangs/ nags sgom chen mi yul dang bral ba shes nas de la 'gram pa glan te kha nub phyogs su 'khor nas ngus so/ /yud tsam na 217

nub phyogs su rgod thang dkar zhig 'phur 'ongs te rgyab /ri'i rtse mor babs/ kho mos gsol ba nan gyis btab pa la rgod thang dkar de sgrub phug gi sgo kha'i brag steng la babs nas 'di skad do/ /‘ btsun ma sgom chen tsha mo lags//ma ngu bdag gi tshig la gson//nga ni sgom chen sprul ba lags//da lta mtho ris yul du gda'//khyod kyi da lta'i gnas tshul dag /ma lus bdag gis shes nas yod//rab dkar ba so'i phreng ba de//da lta lag tu e yod lags//’ kho mos myur du rus dkar gyi phreng ba de blangs nas 6 yod lags’’zer bar 'di ni sngon ngas khyod la byin pa'i phreng ba de ma yin te/ gzhan gyis snga mo nas brjes tshar 'dug khyad par du khyod kyis nga'i bshad pa ji bzhin ma 'grub pas 'di 'dra'i sdu ga pa'i las la sbyor dgos pa byung / 'on kyang skyon mi 'dug ste/ khyod kyis do dgong nga'i gos kyi dra ras de sngas mgo byos 'a/ nyol dang sang snga mor ngo mtshar ba'i ltad mo zhig gda'/ yin na' nga /218

khyod kyis nges par du 'jig rten chos brgyad spangs te ma sems can thams cad kyi don du 'bad na bsam don ji bzhin 'grub 'ong bas snying rus bskyed la sems sdug ma byed cig phyi mar dag pa'i zhing du mjal bar smon’’zer nas 'phur song ngo / /kho mor dad gdung tshad med pa zhig skyes nas de'i rjes su phyag gsum 'tshal/ der bsdad de khong gis gsungs pa ji bzhin byas te nyal/ phyi nyin snga mor gnyid sangs dus rang nyid tshogs gur chen po zhig gi nang du gos kyi 'bol gdan du ma brtsegs pa'i steng du nyal 'dug mal khri'i mtha' 'khor du dar dkar gyi yol ba 'then 'dug kho mo yar bzhengs ma thag grwa ser du ma 'ongs te kho mor bza' btung phun sum tshogs pa drangs shing / tshogs gur gyi sgo khar khri brgyab nas kho mo bzhugs su bcug sa der sgar chen po zhig brgyab 'dug la grwa ser brgya phrag du mas phyag dang bskor ba byas/de nas bzung kho mos grwa ser brgya phrag du ma dang mnyam du sa cha mang bor 'grims nas chos gsungs/ 'jig rten mi choṭa la phan pa'i bslab bya dpag med mdzad pas 'jig rten skye bo mang bos yid mos shing snyan grags kyi ba dan srid rtser g.yo/ nam zhig gi tshe na rgyal bo'i pho brang gi 219

nyi 'dabs su sgar chin brgyab/ gedugs dang rgyal mtshan/ lha dar sogs bsgrengs/ rag dung dang rgya gling / mkhar rnga sogs sgra snyan gyis gang sar khyab/ rgyal bo'i pho brang phyi nang gi skye bo mang bo dang btsun mo 'i tshogs la chos kyi sbyin pa dpag med gnang / nyin der nam mkha' nas me tog gi char babs/ 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khang phub pa la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul ngo mtshar ba byung / der 'dus skye bo rnams la dad pa'i spu long g.yos/ btsun mo rnams kyis ngo mtshar cho 'phrul de dag dngos su mthong nas ya mtshar chen po skyes/ sngar byas pa'i las la 'gyod de jo mo rin po che'i mdun du sdig pa thams cad ma lus par bshags par tshang ma kha 'cham/rgyal po'i gsos bya ne tsos don rnams rtogs shing dga' ba rab tu brtas te rgyal por 'di skad du smras so//‘‘ rgyal bo rgyal bo nga la nyon//btsun mo btsun mo rnams kyis ni//jo mo jo mo rin chen mdun//sdig pa ma lus bshags par byed//khyed kyang ma sdod de gar phebs//mi mngon lkog tu nyan pa na//220

dkar nag shan kha phye nas 'ong //bden rdzun dbye ba gsal nas 'ong // ’rgyal bos ne tso'i gtam de dag thos pas thugs la jo mo rdzu 'phrul can de'i snyan grags snga mo nas gsan mod kyang da lta'i bar mjal ma thub pas da thengs der mjal thub pa byung na tshe 'dir bsod nams bsags pa yin pa dang /btsun mo rnams kyis bya spyod ya ma zung la brtag na legs pas cis kyang 'gro dgos par dgongs te/ skye bo phal ba'i lwa ba gyon te mi tshogs dang mnyam du jo mo rin po che'i mdun du phyag dang bskor ba byas shing mi mngon par bsdad/btsun mo rnams kyis sngar sgom chen tsha mo dang rgyal bo'i bar ji ltar phra ma bcug tshul/ nags sgom chen tsha mo'i phreng ba byin can blangs tshul sogs jo mo rin po che'i mdun du ma sbas ma gsang bar lhug por brjod cing / phreng ba sgro ba gang yod pa sar 'pho ba na/ jo mo rin po che khri las babs te phreng ba brgya phrag du ma las ba so'i phreng ba byin can de ngos 'dzin gnang ba dang / kho mo ni sgom chen tsha mo yin par brjod pas tshang mas kyang ngo shes nas skye bo thams cad ha las par gyur/ btsun mo rnams skug nas kho mor phyag mang du btsal te skyabs 'jug zhus/ rgyal pos sngon gyi 221

do na rnams gsal bor rtogs nas khros te btsun mo rnams 0khrims la sbyar/ nags sgom chen tsha mo btsun mo chen mo'i khri la mnga' gsol te rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs shing rgyal 'bangs bde skyid dpal la bkod do/ /(rta mchog rgyal gyis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1993lo'i deb gsum pa las bdams/ ) ཿ23

btsun lgo natsho lha bubad tho/dang po tsa na/ yul gru zhig tu rgyal phran du mar dbang bsgyur zhing nor longs spyod klu yi bang mdzod la 'gran pa'i dpal 'dzoms zhes pa'i rgyal bo 'dod rngams can zhig yod la/ kho rang mgo skra dkar bo dung dang mig rtsa dmar bo me ltar gyur pas rkang ba ya gcig phyi ma'i yul la spos 'dug rgyal bo de las ldog ste byang sems ldan zhing snying rje che ba'i btsun mo mtsho byung ma ni rga ba dang na ba'i sdug bsngal gnyis dpung bsdebs te lnga ba'i lam du gshegs zin mod/ rgyal bor sdug bsngal phran tsam med pa'i khar nyin mtshan dus drug tu gsar du bzhes shing mdzes pa'i yon tan ma lus 'dzom sa pa'i mo lo bcu drug can gyi btsun mo mtsho lha bzang mo dang mnyam du chang gar la rol bzhin mchis/ srid pa'i kha dper sla ngar 'grogs na dri mag dang mchod rten la 'grogs na dkar rag’’ces pa'i dpe ltar pho lo bco brgyad la son pa'i rgyal bu dpal lha don grub kyang yab rgyal bo'i ngan goms kyis chang dang 223

bud med las bsam rgyu dran rgyu gcig kyang med pa zhig tu gyur/6 skra ring ma dang blo thung ma’nyazhes pa ci ma bden/btsun mo ca/tsho lha bzang mo rgyal bo'i pho brang du 'ongs te lo phyed tsam las ma 'gor mod/ kho mo'i sems su rgyal bo dpal 'dzoms da lta la kha'i nyi ma dang la rting gi grib ma’’yin pas/ gal te rgyal bo dpal 'dzoms tshe las 'das tshe/ bdag la 'di lta bu'i skyid cig yod med sus shes/de bas snga mo nas rgyal bu dpal lha don grub tshur bskor thabs bya dgos snyam ste/ rgyal bu dang 'phrad thengs rer chags pa'i mig mda' 'phen pa dnga'adod pa'i rnam 'gyur gang mang bstan pas/ rgyal bu'ang lus sems rab tu myos te lto la rngams pa'i khyi gu ltar mtsho lha bzang mo mthong thengs rer gdong 'dzum 'dzum gyis kho mo'i rjes 'ded ci thub byed kyin 'dug nyin zhig gi snga dror/ rgyal bus mtsho lha bzang mo rgyun du 'cham 'cham du yong sa'i me tog gi ra bar ltad mor g.yeng khul byas te mig zur gyis mtshams med par mtsho lha bzang mo'i gzim shag gi sgor lta bzhin mchis/ cung tsam 'gor rjes mtsho lha bzang mo sgor bud tshe rgyal bu dpal lha don grub me tog gi ra bar yod pa 224

mthong bas/ dal dal lhod lhod ngang rgyal bu'i gam du bcar te‘ rgyal bu lags/ khyed rang yang 'cham 'cham du phebs yong ngam7zhes ngo tsha ba'i tshul gyis mgo sgur nas dris pa na/ ‘ o lo khyod rang ’’zhes rgyal bus lkugs bzhin du mchil ma zhig sgog mid byas/ 6 bal bo'i sil tog ma zos kyang / kha dog nyid las bro ba shes ’zhes pa ltar mtsho lha bzang mos rgyal bu kho mor dga' bzhin pa kho'i rnam 'gyur las kyang shes 'dug de nas kho mos rgyal bu la me tog cig gi steng du bung ba zhig babs yod pa bstan te rgyal bu lags/ khyed kyis ltos dang me tog 'di skam la nye bas bung ba 'di ji 'dra'i skyo ba la ’zhes bshad par/ rgyal bus de'i don rtogs te skyo dgos don ci yod/ bung ba de gsar skyes me tog cig gi steng du babs te sbrang rtsi'i bcud la rol na mi chog gam’ zhes tshig shugs nas phan tshun 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur 'dzems med du bstan/ dus de nas bzung btsun mo mtsho lha bzang mo dang rgyal bu dpal lha don grub gnyis la go skabs re byung tshe phan tshun 'dod pa'i snying gtam dmar rjen du bton pas phugs kyi 'dun ma snga mo nas 'grub par kho gnyis nas kyang skom pa'i chu bzhin sgug kyin 'dug spyang ltogs kyis ཿ25

sha mi za ba'i dpe med pas na kho gnyis la rim gyis lus 'brel byung ba dang / de'i gnas tshul yang rgyal bo'i snyan lam du son pas/ rgyal bo'i sems la gal te kho rang gnyis da dung mnyam du bsdad na skyo gar 'di mu nga thud du 'khrab nges yin phyin/ bdag gi snyan grags la gnod srid pa dang / mtha' mar rgyal srid dang btsun mo ma co lha bzang mo'ang 'phrog rgyu red/ de bas snga mo nas bu 'di phyi ru smyugs na legs snyam ste/ ji ltar sprugs pa'i thabs la bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis btang / nyin zhig la rgyal bos bu gam du bos te ‘da lta khyod rang‘ blo phar mi 'dri ba dang bro mar mi slong ba'i pho lo drug gsum bco brgyad la slebs yod pas/ khyod rang gcig pu phyi ru nus rtsal slob tu song / bdag gi skad ma thon bar du lo ji tsam 'gor yang phyir yong mi chog’’ces bka' phabs te rgyal bu la tshig gsum bshad dbang dang gom gsum spo dbang ma byin par phyi nyin lam la chas su bcugalo shas 'gor rjes/ rgyal bor mi 'dod pa'i nad kyis gzir te mal sar lhung song bas bya ba thams cad rgyal bo'i bka' bzhin blon chen blo ldan gyis gtso 'gan bzhes te thag gcod byed dgos byung / de ltar dus yun ring bo 226

zhig 'gor tsa na/ rgyal bo dpal 'dzoms mal sar lhung ba'i go skabs dang bya ba gang mang gi dbang gis blon chen blo ldan dang btsun mo rma tsho lha bzang mo gnyis thog mar ngo shes pa dang de nas 'dris par gyur/ mtha' mar phan tshun 'bralami thub pa'i gnas su gyur/ de yang mtsho lha bzang mor mtshon na rgyal bo dpal 'dzoms lo rgas pa'i khar nad kyis gzir ba dang rgyal bu dpal lha don grub kyang sa mthar sgyugs zin pas/ tshe gcig gi 'dun ma blon chen blo ldan la bcol na legs par snyam pa red/ blon chen blo ldan dang btsun mo mtsho lha bzang mo gnyis chu dang nya mo bzhin phan tshun 'bral med du 'dod pa'i 'tsho bar longs su spyod pa'i skabs su kho gnyis kyis gsang ba'i gros shig byas pa dang gzhan su la'ang mi 'chad pa'i dam bcas/nyin zhig la/ btsun mo mtsho lha bzang mo rgyal bo'i mal khri'i gam du bcar te rgyal bo chen po/ da lta khyed kyi gnas tshul yang 'di 'dra red/ gal te stabs mi legs pa zhig byung tshe rgyal srid gzhan gyi lag tu 'chor srid pas/bdag gis bltas na ’’zhes skad mgo je dma' ru btang ste mig zur gyis rgyal bo'i rnam 'gyur la brtabamakhyod kyi thabs de gang 'dra 'dug myur bar shod dang ’227

rgyal bo'i dbugs khog tu lhung 'ing re ba'i mig zung gis btsun mo'i gdong la cer/ mkhyed kyis bu gcig pu la'ang bzod sgom byed mi thub bam’ zhes mig zur gyis da dung rgyal bo'i rnam 'gyur la brtag bzhin de ltar bshad pas/rgyal bo'i sems la rang nyid da lta phyi srog chad de nang srog la thug yod la/ dpal lha don grub gang ltar kyang rang gi sha las mched pa'i bu phrug yin pas/ rgyal srid dang rgyu nor thams cad bu yod bzhin du gzhan la sprod don ye nas mi 'dug snyam nas blon chen blo ldan mdun du bos te‘ thag ring la yi ge gtong ba dang thag nye la mi mngags te zla phyed kyi sngon du bdag gi bu btsal te 'dir thon du chug mices bka' phab pas blon chen blo ldan gdong 'dzum dang bcas te de ltar byed par khas blangs/ phyi nyin nam langs ma thag rgyal bo'i bka' bzhin byas pas nyin bcu las ma 'gor bar rgyal bu dpal lha don grub phyir pho brang du slebs/bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la/ rgyal bo'i nad nyin re las nyin rer je dga' ru gyur te bza' btung gi yi ga'ang phyes zin pas/ btsun mo mtsho nye bzang mo 'dug ma bzod par blon chen gyi bkod 'doms ltar rgyal bu 228

dpal lha don grub mo'i gam du bos te ‘ rgyal bu lags/bdag gis khyod dang mnyam du rgyal srid bskyangs na 'dod mod/ las bsam sar mi 'gro gseg sar 'gro zhes pa ltar khyod kyi yab chen gyi nad nyen re las nyin rer je bzang du 'gro bzhin yod pas/ khyod la las 'di med pa 'dra ’zhes yid sdug pa'i nyams kyis de ltar lab pa dang mnyam du rgyal bu'i ske la 'thams te ngus/ rgyal bu btsun mo mtsho lha bzang mo dang kha bkar te sa mthar sgyugs pas yab rgyal bo la sdang ba dang / ga'an gyis 'gran du med pa'i rgyal srid la chags pa/ lhag par du‘ bud med mdzes ma'i g.yo sgyu'i 'phrul gyis ni/ /skye bo phal cher 'khrul ba'i lam du 'jug / nyaces pa bzhin mtsho lha bzang mo'i mdze sa pa la shin tu chags pa dang kho mo'i g.yo sgyu'i tshag la dpyad pa'i stobs phra bas bden par rlom ste/ rang gis snga mo nas nyar tshags byas yod pa'i dug rdzas de lkog tu yab rgyal bos 'thung bzhin pa'i sman dang bsres pas/ rgyal bo dpal 'dzoms rgyal srid dang mnga' 'bangs/btsun mo/ rgyu nor sogs yod tshad dang bral te de ma thag tu lnga ba'i lam du gshegs/ rgyal bo'i 'das mchod bsgrubs tshar te rgyal bu dang btsun mo mtsho lha bzang mor 'dzem 229

dogs ci yang med par rang snang skyid pa'i dpal la rol bzhin pa'i dgong mo zhig la sprang bo'i dbyug pa sprang bo'i mgo gcog ces pa'i dpe bzhin/ btsun mo mtsho lha bzang mos rgyal bus rang gi yab chen gsod byed kyi dug rdzas de rgyal bu'i ja phor la nyung tsam btab ste 'thung du bcug pas/ ja'ang 'thung ma tshar bar rgyal bu dpal lha don grub glo bur du mal khri'i steng gan rkyal du 'gyel te dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad par gyur/‘ bud med mdzes ma gyod kyi gzhi ma’’zhes pa ci ma bden/ rgyal bo pha bu gnyis bar gyi 'thab rtsod de bud med kyi ched dang / kho rang gnyis lnga ba'i lam du brdzangs pa'ang bud med kyi don/ btsun mo mtsho lha bzang mo 'di gdug rtsub che la snying rje med pa'i khar g.yo sgyu che zhing rang nyid kyi bde ba'i ched du ngo tsha med par bya ngan ci'ang sgrub thub mkhan zhig yin pas/ nga rang yang lo rgas tshe snga ba rta khrid dang gzhug ma lug khrid’’kyi dpe bzhin yin la /mtha' mar thams cad brlag nges yin/ blon chen blo ldan gyis de ltar 'dod de gzhan gyis ma tshor ba byas te btsun mo mtsho lha bzang mo dpag tshad 'ga'i sar sgyugs/ kho rang sngar byas kyi las la 'gyod pa shugs drag tu skyes te/ sgrub 230

nga4 sbyang pyir rgyal srid blon po gzhan zhig la gtad de rang nyid ba/cig pu mi med phung stong gi brag phug cig la gom kha bsgyur/ / (sgrol ma 'bum gyis bsdus〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1 992lo'i deb gsum pa las bdams/ ) 231

zhe ku bya khyud dad stag zhud gi gtan rgyud/srid pa chags nas lo ngo khri phrag mang bo 'gor rjes gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir 'gro ba mi'i rigs rgyud 'phel/de nas cang ma 'gor bar rigs rgyud lha nas mched pa'i bu mo gyo mo zhes drug gsum bco brgyad kyi lang tsho rab tu rgyas shing / stag shar gzhon nus mthong na snying la gdung ba ster ba'i bu mo de nyin zhig grogs mo tsho dang mnyam du bya khyung rdza 'dabs su lci ba 'thu ru song / nyin der nyi bzang skar bzang zhig yin pas yul lha'i rgyal bo bya khyung yang rta mchog ngang dkar la bcibs/ g.yon na rta 'dzin mdzo 'dzin/ g.yas na ja 'dren chang 'dren/ mtha' ru gdugs rgyal mtshan sgreng ba'i 'khor g.yog zhabs zhu ba dang 'khor gsum spras pa'i dmag dpung bgrang las 'das pas bskor zhing / sku gzi mdangs lham mer rang gi mnga' khongs la spro gzigs su phebs pa'i skabs der/ sing sing snyan mo'i glu gzhas shig gis yul lha'i rgyal bo'i snyan dbang 'phrog yul lha'i rgyal bos ye shes kyi spyan gyis mar 232

gzigs pa na/ gzhas 'then mkhan de ni mdzes ma tshogs kyis bskor ba'i gras kyi ches lo na gzhon pa'i bu mo mdzes ma zhig yin zhing / ngag snyan mo'i gzhas dang yid du 'ong ba'i bzhin gyis yul lha'i rgyal bo'i yid dbang med du drangs nas rang 'khor gyi—blon po rig pa can spyan gsum pa mngags nas‘ bu mo de'i rigs rgyud mched khungs sogs dris shog’ ces gsungs pa na/ spyan gsum pa de ma thag sprul bsgyur gyis mgo bo dung ltar dkar zhing / kha na so mu tig tsam yang med pa'i rgan po nyam thag pa zhig tu sprul nas bu mo de tsho'i nye sar bcar ba na/ bud med gzhan rnams kyis rgan po de'i tshugs kur zhen log nas kha ya ma byas/ gyo mo ni de las ldog ste rang gi rum la khyer yong ba'i bro las mang shos rgan po der byin nas kho'i gnas tshul dris/ rgan pos mgo bo g.yug g.yug byed zhor du zung ni bya khyung rdza 'dabs su sgrub la brtson bzhin pa'i drang srong zhig yin/ mdang dgong nga'i rmi lam la nga ni ri 'di'i rgyal bo yin zer ba'i gzhon nu zhig gis lus la khrab dkar rmog dkar gyon zhing / sked par 'khor gsum btags pa/zhal mdangs dung las dkar zhing lus la mtshan bzang dang dpe byad kyis yongs su khengs pa zhig yong nas/ sang 233

nyin nyi shar gyi rtse cho/ra bya khyung rdza 'dabs su song dang tshul dang ldan pa'i lha mo zhig dang 'phrad 'ong / de dus ma brjed par rigs dang ming 'dri dgos zhes nga la bka' bsgo ba zhig rmis byung bas bdag de ring gnas 'dir 'ong ba yin/ mdang dgong gi rmi lam la gzhigs na yul lha'i rgyal bos gsungs pa'i bu mo de khyod yin pa rang 'dug de'i phyir khyod kyis bdag la rigs rus mched khungs sogs mi gsang bar gsung rgyu mkhyen ’zhes bshad pa na bu mos kyang kho la gcig kyang ma gsang par drang mor bshad/phyi nyin/ bu mo gyo mo tshang gi 'bri mo bor song bas bya khyung rdza 'dabs su btsal du song / kho mo song song yang btsal nas ma rnyed pas ngal dub phran bu byung nas gnyid log rmi lam la mi dkar zhwa dkar khrab dkar gyon pa zhig rta mchog dkar bo zhig la zhon nas thad kur mo'i logs su bcar te 'bri mo yod sa'i phyogs der mdzub mos bstan zhor du mig gis 'dzum zhags shig 'phangs pas mo yang ngo tsha ba'i zol gyis gdong lag pas bkab ste mdzub srub nas bltas pa na mdun gyi mi de gar song cha med du gyur/ kho mo skrag dngangs dang bcas gnyid las sad tshe da gzod rmi lam yin pa shes/ sems la rmi lam yin rud 234

gang ltar kyang 'bri mo btsal dgos pas sa de'i phyogs su chas/ de nas yar song ba na mdun phyogs su brag phug cig yod lade ru sngo ljang gi rtswa los khengs shing mi zhig lta ci srog chags shig kyang ma song ba zhig yod —pa mthong nas mdun du song tshe brag phug de rgya che la dngos gnas zhing khams gzhan zhig tu slebs pa'i snang ba ster/ mos brag phug nang du gom 'ga' spos pa na 'bri mo ni rtswa chu 'dzoms pa'i spang thang zhig na nyal nas bsdad yod pa mthong 'bri mos/ rang gi bdag po mthong ba dang ske bsrings nas thengs 'gar ngur/ kho mos gcig nas 'bri mo rnyed pa dang /gnyis nas rmi lam du yang rmis dka' ba'i zhing khams 'di 'dra zhig mthong nas yid dbang med du myos pa'i skabs der/ de snga rmi lam du phrad pa'i mi des mgo la rtse gsum can gyi rmog dkar gyon/ lus la darjel gyi go khrab nyi ma'i 'od la 'gran nus pa zhib/ gyon zhing / dar dkar bo'i phyu chen der dung las dkar ba'i ske rags bcings/ rta chog ngang dkar zhig la zhon nas lag tu dngul las bzos 'dra'i mdung zla tshes ma zhig khyer te ri glu rgyang 'then byed zhor mo'i mdun du baspebs/ mo yang ya mtshar ba'i ngang de sngon mi/ lam du phrad pa'i mi de ma yin nam snyam 235
