bzhin snying chung lu gu lding lding byas nas mgo bo brang khar smad/ yul lha'i rgyal bos kho mo'i bsam tshul phal cher rtogs nas rang gi gnas tshul dang 'dod mos brjod pas phan tshun la chu dang nya mo lta bu'i brtse dung chags/ de nas bzung kho gnyis dung dkar mdo dang 'khor lo sgang nas thengs mang bor thug 'phrad byas pas dmar chung gi sems pa gnyis gcig tu 'dres shing / lo phyed tsam 'gor rjes mi dang lha yi gnyen btsugs nas nyi zla skar gsum la rtsis yang yang byas mthar sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin mi bsu dang rta bsu/ lha bsu dang mchod bsu bcas bu mo gyo mo dung dkar mdo nas yul lha'i rgyal bo bya khyung gi mkhar rdzong bdag mor gdan drangs/de'i nyin rgyal bo gser khrir bzhugs shing sman btsun gyo mo dngul khrir bzhugs/ g.yas na ja 'dren chang 'dren/g.yon na rta 'dzin mdzo 'dzin sogs zhi drag blon chen tshong/sa kyis mtha' na bskor zhing / sngar sgrub ma myong ba'i ngo mtshar ba'i cho ga mang bo bsgrubs/ phyogs bzhi'i bstan srung dang yul lha gzhi bdag ste/ stag lung / gnyan chen/ sras mchog dgra 'dul dbang phyug blon chen shan pa nag po/ a myes dmag dpon sogs mgron la bos nas 236

bya khyung dang gyo mos sku mgron re ri la skyeca/ca/ chang drangs /nas stag lung gi mtshams la thon tshe/ stag lung kho gyo mo'i lang tshor chags nas zur mig gi mda' mo yang yang 'phangs rung gyo mos ma rig khul gyis mgo bo phyogs gzhan la 'khor nas skyems chang drangs/ de nas bzung stag lung gyo mo la chags te 'dod pa'i gdung bas gzir nas zas kyang za 'dod med par lus mdangs nyams shing lus stobs zad/ kho'i nang blon khra 'bar gyis rgyal bo'i sems kyi gdung ba shes nas khong la gyo mo thabs kyis bsu ba'i gros byas/ phyi nyin blon chen khra 'bar gyis 'khor dmag stong gi dbus na lus la dar gos kyi phyu lwa zhig gyon nas rgyal bo bya khyung gi phyogs su 'bul nor bkra shis dkyil 'khor/ g.yas 'khyil mun pa rang sel/ g.yu byu ru mu men mu tig sogs rin thang bral ba'i rin po che mang bo khyer nas rgyal bo'i bka' bzhin bya khyung dang gyo mo gnyis stag lung pho brang du bsu bar song / de ltar nyin chad skar bgos kyi nyin der thon tshe nang blon spyan gsum pa gtsor byas pa'i zhi drag blon chen sogs gang mang gis yul lha'i rgyal bo dang sman btsun gyo mo gnyis bskor nas gdugs rgyal mtshan dang spos dri zhim gyi khrod stag lung pho brang du byon/ stag 237

lung rgyal bo yang pho brang dang thag mi ring ba'i sar phebs nas bsu ba byas te g.yu las grub pa'i rin po che'i pho brang du gdan drangs shing / 'jig rten mi yi blo las 'gongs pa'i zas rigs sna tshogs dang bdud rtsi bsil ma'i skyems drangs/ gar mkhan dang gzhas ma sogs kyis rtsed mo sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bya khyung rgyal blon kun la bdud rtsi bar med du drangs nas rang tshugs mi zin pa'i gnas su gyur mtshams kho tsho phyir bya khyung pho brang du skye la ma byas/phyi nyin yul lha'i rgyal bo gnyid las sad pa na btsun mo gyo mo med pa shes nas blon chen tshogs la dris tshe/ da gzod rang nyid pha rol ba'i g.yo 'og tu tshud pa shes/ kho'i bkod 'doms 'og blon chen spyan gsum pa dang / drag po dgra 'dul gnyis gtsor byas pa'i 'khor dmig stong phrag kha shas la mda' gri mdung gsum gyi mtshon cha legs par spras shing / khyad par du rgyal bo rang nyid kyis gtum mo dmar nag gi sprul gzugs bsgyur zhing rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan gyi rta mchog ngang dkar la bcibs te phyag tu dngul mdung khams gsum rang 'dul thogs te stag lung tshang la dmag tu chas/ stag lung rgyal bos snga mo nas gra sgrig byas yod rkyen gnam sa 'thab pa lta bu'i g.yul 'gyed khrod yul 238

lha'i rgyal bo'i 'khor dmag pham/ rgyu mtshan ni yul lha'i rgyal bo ni zhi ba'i lha yin zhing / dpal dang 'byor ba rnam thos sras kyi bang mdzod la 'phya la/ thob dang go sa stag lung las ma tho na'ang / khong rgyal blon rnams de 'dra'i dpa' rtul ldan pa zhig min/ stag lung rgyal bo ni de las ldog ste drag po'i lha yin zhing / dpal dang 'byor ba de 'dra med mod/ nang blon khra 'bar sogs ni dmar yag stag gi snying zos pa lta bu/ khros na khams gsum dbang du bsdu nus pa lta bu mang phyir/ thengs de'i g.yul 'gyed khrod kho rang rgyal/ de ltar thengs 'gar g.yul 'gyed byas kyang btsun mo ma thob pas/ yul lha'i rgyal bo thugs shin tu khros te rang nyid sprang bo zhig tu brdzus/ rta mchog ngang dkar khyi mo dkar mo 'ig tu sprul bsgyur byas/ gzhu mo dgra bo'i srog len dang mda' mo dngul sgro 'phur shes gnyis skyer ba'i mda' gzhu gnyis su sprul nas phu rung nang du bcug dngul mdung khams gsum dgra 'dul 'khar rten zhig tu sprul bsgyur byas te stag lung mdun ri dang thag mi ring ba'i sar sbas nas bsdad tshe/ de'i nyin stag lung rgyal bo gtsor byas pa'i 'khor blon tshogs g.yul las rgyal ba'i ston mo byed pa dang 'khel bas/ khos gzhu mo dgra 239

bo'i srog len ma'i nang mda' mo dngul sgro 'phur shes legs par sprad de stag lung rgyal bo'i dpral bar dmigs te 'phangs pa na/ mda' des sir sgra dang bcas stag lung rgyal bo'i nye 'khor gyi 'khor dmag sum cu tsam bsgral nas stag lung gi rmog 'phru de ling gis bcad/ mda' gnyis pa 'phangs pas nang blon 'ga' g.yas 'gyel g.yon 'gyel du btang / mda' gsum pa 'phangs pas stag lung rgyal bo'i pho bar phog nas rgyu ma rlu( de ltar rgyal kha thob mur btsun mo gyo mo 'phrog par chas pa na stag lung rgyal bo kha spo kha nas langs/ zhe spo gting nas langs te mar rlugs pa'i rgyu ma phyir khog la bajongs te 'khor dmag tshor lag brda zhig byas pa na mda' mo ser ba 'bab 'bab/ 'phur ra/dung rta rgod rgyug rgyug byas/ yul lha'i rgyal bos gnas tshul mi legs pa shes te sprul bsgyur gyis khyi mo dkar mo de 'phral rta mchog ngang dkar du bsgyur nas rlung nag 'tshub ma zhig dang bsdebs nas mgyogs por bros/ mda' skyin mda' yi dpe ltar stag lung rgyal bos bstud mar mda' lan thengs gsum 'phangs/ mda' dang bo dang gnyis pas sku lus la gnod ma thub par spyan gsum pas mnga' 'og gi blon chen 'ga' bsgral/ mda' gsum pa thad kur 240

byi khyung mdzod khang la dmigs te 'phangs nas mdzod khang brdibs shing 'khor dmag mang bo zhig la shi rmas byung /rjes su stag lung rgyal bo sems ma bde bar btsun mo gyo mo rang gi rgyab ri'i pho brang du bzhag ste 'khor g.yog pas nyin mtshan dbyer med du bsrungs nas bsdad do/ /yul lha'i rgyal bos kyang stag lung gi ngo rig ma 'dod par kha khri dzi'i phyogs su 'khor song / deng skabs ngag rgyun du bya khyung thugs khros nas kha khri ku'i phyogs su 'khor yod kyang / zhe reb gong rogs lor chags yod zer ba dang bya khyung ri bo'i 'gram du ri zhig nyil ba'i shul tsam yod pa de ni stag lung rgyal bo'i mda' 'phangs nas yul lha'i mdzod khang brdibs pa'i shul yin zer/ stag lung ri bor ri rtse med pa ni yul lha'i rgyal bos mda' 'phangs nas rmog 'phru bcad pa'i shul dang / ri sked na cung nyil cing lo mang la rtswa mi skyes pa'i shul tsam yod pa de ni pho bar mda' phog nas rgyu ma rlugs pa'i shul yin zer zhing / ri 'dabs su de'u 'bur mang bo yod pa de ni 'khor dmag bsad pa'i shul yin zer/ rgyab phyogs su stag lung las smi bco brgyad kyis mtho ba'i ri zhig yod pa de ni sman btsun gyo mo yin zer/ reb gong sa cha'i 241

kha dper yang pho mgo mi mtho mo mgo mtho/ mo mgo a ma gyo mo mtho’nyazer ba yang de dus byung ngo / /(reb dkon mchog gis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1995lo'i deb gnyis pa las bdams/ )

lha zhug sga zhudzinazhun/gna' snga mor sa cha zhig tu lha lug ma mo gro yu ma zhes pa'i ma bu gsum yod/ nyin zhig lha lug ma bu gsum po mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba'i spang ri'i phyogs su zhim zhing mngar ba'i bcud ldan dbyar rtswa bza' bar phyin pa'i lam bar du/ mi bzad gdug tsub can gyi spyang ki zhig dang phrad/ spyang rgan des lha lug ma bu gsum po mthong ma thag tu dga' ba'i nyams dang dgod pa'i 'dzum shar te bshad rgyur/ phaya de ring nyin hril bor sa mtha' la skor ba brgyab/ thang chen po'i dkyil nas brgal te song / song song rgyug rgyug gi mthar khyod ma bu gsum la phrad pa 'di ni nga yi las dbang dag pas red/ da lta ngas khyod ma bu gsum bza' ba'i dus su slebs pas/ khyod tshor zhu rgyu'i don dag re yod na myur mor brjod par 'tshal’’zhes bshad/ lha lug ma mos spyang ki 'di bzlog pa'i thabs shib/ btsal dgos snyam pa dang lhan cig thabs shig dran pas/ de na re/ ‘ spyang rgan khyod kyis nga tsho bza' bar mi 243

chog pa ci yang med mod/ 'on kyang nga tsho ni lha'i lug yin pas khyod kyis bza' dgos na thog mar kha dang lag pa chu gtsang mas bkrus nas bza' bar bya’’zhes zer ba la/ spyang rgan gyi sems la ma bu 'di gsum po bza' thub na kha lag bkru rgyu la dka' khag ci yod bsams nas/ ‘ya des na bdag da lta kha lag bkru bar 'gro'o/ khyod ma bu gsum gang du'ang ma 'gro ’zhes zer bzhin rgyug ma 'dur gyis gtsang bo'i 'gram du song / spyang rgan chu khar slebs ma thag tu nya mo gser mig can la dad gus che ba'i nyams kyis phyag gsum 'tshal te bshad rgyur/ ‘ gser nya rin po che lags/ bdag gis lha lug ma bu gsum bza' grabs byed pa la/ lha lug ma bu gsum pos kho rnams bza' 'dod na thog mar kha lag bkru dgos zhes zer bas/bdag gis 'dir kha lag bkru na chog gam ’zhes zhus pa la/nya mos bshad rgyur/ 6 khyod kyis kha lag bkru na chog mod kyang kha lag bkru bar gtsod kyi rwa zhig dgos shing de med na thabs med ’zer/ spyang rgan gyis bden par 'dod nas ya ya zer bzhin gtsod kyi mdun du song ste sngon ltar bshad pa na/ gtsod kyis bshad rgyur/ smyo‘bdag gi rwa mi g.yor ba'i don ci yang med mod/ 'on rkyang pha mgar ba 244

med na nga'i rwa len pa'i thabs dang bral lo’’zer/ spyang rgan gyis yang ya ya zer bzhin du brel 'tshub kyi ngang nas mgar ba'i mdun du song nas sngon ma ltar/ 6‘mgar pa rin po che lags/ bdag gis lha lug ma bu gsum bza' grabs byas pas/ kho rnams bza' bar khyod kyis kha lag bkru dgos zer/ kha lag bkru ba la gtsod kyi rwa dgos zer/ gtsod kyi rwa len par mgar pa khyed med na thabs dang bral bas/ khyed nyid gtsod rwa len par thengs gcig phebs rogs gnang’’zhes zhus pa la/ pha mgar pas nga song na chog mod/ 'on kyang bdag 'gro bar rkyang rgod kyi rnga ma zhig med na thabs med’ ces bshad/ spyang rgan gyis yang ya ya zer bzhin du brel 'tshub kyi ngang nas rkyang gi mdun du song nas dad gus che ba'i nyams kyis phyag gsum 'tshal te bshad rgyur/ ‘rkyang rgod rin po che lags/bdag gis lha lug ma bu gsum bza' grabs byas pa la kho tsho bza' dgos na kha lag bkru dgos zer/ kha lag bkru dgos na gtsod rwa dgos zer/ gtsod rwa len par pha mgar ba dgos zer/ pha mgar pa phebs pa la khyod kyi rnga ma dgos zhes bshad 'dug pas/ khyod kyis bdag la rnga ma'i nyag ma 'ga' byin na chog gam’ zhes zhus pa la/ rkyang 245

i/sa bshad rgyur/ ‘ don 'di mi chog pa gang na yod/khyod kyis nga'i rnga ma'i nang nas rang gi 'dod pa ltar bal nas slar lha lug ma bu gsum bo bza' bar song na legs ’zer ba la spyang ki dga' ste/ 6 ya da bzang ngo bzang ngo /lha lug ma bu gsum po bza' bar dka' las gang mang myangs kyang da bsam don 'grub song / rkyang lha rin po che khyed ni ngo ma mchog tu gyur pa'i lha yi rkyang zhig red’ ces bsngags brjod byed bzhin dga' ba'i nyams dang dgod pa'i 'dzum gyis rkyang gi mdun du song nas phyag gsum btsal te/ rkyang gi rjes su song nas dga' spro'i ngang rnga mar 'khyud nas 'bal ba'i sgang der rkyang rgod dar ma des gdug rtsub khog rul can kyi spyang rgan de'i snying khar nus shugs ci yod kyi sgo nas 'phra kha gcig brgyab pas spyang rgan de'i kha sna gnyis kyi nang nas khrag bzhur zhing cang ma 'gor bar dbugs kyi rgyu ba yang chad do/ /de ltar sha gzan dgra bo spyang rgan de nya dang gtsod dang mgar ba dang rkyang sogs kyi thabs dang blo gros kyis tshar du bcad pas/ lha lug ma bu gsum po mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i spang ljongs kyi phyogs su ro bcud dang ldan pa'i rtsi shing dang / mngar zhing bsil ba'i rdza chu longs su spyad de bde skyid kyi dpal 246
do gyur tobasdus pa〈sum pa la

rngon puspun gnyiska/de yang lung ba'i nyin du shug pa dang srib tu gsom sdong ngam thang shing / lung gzhung du lcang ma dang glang mas 'khrigs 'khrigs su g.yogs shing / khu byug dang 'jol mo sogs bya rigs sna tshogs kyis snyan 'gyur gyi ca co lhang lhang sgrog pa'i yul ljongs shig na/ bsil ba rtse zhes bya ba'i grong tsho zhig yod/ de'i nang du pha ring bu rgyud du ri dwags brngon te 'tsho thabs byed pa'i dud tshang dbul bo zhig yod/de tshang la spun gnyis yod de/ de gnyis rtag tu ri dwags gshor ba'i lam nas mkho med kyi rtsod gleng byas te shwa ba sogs ri dwags mang bo shor ba'i gtam rgyud cig grags pa 'di lta ste/nyin zhig la rngon pa spun gnyis kyis mda' gzhu thogs shing rgyags phye 'dang tshad cig khyer te ri dwags rngon par song / me tog sna tshogs rnam par bkra ba'i thang chen po zhig brgyud pa'i tshe/ mda' rgyang gang tsam na shwa khyu gcig 'dug cing / shwa bo gnyis phar lding tshur lding du rtse 248

bzhin pa mthong ste/ nu bor 'dod rngams skyes te na re/6 a jo a jo ltos dang yar la ltos/ /sems pa gzhan la ma g.yeng yar la ltos/ /ya gi'i shwa khyu bshar ba'i 'go mar ltos/ /khrag rwa pho 'dom gang las yol bar ltos/ /rwa lag bco brgyad phyogs bzhir rgyas par ltos/ /gang sar mthong dka'i rwa lag bco brgyad pa/ /gser srang brgya'am dngul srang stong du brin/ /gos bubs brgya'am 'bru khal stong du brin/ /ma yol ma 'khyog srog gi gnad la phongs/ /’’zhes pa na/ phu bo'i blor ma bab par na re/‘‘gnas lugs phra rags tsam yang mi shes shing / /dran sgo'i bu ga rub pa'i tha shal mched/ /rna bas gzhan la ma g.yeng bdag la nyon/ /rin thang bral ba'i khyad nor 'di 'dra zhig /zas gos tsam la brjes na mi phangs sam/ /de bas bdag gi bsam tshul 'di lta ste/ /ring la 'dom gang rwa lag bco brgyad kyi/ /rin thang gzhal mtha' med pa'i khrag rwa de/ /rgyal bo tshang la 'bul na rgyal sa'i phyed/ /dpon po tshang la 'bul na blon po'i gnas/ /phyug po'i nor la brjes na stong phrag 'ga'/ /rnon po'i tshon la brjes na mda' mdung khri/ /'di las lhag pa'i 'char sgo yod dam ci/ /mi zhes te/ phu nu gnyis kyis 249

gcig gis khyod rang mthong rgya chung zer ba dang / gcig gis khyod rang ham sems che zer te kha rtsod rgyag pa la/ rta dkar 'gros bzang zhig la zhon pa'i lam 'gro zhig der bslebs nas/ bar 'dum byed zhor du rgyu mtshan dris tshe/nu bo na re/ ‘a jo la ham pa che bas rin thang bral ba'i khrag rwa rang gis longs mi spyod par rgyal bo'am dpon po tshang la phul te rgyal sa'i phran bu'am dpon gnas tsam len pa'i stong sems 'chang zhing / ngas de ltar byas na mi legs te/ de las gser dngul dar zab la brjes te khyim gzhis phun sum tshogs par bskyang na bzang zhes pas/ kha rtsod bslangs pa yin ’zhes lan btab pa na/ lam 'gro des der skyon ma mchis/ rin po che rang la yod na longs spyod mi shes pa su yod/ bzang gi bzang gi shwa rwa gang na yod’ ces dris tshe/ phu bos ‘ya gi'i thang na 'dug’’zer te ba ltas pas na/ shwa khyu de zhogs pa'i rmi lam lta bur mthong rgyu mi 'dug pas/ lam 'gro de'i sems la gsal bor babs te/ khong dgod cig shor nas smras pa/6 kye kha bsod med pa'i rngon pa/ /shā rwa lag bco brgyad can po/ /rwa rin thang can por 'phangs nas/ /ri mthon po'i rtse la bros song / /khyed gnyis kyi rtsod pa skyur 250

dang / /pha gi'i grog 'gram zhig nas/ /g.yag ra 'dom gang mthong byung / /de khyer te rgyal bor 'bul dang / /des rin chen ca dzod kyi nang nas/ /gser re 'dod tshims pa los gnang / /de gsog nas so nam 'bod dang / /'bru sna lnga 'khyongs pa'i gzhi yin/ / ’zhes te rta bor lcag gis bskul te bya 'phur ba bzhin phyin rjes/ rngon pa spun gnyis 'gyod cing skyengs pa'i ngang rangayul du log /de nas yang nyin 'ga'i rjes kyi nangs snga mo zhig 'a//rngon pa spun gnyis kyes ri dwags gshor du 'gro ba'i sta gon gang legs byas te/ lam la chas shing lung ba gu dog po zhig tu sngon shwa ba shor tshul dang 'tshang brus tshul gyi gtam gleng byed ba'in du 'gro ba'i skabs su/ yang nu bos pha ri'i rdza gseb na kha sha gnyis yod pa mthong ste smras pa/ ‘ a jo a jo ra ltos yar la lto sa/ /pha ri'i brag de'i 'bar 'bur sayas zur dang / spen ma tshom bu gsum gyi g.yon zur na/ /kha sha gnyis de bong bu'i tshad tsam 'dug /sngom ma tsho la rjes mar sha 'bab che/ /nyag phran 'phen pa'i byang cha khyed la yod/ /ma 'chug ma nor sngon ma de la phongs/ /nya zhes bshad tshe/ phu bos phar bltas tsam byas 25/

nas smras nga// ‘‘nu bo kha 6/nga gtam 'chal ma lab dang / /ri dwags nyul ba'i nyams myong yod pa bden/ /tsho rjid dpag pa'i nyams myong ldan pa brdzun/ /nga yis bltas na sngon mar sha 'bab che/ /mi bden 'dod na za dus bltas kyang chog /’ ces te/ nu bos 'bab cam yul du khyer na kun la them zer ba dang / phu bos tshon po tshwa la sbyar na lhag par zhim zer te rtsod gleng byed bzhin pa'i skabs su/ lug rdzi zhib/ ges mthong ste der phyin nas bar 'dum byed zhor du khyed gnyis kyis ci zhig rtsod kyin 'dug ces dris tshe / nu bos rtsod gzhi ji ma ji bzhin du bshad de/ lug rdzis nye 'khor du bltas pa na/ ci yang med pas/ ca‘kha sha gang na yod ces dris tshe/ phu bos mgo sgur sgur du zu‘pha ri'i rdza gseb na 'dug 1zer/ lug rdzis de thos ma thag tu hab dgod byas te na re/ 6‘kha bsod med pa'i spun gnyis kha rog sdod/ /kha sha'i spu tsam ma thob kha rtso da bslangs/ /la mang ca co bsgrags pas kha sha 'drogs/ /kha skam ngo skyur mi lob/ kha med red/ /sha 'bab them min rtsod pa ngo re tsha/ /tshon po tshwa la sbyar ba ya re nga shwa ba ma sod tho/nga du tshwa gleng da/ /dper 'os khyed gnyis gzhan na ma mchis so/ / zhes bshad de phyin no/ /252

de nas rngon pa spun gnyis kha sha ri la shor bas kha skyengs thing / slar yang 'tshang ngan brus pas ngo skyengs te/gcig ngor gcig gis ce ri lta bzhin sems phangs pa'i ngang yul du log go/(bsod nams kyis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1985lo'i deb gsum pa las bdams/ )

zhu tho spun gahaṃska/de snga yul ga ge mo zhig na bu mo spun gnyis yod de/spun chung ba de rig pa rno zhing las la brtson pa dang / nang la brtse zhing phyi la byams/ che ba de las ldog ste/ rig pa rtul zhing le lo can/ nang la rtsub cing phyi la sdang bas rang rang la gshis spyod re yod/ las skal dman pas spun chung ba snum tshong mkhan zhig dang / che ba shan pa zhig dang gnyen sgrig byas te/ dgod bro ba'i gtam rgyud 'di 'dra zhig grags 'dug /de yang snum tshong mkhan gyi khyim bdag ma de khyim gzhis skyong mkhas la blo rig ha cang grim pas khyo ga khrom la song shul du nyin ltar lkog tu snum rdza las snum thom bu gang re bcus te rdza ma zhig tu blugs/ de nas lo sar la nye ba na/ khyo gar lo sar rgyu phar zhog bu lon yang 'jal thabs bral te/ yid ha cang sdug pa'i ngang khyim mtshes la ba mo zhig yod pa rku rtsis byas tshe/ khyo mos tshor te myur du snum rdza ma gang bo de bstan nas na re/ 6 kye kye/ khyed la bud med cig gi 'char sgo tsam yang med par ma rabs kyi las 254

su zhugs rgyur ya mi nga'am/ de ni tha mar rang nyid brlag pa'i rgyu yin te/ de las 'dir ngas yun ring du bsags pa'i snum rdza ma gang 'dug 'di btsong na ma mtha' yin na'ang bu lon 'jal los thub/ ’ ces pa na/ kho ha cang dga' nas khyo mor bzang tshul rgyan tshul gyi ngo bstod gang mang byas mthar/ snum rdza khur nas khrom la song / snum rin gyis bu lon 'jal bar ma zad/ da dung lo sar la mkho rdzas gang 'dod cig nyos te yul du logade nas nyi ma 'ga'i rjes su don de shan pas thos nas chung mar ji ma ji bzhin du bshad pa na/ mo'i blor ma bab par/ ‘ 'o/ de de 'dra ngo mtshar ba zhig yin nam/ khyod ci 'dra'i blun po ang / thag ring yul nas zas nor 'tshol dka' ba las/ khyim gzhis lto phor 'dra ba 'di'i nang gi zas nor gsog rgyu sus mi shes/ khyod kyi blo bde mo gyis/ de de 'dra bya dka' ba zhig ma red/ ’’ ces kha pho bshad mod/ don du 'dug sa nas nyal sar 'gro ba'i tshegs la 'dzem pa zhig yin/ khyo gas de la de 'tsham gyi lan btab ste/ ‘ ya/ bzang gi ngas da bar du khyod kyis khyim/ gzhis legs par skyong ba mthong ma myong mod/ 'o na da nas khyod kyis nga la raca/ 'degs gyis dang / ji 'dra 255

yin par bltas pas choganya zer te khrom la song / de nas bzung ste kho mos kyang nyin ltar sha rdog po re bcad de sle bo zhig tu bzhag yang lo mjug tu bran bdag gis khyo gar bu lon bsnyegs tshe/ 'jal ba'i thabs zad nas shugs ring nar nar 'byin bzhin 'dug skabs der chung mas ngo la 'dzum rgyas kha nas ca co bsgrags te sle bo zhig khur nas thon byung / 6 khyod kyis de 'dra'i semaje sdug byas nas ci phan/ de las sla mo zhig red/ ngas 'dir lo gang bor bsags nyar byas pa'i sha sle bo gang yod/ 'di btsong na bu lon 'jal los thub/ ’ ces bshad rjes/ sle bo dri ngan 'thul ba de khyer yong ba na/ sle bo'i nang du 'bu sob sob tu 'dug pa las sha ni gang na yod/ de mthong ma thag khyo ga yid thang chad de na re/ 6‘kye kye khyod 'dra'i gzab 'phyor dang zhim mngar zas la rngams pa dang /phyi nang du spyod pa ngan pa'i dug rlangs lding ba'i blun zhing rtul ba'i rna nag ma zhig la sdeb pa las/ brag khung zhig tu kher 'dug byed dgos kyang 'gyod pa medanya’ces khyo shug gnyis 'khon no/ /(bsod nams kyis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1985lo'i deb gsum pa las bdams/ )256

khri shor rgyalu sko dad yun chud lha sgo/gna' bskal ba'i dus su brjod pa ltar na/ mtsho snying zhes pa'i ri de'i zhabs na klu'i pho brang zhig yod/ pho brang du g.yu 'brug ces pa'i klu khams dbang du sdud mkhan gyi klu'i rgyal mo zer ba rngam brjid can zhig mchis/steng gi bkra shis dbyar mo'i rtswa thang du 'brog ru khri stong dang rta nor lug gsum mang bo skar tshogs bzhin du khra lam mer sa gzhir khyab 'dug yul khams 'di'i byang mtha'i ru sde'i 'brog khyim zhig la yum chung lha mo zhes pa'i bu mo sgeg cing pe dzes pa zhig yod/ de'i skyes pa'i ming la ber skya 'od 'bum zhes zer zhing bza' zla gnyis ni phan tshun shin tu brtse zhing dungs/ lo gcig 'gor ba'i rjes su/ yum chung lha mor bu zhig 'khrungs stabs ber skya 'od 'bum dga' ste gtam snyan de phyogs so sor 'ur zhong gtam de sgrog gin sgrog gin klu'i pho brang gi g.yu 'brug rgyal mo'i rna ru 'byor/ rgyal mos myur bar sbal ba klu sgrub mi 257

yul du mngags nas myul dpyod byas dus su/ ngo mas bu mo sha rtsa dkar bo dung 'dra ba dang mdzes mdangs me tog padma las lhag pa zhig la bu zhig 'khrungs pa mthong / de nas sbal ba myur bar phyir log ste klu'i rgyal mo la 'di skad du rgyal mo lags/ sa steng byang mtha'i ru sde na/ ngo ma'i bu mo mdzes shing lta na sdug pa/ mthong na yid dbang 'phrog pa/ klu yul na do zla med pa zhig mchis/ ming la yum chung lha mo zer’ zhes zhus tshe/ rgyal mo'i thugs dgongs la/ ang / snga nyin mi bkra mi shis pa zhig klu sgor yong nas klu chu'i sgo phyes pa dang / de ring bu mo mdzes ma yid sems 'gugs pa de 'dra zhig yod pa yin na/ e/ ngas dbyar mo thang la mtsho zhig bskyil nas ru sde thams cad bsnubs te/ bu mo de sras kyi mna' mar 'phrog dgos snyam/ de nas blon chen sdig srin mgo la bka' phab ste/ pho brang bla ri'i gting 'og gi mda' ma mde'u mtshon rdzong ba byas nas klu dmag rnams la dbyug gi sta re kha dgu dang rno nag phur bu sne dgu sogs 'khur du bcug nas/ klu chu mtsho mo'i khar phyin te mtsho rags rnams bshig cing / mtsha chu rba rlabs 'phyo bzhin du klu chur 'dres te klu sgo nas sa steng du 'phyur/ der brten bkra shis dbyar mo thang hril 258

bor skad cig nyid la chus bkang ste 'brog ru khri stong mang bo bsnubs shing / rtswa thang yongs rdzogs mtsho chen zhig tu gyur/ rgyal mos skabs der bstun nas myur bar dmag btang ste byang 'gram ru sde nas yum chung lha mo klu'i pho brang du phrogs song /dgong mo der/ rgyal mos gsol ston rgya chen po bshams/ pho brang gi phyi nang du rin po che dkar ser dmar ljang gis gzi 'od 'phro ba dang / shel khang gi sgron 'od dkar chem chem nyi ma shar ba ltar yul khams yongs la khyab/ gsol ston khang du g.yang ṭi'i cog tse dang / mu men gyi sgron me/ byu ru'i chang bum/ mu tig gi chang dkar/ glang chen mche ba'i bzhugs khri/ gser dngul gyi sder sngod/ mtsho las grub pa'i zas rdzas sna tshogs ci 'dod du phun sum tshogs pa bshams pa'o/ /g.yu 'brug rgyal mo'i bsam pa la/ bu mo gang dang gang yin yang rgyu nor zas sos la zhen pa yin snyam mod/'on kyang / de dag rnams ji ltar mdzes kyang yum chung lha mos mig gi zur gyis kyang ma bltas par mgo bsgur nas bsdad/ gnyen mkhan sku dmar mtsho mo yum chung lha mo'i byub tu yong nas yag bshad rtsub bshad gang byas kyang mo'i 259

rna nang du tshig spu tsam yang ma song zhing / mos sems sdug ngang nas ngu bzhin du rgyal mor sdigs mdzub btsugs te 4 nga phyir la 'gro ru chug ces brjod/rgyal mos tshul de mthong bas khong khro skyes te na re/61hang / khyod la ston mo 'di 'dra zhig bsgrigs kyang da dung mna' ma byed mi 'dod na/ khyod phyir 'gro sa med/chu srin dmag dpon la/ bu mo tha shal ba 'di chu rnyog rdzing bur phongs shig /ces bka' phab/ chu srin gyis klu dmag bos nas yum chung lha mo yar bkyags nas ‘nyog se chu rnyog nang du 'phangs/ rus sbal blon gyis de mthong bas ha las te rgyug 'ongs nas bu mo skyob 'dod kyang skyob long ma byung ba red/ yum chung lha mos rdzing bu'i nang du 'phag ra byas byas pas chu khar g.yeng dus/ rkang ba gnyis la rdo btags pa ltar 'gul rgyu ci yang med par gyur/ de nas mo'i sems la nga rang ci byas kyang yul la 'gro dgos snyam bzhin sems skyo ste mchi ma 'dzad med du bzhur gyin dran med du brgyal song /skabacan der/ rus sbal blon gyi bsam pa la ngas cis kyang yum chung lha mo bskyab dgos bsams te/ lkog nas rin chen ril bu ba/cig khyer song ste yum chung lha mo'i 266 /

kha nang du bzhag ma 'gor bar yum chung lha mo brgyal ba las sangs te mig phur bzhin du a ya/ nga la ci ma nyan7zer bzhin g.yas g.yon du lta dus/ rus sbal blon ni mo'i gam du yod pa mthong / de nas rus sbal blon gyis bu mo sad pa mthong bas dngangs 'tshub 'tshub tu ya bu mo/da khyod 'dug ran ma red/ myur du phros shig khyod la da rung sbrum chags yod pa red’’ces bshad/ yum chung lha mos skad cha de thos pas shin tu yid skyo ba dang / mo'i sems la 'phral du ber skya 'od 'bum dang yul gyi byis pa gnyis shar te bzod ma nus par rus sbal blon gyi rogs ram 'og tu klu sgor phyin/ klu mkhar sgo srung gis mo rang bkag ste 'gro ru mi 'jug par/ yang rus sbal blon gyis klu'i rgyal mo'i bka' yin khul byas nas srung dmag la lab pa na sgo srung gis bden snyam nas 'gro ru bcug der brten nas yum chung lha mo klu chu'i bzhur log cig la 'brel nas myur bar klu sgo'i phyi ru thon mod/ 'on kyang phyi rol gyi yul khams thams cad kyang sngo ltem ltem gyi chus bkang ste mngon mtha' med par gyur 'dug de lta na'ang yum chung lha mo bza' zla dang byis par ngo 'phrad pa'i ched du/ yid ma chad par nyin nas zhag dang zhag la nyin bsnan nas nyi ma'i shar 261

nub la bltas te byang phyogs su brkyal/ mtshams mtshams su lam phyogs nor na'ang nam mkha'i bya rnams la 'dri zhor du sngon la brkyal/ lam bar nas mos bkres ltogs dka' ngal gang mang khyad du bsad de nyin ci mang la song rjes su nyin gcig mtsho mtha'i rang gi ru sde yi 'dabs su bslebs/mos rang sde'i 'brog pa dang ber skya 'od 'bum rnams mtsho kha na yod pa mthong / de nas yum chung lha mo'i sems la dga' ba brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig skyes te/ sems la myur bar gshog pa zhig thogs te bya 'phur ba ltar khong rnams kyi gem du 'byor na ci ma rung 'dod mod/ 'on kyang / mi legs pa zhig la/ skabs der mtsho'i ba rlabs gcig rjes gcig gis mnan 'ongs pa'i khar lus ngal bas mnar te mtsho mthar 'bud ma nus shing / mi rnams kyis mtsho nang du srog chags shig yong ba 'dra snyams/ de yum chung lha mo yin pa ma shes par sems la chu srin dmag dpon slar yang mi 'dzin du yong ba red snyam nas rang rang sar bros song / de nas bzung yum chung lha mo mtsho nang du lus te rang gi yul mi tshor lhan 'dzoms ma thub pa'i rkyen gyis zhe sdug ste mchi ma shor bzhin mtsho nang du 'khyams so/ /262

de dus mtsho ni da rung klu sgo'i chu 'byur bar brten nas/ mu mthud du ches cher rgyas te stong skor dang khri ku'i phyogs su 'byo nyen yod/ rgya gar chos kyi rgyal bo'i dge 'dun pa o rgyan gyis klu'i rgyal mos klu chu 'phyur du bcug ste rtswa thang 'brog ru khri phrag bsnubs nas mi yul la gnod 'tshe chen po bskyal 'dug pa mngon par mkhyen zhing /gnod 'tshe de sel ba'i ched du/ o rgyan gyis rgya gar gyi ri bo ma hā de wa'i dbu rtse bcad nas mar dbyugs te klu chu'i chu mig kha bcad par ma zad/ khong dngos su byon te yar la mer bzhin pa'i mtsho chu gzan lcag gis brabs te rdzu 'phrul gyis phyir bsdus pa dang / mtsho chu mi skam pa'i ched du/yang mtha' skor gyi ri lung so so'i chu sna che chung brgya dang brgyad mtsho nang du drangs/ de las chu gcig gis ma 'dangs pas shar phyogs su bzhur ba'i rig smon chu de dug sbrul zhig la khrid du bcug ste nub phyogs su drangs/ mi rnams kyis der rjes dran bya ched/ mtsho der ‘khri shor rgyal mo’’zhes pa dang / ri de mtsho yi dbus su gnas pa'i snying dbyibs dang 'dra bas mtsho snying dang 'chad khungs rgya gar gyi ri bo ma hā de wa yin pas yang mtsho snying ma hā de wa zhes bya'o/ /263

de nas klu khams kyi dmag dpon chu srin gyi a khu srin pos o rgyan gyi bca' lugs la shin tu ma dga' bar thugs khros te/ sems la gang ltar mtsho snying gi ri de bshig ste/ klu chu'i kha slar yang 'byed dgos snyam nas/shed shugs gang yod phyung zhing brag dkar therma rdzong gi dbu rtse bcad nas mar mtsho snying gi ri thog tu dbyugs mod/'on kyang srin pos tsha bo la rogs byas nas de ltar byed srid pa o rgyan gyis sngar nas mkhyen 'dug cing / srin pos brag rtse dbyugs ma thag tu o rgyan gyis myur bar rdzu 'phrul bstan te mtsho rnga'i lho nub kyi mtshams su btul nas ming la 'dre mo brag dkar ’zhes mi snyan pa btags shing lha mi kun kyi dgra bor 'chad pa'o/ /rjes su/ yum chung lha mos mi min klu min gyi byis pa zhig btsas/ de'i phyir mo rang lhag par zhe smreng ste ngu bzhin du mtsho las gar gnas gar 'gro med par gyur nas lho ru 'khyams yong mod/ 'on kyang mo'i sems su da rung bor skya 'od 'bum pha bu gnyis bzung yod cing / zla re'i bco lnga'i dgong mo'i zla ba ha cang gsal ba'i dus la/ mo rang mtsho khar g.yeng ste 'dre mo brag dkar gyi steng du bud nas〈〈mtsho ngogs〉〉skyo glu len bzhin du mi min klu min byis 264

par nu ma bsnun te ma/chi ma bton no/ /skabs der/ ber skya 'od 'bum pha bu gnyica4 kyis da rung sngar bzhin du yum chung lha mo phyir yong bar bsgugs/nyin sgug mtshan sgug dang zla sgug lo sgug byas kyang yum chung lha mo phyir yong ma byung stabs/ nyin gcig pha bu gnyis rkyal gzings shig la bsdad de mtsho snying ri'i mtha' skor phyogs so sor btsal du song ste/ mtsho yi mgo nas mjug bar a ma/ a ma/ ’’zhes bos pa dang / ber skya 'od 'bum lhag par du yid smreng zhing mchi ma 'don bzhin skad gang yong phyung nas ka yi yum chung lha mo/ ka yi yum chung lha mo/ ’ zhes bos kyang yum chung lha mo mthong rgyu lta ci a lan zhig kyang thos rgyu ma byung / de nas nyin zhig 'dre mo brag dkar kyi nye 'dabs su bskyod dus/ ber skya 'od 'bum gyis rba rlabs shig gi nang nas glo bur du bu mo zhig gi lus gzugs mthong / de'i rgyab na skra nag po thur du dpyangs shing skyo glu len pa thos/ kho'i segs la de ni yum chung lha mo yin snyam nas khos gzings khem gyis mgyogs por dkrugs nas mo yod sar bskyod de sleb la khad kyi skabs der/ klu'i rgyal mo sems nag des shes te cho 'phrul gyis mtsho rlung g.yugs nas/ gnam sar byang sgra 'ur sgras 26 5

khengs par brten nas rkyal gzings dang mi tshang ma nam mkhar drangs song ngo / /de nas bzung ber skya 'od 'bum pha bu gnyis mthong rgyu ma byung zhing / kho gnyis ni dkar skya dngul mdog 'dra ba'i mthing ril che chung gnyis su gyur te/ nyin bzhin du mtsho sngon po'i mkha' dbyings su 'phur zhing bskyod de yum chung lha mo 'tshol bzhin mchis/ nga tsho mtsho mtha' la phyin tshe/ rgyun par‘ us ya/ us ya/ ’ zhes pa'i chu bya'i 'bod sgra zhig thos/ rgan pa tshos6‘de ni mthing ril gyis yum chung lha mo 'bod pa yin’ zer/da lta mtsho sngon po'i nang du mthing ril khri stong mang bo tshogs bzhin mchis pa de dag ni de'i rjes rgyud kyi rgyun 'dug bya dang mtsho sngon po'i bdag po'i bya rigs shig yin par grags so/ /(lha rgyal tshe ring gis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1986lo'i deb gnyis pa las bdams/ )266

nya sko nyag ga dad rgya zhaba' kod rdo/mtsho sngon po'i shar phyogs kyi spyi le bzhi bcu'i mtshams na nyi zla nyag ga zhes pa'i nyag ga mda' ltong 'dra ba zhig mchis/ de'i g.yon phyogs ni stong skor khog ces pa'i lung ba ring bo zab shing dma' la dro bas 'bru gzan sna lnga skyes pa'i rong yul zhig yin pa dang / g.yas phyogs ni dkar bo gangs kyis bskor ba'i rtswa thang du sbra nag dud khyim chags te rta nor lug gsum gyis bkang ba'i 'brog khul zhig yin/ nyag ga de ni sngon dang bo bod rgya sog gsum gyi tshong mgron mang bo'i bzhud lam yin pa yang zin bris gang mang las gsal 'dug lhag par du thang rgyal rabs kyi rjes su nyag ga de rgya bza' kong jo bod la gdan drangs pa'i gtam rgyud nas 'brel nas lhag tu don snying can dang snyan 'jebs can du gyur to/ /de yang rags tsam brjod na/ sprul ba'i rgyal bo bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i thugs dgongs la/ bdag gis kha ba can gyi yul 'dir / theg pa chen po'i chos dar bar byed 267

pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku lacig rgya gar na bzhugs/gcig bal yul na bzhugs/ rgacig rgya nag na bzhugs/sku de gsum gang na bzhugs pa'i yul der theg pa chen po'i chos dar yod pas/ ji ltar byas kyang sku de gsum gre/dan 'dren dgos dgongs te/ tsardzan gyi sku rang byon la gsol ba btab/ dgeng cho/ rgyal bo'i rmi lam du sku de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gnyis gcig shar du 'phros pa dang gcig nub tu 'phros/ sar du 'phros pa de la gzigs pas shar phyogs rgya nag bi yul na rgya rje the tsong rgyal bo la sras mo lha gcig kong jo bya ba sku mdog sngo la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal nas utpal sngon po'i dri bro ba/ rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi bstan bcos tham sa cad la mnga' brnyes pa zhig bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /de nas nangs par rgyal bos blon po thams cad drung du bos te/ mdang nga'i rmi lam du shar phyogs na rgya rje'i sras mo bu mo mdzes ma zhig yod pa nga'i khab tu byung ba rmis so gsungs pas/ blon po myo/gar gyis rgyal bo la des na de ni gdan 'dren pa'i pama' gnang bar zhu’ zhes zhus/ de nas rgyal bos zhu rten la gser gyi dong tse bdun dang lha gcig de'i rin la padma rā gas phra brgyab pa'i rin po che yi khrab gcig gang 268

dgos kyi 'gro sgo la gser phye bre gang / bka' lung la lan gyi bka' shog gsum bcas bskur ba dang / 'phral mkho'i yo byad gos dang rgyan cha la sogs pa rnga mong dang drel rta la bkal ba'i khal mang bo brdzangs/ de nas myo/gar gyis rgyal bos bskur ba rnams khyer te khal ma thams cad ded nas blon 'khor rta ba brgya dang lhan du me pho spre'u'i lo'i (spyi lo 640 lo) zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes brgyad nyin rgya nag tu chas so/ /mgar blon 'khor rnams rgya nag gi rgyal sa khrang an du slebs dus/ der rgya gar chos kyi rgyal bo'i blon po dang / ge sar dmag gi rgyal bo'i blon po/ stag gzig nor gyi rgyal bo'i blon po/ bha dā hor gyi rgya' bo'i blon po rnams kyang sras mo gnyen du slong bar bslebs 'dug thang the tsong rgyal bos de rnams mthong bas rgyal khab so so'i rgyal blon rnams la zhal mjal gnangs te de dag gi yong don gyi zhu ba la gsan rjes su/ ha las te gang la yang ster ma phod par blon rnams rang rang sgar thog tu 'gro ru bcugarjes su yab rgyal bo dang yum btsun mo dang sras bu chung gsum gyis gros mdzad mthar/ rgyal khab so so'i blon po'i bar la rig pa 'gran pa'i thabs shig brnyed de su yi blo 269

rig mkhas tshe/ rgyal khab de'i rgyal bo la lha gcig ster rgyu thag bcad/ nyin zhig thang the tsong gis blo thabs de ltar du rgyal khab so so'i blon po rnams pho brang du gdan zhus te na re/ 6 da lta rgyal khab so so'i blon gyi bar la rig pa 'gran dgos/ su yi blo rig mkhas na de la lha gcig ster rgyu yin’nyazhes bsgrags shing thog mar bla g.yu sgor mo khung mig khog 'khyil can zhig yod pa de'i khung bu la dar skud 'dren pa'i rig pa 'gran du bcug de'i rjes su lug brgya gtang nas nyin gcig la de rnams bshas tshar ba dang / sha zos tshar ba/ pags pa mnyes tshar ba'i rtsal 'gran du bcug de'i rjes su chang ben brgya gtad nas/ de rnam sa sang gi nyin phyed tshun la 'thung tshar te mi bor ba dang mi bzi ba'i stobs 'gran du bcug de'i rjes su rgod ma brgya dang rte'u brgya ma bu kha bkar rjes/ ma bu so sor ngos zin pa'i blo rig 'gran du bcug de'i rjes su bya mo brgya yi bya phrug rnams bkar rjes su/ ma bu so sor ngos zin pa'i thabs shes 'gran du bcug de'i rjes su gsom sdong 'dzer ba med pa mgo rting mi shes pa khru gang re can brgya gtad nas/ de yi mgo mjug shes pa'i thabs 'gran du bcug de'i rjes su yang dgong mo zhig 270

la blon po rnams pho brang du zhus te ston mo byas pa dang /srod kyi mun nag la blon po rnams phyir song nas rang rang gi khang ba rnyed par 'gran du bcug de rnams rgyal khab gzhan pa'i blon po tshang mar blo thabs zad de 'grub ma thub cing / blon po mgar gyis de thams cad re re bzhin blo dang rig pas ngos zin pa dang 'grub na'ang thang rgyal bos lha gcig bod la sbyin mi 'dod pas/ mthar thang rgyal bos slar yang blo gcig bton pa zhag gsum pa'i nyin shar sgo'i thang la/ bu mo mtshar sdug ldan pa sum brgya rgyan gyis brgyan nas gral bsgrigs/ de'i khrod du lha gcig 'jog la/ de su yis ngo shes pa la ster ba yin’ gsungs/de ni mtha/ra la'ang thabs zad pas na/ sngon rgyal bo'i pho brang du lha gcig sras mo'i g.yog mo byas myong ba'i gnas mor gser phye bre gang phul te lha gcig gi rgyu mtshan mtha' dag zhib par dris/ de nas lha gcig bsal ba'i nyin der/ shar sgo'i thang nas bu mo rgyan gos dang gzugs dbyibs gcig 'dra ba sum brgya bsgrigs pa'i nang nas/rgyal khab so so'i blon po tshang mas bu mo gang mdzes ma gnyis re ngos bzung nas rang rang sar khrid nas song / blon po mgar gyis myur du ngos ma bzung bar gnas mos ཿ71

bshad pa ltar du/ smyo bu mo gzhan las che rgyu med/ skye gzugs gzhan las yag rgyu med/ rgyan gos gzhan las bzang rgyu med/ sku mdog sngo la dmar mdangs chags/utpal sngon po'i dri ngad bro/ lus dri zhim pas g.yu sprang 'khor/ mkhur tshos g.yas steng cho lo ris/ g.yon pa'i ste nga na padma ris/ dpral dkyil sirdzu'i theg le'i steng / ārya tā re nas tsam yod / lha gcig 'phrul gyi kong jo de/gral gyi ma tha' mar yang mi yong / dkyil nas mi 'dug g.yon gral nas/ bsgrigs pa'i drug gi gong du 'ongs zhes pa bzhin brtags nas bltas pas/ rgyal khab de dag gis khrid pa thams cad lha gcig kong jo min pa shes te/ 4mgar rab tu dga' nas 'dzum dmul shor bzhin g.yang mda' gsar ba zhig khyer ba dang bod blon rnams khrid nas g.yon gral du phyin te gral gyi mtha' ma'i bu mo nas rim par lta bzhin du ang brgyad pa'i drung du bslebs pas/bu mo der gong gi yon tan thams cad 'dzoms 'dug pa mthong ste/ de ni kong jo yin par ngos bzung nas gos kyi gong ba la mda'i ltong gis bzung nas 'then pas na lha/ sa cig kong jo ngu bzhin du blon po'i rjes su 'brangs te phyin no/ /272

de nas kong jo ngu ba la/ blon po mgar gyis spro ba bskyed pa'i glu blangs pa dang / thon mi sastoṭa dang 'bri se ru gong ston gnyis kyis ram btegs nas bod kyi rgyal khams la chos kyi nyi ma shar ba dang / gser dngul zangs lcags sogs kyi rin po che 'dzoms pa/ 'bru gzan sna lnga 'khrungs pa/ rta nor lug gsum 'phel ba/ bod rgyal srong btsan zhes pa de rigs gzugs dpal gyis brjid pa/mthong na yid sems 'phrog pa sogs kyi sems gso ci mang mdzad/ rjes su yab rgyal bos kyang bod la mi 'gro ka med kyi bka' phab pa dang thugs brtse ba'i gtam gang mang gnang zhing 'jig rten la dgos pa'i bslab bya dpag tu med pa mdzad par ma zad/ rin po che'i rgyu nor gyi rdzong ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byin/ de nas kong jo blon po mgar gyi rtsar yong nas na re/ 8 blon po chen po lags/ khyed kyi yul du jo bo shākya yang gdan 'dren/ nor dpag tu med pa'ang khyer nas 'gro/ de min khyed kyi yul na sa kham pa yod dam/ rdo srin zan yod dam/ shing se ba yod dam/rtswa dres ma yod dam/ yungs ma yo da dmanya’zhes zer ba la/mgar gyis gzhan rnam/sa yod/ yungs ma med/ : ces pas// yungs ma'i sa bon khyer zhing shing rta'i steng du jo po 273

shākya bzhugs/ shing rta de rgya nag na stobs che ba'i lha dga' dang klu dga' gnyis la 'dren du bcug gzhan yang rin po che dang / dar dang / gos dang / rgyan dang / 'phral mkho'i yo byad rnams bkal ba'i rta dang drel dang rnga mong la sogs pa mang bo brdzangs shing / bod blon rnams la'ang ston mo dang gnang sbyin dpag tu med pa mdzad/ de nas kong jo rin po che'i rgyan mang bos brgyan nas/ mdzes pa'i bu mo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'khor dang con bang lis to tso nga bcas nga/sa srung skyel byas nas so so rang rang gi rta la bcibs te/ yab yum sras gsum dang blon 'khor bcas pas skyel thung mdzad 'og bod du chas so/ /skabs der bod blon 'bri se ru gong ston zer ba des blon po mgar la phrag dog byas nas thang rgyal bo la/ ‘ kong jo'i tshab tu blon po rig pa can gcig bsdad na bod rgya gnyis mthun 'ong’’zer nas blon po mgar la mig ce re bltas pas na/ rgyal bos kyang kong jo'i tshab tu blon po mgar 'dug dgosanya gsungs/ blon po mgar gyis se ru gong ston gyis phrag dog byed 'dug pa shes na'ang ‘rgya bod gnyis mthun pa ngas byed’ zer nas zla ba drug lhag la rgya nag tu bzhugs so/ /274

kaung dzo dang blon 'khor rnams khrang yon nas chas rjes la ma bar du byams pa'i sku bzhengs pa dang / zhing 'debs pa/ rang 'thag chu 'khor 'dzugs pa sogs byed bzhin du dal bar phebs/ phyi lo'i dbyar 'gor da lta'i nyi zla nyag ga brgyud nas bkra shis dbyar mo thang(da lta'i rig smon gzhung) du sgar btab ste zla ba gnyis tsam la bsdad/de dus dbyar kha yin pas rtswa thang yongs la sngo ljang gis khebs pa dang nam zla yang cung dro bas kong jo dang blon 'khor rnams kyis mtsho sngon po dang ri lung dag la lta skor dang skyo bsang mdzad de blon po mgar phebs par bsgugs/de ni kong jos thengs dang por kha ba can gyi sa thog tu gom pa spos nas bod 'brog mi dmangs la 'tshams 'dri dang / bod kyi yul srol goms gshis dang 'tsho ba'i nyams tshod myangs pa zhig yin/ nyin zhig kong jos kho kho nor ri lung(da lta'i blon po gser chen ri) du skyo bsang byed pa'i dus su/ 'brog phrug rta zhon rdzi bo gnyis kyis g.yang dkar 'tsho bzhin du thog mar rta rgyug res dang / rjes su glu len res/ mthar 'ju res byed pa'i rtswa thang gi rtsed mo'i rnam pa mthong bas shin tu thugs dgyes te myur bar gam du bcar nas kho gnyis la zhal ta mdzad de/ ming la ci zer/275

yul gang du sdod/ bza' mi gang dag yod/ gyugs ci tsam skyong ba sogs zhib par dris shing / rgya nag nas khyer 'ongs pa'i ka ra sil tog sogs gnang / phyir sgar thog tu phebs nas phyi nyin nye 'khor gyi bla dpon gtsor mdzad pa'i 'brog pa glu ba glu ma dang rta rgyug mkhan/ 'ju rtsal pa sogs mang tshogs brgya phrag du ma gdan zhus nas rgya nag zas chang gi gsol ston rgya chen po bshams te 'brog 'bangs rnams la 'tshams 'dri mdzad cing glu len gar rtsed dang rta rgyug byas so/ /bkra shis dbyar mo thang sa ngos mtho la/ shar nas nub tu rim bzhin thang gzhung yangs shing che ba/ gzhung stod dog pa'i rkyen gyis nub rlung gi rlung sgo zhig tu gyur 'dug pas/ dbyar zla drug pa'i nang du'ang kha char bu yug gis rgyun mi chad cing / nam zlar 'gyur ldog shin tu che/ kong jos tshul de rnams mthong nas zhe sdug ste khrang an gyi rje yab yum gnyis dang zas gos rol gsum la zhen nas sa 'di'i nyi zla ni khrang an gyi nyi zla dang mi 'dra sems te spyan chab shor zhing bod du 'phebs 'dod ma skyes/de nas ston 'go la nye ba'i dus su kong jos lho phyogs pha yul du skyog pa'i khrung khrung la 'phrin yig bskur te khrang an 276

gyi pha mar sems kyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhus/ yab rgyal bo dang yum btsun mo gnyis la khrung khrung gis khyer 'ongs pa'i 'phrin yig de 'byor 'phral du/ kong jor sems gso mdzad pa'i ched du myur bar gser gyi nyi zla gnyis bzhengs te bskur yong ba de'i don ni kong jo zhe sdug dus gser gyi nyi zla de gnyis la gzigs tshe de ni pha yul gyi nyi zla dang mtshungs zhes pa'i brda'o/ /'on kyang skabs der blon po mgar yang rgyal sa khrang man nas phyir stong skor du bslebs shing tshul de shes te thugs dgongs la/ kong jos pha mas gnang ba'i dran rten de mthong tsa na lhag tu pha ma dang khrang an la zhe chags nas bod la phebs dka' rgyu red sems nas kong jo pha ma la zhe log pa'i ched du/ rdo bzo zhig la gser gyi nyi zla gnyis dang mtshungs pa'i rdo yi nyi zla gnyis bzo ru bcug ste der gser chu byugs nas ra rkyal rlon pa zhig gi nang du bcugade nas kong jos pha mas gser gyi nyi zla gnyis kyi dran rten bskur yod pa thos 'phral du/ sems dga' ste myur bar blon 'khor rnams khrid nas da lta'i nyi zla nyag ga la bsu bar phebs/ skabs der blon po mgar gyis rkyal ba de bzung nas sa der bslebs pa dang / 8 kong jo'i pha mas 27 7

bskur ba'i gser gyi nyi ma dang gser gyi zla ba yin zhes rkyal ba de kong jo'i phyag tu phul/ kong jos tshur blangs te rkyal ba'i kha phyes nas lta dus su/ gser chu rnams dag zin pa'i rdo yi nyi zla gnyis yin pa mthong bas ngo tsha ste zhal mdog dmar bor gyur nas spyan chab shor zhing /sems su pha ma gnyis kyis rdo yi nyi zla gnyis bskur nas bu mo'i sems bsad pa red bsam bzhin khong khro chen po skyes mas rdo yi nyi zla gnyis de ru dbyugs shing blon 'khor khrid nas phyir sgar thog tu log go/ de nas nyin 'gar kong jos bza' btung mi bzhes par ngus nas bsdad/ blon po mgar gyis tshul de mthong bas sems su dga' ba skyes te nyin zhig kong jo'i drung du phyin nas na re/6 sras lha gcig rgya bza' kong jo lags//yid ma skyo bdag gi tshig la gson//rje yab yum gnyis kyi sems nang du//khyed lha gcig lhan du yod tsa na//sras mdang chen yin pa'i snang tshul bstan//dus deng sang bod du phebs sgang la//rdo nyi zla'i dran rten gnang ba de//khyed mdangs med rtags mtshan bstan pa red//278

zhe ma skyo gangs can bod la 'gro//god kha ba can gyi rgyal khams na// gser rin chen sna lnga 'bol po yod//rje srong btsan rgyal bo'i pho brang na//mi rje lha yi tshul mdzad yod//rje chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po de//rigs gzugs dpags shing dpal gyis brjid//mthong bas yid 'phrog thugs rje che//rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs nas gda'//rgyal blon 'khor 'bangs thams cad la//chos srid gnyis kyi nyi ma shar//dga' la skyid pa'i glu dbyangs len//ri lung kun la shing sna tshang //sa gzhi 'bru sna lnga yis gang //rta nor lug gis nor 'dzin khyab//zas nor longs spyod de ru 'dzoms//bde ba'i dga' skyid de na yod//khyed lha gcig myur bar phebs par zhu//’ zhes zhus pa na/ kong jo'i bsam pa la de 'dra yin na bod kyi rgyal khams sa cha yang rang gi pha yul dang khyad par 279

med/ da lta phyir song na yang 'gro sa med par ma zad/ ngo tsha de las che/ pha mas kyang sdang nyen yod/ rgya bod mthun min gyi 'gan tshang ma da ‘sta yongs su rang steng du bab 'dug bsams nas 'phral du blon po rnams bos te blo gcig rtse gcig gi sgo nas bod du 'phebs pa'i sems thag bcad do/ /phyi nyin gyi nyi shar la rgya bod gnyis kyi mthun sgril dang / rje yab yum bde ba'i smon lam/ smad rgya nag skyid pa'i bkra shis/ bod gangs can dar ba'i rten 'brel la/ stod dbus gtsang mthong sa dang smad rgya nag rig pa'i kho kho nor ri①ni rgya bod mdza' mthun gyi dpang bo byas nas der bsang mchod rgya chen po mdzad do/ /ma 'gor bar rgya bza' kong jo dang blon 'khor rnams sa de'i 'brog pa mi dmangs kyi lam skyel 'og tu blon () kho kho nor ri/ kho kho nor zer ba ni sog skad yin zhing / ri de ni mtsho sngon po'i mtsho mgo'i sto 'gram du gnas pa dang mtsho ngos las mtho tshad khru bzhi stong lnga brgya so brgyad yod/ blon po mgar gyis rgyal kha'i ngang nas rgya ba 'a kong jo bod la bsus shing kho kho nor ri ni rgya bod mdza' mthun byung ba'i dpang bo byas par bstod pa dang rjes dran zhu ba'i ched du/ phyis mi tshos ri der blon po gser chen ri zhes pa'i mtshan snyan btags te/ khong gi thugs rje ni ser bo gser gyi mdangs mi yal ba bzhin du nam yang mi dmangs kyi sems nang du gsal ba'i don gyis ming de chags so/ /280

po gser chen ri'i rgyab phyob/sa brgyud de lam bar nas dka' ngal mang bo khyad du bsad nas bod mtsho(da lta'i mtsho skya rengs dang mtsho sngo rengs)khar phebs/kong jo nyi zla nyag ga der bslebs nas rje yab yum gyis bskur ba'i nyi zla gnyis de ru dbyugs te bod rgya mdza' mthun yong bar blo gcig rtse gcig sgos bod du phebs par rjes dran zhu ba'i ched du/ phyis mi rnams kyis nyag ga de la 6‘nyi zla nyag ga’’zhis pa'i mtshan snyan btags te lha gcig kong jo'i gtam rgyud de ni da lta'i bar du bod rgya yongs la grags 'dug go /(lha rgyal tshe ri nga gis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1986lo'i deb gnyis pa las bdams/ ) 281

zhu sgo gahaṃrga kyi wag skazha/sngar rgan mo zhig la bu mo gnyis yod de/ gcig rna rang gi phru gu ngo ma yin pa dang ming la bkra sgrol zer/gcig ni gsos phrug yin la ming la g.yang lha zhes zer/mos dus nam yang gsos phrug g.yang lhar bong bu ltar khyim du g.yog las byed du bcuganyin zhig la/ mos yang g.yang lha ri mgor gro ma brko ru mngags/ snying rje can gyi bu mo nangs snga mor lam la chas nas nyin phyed kar 'gor yang gro ma skyes yod pa'i sa leb cig kyang ma rnyed mod/ 'on kyang sbom zhing che ba'i lhum tsha'i lo ma zhig mthong bas/ de nas mo'i sems la lhum tsha lo ma'i rtsa ba brko e nus sems bzhin lhum tsha de brkos/a ya mtshan chen mo/ brkos shul na dong chen po zhig yod la/ dong gi nang du da dung skas chung ngu zhig btsugs yod/ mo skas chung ngu'i steng nas mar babs te nang du 'dzul nas bltas tshe/ nang du khang ba zhig yod pa de'i nang du byi ba mang bo gnas 'dug de tsho brel brel zing 282

zeng gis las la brtson bzhin yod pa ste/ byi ba chudza ba zheg gis gyon chas 'khrud pa dang gzhan zhig gis dong chu nang nas chu yar la 'then pa / byi ba la las ja ma byas nas thab las byed bzhin 'dug byi ba nag chung zhig gis gos hrul la lhan po rgyag pa dang byi ba khra chung zhig gis zas snod 'khrud bzhin yod/ mos byi ba chung ba zhig gi lag nas phyags ma zhig blangs te thang phyags nas rogs ram byas pa dang de'i rjes byi ba chung ba zhig gi lag las gyon gos dri nag can zhig blangs nas bkrus/ de nas mu mthud du chu 'then pa'i byi ba chung ba la lag rogs dang ja ma la'ang rogs ram bcas byas/nyin gung bslebs skabs/ lo na mtho ba'i byi ba rgan mo zhib/ khang ba'i nang du 'dzul 'ong ba de ni byi ba chung ba tsho'i ma rgan yin 'dug rno/sa dril bu g.yug nas su las la zhugs yod na zas za ru shog su zhugs med na 'gram du sdod la ltos ’zhes 'bod skad brgyab par/ byi ba chung ba rnams kyis mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis‘ a ma lags/nga tsho tshang mas khyed kyis sprad pa ltar las 'gan bzang 'grub byas shing spus ku'ang sngar las lhag par legs/ de ni gzhon nu ma 'dis dka' ngal la ma 'dzems shing rogs 283

ram rgya chen byas pas yim zhes zhus/ byi ba'i ma rgan gyis gtam de thos nas bu mo la khyed mdun du shog dang nga tshos mnyam gcig tu zas za’ zhes smra sa/ byi ba chung ba rnams zas za sa'i cog tse'i 'ogam du bsdad cing bu mo yang byi ba chung ba tsho'i dkyil du sdod du bcug byi ba'i a mas mo la sha mar thud gsum dang gro 'bras tshod ma bcas zas sna mi 'dra ba sogs za ru bcug pa dang mo'i bu rgyud rnams la tshod ma ma gtogs gzhan ci yang za ru ma bcug bu mos rang rkyang rkyang gis zas 'di 'dra yag po dang zhim po mang bo zos na shin tu 'dra mi chags pa snyam pa dang byi ba chung ba rnams kyang lto ba rgyags med pa mthong bas byi ba'i yi/ mas rang la byin pa'i za rgyu de tsho byi ba chung ba rnams la bgos nas za ru bcug dros ja 'thung tshar rjes bu mos cog tse phyis pa dang zas snod 'khrud pa/ 4 khang ba'i nang du gad rgyag pa dang ca lag thams cad legs sgrig byed pa'i las la zhugs/ de nas mos byi ba'i ma man la‘ mdza' brtse ldan pa'i a ma byi ba lags/ da lta nga 'gro ba'i dus la bslebs pas da song na legs/ di min bdag gi a ma khong khro langs te nga (ra rdung rdeg byed nges yin ’zhes zhus pa la/ byi ba'i mas‘ sgug dang bdag gi phru gu/ ngas khyed la rgyu 284

'gangs chen zhig ster’ zhes bshad kyin khang ba'i nang la song / 'og khang zhig yod pa de'i nang la dngos rdzas sna tshogs nyar tshags byas yod pa 'di lta ste/ smad g.yogs dang stod thung / pang khebs/ mgo ras/ da dung ko lhar/ cha rma/nga bo bcas yod/ byi ba'i a mas bu mor che rgyu gang 'dod na khyer songanya’zhes smras/ snying rje can gyi g.yang lha de'i lus kyi gyon gos de ral ba ral rkyang yin pa dang rkang rjen yang yin pas/ mos nga la gyon rgyu'i gos shig dang lham cha gcig mgo ras shig gnang na chog pa dang gzhan ci yang mi dgos zhes lan btab/ byi ba'i ma rgan bsam blo der mi 'thad par khyed nga'i byi ba chung bar byams sems ha cang che bas/ ngas khyed la rgyu 'gangs chen zhig sprad dgos’’zhes bshad nas rab tu mdzes pa'i dar gos kyis bzos pa'i phyi gos shig dang tshon mdangs rnam par bkra ba'i sked dkris chen po zhig gos chen gyis g.yogs yod pa'i dgun lham bcas phyir khyer 'ongs te bu mo la bskon cing / 66da lta khyed phyir 'gro chog pa dang gyang ngos na i khung chung ngu mang bo yod pa de'i nang du khyed kyi lag pa bsrings ste phyir 'then byas nas/ mgo'ang yar bkyag ste nam mkha'i dbyings su ltos zhes kha brda btang /285

bu mos byi ba'i a ma'i bka' mngags bzhin lag pa i khung nang du brkyangs nas phyir 'then pa na lag mgo la rin po che'i lag gdub kyis khengs 'dug la/ mdzub mgo re la sor gdub res brgyan yod pa yin/ de tsho gcig las gcig lhag tu mdzes pas brjod kyis mi lang yang mos mgo yar bkyag par 'phral du mo'i thod pa'i steng la 'od gsal can gyi skar ma zhig lhung nas bu mor mdzes rgyan spras pas bag ma zhig dang mtshungs par khyim la log go/ma yar gyis g.yang lha la 'di 'dra'i rgyu yag po sus byin pa yin’’zhes dris par gshis drang ba'i bu mos‘‘a ma lags/ nga de ring byi ba chung ba mang bo la thug nas ngas kho tshor las rogs byas pas/ kho tshos nga la dngos rdzas 'di dag gnang ba yin’’zhes don gyi byung tshul ma lus par bshad/phyi nyin snga mor ma yar gyis rang gi sha khrag las chad pa'i bu mo bkra sgrol de dong nang du mngag par 'dod nas bkra sgrol la tshunga'i gces phrug mgyogs myur du song zhig khyed la'ang gcen mo dang 'dra bar rgyu ba/nga mdzes tshang ma thob srid ces kha brda byas kyang nam rgyun gces phrug lang shor gyi bu mos ‘nga gom pa spos nas lam du 'gro mi 'dod/286

khang ba'i phyir 'khyag grang yang ha cang che bas thab ku'i 'gram du sdod dgos ’zhis lan btab par/ ma rgan khong khro chen po langs te mo la lag pas rdung ba dang kha nas rjo‘nges par du song / mi 'gro na mi choganya’ces gshe gshe btang bas/ mor blo thabs ci yang med par sa thag ring bo zhig la song ba'i mthar lcum tsha de rnyed cing brkos nas byi ba'i khyim du song / mos dang por byi ba nag chung gi rnga mar 'jus te 'phur 'phur byas la/ de nas byi ba khra chung gi rna ba sgrib/ der 'thud nas yang byi ba ser chung gi kha spu re gnyis btob/sa pa'am byi ba chung ba zhig gis gyon chas bzo ba mthong nas khab mig nang gi bal skud kyang phyir 'then/ da dung byi ba chung ba zhig gis chu zom nang du chu bcu ba rig nas chu zo de chu nang du 'phangs/ mdor na snga dro'i ring la mos byi ba chung ba rnams la zhe nag khog btsog gis brnyas bcos byas pas/ kho tshos skad mthon pos tsi tsi zhes mtshams med par 'bod kyin 'dugayang nyin gung gi dus la slebs par/ byi ba'i ma rgan gyis sngar bzhin dril bu g.yug te 'og khang nang du 'dzul nas/ ‘ su las la zhugs yod na zas za ru shog su las la zhugs med na 'gram du sdod la ltos zhes gleng bar/ byi 287

ba chung ba tshos gtam de thos ma thag tu 'khang ra dang bcas mgrin gcig tu a ma lags/ nga tshor ma gzhir las ka las pa'i spobs pa yod mod/ bu mo 'dis nga tshor brnyas bcos gang mang byas stabs/ snga dro'i dus der bya ba gang yang bsgrubs ma thubanya ces zhus/ byi ba'i ma rgan gyis zhe sdang gis ya da shog dang dros ja 'thung’’zhes ngar skad brgyab/ mos bu mo bkra sgrol la skyur chu nang du sbang yod pa'i go re zhig byin pa dang zas bcud bzang bo dang sha tshon po de dag byi ba chung ba rnams la bgos/ yin na yang bu mos ham sems kyis mtshams med par byi ba chung ba tsho'i zas 'phrogs te zos/ tshang mas zas zos nas co ga tse dang kha bral rjes/ mos byi ba'i ma rgan la da nga la khyed kyis bdag gi gcen rmar byin pa'i rgyu rdzas 'bul rten zhig gnongs shig’ ces bshad par/ byi ba'i ma rgan gyis mo nyar tshags khang la khrid nas khyod la rgyu nor ci dgos’’zhes dris par/ bu mos nga la ches mjes pa'i stod thung ngam phyi rting ches mtho ba'i ko lham cha gnyis dang /gzhan gyi rgyu rdzas ji tsam gnang na de tsam dgos’’ches bshad/ byi ba'i ma rgan— gyis 'o na khyod kyis gyon gos 'phud nas bal rnying gi gos btsog 'di dang phyi rting med 288

pa'i ko lham 'di gon zhig ces bshad pa dang / da dung bu mo'i sked la sked dkris rnying hrul zhig dkrir bcug ste 6 khyod da lta myur du sgor song / phyir 'bud dus thog mar lag mdzub gyang gi i khung nang du rkyongs/ de'i rjes mgo (5ra bkyags nas nam mkha'i dbyings su ltos dang bsod nams chen po thob nges yin’ zhes bskul te sgo'i phyir bskrad/ le lo can gyi bu mo phyir 'gro bzhin du lag mdzub gyang ngos kyi khung bu'i nang du brkyangs nas phyir 'then skabs/ ya sus shes/ mdzub mgo thams cad la 'bu daca/ra gyis khril yod pas/ mos shugs kyis ci ltar g.yugs kyang 'bu dmar yang de ba'in dam por 'khri/ de nas cho/sa mgo yar bkyags te nam mkha' la bltas tshe glo bur du khrag sgong chen mo zhig lhung nas mo'i kha la 'byar bar/ mos ngar shugs kyis mtshams med par khrag sgong der so 'brad rgyag pa las gzhan thabs gang yang ma rnyed pas bzo lta shor nas phyir rang khyim du log skabs der ma rgan gyis bu mo bkra sgro' gyi tshugs ka 'di 'dra mi sdug par gyur yod pa mthong bas/ 'phral du khong khro tshad med skyes nas shi song / skyid lug can gyi bu mos khrag sgong ril bu de zoca/ rjes pho ba skrang ste yang a ma'i rjes su song ngo /289

de nas las la brtson zhing rang gshis bzang ba'i bu mo g.yang lha lus gzugs mdzes shing sems rgyud drang ba'i pho gsar zhig dang gnyen sgrig byas shing / khong gzhon nu gnyis kyis bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba gsar ba la rol zhing skyid kyi dga' ba dgung la mnyam zhing sdug gi lo ma chu la bskur ro/ /(zla ba bzang pos bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉1984lo'i deb bcu ba pa las bdams/ )nga7290

tshod bu/ 0 thod 'u/ rkun na/dang po tsa na/ grang rlung 'ur 'ur ldang ba'i mtshan mo zhig la tshong ba zhig gis bong bu dre'u 'dra ba zhig khrid nas rang yul du log bzhin 'dugaskabs der/ kun ma ming grags can gnyis yod pa de gnyis kyis bong bu dre'u 'dra ba de mthong 'phral/ brku 'dod pa'i spu long g.yos nas dal bur tshong ba'i rjes nas 'jab ste bong bu'i mgo yi mthur phud rjes rkun ma gcig gis mthur rang gi sker gon nas mu mthud du tshong ba'i rjes bsnyegs/ rkun ma gcig gis bong bu ded nas phyir yong /tshong ba rang khyim la slebs la khad du kha phyir 'khor tsa na/ a ltas ngan/ mi zhig gi mgor mthur bskon nas khrid yong gi 'dug pa mthong bas re zhig had de lus/mtshams der rkun mas dal dal lhod lhod kyi ngang nas‘ bdag po lags/ khyod ya mtshar dgos don med/dang po nga rang lha'i yul nas skyon la thogs rjes/ lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyis nga rang lha khrims ltar mi yul 'dir 291

mngags nas bong bu zhig gi skye ba len du bcug yin na'ang da lta nyes dmigs dag zin pas/ mi lus 'di'i bskal ba thob pa yin/ ’zhes bshad/tshong bas rkun ma'i skad char nyan rjes gnas lugs chen po 'dug snyam nas/ 6‘de ltar yin na/ khyod kyi da reg bar du nged tshang gi don du dka' las mang bo zhig myangs song bas/ ngas 'di nas dngul lnga bcu ma gsum khyod la 'o rgyal du ster/ da song nas mi lus rang dbang gi 'tsho ba skyid po zhig rol bar gyis/ rjes phyogs su bya ngan 'dra las nas phyir bong bur 'gyur du ma 'jug’’ces kha brda mang bo byas rjes 'gro ru bcugazla 'ga'i rjes su tshong bas grong khyer chen po zhig tu rang gi bong bu mthong bas/ sems skyo ba'i ngang a las ngan po/ yang khyod phyir bong bu zhig tu gyur song ngam/ bya ngan ci zhig las pa yin/ da ni nga la'ang bya thabs med pas dkon mchog gsum pos mkhyen/ nya zhes skyabs 'jug zhu bzhin bong bu dang kha gyes nas song / /(tshe dpal bkra shis kyis bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1990lo'i deb dang po las bdams/ )292

na na' na dud lgo natsho/dung skyong rgyal dang dung mo mtsho gnyis bkra shis pa'i gnyen sgrig bya rgyu thag bcad pas/ dung skyong rgyal bza' tshang gang bo shin tu dga' 'dug mod/ 'on kyang / lo bdun cu lhag son pa'i a phyi'i bzhin ras su da dung dga' ba'i mdog spu tsam yang ma mchis/ mo dang sngon chad kyi mna' ma lha mo mtsho gnyis kyi bar la 'grig mthun mi yong phyir/ mos nam yang zas 'khyag gam gos hrul tsam la brten nas 'tsho thabs byed kyin 'dug lo mang bo'i ring mna' ma dang ma 'grig stabs/ kho mor deng dus mna' ma bzang rgyu med/ rkun ma'i tshig la rlom rgyu med/ ’ ces pa'i phyogs nyu/nga gi lta tshul mkhregs po zhig chags 'dug kho mo'i zhe sems su tsha bo'i da lta'i mna' ma 'di'ang mna' ma lha mo mtsho las sdug pa min yang / dga' ba'ang yin mi srid snyam bzhin yid mug kyin bsda da/dung mo mtsho dung skyong rgyal tshang la yong ma thag nas//a phyi lo lon yod sar song nas kha brda byed pa dang bde 293

sdug mang bo dris par ma zad/ da dung kho mor rdo ka ra dang nang lwa sogs nyos nas sems gso gang mang byas mod kyang / a phyi'i sems la/ 66a la gsar la 'o dri dang /bsdad kyin bsdad kyin bskyur dri/ mi’zhes pa'i dpe 'dug pas/ mna' ma tshang ma dang thog 'di 'dra yin snyam/dung mo mtshos rang gi pha mar rta nor la sogs pa'i rgyu len du ma bcug pa dang / g.yu byu ru la sogs pa'i rgyan cha'ang sgrig dgos tshul gleng ma bcug kho mor yang zhing 'jam pa'i tshar lwa zhig dang / dro zhing mthug pa'i nyal thul nyal gdan gsar ba cha tshang zhig bzo dgos tshul bshad/ gnyen tshang tshang gis de tsam sgrig rgyu ni las sla mo 'dug snyam bzhin dga' spro'i ngang myur du bzo rgyu thag bcad/ a phyi lo lon gyis/ a ma'i nu rin la 'bri dang / a phas gsos rin la rta dgos zer srol yod pas/ nyal thul nyal gdan dgos tshul bshad pa ni glen mo 'di las mthong ma myongasnyam bzhin du kha rog bsdad/tshar lwa dang nyal thul nyal gdan tshang ma bzos tshar rjes/ dung mo mtsho bos nas lta ru bcug pa la/ kho mo na re/ 4 phar bltas na yag po 'dug mod kyang / a phyi khrid yong nas 'grig min la lta ru bcug na da gzod shes ’294

ther/ cang ma 'argar bar/ a phyis lag rten zhig la brten te dung mo ma/tsho yod sar bslebs pa na/ kho mo mgyogs por ya ra langs te/ a phyi bskyor nas tsha thab steng du 'bud du bcug sa phyis gsar du bzos pa'i tshar lwa dang gos chen gyi phyi ma sprad pa'i nyal thul nyal gdan mthong rjes/rang gis gyon 'dug pa'i lwa hrul dang nyal thul nyal gdan rnying ba yid la shar thog yid skyo bzhin mchi ma dbang med du shor/ zhe‘a phyi/ khyed la sems sdug ci zhig gda'/ 7‘ deng sang gi mna' ma ni ci 'dra'i skyid po red ang / chung dus skyid sdug rang gi lag rgas dus skyid sdug gzhan gyi lag zer ba de ci mi bden/ mi dung mo mtshos a phyi'i tshig nang du gzhan la bshad srol med pa'i sdug bsngal gnas pa shes te/ kho mo'i yid kyang ha cang skyo ba dang snying rje skyes te/ mig mtha' mchi ma 'khor 'khor byed bzhin 'dugacang ma 'gor bar dung skyong rgyal tshang gi gza' mi tshang ma der 'dus pa la/ dung mo mtshos 'dzum dmul ngang na re/ ‘ tshar lwa 'di dang nyal thul nyal gdan 'di dgangs a phyi la bzos pa yin pas/ da lta nga tshos kho mor e 295

'grig gi blta/ ’’ zhes zer zhor du tshar lwa a phyi'i lus la bskon/skabs der a phyi lo lon da gzod gnyid las sad pa nang bzhin ha las shing / sems 'gul thebs pa'i rlung gis lus kyi khri shing g.yos te 'dar lhug lcug byed bzhin du/ dung mo mtsho'i lag mgor 'jus shing / mig chu sgrog ril 'dra ba lwa'i steng du thar thar thor (rdo tshe brtan gyi4bsdus pa〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉〉1987'o 'i deb dang po las bdams/ )296

du sgo gagiska zharnad na/gna' snga mo snga mo zhig la/ yul me tog ldan pa zhes bya ba'i sa cha na ma rgan dbul mo zhig yod pa'i ming la 'jam sgro zer/ de la bu dang bu mo bzhi yod/ mos phyugs bdag dang dpon po rnams la g.yog byas pa'i gla rngan phran bus byis pa bzhi bo'i kha gsos/ dbul zhing phongs pa'i ma rgan lo lon gyis gla mang ba'i g.yog las yag po zhig mi rnyed stabs/ nyin re'i gla rngan phran bu des rang gi byis pa bzhi bo'i lto ba 'grang thabs tsam yang ha cang dka'/ byis pa bzhi bos slog pa'am snam bu hrul bo gyon pa las gon rgyu yag po gcig kyang med/ mi sems bzang can 'ga' res gyon pa rnying ba re mo la byin tshe/ mos bzo bcos byas nas thog mar byis pa che ba la bskon/ byis pa gnyis pa dang gsum pa la yang de bzhin bzos/ byis pa bzhi ba ni bu mo zhig yin la ming la tshe ring lha mo zer/ ma rgan gyis bu mo 'di la gon rgyu zhig ma lon par dbyar dgun ston dpyid gang la yang snam bu'i lwa rkyang hrul bo zhig 297

las gon rgyu med/lo zhig gi dgun khar/ yul me tog ldan pa'i sa char nyin zhag mang bo zhig gi ring la kha ba bu yug tshabs chen babs pas rus pa'i gting la 'big gtsags byed pa lta bu'i grang gzer lus la khyab/ snying rje ba'i bu mo chung chung 'dis grang ba'i sdug bsngal ma bzod par a ma'i gam du song nas ‘a ma lags/ nga rang gyon pa dron po zhig 'tshol du sa gzhan la 'gro rgyu yin/ snam bu'i lwa rkyang hrul bo 'di la drod me stag tsam yang med pas/ bdag 'chi rgyu las thabs med/ de'i phyir nga rang sa gzhan zhig la dgun lwa zhig 'tshol bar 'gro rgya yin’ zer nas bud song :dra( ra bu mo chung chung 'di mo rang gi khyim dang bral nas thag ha cang ring ba'i lam chen bzhi mdo zhig la bslebs/ de na shing gsom sdong rgan zhig skyes yod/ sdong rgan de'i rtsa na byi'u phrug chung chung zhig yod pa mos mthong / zhib tu bltas pa na btsas nas nyin mang bo ma 'gor ba'i spu med pa'i byi'u phrug cig yin zhing / tshang gi nang nas sa la lhung ste 'chi la khad du gyur pa dang / lus la stobs shugs med pas phyir byi'u tshang la 'phur ma thub/ kha nas skad sgra 298

gnyom la phra ba zhig grag gin yod pa de ni bu mo la kho skyob rogs zhu zhes zer ba los yin snyam/ bu mos byi'u phrun/ la snying rjes ma bzod par mo rang gi lag tu blangs nas dros su bcug mos lam du 'gro ba'i mi zhig la byi'u phrug 'di phyir byi'u tshang la 'jog tu bcug bu mos rogs ram byas pa la brten nas byi'u 'di phyir rang gi tshang nang du log thub par gyur to/ /bu mo tshe ring lha mo ni sngar bzhin mu mthud du sngon la song / lam thag ha cang ring bo zhig la slebs pa na shing sdong chen po zhig gi mdun du sdom zhig gis brel ba chen pos dra rgya 'thag gi yod pa dang thug bu mos sdom de la ‘ sdom lags/ bdag bskor nas song chog pas khyod kyi dra rgya la gnod pa til 'bru tsam yang mi byed/ khyod skrag mi dgos ’zhes bshad/ sdom gyis bu mo la/ ‘ thugs rje che/ khyod ni bu mo gshis bzang zhig red/ khyod kyis bdag la 'di ltar snying rje ba de la bdag gis kyang drin lan 'jal nges yin/ khyod rang phyir 'ong dus bdag gis khyod la don re bsgrub na chog khyod lham med rkang rjen du gang la 'gro rgyu yin ’zhes dris/ bu mos ‘‘bdag song nas gyon pa bzo rgyu'i rgyu cha zhig btsal 299

nas bdag gi ma rgan la sprad de/ bdag la gyon pa zhig bzo thabs byed rgyu yin/ bdag la gyon rgyu med pas grang 'khyags bzod thabs medanya’ces zer/ sdom na re bu mo gshis bzang ma/ da khyod rang song /rjes sor khyod 'dir 'ong dus khyod la don re bsgrub rgyu yod na bdag gis rogs ram byed nges yin ’zhes zer/bu mo 'di mu mthud du sngon la song / shin tu rgyang ring bo zhig na tsher ma mang po skyes yod pa'i sa zhig la bslebs/ bu mo ngal dub kyis 'gro ma thub par yod tsa na lus la gyon pa'i snam bu'i lwa rkyang hrul bo de yang tsher mas gshags te gyon rgyu zhig ma lhag mo ni gsar du skyes pa'i byis pa gcer bu zhig dang 'dra/ mos rang gi lus ni 'di 'dra'i nyam thag pa zhig tu gyur yod pa mthong ba dang yid mug nas skad chen pos ngus/mo'i ngu skad kyis lam 'gram du rtswa za bzhin pa'i lu gu zhig yod pa dkrogs/ lu gu yong nas bu mo la/‘‘don gang zhig gis khyod la sems sdug bzos pa yin/bu mo khyod ngu dgos don ci yin/ mi zhig gis rdung sdeg byas pa yin nam/ ’ zhes dris/ bu mos e/300

bdag gis gon rgyu dron po zhig btsal nas dgun brgal dgos snyam pa yin mod/ 'on kyang tsher shing 'di'i 'gram brgyud skabs bdag gi gyon pa hrul bo 'di tsher mas gshags te lhag ma med par btang / da bdag gcer bur gyur pa red’’zer/ lu gus nyan rjes khong khros ngang tsher shing la‘‘khyod kyis bu mo 'di la gnod 'tshe gtong don ci yin/ khyod kyis bu mo 'di shin tu nyam thag pa zhig tu btang ba ma red dam/ ’ zhes gshe gshe btang /tsher shing na re bdag la lhod yangs gnang rogs zhu/ bdag gis kyang bsam bzhin gnod pa btang ba min/ khyod kyis rang gi lus kyi bal rdog po zhig mo la ster rogs byos/ bdag gis bal shad rogs byas nas cho/sa ma rgan la byin te gyon pa zhig bzo thabs byas na legs/ khyod kyis shes gsal ltar lug bal ni drod dang ldan pa'i gyon pa'i rgyu cha zhig red ces zer/lu gus tsher shing la bskor ba brgyab nas rang gi rgyab kyi bal ha cang mang bo zhig bal nas lan bu byas rjes su bu mos lu gu la snying nye ba'i lu gu lags/ thugs rje che/ da ni bdag ma rgan yod sar song nas skud pa bkal nas ( 301

dgun 'ashā dron po zhig bzo ru 'jug dgos/ da lo'i bod kyi lo sar skabs bdag la gyon pa yag po zhig gyon rgyu yod nges red/ ’’ces zer/phyir yul la log pa'i lam du bu mo ni shin tu dga' zhing spro bar gyur/ 'on kyang ma rgan gyis nyin ltar gzhan la g.yog byed kyin yod pa dang lo sar skabs la yang de ltar yin phyir/ mo la gyon pa bzo khom med pa yid la dran pas mig mthar mchi mas bkang / sems sdug byed bzhin byi'u phrug gi tshang yod pa'i sdong rgan de'i rtsar bslebs pa na/ byi'u phrug gi ma rgan gyis bu mo la bsgugs yod/byi'u ma na re/ 6‘bu mo gshis bzang ma lags/khyod kyis bdag gi snying nye ba'i byi'u phrug gi srog bskyabs pa yin stabs/ bdag gis khyed la drin lan zhig 'jal dgos/ khyod kyis lag la bzung yod pa de ci yin/ mi’zhes dris/ bu mos byi'u ma la/ 6 'di ni lu gus bdag la byin pa yin/ bdag yul la song nas ma rgan la skud rnga4 'khel du bcug nas snam bu 'thag ste/ bod kyi lo sar skabs gyon pa gsar ba gyon rgyu yin ’zhes zer/byi'u mas ‘bdag gis khyod la skud pa 'khel thub’’ces 302

zer byi'u mas bal kha bzung nas shing sdong gi rtse la dkris/de nas yar la 'phur ba dang mar la bab nas skud pa bkal/ skud pa bkal rjes su skud dkris log log de bu mo la sprad/ bu mo ni dga' zhing spro ba'i ngang nas lam la bud/ mo rang sdom gyi dra rgya'i gam du bslebs pa na sdom gyis sngar nas mo la bsgugs yod/sdom gyis mo la bu mo sems bzang ma sku khams bde'am/ dngos po 'dra lag la lon yod dam/ ’ zhes dris/ sdom gyis bu mo'i lag na yod pa'i skud dkris log log de blangs nas mgyogs par snam bu btags/ sdom ni skud pa 'thag par mkhas la glog 'khyug pa lta bu'i mgyogs pa zhig kyang yin stabs/ dus tshod thung ngu zhig gi nang la snam bu yag pa mdzes pa'i bkrag mdangs 'phro ba zhig 'thag nas bu mo la sprad/bu mo dga' zhing mgu ba'i ngang du yul la song nas btags zin pa'i snam bu de ma rgan mo la sprad/ ma rgan gyis mtshan mor rang gi bu mo che ring lha mo la snam lwa yag po zhig bzos nas bskon/ bu mo tshe ring lha mo ni mdzes shing yid du 'ong zhing / ming don gnyis ldan gyi lha yi bu mo lta 303
gyu

byizhu chud rdo rde zhaphruwa ldan/gna' snga mo'i dus shig la/ rgyal bo'i bu dang blon po'i bu gnyis yod par kho gnyis rdzi bor song nas nyin gang la sho 'phangs/ phyi dro'i dus su sho rde'u gcig gril nas khung bu thur khung zhig gi nang du lhung / khung bu kha shin tu dog stabs lag pa mi thar la nam zla dgun kha yin pas bsko thabs kyang ma byung bas kho gnyis kyis khung sgo der sa rtags shig brgyab nas phyin/de'i tshe shing byi'u mthe bong le(shing la gnas pa'i byi'u mthe bong tsam zhig) zhig 'phur 'ong nas khung sgo nas bltas pas sho de'u de mthong / kho rang gzugs chung stabs khung bur 'dzul te blangs shing kho rang gi rtse spyad byas/ sho rde'u de phyogs rer 'khor na bzhi thig dang phyogs rer 'khor na drug thig re 'bab pas khos 'di ha cang ya mtshan zhig red snyam/ der bsam blo zhib tu btang bar 'di 'dra'i dngos po ya mtshan zhig lag tu rnyed par bltas na don chen zhig 'grub nges red/ de bas byi'u thams cad 305

'du ba rgyag tu bcug na nga rang la phan khe zhig 'byung rgyu red bsam nas byi'u thams cad 'du ba rgyobs zhes skad btang / thams cad 'dus pa na khos byi'u tshogs kyi mdun gral nas‘ a rogs tsho/ ngas 'dang brgyab pa ltar na/ la kha'i go bo ser ldang 'dis nam mkha' nas shar sgra dang shur sgra byed/ ngas bltas na 'u cag gi steng red/ thang dkyil pho rog nag chung de'ang chung 'gro dang che 'gro byed/ ngas bltas na 'u cag gi steng red 'dod/ phyi na bya rgyal khyung chen zer ba'i dpon yod tshul dang / nang na rgya khra glag sder zer ba'i blon yod tshul la bltas te/ 'u cag gis kyang dpon zhig bzhag na mi chog gamanya’zhes bshad pa na/byi'u thams cad kyis mi chog rgyu med mod gang ltar byas na legs ’zhes smras/ byi'u chung gis/ ‘ de las sla mo zhig red/ srid pa sa chags pa dang / ba so khar skyes pa nas bzung dung sho zer ba de 'phangs na 'bab rgyu yod pas nga'i lag na sho rde'u zhig yod/ 'di 'u cag gis 'phangs nas drug thig su la babs na de dpon la 'jog ’ces bshad par tshang mas de blo thabs shig red zer nas blo thag gcig la bcad/de nas byi'u thams cad kyis re re bzhin 'phangs — 306

rkyang/su la'adza ma babs/ mjug ma de kho rang yin pas khos sngon nas drug thig 'bab na ci ltar 'phen dgos tshul sbyangs yod pa ltar 'phangs pa na cung bzur yod kyang khos gshog pas sgul tsam gyis bar bde bcos/ tshul de byi'u 'phre bas mthong bas/ rjo khyod kyis lag pas ngan byas na/gshog pas bzang byed sa 'gro 'am ’zhes bshad pa la/ byi'u chung gis/ ‘4ngas brgya 'dus stong tshogs kyi sdun nas 'phangs pa yin pas ci bshad/ khyod rang gis kyang de ltar byas na chog ste/ ma babs pa min nam’’zhes bshad pas/ thams cad kyis de red ces byi'u chung mthe bong le dpon la bskos/ der tshang mas kho la/ 66de ring nas khyod dpon la bzhag pa yin pas khyod kyis ci byed grabs yin/ phyi la grags rgyu sku khrims dgos/ nang la grags rgyu dmangs khrims dgos/ phyugs la skya lo sngo khrims dgos/bkod pa gang lags’ zhes bshad par/ khos kyang 'dang ma brgyab par bshad rgyur/ smyo ya ngas cig shes 'dug 'u cag 'di ltar bsdad na rgum 'bu 'thu rgyu las ci yang med pas yang min na stod rgya gar la 'brong bda' ru 'gro/ yang min na smad rong yul la nas len du 'gro de gnyis gang dga' khyod tshos ltos’’zhes bshad/ der 'ga' res sha za 307

'dod dang / yang 'ga' res nas za 'dod zhes bshad mthar / sha tshil gnyis rgyun par dkon stabs mang shos 'brong bda' ru 'gro rgyur gros mthun/ byi'u chung gis byi'u 'phre ba la da lo khyod kyis byi'u dmag cig khrid la song dang sang lo gzhan zhig la 'gan sprod’’ces bshad/ byi'u chung dpon po yin phyir byi'u 'phre bar red ma red kyi skad cha med par byi'u dmag khrid de 'brong bda' ru song /kho tsho yar phyin pa na bya 'ol ba zhig dang 'phrad/ des ‘ khyod tsho gang la 'gro 'o zhes dris par/ 'phre bas‘ nged rnams rgya gar la 'brong bdar 'gro'o ’zhes lan btab/'ol bas khyod tshos rgya gar gyi 'brong sod pa phar zhog rgya gar la thon yang e thub bam’ zhes smras par/ 'phre bas/6‘cis phyir mi thon/ 'jig rten la gtam dpe zhig yod de nam zla bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi ngan sgang / rta brgyas sga mi theg lug brgyas gri mi theg bya 'ol ser gyis 'dab ma lar mi theg’ ces khyod ngan pa'i dpe 'jog red mod/khyod kyang lo rer skor re phog na nged tsho cis phyir mi thon zhes song / yang song song ba'i mtha' zhig la rgod cig la thug ste rgod des ‘khyod tsho gang la 'gro’’zhes dris par/‘‘nged tsho stod rgya gar la 'brong bda' ru 'gro ’zhes lan 308

btab/ rgod des/ 8 rgya gar gyi 'brong khyod tsho 'dra bas sod dam’’zhes par/ ci'i phyir mi sod ces pas/ rgod gyis/ 4 dpe 'u cag la bzhag na nga bzang mod/ ngas kyang mi sod 'dug’ ces bshad par/ byi'u 'phre bas/6 khyod la nged tsho las lhag pa'i cha rkyen ci zhig yod/ ’ rgod kyis/ 6 nga la ya mchu smug po ldem yag yod/ tshon po'i tshang ra btog nyin mkho/ ma ma chu smug po 'gug bzang yod/ rgyud pa'i nywa bzhi 'drad nyin mkho/ sgro chen leb ma bcu gnyis yod/ dgung a sngon gnam 'phangs bstod nyin mkho/ sgro chung brtsi brtsi grangs med yod/ nam mkha'i char chu 'gog nyin mkho/ sder mo sdig pa'i sa bon yod/ sa gzhi'i steng la 'bab nyin mkho/ nga la cha rkyen de 'dra yod/ ’’ces zer tshe byi'u 'phre bas ha ha sha nye/khyos ci zer/ nga byi'u chung khra mo'i mgo thog na/ a tsa ra yi sgom khang yod/ nga byi'u cog khra mo'i gshog zhabs na/gling phu nus rta brgya 'jog sa yod/ nga byi'u khra mo'i sder 'og na/ lha 'dre dam la 'dog sa yod/ khyod bya chen tshang mar cha rkyen yod na thang mod/ nged byi'u chung tsho la'ang cha rkyen de 'dra yod pas/ 'brong mi sod pa'i nges pa yod dam’ zhes lan btab ste song / 309

de nas kho tsho yar song ba na bye thang chen po zhig tu gzugs po nag yor re ba zhig 'gro ba mthong / kho tshos 'brong zer ba kun yin nam snyam gyin de'i phyogs su 'phur ba la 'brong chen po ri sna chad pa 'dra zhig yid/ byi'u dmag gis/ 6 'di 'dra'i chen po zhig 'u cag 'dra zhig gis mi sod kho thag red mod/ phyir song na dpon la zhu rgyu gsal bo med pas bden kha med nges yin’ zhes bshad kyin 'brong de song shul tu babs tsa na/ mig shul gyi phyed tsam yang byi'u dmag gis dgang ma thub/ o/ bden lugs de red ces thams cad phyir la logabyi'u chung gis khyod tshos rgya gar gyi 'brong bsad pa ga red’ ces dris par/ 'phre bas rgya gar gyi 'brong zer ba de ya mtshan chen po zhig yod pas nged cas 'dra bas sod rgyu zhig ma red’’ces bshad/ shing byi'u ra/the bong le dpon po la bskos rkyen rang nyid kyi lus po de chen po zhig yin snang skyes yod/ khos lus bongs chung chung byas/ skad phra mo byas nas‘ da mtshams nga 'dra zhig e yod ces dris/ 'phre bas des mi tshad/ ’ ces lan btab/ yang byi'u chung gis lus bongs che che byas/ skad ldir ldir byas te da mtshams nga 'dra zhig e yod/ ’’ ces dris ca na/310

'phre ba khong khro langs te khyod 'dra zhig las med na ngas 'di ltar byed nges red’ ces rna rtsar khu tshur gyis gcig brgyab nas de gar bsad/der byi'u thams cad kyis‘ khyod kyis dpon po bsad payonged cag bya rgyal khyung chen la gtug bsher du 'gro'o’’'es lab tshe 'phre bas bshad rgyur/ 64de la gtug rgyu ci yod/ gtso bo deng thog gi thabs bkod ma 'grig pa 'dugarang cag smad rong ba la nas len du 'gro dang rang tshos thub pa'ang de red/ dpon ngas byed na chog nyaces kho rang rtogs kyis dpon por bsdad cing / smad rong ba la nas len du 'gro ba'i gros thag babyed/ kho tsho rong ba'i lam la chas dus nam zla'ang sos kur slebs 'dug 'phre bas/ byi'u tshogs la/ ‘ khyod tsho rjes nas dal mo gyis la shog dang / nga sngon la song nas dma' rong gi gnas tshul la lta zhib cig byed/ de nas nas len rgyu sla mo e red blta zer nas sngon la song / byi'u tshogs kyis sgo nga 'jog ran la thon yod stabs tshang bca' zhor dang sgo nga 'jog 'or la song / 'phre ba rong yu la la thon nas yug po 'ga' rbum pas rang nyid lto brgyags pa byung / de nas yug po gcig khur te yar 'phur nas/ 'ong / lam nas byi'u 311

tshogs dang 'phrad pa na de tshos‘‘khyod kyi yug po gcig gis ci yang mi phan pas ci byed’ ces par/ 'phre bas ‘a/ khyod tshos cang mi shes/ nga'i yug po 'dis yang min na dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo zhig bskor ba dang / yang min na smug nag khrag gi 'khor lo zhig bskor thub’’ces bshad/byi'u tshogs kyis yug po gcig gis dam pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba phar zhog smug nag khrag gi 'khor lo zhig kyang dka' rgyu red ces snying khrel btang / kho de la ma dga' nas lam bar du bzhag yod pa'i byi'u sgong rnams dbral gyin 'ong zhing yar thon rjes sa khung zhig bskos te gzhi btsugs/ kho rang dpon po byas te/ rgya byi'u khra ka ma g.yog mor bzhag jo byi'u dmar ldang a mchod la bzhagabra rta skya ril de a bo la byas/ rdzi li brang dmar de sring mo byas/ khra mo rdo byi'u de a ma byas nas bsdad/ byi'u gzhan rnams kyis 'u cag gi phru gu bsad pa de ci byed ces kha thug par/ bya rgyal khyung chen la gzu gtug pa las thabs gzhan med ces de bzhin byas/ bya rgyal khyung chen gyis mug gu zhig mngags nas bya 'phre ba nga'i mdun du bos shog ces 'bod pa btang / mug gus 'phre ba btsal nas nyin srib kun la 'phur ba na/ 'phre bas tshor nas/ a 312

che rdzi li brang dmar sogs nyon dang / 'u cag gi steng phyogs na shar sgra shur sgra grags kyin 'dug pas lta rtog re byas na bzang zhes tshe/ rdzi li brang dmar gyis sgo phying bltas pas mug gu zhig slebs yod pa mthong / der ci yin dris par/ mug gus ‘bya rgyal khyung chen gyis 'phre ba 'bod par mngags pa yin/ 'phre bas dang thog byi'u brgya'i dpon po bsad/ de nas byi'u dmag gi sgo nga phral / kho mi thon dgu thon zhig red zer/ nga mngags pa'i myi bo gochod yin/ 'phangs pa'i mda' mo don chod yin’’zhes lan btab pa ltar rdzi li brang dmar gyis 'phre ba la de ོ bzhin bshad/ 'phre bas/ ‘a tsi/ nga ci'i phyir du 'gro/ ngas sde chu'i chu mig ma zin mdzo la bskyur/ ca dzo chu'i chu mig ma zin ri la skyur du 'jug pa'i nyin der/ phyi na bya rgyal khyung chen zer ba'i dpon zhig med la/ bar na rgya khra glag sder zer ba'i blon zhig med/ nang na byi'u chung rdo rje 'phrul ldan zer ba'i sde zhig kyang med/ da rung yang yod don med’’ces bshad/ mug gus/ 6‘khyod kyis de 'dra ma zer dang nga la mi nyan’nyazhes smras par‘ khyod la skyon med/ khyod shog dang lwa zhig bzo ’zhes ras lwa sngon po zhig bzos te phyir mngags/ mug gus khyung chen la 'phre ba 313

mi 'ong ba'i rgyu ma tshan zhus par khyung chen gyis/ smyo‘o/ da rang bzhin zhig mngags na mi 'ong thag chod red/ btsan po zhig la su sa dga'/ yang na dpa' /bas len mkhan 'dra e yodanya ces dris par/ bya tshogs kyi dkyil nas 'ub/ chung yar lding ste/ ‘ 'phre ba bos na yong srid rgyu red/ de rtsi/na rung bzung yong na chog1 ces bshad tshe/ smyo ya/ khyod kyis dpa' khas blangs pas khyod song zhes 'ug chung 'bod du mngags/'ug chung gis 'phre ba'i gam la gtugs te khyod kyis dang bo byi'u'i dpon bsad tshul/ de nas byi'u dmag gi sgo nga sator tshul/ mtha' ma mub/ gus bos kyang myo/ 'ong tshu0 /da thengs dpa' khas len byas te 'ong ba yin pas ngernga 5 par du 'gro dgos tshul bcas bshad tshe/ khos sngon du bsad pa'i tshig yang bskyar 'ug chung la bshad pas mi tshad/ da dung klad leb khyod nga la bshad rgyu'i 'os med ces kha tshon btab par lub chung khros nas a tsi khyod kyis nga la mtshang 'bru 'am zheca/ stob thengs gcig gis 'phre ba sder 'og tu bcug ste khyer nas bya tshogs 'dus yod pa'i dkyil du 'phangs/bya tshogs kha rub ste g.yas g.yon kun nas gong gi nyes skyon mtha' dag bgrangs shing / mjug mthar bya brgyas 314
