rga/shob/ lcag rgyab/ rgyu'i chad pa gcod nga/'i gros/ byed pa na/khos dus de dang bstu na nas myur mor sa bsko ci thub byas te cung tsam nas rang gi lus chud sa zhig bskos zin/ bya rnams kyis gshog ñtsa ga brgyab kyang /tso sa sngon nas rang lus dang kha mnyam khrigs tshod kyi dung bskos yod phyir ci yang ca/ gnod/ lug chung gis 'dis nga la mtshang brus pa yin pas ngas 'di la mchu gtsags rgyag dgos zhes bshad/ 'ug chung gi rwa mchu thad gar du babs pas na nas a tsi bya brgya'i gshog lcag las 'ug chung gi mchu gtsags tsha 'dug ces ba༅da pas gtam dpe de'ang de las byung /der khyung chen gyis/ 8 chad pa das chog par byed /da 'di nges par du bya sha zan zhig la ster dgos te glag la ster ram skong yun la ster zer bar/ kho gnyis kyis de la so bar gshongs spyad tsam las med pas mi dgos zhes bshad/ ra thar khra zhig gis/ 6 'di gang ltar yang bdag gi za skal yin pas bdag la sprod cigs ces khyer nas 'phur te gdong thog cig tu babs te za rtsis byas/ 'phre bas/ ‘‘a rogs khyod kyis nga 'di nas za rtsis min namanya’zhes pa ra/ khra yis yinanya’zer/ jer 'phre bas/ smyo 'di naṭan ma za ma gtogs 'di ni pha phyug po'i lug rdzi 'dug sa/315

lug rdzis glu chung len sa/ lu gus rtse brad 'then sa reng/ nam zhig na/ o snying rje/ 'di nas khra ngan zhig gis byi'u bzang zhig zos 'dug ces zer na/ khyod rang la mtshang zhig red mod/ nga shi yang bla sgul 'dug na sdug cig red’’ces bshad par/ khra yis de bden mod snyam nas na khug cig tu khyer nas za rtsis byas tshe/ yang 'phre bas/ 'di nas kyang ma za ma gtogs zhes sogs sngar gyi skad cha de bshad par khra yis de yang bden du rlom nas lhas 'bog che 'thug cig tu khyer bar 'phre bas sngar pazhin du 'di nas kyang za mi nyan tshul bshad/ /khra yis 'o na gang nas za’ zhes dris/ 'phre bas/ ‘ khyod kyis nga khyer te song dang za sa la thon dus ngas khyod la bshad 'ong zer ba ltar 'phur te song bar/ 'phre bas g.yas rwa chen po zhig yo da sa bstan te kun nas zo zhes bshad/ der 'phre bas yang bshad rgyur/ ‘ nga ci byas rung shi ran 'dug pas gom gsum spo dbang ma yod rung / tshig gsum bshad dbang e yod’’ces par khra yis yod/ khyod kyis ci zhig bshad dgos’nyazhes dris/ 'phre bas/ ‘‘ngas yul ba mtha' dag la kha ta re dang kha chems re 'jog dgos ’zhes smras/ khra yis 'o na shod ces par/ 'phre bas ‘khyod kyis lcags kyi 3 16

sder mo nga'i snying khar gdab rkyen cung tsam ma lhod na bshad re meg ’ ces bshad tshe khra yis cung tsam lhod par/ 'phre bas khyod kyis nga'i a ma khra mo rdo byi'u la/ khyo'i brgyad cu'i lag rten chag thal zhes su shod/ ’ ces par khra yis‘ a tsi gces rgyu la da rung cig shod dang7zhes tshe/'aze bas/ mkhyod kyis nga bsdams rkyen cung tsam ma lhod na bshad re med/ ’ ces bshad/ khra yis yang cung tsam lhod du bcug 'phre bas/ ra a mchod jo byi'u dmar ldang la khyo'i sbyin bdag spre'u rgan 'das thal zhes su shod ’ ces bshad/ khra yis sngon ltar bshad par 'phre bas kyang sngon ltar du lhod bcug ste yang 'phre bas a bo tsi tsi skya ring la rgya dbus gser lam chad thal zer dgos ’zhes bshad/ der yang khra yis sngon ltar bshad cing 'phre bas kyang sngon ltar lab rgyur/ ‘ g.yog mo 4rgya byi'u khra ka ma 'bru'i mar khu'i zangs ldag chad thal zer dgos 6 zhes par khra yis sngon ltar mtshar snang skyes shing khos kyang sngar bzhin lhod du bcug pas phal cher shor la nye ba'i skabs der/6 da ngas khyod la bla ma 'dren tshul gyi skad cig 'jog’’zer nas/ 66 bar snang stong ba'i dbyings rim na/ /bya brgyas mchod pa'i bla ma yod/ /nga'i pho 'debs bla ma de 317

yis byos//’’zer nas sngon ltar lhod du bcug yang / ‘4rgya rdzong ོgas/ kyi pho brang na/ /lha bya khu byug sngon mo yod/ /nga'i skar ma'i bla ma de yis byos//’ zer bar/ khra yis ‘‘khyod kyis de 'dra dag dag shod dang ngas khyod mngag go ’zhes myo/ngags pa na/ 'phre bas/ 6 shar phyogs ngang rim ma tsho kha na/ /lha bya ngang ba ser bo yod/ /nga'i rdzogs pa'i bla ma de yas byos//mi zer nas mchong thengs gcig gis g.yag rwa'i nang du 'dzul/ khra yis khyod kyis nga mgo skor btang ba ma yin nam’’zhes bshad par byi'u 'phre bas‘ ci la yin /da khyod kyis nga'i pha gsod gsod byed chog pa ma yin nam ’zhes lab/ khra yis khyod kyi pha ci ltar bsad pa yin’ zhes dris/ 'phre bas nga'i pha de chu nang la lding nas phyir bud de phye ma'i nang la 'gre ldog brgyab/ yang yang de ltar byas mthar yar 'phur nas stod nam mkha'i bya lam gong mar song ste gshog lcag gru gu 'dra zhig ldog nas rang shugs kyi sa lhung ste g.yag rwa'i steng du brgyab pas g.yag ra bkad nas bsad ba yin ’zhes bshad par khra yis bden du bzung ste de ltar byas pa la gshog tshig phud nas shi ma gson gyi mtshams su bskyal/ der byi'u 'phre ba phyir bud nang/ rtswa 'jag thur zhig btogs te khra yi mig la gtsags kyin byi'u 318

'phre ba'i khrel 'di khrel zhig zed/ rtswa 'jag ma'i mdung 'di mdung zhig red/ /khra mig dmar mis/ gi sdu ga cig med//’’ces/ glu chung blangs so// / (mtsho skyes rdo rjes legs bsgrigs byas pa〈〈mgo log gi dmangs/ khrod gtam rgyud〉〉las bdams/ )

drezhu rta rkad gsun/ sana' dus shig la/ dpon po tshang ge bu dang dbul bo tshang gi bu gnyis mnyam du rdzi bor song / glo bur du char ba chen po zhig thon 'ong nas khong gnyis mnyam du brag khung zhig gi nang la 'dzul na'ang da rung mi gcig rlon par gyur 'gro bas dbul bo'i bus dpon po'i bu la ‘khyed yul la song na gos lwa tsha ru brje rgyu yod/ nga'i slag thed sbangs dus tshar ni yin stabs/ brag khung gi phugs su nga 'dzul na e chog ’ces dris/ dpon po'i bus chog gi’’zer nas dbul bo'i bu brag khung gi phugs su 'dzul du bcug char ba babs kyin babs kyin je che yin pas dpon po'i bu'i ‘lus yongs sbangs song ba dang / dbul bo'i bu char bas ma sbangs/phyi dro khong gnyis phyir yul la song dus sde ba'i nang yi/ mi rnams kyis byis pa gnyis kyi gcig char bas sbangs yod pa dang gcig sbangs med pa mthong nas ya mtshar skyes te skad cha dris/ dpon pos dbul bo'i bu 320

mdun la bos nas ‘khyod char bas sba ngas med pa dang nga'i bu char bca sbangs don ci yin ’zhes dris pas na/ dbul po'i bus char ba yong skabs kyi gnas tshul drang bden gyis bshad pa ra dpon ngo/ khong khro chen po langs te/ phangs khyod de 'dra ba zhig yin pa snga mo nas shes/ da lta khyod song nas gos kha gang gi thog tu ri mo mi gcig pa mi mang mi nyung brgyad brgya brgyad cu yod pa zhig tshol shog btsal ma thub na srog gi chad pa gcod nges yin/ 7 zhes bshad par dbul bo'i bus de 'dra'i gos zhig mthong ma myong bar ma zad/ thos kyang ma myong bas gang nas btsal/ dpon pos gsod pa las ldom na bzang bsams te ldom so nga /nyin la mtshan mthud de ldom pas nyin zhig la rgyal bo zhig gi mnga' khongs su slebs/ rgyal bo des mi mngags nas dbul bo'i bu bzung ste pho brang nang du khrid de/ 6‘khyod ldam me ldom mer gnas 'di la yong don ci yin/ ’ zhes dris/dbul bo'i bus sde ba'i dpon pos nga la btsan btsugs nas gos kha gang gi thog na ri mo brgyad brgya brgyad cu yod pa zhig btsal dgos zhes bshad par/ ngas gos de 'dra zhis btsal ni ma dgos/ gos de 'dra zhig yod pa thos kyang rma myo/ nga bas ldom nas 'ongs pa yin/ /zhes yar zhu 321

byas/ de nas rgyal bos dbul bo'i bu la/ phakhyod kyis/ zas 'grang du zos rjes stod kyi ri sked du tsan dan gyi sdong bo zhig yod pa'i zur na nyal khri zhig bzhag yod pa'i thog tu dgong ma gcig la nyal 'dug phod na/ nga'i mdzod khang nang du gos yod pa'i nang mas khyod la gos kha gang gi thog tu ri mo mi gcig pa brgyad brgya brgyad cu yod pa zhig bsal du 'jug7ces gsungs/ dbul bo'i bus za 'thung rgyags rgyags pa zhig zos rjes tsan dan sdong bo'i zur gyi nyal khri'i thog tu nyal bar song / yar la 'gro zhor du sa nas rdo ba zhig blangs mi/nga rang gi glo gri rdor zhor du song / tsan dan sdong bo de'i zur la thon nas nyal khri'i thog tu lta dus/ kho'i sems su nyal khri 'di'i thog tu nyal na za mkhan zhig yod pa thag chod yin mod/ 'on kyang sang nyin phyir la song na'ang shi 'gro bas gang nas shi na gcig red bsams te rang gi gri chung zur du bzhag nas nyal khri'i thog tu nyal bsdad/ nam gung dkyil du srin po mgo dgu can zhig gis blon po zhig khrid de ser 'chu ba cig dang mnyam du can dan sdong bo'i zur du thon pa dang des blon por nga'i lag pa re re'i nang gi gser dngul lcags ga sum gyi thur ma cha re re rgyal bo'i bu 322

mo 'i ma gor skor te rus tshab tu rus tshobs/ sha tshab tu sha tshobs/ khrag tshab tu khrag tshobs zhes bshad na rgyal bo'i bu mo'i nad de drag 'gro bar ma zad/ sngar las je yag tu bud 'gro zhes zer zhor du tsan dan sdong bo'i zur du thon 'ongs/ dbul bo'i bus skad cha de thos ma thag tu myur mor rang gi gri chung bzung nas tsan dan sdong bo'i rgyab tu slong bsdad par ‘ rgyal bo tshang gis myi khral byin med/ rgyal bo'i bu mo'i khrag gzhib tu 'gro7zer ba la dbul bo'i bus gri chung gcig g.yug pas na/ srin po'i lag pa gsum bcad de gcig las ma lha ga sa la lhung ba'i lag pa gcig yi na nga na gser gyi thur ma cha gcig bzung yod pa dang /lag pa gcig gi nang du dngul gyi thur ma cha gcig bzung yod/ lag pa gcig gi nang du lcags kyi thur ma cha gcig bzung yod/ lcags kyi thur ma cha gcig po blangs nas sngas mgor bzhag pa dang / dngul gyi thur ma cha gcig po blangs nas 'og tu mnan/ gser gyi thur ma blangs nas rten mar bzhag ste gnyid logaphyi nyin snga mo nyi ma shar ba dang mgyogs por thur ma rnams rum la bcug ste phyir rgyal bo tshang la song / rgyal bo tshang nas bza' btung rgyags 'dug pa zhig— zos rjes su 323

rgyal bo'i mdzod khang re re'i nang du song nas bltas pe la gos kha gang gi thog tu ri mo mi 'dra ba brgyad brgya brgyad cu can zhig med pas phyir 'gro grabs byed dus/ rgyal bos /phanged tshang gi bu mo gces phrug ma gcig po de shi na shi kha mi nyan/ gson na gson kha mi nyan pas khyed kyis gcig lta rogs zhu’’zer/ dbul bo'i bus ‘ngas lta mi shes ’zhes ci 'dra bshad kyang rgyal bos ma gsan par bu mo'i gzim khang nang du khrid song ba la dbul bo'i bus gser gyi thur ma cha gcig po blangs nas bu mo'i mgor skor zhor du rus tshab tu rus tshobs/ 〉zer ba dang / de nas dngul gyi thur ma blangs nas bu mo'i mgor skor zhor du‘ sha tshab tu sha tshobs ’ zer/ de nas lcags kyi thur ma blangs nas bu mo'i mgor skor zhor du khrag tshab tu khrag tshobs zhes zer ba 'a// bu mo'i nad de myur ba myur du drag yong bar ma zad/sngar las je yag tu song ba la bu mos‘‘nga 'jig rten dkar nag gi mtshams nas phyir len mkhan ni khyed yin pas/khyed sa gang la song na mo rang khyed kyi rjes ded de 'gro’ zer/ dbul bo'i bus‘ de ltar ma byed/ nga dpon po zhig gis bka' babs te ras kha gang gi thog tu ri mo mi 'dra ba brgyad brgya brgyad cu yod pa btsal du 'gro dgos pa yin/ gal 324

te de 'dra zhig ma/ lon na nga 'gro sa med/ ras de 'dra zhig lag tu son na phyir 'ong nas khyod khrid 'gro’’zer nas lam la chas/kho song song mthar sbra ser bo zhig gi sngon na rta rgacha dmar bo rlung phar la g.yug na phar la log 'gro ba/ rlung tshur la g.yug na tshur la log 'gro ba zhig yod pa mthong nas sbra de'i nang du song ba na/ rgan mo lo lon zhig gson na gson ma thub/ mi/ na shi ma thub par bsdad yod pa zhig gis‘ mi yul gyi gces phrug khyod gang nas 'ongs pa yin/gnas 'di ni 'ong sa'i sa zhig min te srin po'i yul zer ba de red/ ma dang nub srin po'i rgyal bo phyi tshor song nas lag pa gsum bcad de 'ongs pa red ’ces zer ba la/dbul bo'i bus/‘‘srin po'e lag pa gcod mkhan nga yim/ nga de ring srin po 'dul du 'ong ba yin ’zer/ de nas srin po de rlung 'tshub ma zhig dang mnyam du 'ongs nas blon por rta rgan der khrag gzhib rgyu med pas rgan mo'i khrag gzhib tu 'gro nyazer nas rgan mo lo lon de'i sbra nang du song bar dbul bo'i bus gris brgyab nas mgo gsum bcad pa la sa cha yu la phyogs der 'ur sgras bkang song /dbul bo'i byus myur du rum gyi thur ma blangs te rgan 325

mo 'i mgor skor ba la rgan mo'ang rgyal bo tshang gi bu mo rjedang 'dra bar nad myur du drag song bar ma zad/ na je gzhon du song / rgan mo da1ka' spro skyes te myur ba myur du gnas 'ji dang bral nas mi yul la 'gro zer ba la/ dbul bo'i bus / sngon ltar gos de btsal du 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mchan bshad dus/ rgan mo sa snang ma bzhi lha yul gyi bos 'thag ca/khan zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang mi yul la 'gro 'dod che bas srin po'i yul la 'phangs pa yin/ gos de 'dra zhig btsal nas mi lon pas/ ngas khyed la 'thag na chog ’zer nas skud pa 'then te ras 'thag nyin gcis zhag gcirga/ la btags rjes ras kha gang gi thog tu ri mo mi gcig pa brgyad brgya brgyad cu yod pa zhig btags nas grub song /dbul bo'i bus sngon rgyal bo'i bu mor bshad pa lta ra du ras kha gang bo bzung / a ma rgan mo rta la zhon du bcug ste rta rgan dmar bo de khrid nas phyir rgyal bo tshang la song zhing rgyal bo'i bu mo khrid de rang sar song / nyin mang bo song rjes pha yul la thon te dpon po tshang du song nas smyo dpon po 'a gas/ khyed kyis tshol shog zer ba'i ras /ba gang gi thog tu ri mo mi gcig pa brgyad brgya brgyang ) cu can 32(〉

de ngas btsa‘ra 'ongs pa yin / de ring khyed kyi lag rogs pa 'di 'dra'i mang bo yod sa nas khyed la 'bul zer nas a ma pom cho/sa btags pa'i ras kha gang bo yar la phul/dpon po ya mtshan skyes/ te myur du lag rosas pa rnams bsdu sa nas dbul bo'i bus ngas 'jig rten thog tu mi lon bsam pa'i gos kha gang gi thog tu ri mo mi gcig pa brgyad ba rgya brgyad cu can de btsal nas rnyed 'ongs pas/ da lta ngas / ro rang ma bsad na khos nga rang gsod rgyu yin pas/babul bo'i bu gsod thabs shig tshol zhes zer/ lag rogs pa ngan pa zhig gis stod lha yul na dre'u rta rkang gsum zer ba zhig yod pa yin zer ba thos myong cho/da/ 'on kyang mthong ma myong bas dbul bo'i bu la zungs shog zer nas bzung yong ma thub na srog gi chad pa bcad ma chog /zer/ dpon pos dbul bo'i bu la de ltar bshad pa/sa dbul bo'i bu phyir song nas a ma rman mo dang rang yi/ chung ma gnyis la rjo dpon pos yang dre'u rta rkang gsum tshol shog ces pa'i bka' babs pas ci byas na bzang ’ zhes dris dus/ a ma rgan mo des der skrag don med/ khyodati rgan dmar bor zhon nas rta'i rna rtse 'dar reg bar du ḍaso nga / rta'i rna rtse 'dar skabs sar babs te rta'i rnga ma 327

ma dud pa dang rta sga'i glo gcig nas dgu bar rtsis nas 'then rjes mig btsums te rta la zhon nas song / de dus khyed kyi snying 'bal 'gro ba bzhin tsha na'ang kha nas a tsha ma shor na lag tu 'ong ba yin/ gal te kha nas a tsha shor na rta rgan log 'gro bas ma bzang ba red’ ces zer/dbul bo'i bus a ma rgan mos bshad pa ltar du lam la chas nas song ba dang lam kha nas kyang rgan mos bshad pa ltar du phyin/ mtshams shig tu snying tsha ba'i rkyen gyis kha nas a tsha tsha’’zhes tshig shor song bar rta rgan log song / der rta rgan gyis a ma rgan mos khyod kyi kha nas a tsha shor mi —nyan zhes bshad mod khyod kyis kha mi nyan pas da lta nga 'gro —mi thub/ khyed rang song nas dre'u rta rkang gsum tshol dang lag tu son rjes 'dir shog la ngas 'di nas sgug 'dug zer bas/ dbul bo'i bu lam la chas/nyin mang bor song dus ri khrod pa zhig la thug nas ngas khyed la kha bskol byas nas bsdad na e chog nyaces dris par/ ri khrod pa de 'thad pa byung nas nyin 'gar ri khrod pa der kha bskol byas te bsdad/ ri khrod pa des nyin re rer mar ril bu 'ga' dang nas khra 'ga' khyer nas ya ra la bud 'gro/ nyin zhig la dbul bo'i bu'ang dal mor ri 328

khrod pa'i rjes ded de song ba na/ ri khrod pas me tog 'dab ma bco brgyad can gyi chu mgo zhig gi mgo nas nas 4 khra chu'i nang du gtor ba dang / mar lag tu zungs 'dug par lha yul gyi drel rta rkang sasum bongs nas nas khra dang mar zos rjes phyir bud song / ri khrod pa phyir ma thon chang du dbul bo'i bu sngon la phyir 'ongs nas bsdad pa dang ri khrod pa phyir thon dus ‘a khu lags/ khyed kyis nga la rogasashig byed rgyu yod pas rogs byed dam mi byed’’ces dris pa la/ ri khrod pas rogs los byed’’zer/ dbul bo'i bus dpon po'i btsan gyis ras btsal tshul dang ras btsal rjes yang btsan btsugs nas dre'u rta rkang gsum bzung nas khyer yong dgos pa sogs zhib mor bshad dus/ ri khrod pa la'ang snying rje skyes te ma gzhi dre'u rta rkang gsum de 'dzin mi chog mod/ khyod la rogs ram byed ched du ngas khyod la dngos po 'ga' ster/ khyod kyis de rnams khyer so/nga ngang dre'u rta rkang gsum lag tu 'ong ba yin ’zhes bshad nga/ dang / mar ril bu 'ga' dang nas khra 'ga'/ gser gyi ga 'u zhig gi nang du 'ja' yi zhags pa zhig bzhag pa bcas dbul bo'i bu'i lag tu bzhag cing / rang gi lwa dbul bo'i bu la bskon te‘ khyod so nga nas mar ril bu dang 329

nas khra gtor te dre'u rta rkang gsum gyis za skabs/ ga'u'i nang nas 'ja' yi zhags pa blangs5 te dre'u rta rkang gsum gyi ske la bskon dang gnam 'drud sa 'drud byas kyang gtan nas gtong mi nyan zer/phyi nyin mar dang nas khra/ 'ja' yi zhags pa bcas bzung ste ri khrod pa'i lwa gon nas dre'u rta rkang gsum 'jin du song / mar gyi ril bu sar gtor ba la dre'u rta rkang gsum yong nas za skabs yag che bas mig dbang 'phrog nas 'ja' yi zhags pa 'phen rgyu brjed song / mar dang nas khra zos tshar rjes phyir 'gro skabs da gzod 'ja' yi khyags pa yid la shar de mgyogs por zhags pa blangs nas btab pas dre'u rta rkang gsum bzung ba na gnam lding sa lding byas te dbul bo'i bu drud song / dbul bo3 bus thag pa dam por bzung ste gtan nas ma btang ba na dre'u rta rkang gsum sar babs te dbul bo'i bu la ‘da ni khyed kyis nga thub yod pas/ nga'i ske'i thag pa khrol dang chog zer ma'ang / dbul bo'i bus gtan nas ma blangs par ri khrod pa/ yod sar khrid song / ri khrod pas dre'u rta rkang gsu / de khyed kyis zin song bas/ da bal skud kher skya zhig gis khrid kyang chog pa red/ 'on kyang dpon po tshang la thon 330

dus rnabreng ba dgu skya bcu skya zhig ji/sa 'dog dgos / gal te shor song na 'dzin mi thub ces shodanya’zer/dobul bo'i bus bal thig kher skya zhig gis khrid de phyir 'ongs/ lam ke/ da du rta rgan la zhon nas yul la thon de ri khrod pas bshad pa ltar du dpon po tshang la bshad/dpon po des dbul bo'i bus bal skud khor skya cig gis thub na nga rang gis 'breng ba kher skya nyis skya zhig gis4 thub thag chod yin bsams te 'breng ba zhig gis ya/ra 'then ma ra 'then byas nas btags/ dbul bo'i bu phyir yul la song ma thag dre'u rta rkang sasum gyis mtsher rgyang /nig byaṭa te 'breng ba bcad de phyir lha yul la 'phur song /dpon ngan des yang 'a5 ga rogs pa rnams bsdus/ nge gos byas par/ la las kho bsad de dar shing ring cho/'i ca/so la btags na bzang zer/ lag rogs pa rgan pa zhig yo da pa des zu‘lha yul na gser gyi kong bu pad ma 'dab brgyad can zhig yod zer srol yod pas de ma lon na ra/bo cod rgyu yin zer nas bshad na/ gser gyi kong bu de lag tu mi 'ong thag chod yin pas/ de dus ma go bcad na sems can thams cad la bshad rgyu med pa red ces zer/de nas dpon pos myu ra du dbul bo'i bu la de lta ra bshad 331

pas dbul bo'i bu phyir khyim du 'ong nas a ma rgan mo dang rang si chung ma gnyis la de ltar bshad pas/ rgan rmas7‘ der skyo 'o meng/ khyod song nas dpon po tshang la khyed tshang gis lha yul gyi gser gyi kong bu pad ma 'dab brgyad cam de nges par du lon dgos na/ ma mog gi ri zhig brtsi gas nas de'i steng du g.yes/ nag gi ma tsho mo zhig bskyil ste nga de'i mgor bud rjes me la sgron dang nga song nas khyer 'ong zhes 7shod’nyazer/ dbul bo'i bu phyir dpon po tshang la song ste de ltar bshad pas ngas ma/ bsad la kho rang shi bsam pa de shin tu bzang zer nas dga' spro chen mo skyes te myur du mi mngags nas/ ma mog gi ri zhig brtsigs pa dang de'i steng du ga yis nag gi mtsho mo 'ig skyil du bcug dbul bo'i bu de'i mgor bud pa dang me bsgron rjes/ sngon ma nas brkos yo da pa'i dong nang du 'dzul nas bsdad pas me 'bar tshar rjes su phyir thon 'ongs pa dang dpon po la nga lha yul la song yang khyed kyi gnyen mi tshos kong bu pad ma 'dab brgyad can de mi ster bar/ khyed rang dngos su len du shog zer’ zer nas dpon po tshang gi shi bo rnams rkya ming bshad de de rnams la thug thal zhes bshad par/ da pon po ngan pa de ham sems kyis khyod dbul bo zhig lha yul la 332

'gro thub na nga dpon ngo/ lhag par du 'gro thub pa yi na bsams te 'bangs mi/ tshor bka' babs te ma mog gi ri zhig rtsig tu bcug pa dang de'i mgor g.yis nag yi mtsho zhig skyil du bcug rjes dpon ngan de de'i mgor bud pa na me bsgron pas mes tshigs nas shi song /dpon po shi rjes su/ dbul bo'i bu'i chung ma'i pha rgan gyis rang gi mag pa dpon por bzhag pas dmangs rnams kyis bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol ba dang / khong bza' zla gnyis kyis kyang a ma rgan mor brtsi bkur byas te bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol lo /(bstan gces skyabs kyis legs bsgrigs byas pa〈〈mgo log gi dmangs khrod gtam rgyud 〉〉las bdams/ ) 333

lha rta nagrin danar pozhi skye zha/‘gama' dus shig la/ sa cha zhig na khyim tshang chig 'o da pa ha cang dbul bo yin pas pha tsha bu byud kyi ring la rgya9 bo tshang la g.yog byas nas 'tsho ba rol/ lo zhig la khyim/ tshang de ku'i gnyen mi tshang ma shi tshar nas byis pa chung chung 'i/ga dang a ma rgan mo zhig las ma lhag bu chung de lo lnga/ra bud dus a ma rgan mor 'dri rgyur 6khyed kyis rgyal bo tshang du g.yog byas kyang gla leg rgyu ma yod dam/ gla me ster ba yin nam / nyazhes dris/a ma rgan mos/rjo‘rang tshang gi gnyen mi ma shi ba'i sngo ma gyi pha tsha bu rgyud kyi/ ring la rgyal bo 'di tshang la g.yog byas kyang gla byin ma myong / da lta nged gnyis kyis g.yog byaru/ pa la'ang gla len rgyu med/ nyaces zer bar/ bu chung deng 66ci'i ngon la gla len rgyu med pa yin zer nas dris dus/ a ma pon mos/ lan 'debs rgyu ma rnyed pa sa/ bu chung gis rgyal bo tshang la 'dri ru 'gro/ g.yog byas na gla mi ster ba ga la yod’ zer nas 'gro grabs byas par a ma rgan mos bkag 334

kyang ma thub par rgyal bo tshang la so nga / kho rgyal bo bzhugs sar co /nga nas rgyal bo lags/ — ngas shes tshulaltar na nged tshang gi pha ring bu rgyud la khyed tshang la g.yog byas nas bsdad kyang / khyed tshang ji/sa gla gcig kyang ma byin/ de'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/ pha ring bu rgyud la g.yog ji ltar byas pa ngas 'ded mi shes kyang nged ma bu gnyis kyis lo 'ga'i ring la ba /yog byas pa'i gla dgos pa yin/ ’ zhes zer ba la/rgyal bo khong khro chen po langs te byi li chung chung mkhas lugab/ la/ /ma rabs blo rig can zhig 'dra/ /rgyal ngo gus pa med lugs la/ /pha med dwa phrug cig dang 'ang/ / /pha bu'i g.yog gla 'ded lugs la/ /dpa' bo gdeng tshod med pa 'dra/ /gla bar gla rin ma byin na/ /khyod da lta'i bar du ci ltar gson/ /’’zer zhing blon po tshor ‘sprang phrug kun skas thog nas mar la phongs shig’’ces bka' babs/blon po stobs po che gnyis kyis bu chung skas thog tu nga ra la phongs zer ba thos nas dga' spro chen po skyes te dgod zhor du bu chung gi rtsib la rgyug blo yul las 'das pa mi bu de skas thog nas mar 'phen ma dgos/ blon po stopas chen de gnyis/ kyis sgul tsam yang ma thub pas rgyang/ bo 335

ya mtshan chen po skyes/ bu chung des rgyal bo dang blon po tshor mig log gis lta bzhin brjid bag gis phyir song /rgyal bo'i sems su bu de ni rang bzhin gyi bu zhig min pas nges par du ri khrod pa zhig la 'dri ru 'gro dboca/ bsams nas blon po rig rgod gnyis ri khrod pa de yod sar 'dri bar 'gro ru bcug ri khrod pa des thog ra/ra ci yang mi gsung bar spyan gnyis btsums nas sgom rgyag 'dug pa la/ blon po rig pa can gnyis kyis skor ba dang phyag mang bo 'tshal/ zhu ba yang yang byas stabs ri khrod pa des‘‘ma sa/zhi ngas khyod gnyis la bshad rtsis med mod/ 'on kyang khyod gnyis kyi re ba nan che tshul gyis lan zhig ma byin na mi bzang / khyod gnyis kyis 'drir 'dug pa'i bu chung de ni lha rta mgrin dmar bo'i skye ba red/ ’ ces zer/de thos 'phral blon po rig pa can gyis bu de rgyal bor ster mi 'dod par/ bu chung de rgyal bo'i zhabs 'og tu bzhag na g.yog po yin pas/ rang gi 'bangs mi'i gas su bzhag na bzang bsams te rang gis bdag byed do/ /nyin du ma 'gor rjes/ rgyal bos blon po rig pa can gnyis ri khrod pa yod sar song ba'i gnas tshul yar zhu 336

ma bya sa pa mthong nas/ bu chung de khyad par can zhig yin pa shes te blon po rig pa can de gnyis myur ba myur du pho brang du shog 〉zer nas bka' babs/ blon po rig pa can ba/nyis kyis ci yin 'di yin ma shes parje rgyal bo'i pho brang la thocha pa na/ rgyal bo dgod kha shor nas hab cha brgyab/blon po gnyis kyi sa lhag par du mgo rnga ma shes par rgyal bo dang bstun nas bgad/ rgyal bos glo bur du dgod ma tshams bzhag cing ngas khyed gnyis rig pa ca na zhig yin bsams mod/ 'on kyang khyed gnyes las glen pa zhig med/ ngas bkod sgrig byas pa'i don bya ci'i phyir nga la yar zhu mi byed pa yin/ khyed gnyis la sprang bo ma bu gnyis po dgos sam rang gnyis kyi srog dgos/ gal te khyed gnyis la sprang bo ma bu gnyis po dngo/sa na/ srin po'i yul na gser gyi gdugs shig yod pa de khyer 'og dang g.yog po ma bu de gnyis khyed gnyis la ster/ gal te saser nag gi gdugs de khyeng 'ong ma thub na/ nga la khyed gnyis kyi srog dgos pa yin/ ’ zhes bshad/ blon po gnyis por skrag snang chen po skyes te g.yog po ma bu de gnyis nged gnyis la dbang ga la rung / de ni rgyal bo tshang gi g.yog po go chod yin pas khyed tshang gi yin thag chod red/ ri khrod pa la 337

dris rjes khyed la yar zhu ma byas pa'i rgyu mtshan ni ri grod pa nges sgom brgyab 'dug pas ci yang ma gsung / de bas khyed la'ang yar zhu ma byas pas thugs rgyal ma bzhengs lags/ nyazhes yang yang zhus par/ rgyal bos des na gyed gnyis mgyogs por song nas sprang phrug bu chung de'i a ma rgan mo bos shog’nyaces bka' babs/ blon po ོrtse / po rlung 'tshub mas khur ba ltar du a ma rgan mo tshang ra so nga zhing btsan skad kyis rgyal bos khyod pho brang gu shog ceb bka' gnang bas mgyogs por lam la chas zer na 4ska did song /a ma rgan mo rgyal bo'i mdun du thon durdo tha rgyal bos pha rgan mo / khyod tshang gi tsha bo rgyal khrims dang 'gal ba la ma sa/'i gsod dgos mo da/ khyod lo rgas stabs gnyor skyo nga byed mkhan med pa de bsams nas mi gsod rgyu/ byasag / ri na na'ang srin po'i yul na gser nag gi gdugs shig yad pa de khyer 'ong dgos/ gal te gdugs de khyer 'ong ma thub na khyod kyi tsha bo gsod rgyu yin/ ’’ zhes bshad/ gam mo sa rgyal bor zhu ba ji 'dra byaca/ kyang ma phan pas mo ngu 'or la yul du song / tsha bos ci yin gang red 'dri dus/ a ma gi na mos rgyal bos bshad pa ltar du gcig kyang ma lus par 338

rṇab mor bshad/ bu chung de ri khrod pa yod sar song nas skor ba dang phyag mang bo byas shing gus gus bkur bkung byas te 'jig rten gyi sems pa yongs su spangs te chos ga cib/ po sgom pa'i a khu ri khrod pa lags/ nga ni rgyal bo tshang la g.yog byed pa'i bu chung zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang rgyal bo tshang gis nged ma bu gnyis la g.yog gla mi ster bar ma zad/ da rung btsan gyis srin po'i yul du gser nag gi ba/dugs shig yod pa de khyer shog zer/ de khyer yong ma thub na srog gi chad pa gcod rgyu zer bas thabs med par khyed nyid la yar zhu byed du yong ba yin/ khyed nyid kyis nga ngang nge'i a ma rgan mor snying rje sgo ma nas thabs re gnang rgyu bka' drin zhu nyazhes mgo pus mor gtug nas bshad par/ ri khrod pa des zung 'dra'i nyam chung zhig gis khyed la rogs byed mi dgos kyang / khyed kyis de ltar srin po'i yul du yod pa'i gser nag gi gdugs de len pa'i blo 'dri mi bshad ka med yin pas bshad dgos/ da nas bzung khyod kyis nga'i gam du zla lam nyin gyis chod pa/ lo 'a ma zla yis chod pa'i thabs shig slobs dang de nas ngas dngos po zhig ster/ de khyer nas song dang gser nag gi gdugs lag tu 'ong ba yin ’zer/339

bu chung gis ri khrod pa'i gam du nyin bdun la mgyogs 'gro sbyangs mthar ri khrod pas ras kha gang dang ḍa ru gcig byin te lam la chas/ kho zla gcig gi 'a/ma la nyin gcig gis song / lo gcig gi lam la zla gcig gis song nas ma tsho chen po zhig gi khar thon dus 'gro ma thub par ri khrod par gsol ba btab pa na/ 'bral khar byin pa'i ras kha gang bo de je ring je ring la song nas mthar mtsho la dar lam ring bo zhig chags pas phar khar 'gro thub pa byung / de nas nyin lnga tsam la song dus brag ri mthon po zhig gi rtsar slebs pa na ngal zhing dub pas 'gro ma thub par brag ri de'i rtsa nas zhag 'dug byas/ brag ri de'i sked na rgod tshang zhig yod/ rgod tshang nang du rgod phrug 'gas a mas zas mngar mo khyer5'ong bar bsgugs bsdad yod/ rgod mos sa nub khar sha tshil mang bo khyer na sa phyir thon 'ong / rgod phrug tshos a ma la‘ de ring khyod 'di 'dra 'gor don ci yin’ zhes dris dus/ rgod phrug gi a mas (srin po'i rgyal bo tshang gis ston mo byed 'dug pas sha tshil mang bo rgum rgyu yod pas yin/ zhes bshad zhor du sha tshil de phru gu rnams 9 byin/ phru gu bra tshags shig yod ba des 4 rgyal bo tshang gis ci' phyir ston mo byed pa yin/ zhes 340

dris/ rgod phrug gi a masaphade bshad mi nyan/ gzhan pas go song na ma bzang ba red’ ces zer yang rgod phrug bra tshags des kha ma nyan par sa stong lung ba byang stong 'di na nyan ma khan su zhig yod/ khyed kyis mi bshad na khyed sang nyin song shul nas ngas tshang bshig rgyu zer bar rgod phrug gi a mar thabs zad nas gsang don de bshad dgos byung ste/tshang sgor bud nas yar lta mar lta byas nas mi dang gzhan pa'i srob chags yod med la bltas rjes/ ca rgyal bo tshang gi gser nag gi gdugs de mi yul gyi mi zhig 'phrog tu 'ongs yod pas/ rgyal bo tshang gis dmag btang ste gser nag gi gdugs srung daso/sa zhes dmag ston byas pa red’’zer nas bshad/ bu chung des don de tshang ma gsal bo zhig thos na'ang rgyal bo tshang gi gser nag gi gdugs de gang na yod pa ma shes pas phyi nyin spen ma ring bo skyes yod pa'i gseb tu bsdad par bye'u tshang zhig yod pa'i nang gi byi'u phrug tshos kyang sngon dgong rgod tshang nang gi rgod phrug la bshad pa ltar du bshad par ma zad phyi nyin srin po'i rgyal bos gser nag gi gdugs la mjal du 'jug rgyu red ces bshad pa thos/ phyi nyin kho srin po'i yul la thon dus srin po'i rgyal bo'i bzhugs mkhar brtsegs ma dgu thog can de 341

dgung sngon gamam la zu ga yod cing / mkhar skyed na sprin dmar 'khrigs pa/ mkhar steng na srin phrug rtse ba/mkhar sgo na srin po'i srung dmag gis bzung yod pa'i mtshon cha de rnams mthong ma myong la thos kyang ma myong ba tag tag yin stabs/ ci ltar 'gro bsams pa'i skabs su ri khrod pa la gsol ba btab pa na/ kho myur du sbrul zhig tu gyur song ba dang srung dmag tsho'i rkang bar nas bde blag gis pho brang du bud song / de nas yang bung ba zhig tu sprul te pho brang gi rtse la 'phur song ba dang / de nas srin phrug zhig tu sprul nas srin phrug rnams kyi dkyil du song ba la/ srin phrug tshos de ring nga tsho'i dkyil du mi dri zhig bro 'dug ces skad cor brgyab par/ bu chung des rang shes thal bsams shing sna phu thung byas te ngo mas mi dri zhig dro 'dug’ zer nas/ bdugs mjal sar song /srin po'i rgyal pos gser nag gi gdugs de zur 'a/ bzhag ste srin po rnams la mjal du bcug lha rta mgrin dmyo/ra bo'i skye bas gser nag gi gduṭa la mjal skabs sren po'i rgyal bo la srin phrug ngas gser nag gi gdugs 'de lta bu'i rin po che zhig mthong ni ma dgos yod pa thes kyang ma myong bas sems chung byas nas lag tu bzung ste 342

bltos na e chog’ ces zhu ba byas pa la/ srin po'i rgyal ngos kyang da thengs las lta khom dang mjal khom med pas chog brjod pas/ lha rta mgrin dmar bo'i skye bas gser nag yi/ gdugs lag tu bzung ma thag rgyal bo'i khri thog tu lding nas srin po'i rgyal bo'i phyag gri bzung nas bros song / srin po srin mo tshos lha rta mgrin dmar bo'i skye ba'i rjes ded de bda' yong bar ma zad/ srin phrug des rgyal bo tshang gi rin chen gser nag gi gdugs 'phrog nas bros song bas zungs shig sod cig ces pa'i 'ur sgras gnam sa gnyirngag ka/ nga song /bu chung gis gser nag gi gdugs khur nas kho thog mar 'ong sa'i brag sgor thon dus/ brag dmar bo'i sgo chen de sngar nas brgyab yod pas 'gro mi thub par gyur/khos 'phrog pa'i srin po'i rgyal bo'i gris brag dmar bo'i sgo chen la thengs gsum brgyab pas sgo chen de phye thub byung / rjes na srin dmag gis ded yong gin yod pas myur du brag sgo de'i phyi tshor bud/ mdun phyogs ca5/tsho chen po zhig yin pas lam bkag nas 'gro mi thub par ci byed 'di byed med par mtsho nang du lding ba la/ srin daca/ga rnams kyang nya mang bor sprul nas mtsho nang du thon/ khos 343

ma tsho gting nas srin po'i rgyal bo'i gri chen de g.yug zhor dang 'bro zhor byas nas yar mtsho khar 'bud la yod dus nya dkar bo zhig gis kho'i sgyid pa nas bzung / bu chung gis nya de drud nas mtsho khar bud pas/ da ni nga rang bda' mkhan dang 'dzin mkhan/ gser nag gi gdugs 'di 'phrog mkhan bcas med pa red bsams te sems bde la phabs mas gnyid log pa la/ kho gnyid las sad dus srin dmag gis phyi skor nang skor byas 'dug sems shor nas de ring bros te thar thabs med bsams kyang nya dkar bo 'di bas5 da nas 'gro dgos 'dod de gris rgyag rtsis byas par/ kho skor yod pa'i nang gi mi dkar bos lwa dkar bo gon pa/ mda' gzhu dkar bo bzung ba/ rta sga dkar bo bstad pa/ rta dkar por zhon pa zhig gis ki btab nas nya dkar bo de ma gsod zer zhor la kho'i zur du rgyug 'ong /mi de zur la thon ma jag rta thog nas babs te pus mo gnyis sa la btsugs nas dpa' bo lags/ khyed kyis nga 'i phu bo ma gsod dang gser nag gi gdugs/ rgyal bo'i gri chen bcas khyed la ster bar ma zad/ nge da klu'i rgyal bo la yod pa'i dngos po zhig yin tshe ci dgos kyang khyed la ster nges yin’ zhes bshad par/ nya dkar bo de phyir byin 344

pa na nya dkar bo des kyang rjes sor khyed la mkho ba ci yod na btsal nas shog dang chog nga yod sa ni khyod kyi/sa shes pa ltar red/ klu phrug rnams la klu'i rgyal bo'i nye ring yin zhes bshad na khyod mngags 'ong ba yin’’zhes bshad/der bu chung 'thad pa byung nas rang rang sar song /bu chung des gser nag gi gdugs dang gri chen gnyis khur nas yul phyogs su song / kho phyer 'ong ba'i nyi chad ni lo gcig yin pas/ lo gcig gi ring la a ma rgan mor ma thug pa dang gnas tshul ci yin pa ma shes pas myur ba myur du a ma rgan mo yod sar song tshe / a ma pon mo la na ba tsha ba ci yang med par 'tshams po bde mo yin pas bu chung phyer thon 'ongs pa mthong nas dga' spro chen po skyes shing mgyogs por thab tu me bzhag nas ja skol/ za ma las nas bu chung lha rta mgrin dmar po'i skye ba dang mnyam du zas zos nas kha ta byas/ blon po rig pa can gyis bu chung gis gser nag gi gdugs lon yod med la sems khral byas te gnyid mi khug par yar langs nas rang gi mkhar thog tu bud de lta dus/ a ma rgan mo'i khang klad na du ba 'ong gin 'dug pas sems su rgan mo kher 'dug cig si/sa mtshan mo me 'bud don med pas/ bu chung phyir thon pa 345

thag chod red bsams shing myur du a ma rgan mo tshang la song ba na/ bu chung de ngo mas phyir thon 'dug pas/ blon po rig pa can shin tu dga' nas bu chung la gser nag gi gdugs lon nam ma lon gyi kha ta dris/ bu chung gis gser nag gi gdugs ci ltar lon tshul rnams zhib mor bshad rjes gser nag gi gdugs 'di red ces bstan pa la rgan mo ma bu gnyis kyi khang ba'i nang hril bo 'od kyis bgang /blon pos gser nag gi gdugs de mthong nas ham pa langs te ngas khyer song nas rgyal bor 'bul zer yang bu chung la mgo skor gtong ma thub par/ bu chung gis de mi chog rgyal bor 'bul na nga rang dngos su song nas 'bul rgyu yin/ de min par khyed la mkho ba yod na khyed 9pa byin na'ang chos ’ces bshad par blon po rig pa can dga' spro chen po skyes nas gser nag gi gdugs de rang gnyis kyi byas te rgyal bor ma byim na chog zer nas gser nag gi gdugs de bu chung gi 'a/ga nas blangs shing khyer song nas rang gi mkhar gyi rtse la bzhab gser nag gi gdugs de khang ba'i rtse la bzhag ma thag tu phyogs bzhe mtshams brgyad la 'od kyis bkang song /346

de'i dgung mo rgyal bo'ang gnyid mi 'ong bar pho brang yi dgu thog la bud nas lta dus/ rang gi pho brang gi mtha' 'khor du nag 'thibs bee yod la/ blon po rig pa can gyi mkhar rtse na 'od 'tsher nas nyin dkar lta bu yin pa mthong / rgyal bos bsam par blon po rig pa can gyis gser nag gi gdugs yar la ma sprad par khyer song ba red bsams nas kha spo kha nas langs/ zhe spo gting nas langs te nyal ma thub par nam langs rag tu sgug nam langs ma thag tu srung dang/ga yod tshad kho'i 'dug khang du bos nas srung dmag su zhig blon po rig pa can yod sar song chas gser nag gi gdugs blangs nas 'ong thub na/ blon ngo/ rig pa can gyi go gnas mi de la ster :zhes bshad par/gsar bu stag 'dra ba 'ga' zhig gis dpa' khas blangs ming mdung sked la btags nas nga 'gro/ nga 'gro zer bas rgyal bos gsar rgod bcu 'dems nas blon po rig pa can gyi 'dug gnas/ su gser nag gi gdubs len du 'gro ru bcugargyal bo'i srung dar ga tshos ngar ngar rdzig rdzig gis blom po tshang gi sgo gtor nas khyim la song ba na/ bu chung dang blo7 po rig pa can gnyis kyis khri gnyis brgyab ste kha 347

ta byed bzhin yod/ rgyal bo'i srung dmag tshos don de ma/thong ma thag tu lhag par du khong khro chen po langs te blon po rig pa can la myur du mar bab nas rgyal bo'i bka' la nyon zer/ blon po rig pa can de khri thog nas mar la 'bab ma dgos/ dgod shor te‘ da lta nga'ang rgyal bo yin pas sus su'i bka' la nyan rgyu’’zer/ srung da ma ga tshor thabs med par gser nag gi gdugs de mgyogs por rgyal por sprod/ mi sprod na srog gi chad pa gcod rgyu/ mi’zhes bshad pa la bu chung dang blon po rig pa can gnyis kyis kha su ma gyogs gang mgyogs la bltas te gser nag si/ gdugs mi ster zer/ de dus rgyal bo'i srung dmag mi lnga bu chung gi thog tu rgyug pa dang mi lnga blon po rig pa can gyi thog tu rgyug bu chung khri thog tu yar langs zhor la srin po'i rgyal bo'i gri chen blangs nas gcig g.yug pas rgyal bo'i srung dmag lnga bo bsad/ de nas phar blon po rig pa can la bltas dus/ rig pa can de srung dmag gis mar la mnam/ 'dug par bu chung gis re rer gris/ brgyab nas bsad/nyin 'ga' 'gor song / rgyal bos mngags pa'i mi de rnams phyir 'ong rgyu med pas rgyal bos gnas tshul zhig 348

byung ba red/ de min na srung dmag de rnams phyir 'ong ba thag chod yin snyam ste blon po rig pa can tshang la dmag phud rgyu byas / blon po rig pa can des rgyal bos dmag phud 'ong ba shes nas bu chung la rgyal bo tshang gis dmas/ phud 'ong ba kho thag yin/ gal te dmag phud 'ongs na rang tshang la dmag brgya tsam las med pas ci byedanya’ces dris/bu chung gis sngon gser nag gi gdugs khyer 'ong skabs kyi nya dkar bo de sems su shar nas der skyom med/ nga klu yul na gros/sa po zhig yod pas khor bshad na rogs byed thub pa yin7zer/ blon po rig pa can gyis de 'dra thag ring po zhig gis rogs byed bsam/sa nas tshur la myur du thon thub kyang rang rnams ni mi dkyus ma zhig yin pas der thon rag bar la rgyal bo'i dmag gis brgyab tshar 'gro 'dod de ngus/ de nas bu chung gis ri khrod pa'i gam du bslabs pa'i mgyobs 'gro'i man ngag de yid la dran nas khyod ma ngu dang / nga la mgyogs 'gro'i man ngag yod/ nga de ring song nas sang nyin phyir thon 'onganya zhes bshad de lam la chas// bu chung gis ri khrod pas bslabs pa'i kha bton de bton nas klu yul gyi mtsho chen po'i khar slebs pa na brag dmar po'i sgo chen zhig yod pa'i khar song nas sgo rdung zhing srung dmag 349

la rang ni klu rgyal gyi nye ring zhig yin zer nas bshad pas srung dmag gis kho khrid de klu'i rgyal bo'i pho brang la song /khos klu'i rgyal bo la bltas dus/ klu'i rgyal bo ni sngon gyi nya dkar bo de min par khog stod ni seng ge dkar mo gangs naca5 'gying 'dra/ rnga ma ni dug sbrul nab/ po sdong ste nga la 'khyil 'dra/ lag pa gnyis ni g.yu 'brug kha skya'i sder mo 'dra ba/ rkang ba gnyis ni dred mo nag po'i sder rkang 'dra ba/ mgo bo mi min zog min zhig yin pas na/ skra ga snang gis ngor lta mi phod par gyur/ klu'i rgyal bo'i sku ma dun nas cung tsam la langs bsdad rjes/ rgyal bo la nga dang blon po rig pa can gnyis kyis gser nag gi gdugs de rgyal bo la ma sprad pas/ rgyal bos dmag phud de nga tsho'i mkhar skor yod pa dang / gser nag gi gdugs kyang btsan 'phrog byed 'gro bas khyed kyis rogs byed par zhu zhes bshad/ klu'i rgyal bosaphader skyon med/ ngas khyed la sgam li dmar bo zhig ster/ khyed kyis sgam li de khyer nas kha phyes te dmag bud ces shod dang dmag ci tsam dgos na de tsam thon 'ong’’zhes zer ba dang nga la'ang khyed la re ba chung chung zhig yod pas khyed kyis skong rogs zhu’ zhes zer ba la/ bu chung si/sa re ba ci zhig red/ ngas 350

sgrub thub pa zhig yin na sgrub kho thag yin zhes lan btab/klu'i rgyal bos khyed ni lha rta mgrin dmar bo'i skye ba yin pas/ khyed kyi dngos po zhig nga la gnang rgyu dang nged kha gnyis kyis gnyen zhig bca' rgyu de yin/ gal te khyod 'thad pa yin na/ nged tshang gi bu mo chung ba de khyed la chung mar ster’’zhes/ bshad/bu chung gis rang gi lag tu dngos po gzhan pa ci yang ster rgyu ma rnyed de a khu ri khrod pas byin pa'i ḍa ru klu'i rgyal bor byin pa dang klu'i rgyal bor gnyen bca' rgyu'ang 'thad pa byas/ klu'i rgyal bo dga' spro dpag med skyes te ston mo rgya chen po sgrig dgos zer mod/ bu chung phyir 'gro rgyur brel ba che bas ston mo ma bsgriṭa par dmag sgam dmar bo khur nas lam la chas/ kho phyir yul la thon dus/ rgyal bo tshang gi dmag gis blon po rig pa can tshang gi mkhar skor bar ma zad/ blon po rig pa can yang gsod la khad yod/ bu chung gis gri chen yar g.yug mar g.yug byas nas rgyal bo'i dmag mang bo bsad de blon po rig pa can gyi zur la thon nas khyod la mas ma byung ngam7zhes dris par/ blon po rig pa can gyisamakhyed kyis khrid 'ongs pa'i dmag sang na yod/ da ni gser nag gi gdugs srung ma dgos rang 351

gi srog kyang shor nyen yod pas ci byas na bzang ’zhes zer ‘ba la/ bu chung gis khyod skrag dgos don med/ ngas dmag sgam khur yong yod ’’zer ba la blon po rig pa can lhag par du ya ma tshan chen po skyes nas tshugang na yod/mgyogs por khyer shog’ zer/ bu chung gis mgyogs por sgam li dmar bo'i kha phyes nas dmag bud ’zer bar/ sgam li dmar bo'i nang nas dmag mang bo phyir thon 'ongs 4nas gang la rgyug rgyu/ gang la rgyas/ rgyu’ zer/ bu chung dang blon po ris pa can gnyis kyis rgyal bo tshang gi dmag la rgyob/ yod yod thams cad so/danya zer/ sgam li dmar bo'i nang du dam/ga mang bo phyir bud 'ongs nas rgyal bo tshang gi ngani rma/ga tshang ma rmas pa rmas/ gsod pa bsad/ 'phro ma 'ga' re phyir bros song / bu chung dang blon po gnyis kyis sga ma chung gi kha phyir brgyab cing bde mo spyid po byas/ nas zhag ma gcig la ngal gsos/phyi nyin nam langs dus rgyal bos khrab dang rmog gon 'ing rin chen glo gri btasas nas sngo nag nyi 'dzin zer ba'i rta la zhon te bu chung tshang gi sgo khar thon pa dang bu chung la sprang phrug khyod bu bzang yin na/ phyir bud shog dang de ring 'u gnyis gnam sngon po min pas lta ni med sa/ brag 352

dmar bo min pas bar ba med sa zhig nas rta gang mgyogs dang bu su rgod la lta7zer/ bu chung gis kyang gnyom chung mi byed par rgyal bo la khyod kyis nged tshang gi pha tsha bu rgyud kyi ring la g.yog byas pa'i g.yog gla ma byin par ma zad/nga'i gser nag gi gdugs 'phrog 'dod pa ni stong sems red/ bu bzang na cung sgugs dang ngas gri khyer nas 'ong zhes zer/ bu chung mgyogs por phyir khyim du song nas gser rmog gser khrab gon pa dang srin rgyal gyi ral gri chen po bzung nas sgo khar bud de khyod kyis yin gcig min gnyis bu su bzang la lta zer na/ khyod ni rgyal bo yin stabs sngon la khyod kyis rgyob/ nga ni g.yog po yin pas ngas gzhug nas rgyag’’ces bshad tshar ma thag tu rgyal bo khong khro 'a ngas nas tshig gcig kyang bshad ma thub par 'brug grags pa lta bu'i ki zhig btab nas lha rta mgrin dmar bo'i skye bar gri btsugs 'ong bar/ bu chung des glog 'khyug pa ltar byol ba dang rgyal bos yang rgyag rtsis byas pa la/ lha rta mgrin dmar bo'i skye bas myur du rgyal bo'i ol sgo nang du ral gri chen pos gtsags pa la gri rtse ltag rgyab tu bud de shi song /de nas sa cha bde 'jags su song zhing bu chung gis 353

kyang bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol nas bsdad/ rang la klu'i rgyal bos chung ma zhig byin pa brjed song nas/ a ma lo 'o na pos kha skol byed mi zhig med na mi chog ste nag mo zhig btsal dgos bsams/ te/ yang ri khrod pa yod sar chung rma gang nas blangs na bzang ba/ khyim tshang ga 'dra zhig gi bu mo blangs na bzang ba sobs 'dri ru song / ri khrod pa des 6khyed klu yul la dmag khrid du song dus klu'i rgyal bos byi na pa'i sgam chung de'i nang na klu'i rgyal bo'i bu mo chung ba yo nga/ de khyed la chung mar byin pa yin pas/ de len pa 'a sa gzhan pa chung mar blangs na mi bzang mizhes zer ro/ /de nas ri khrod pas cangs khyed la byin pa'i ḍa ru de da lta gang na yod/ khyed kyi lag tu yod dam’ zhes dris par/bu chung gis ḍa ru de ngas klu'i rgyal bo la 'tshams rtags su byin zim pas khyed thugs rgyal mi bzhengs bar zhu zhes bshad pa la ri khrod pas de ltar yin na 'grig yod/ ngas kyang klu'i rgyal bo la ster thabs byed bsams nas khyed la dris/ pa yin/ da lta khyed mgyogs por phyi ra song nas chung ma ‘ ba ltos zer nas lam la bcug bu chung phyir 'ongs nas klu'i rgyal bos byin pa'i dam/ga 'dus sgam chung gi kha pyes nas lta dus der bu mo mdzes ma zhig 'dug pa mig khra — 354

chung chu skyes me tog lta bu/ lus phra mo smyug ma tshigs/ drug lta bu/ gdong dkar bo bco lnga'i dung zla 'dra ba/ 'gro bom pa bya spu rlung gis khur ba ltar yin pa des yid dbang 'phrog ste yun ring por bltas bsdad/ ma rgan dang blon po rig pa can rnam pa gnyis dga' spro chen po skyes shing ston mo rgya chen po byas/de nas bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol nas nyin mang bo ma 'bor bar btsan po zhig gi sras la mna' ma/ len gi yong zer mas/ yul de'i mi ming grags can dang phyug po rnaca/ru/ rtsa /gron du bos/ bu chung gis kyang chung mar bshor lwa gon du bcug mas khrid de 'gro bsam par/ blon po rig/ pa catsha gyis bu chung la khyed ston mor 'gro na'ang chung ma ma khrid na bzang / gal te yin gcig min gnyis khrid rgyu zang na/ bshor gtan nas byed mi nyan par ca/ zang/ ngo la dri ga bskus te rgyab la slog pa thed po zhig bsko'o/ nas khrid song na bzang ’’zer/bu chung gi sems su/ mi'i kha ma blangs na mi'i gzhub mi chod bsams nas blon po rig pa can gyis bshad pa ltar du chung ma la slog nga/ thed po zhig gon du bcug pa dang ngo la dri 'og bskus te ston mor khrid song / ston thog nas kho'i 355

chung ma 'khor g.yog tsho'i gral tu bsdad cing bu chung kho rang phyub/ po'i gral du bsdad/ ma gzhi ston mo byed pa min par btsan po gtum po de'i bu la mna' ma btsal bzhin pa yin/ skabs der rgad po mgo skra dkar bo lug gu'i tsha ru 'dra ba zhig thon rongs nas phyub/ po'i gral du bltardo ga pa dang de nas g.yog po'i gral du bltas rjes/ su rgyal bo tshang gi mna' ma de g.yog po'i gra' du btsal na bzang ’zhes zer/ btsan po de'ang g.yog 'khor nang nas btsal rgyur 'thad pa byung nas g.yog 'khor nang la bltas pa na bu chung gi chung ma blor babs/ nas khrid song / blon po rig pa can khong khro chen po langs te gri bzung nas rgyag rtsis byas kyang bu chung gis 'u gnyis kyis 'di 'dra'i dgra mang bo mi thub pas/ rjes su thabs baḍa//da 'then na bzang zer nas gris rgyag tu ma bcug par chung mar mig brda brgyab/ chung ca/sa skyes pa'i mig brda'i nang don go nas ci yang mi bshad par so/nga / bu chung giru/ kho gnyis bza' zla mi na khul byas nas bsdad 'dug phyi nyin ni ston mo ngo ma yin pas bu chung dang blon po rig pa can gnyis kyis gnas tshul ci yang ma byung ba ltar du ston mor song nas chung ma gang la bcug 356

yod pa ra bltas/ btsan po tshang gis stom mo nyin4 zhag gsum la byed rgyu zhes brda brgyab par chung ma rgyug 'ongs nasabu chung la4khyod g.yog po'i gral nas sdod/ de ma byas na 'dzin bzung byed pa'i nyen kha yod ’’ces bshad na'ang /bud med tshos ci yang mi shes bsams te g.yog po'i gral tu ma bsdad par phyug po'i gral du bsdad/ cang ma 'asor bar bu chung gi chung mas mo ni skyes pa yod pa'i bud med cig yin pas btsan po'i bu dang gnyen sgrig mi byed zer nas bshad pas/ btsan pos rtsad bcad nas bu chung ni mna' ma'i skyes pa yin pa shes song bas 'dzin bzung byas te khrims la sbyar/ bu chung gis nyin re rer mdzub gus gyang ngor bu ga brkos/ nyin dgu zhag dgu la brkos dus gyang ngor bu ga chung chung zhig brko thub byung / bu chung gis khung bu'i nang nas phar bltas dus blon po rig pa can gyis rang gi dmag gi nang nas blo gsal zhing rig pa can zhig yod pa de mngags nas bu chung de btsal 'dug pa mthong / khos khung bu nang nas thag sne zhig phyir phud de sgul 'dug par rig pa can des mthong ma thag tu ya mtshan skyes te thag sne bzung ba na bu chung gis khyod ma gyogs por phyir song nas thabs ci yod kyis nga'i ral gri nga la sprod thabs byosanya zhes 357

bshad/dmag mi rig pa can myur du phyir song nas bu chung gi ral gri chen po de kho rang la sprod thabs byas/ khos ral gri chen pos btson ra'i sgor brgyab nas phyogs gnyis su 'phangs shing btsan po'i pho brang gi dgu thog tu rgyug song / khos btsan po'i pho brang gi shing sgo lcags sgo tshang ma gtor mas yang rtser thon dus/ yang rtse ni shel gyi khang ba 'ib/ yin la nang du kho'i chung ma bcug yod/ shel gye khang ba'e sgo gtor ba na chung ma kho'i sngon la rgyug 'ong / bu chu nga sis chung mar khyed kyis 'di nas cung sgugs dang nga ma gyogs por thon 'ong’’zer zhing mgyogs por btsan po'i sras btsal du song / btsan po'i sras kyang shel gyi khang ba 'ig gi nang du sdug la thug nas bsdad yod par/ bu chung sis khyod sgo khar shog zer ba la btsan po'i sras skrag snang chetsha po skyes na'ang bu chung gis de ring 'u gnyis kyis bu su rbod la blta/ khyod mgyogs por song nas khrab dang rmog son shoganya ces btsan skad kyis bshad nas 'gro ru bcugakhos ral gri bzung nas sgo khar sgug bsdad/ btsan po'i sra sa kyis rmog dang khrab gyon pa las mtshon cha ci 'a/nga ma bzung bar phyir thon 'ongs pa la khyod kyis mtshon cha ci 4358

yang ma bathung na/ nged gnyis kyis g.yug res byed ces zer nas btsan po'i sras bzung nas g.yug thengs gcig ica/ gnam la 'phangs te sa la brgyab pas mgo bo gas nas thi/ bu chung myur du phyir chung ma yod sar 'ong ste chung ma khrid de bros song /btsan pos rang gi gces phrug bsad yod par ma zad mna' ma'ang 'phrog song ba mthong ste kha spo kha nas la ngas/ zhe spo ba /ting nasalangs te dmag khrid nas bu chung dang blon po rig pa can gnyis la snying nad rtsod du song nas mkhar phyi skor nang skor gsum byas/ bu chung dang blon po rig pa can gnyis mkhar thog tu bud de dmag 'dus sgam li'i kha phyeru/ pa na dmag mang po phyir bud 'ongs nas‘ gang la rgyug rgyu/ gang la rgyug rgyu’ zhes skad cor brgyab pa la/ 6 grwa ba min pa tshang ma brgyab nas bsad na chog nyaces bshad rjes mkhar kha nas ltad mor bltas bsdad de sgam li'i kha rgyab/ rgyu brjed song bas sgam li'i nang nas phyir bud pa 'i dmang/ gis btsan po'i dmag bsad tshar bar ma zad dmag je mang je mang la song ba dang rang gis rang gi dam ga gsod res byas/blon po rig pa can rgyung/ 'ongs te tsa'adi ni ci'i don 359

du yin ’zhes dris pas na/ bu chung gis de ni sgam kha ma brgyab pa'i rkyen gyis red/ mgyogs por sgam kha rgyobanya ces bshad pas/ 'khor g.yog tshos sgam li'i kha brgyab/bu chung dang blon po gnyis kyis btsan po de'i rgyu nor dang nor lug sa zhing bcas 'bangs mi rnams la bgos pa dang rang rgyal bor bsdad de rong bar sa zhing yod pa dang /'brog par phyugs zog yod pa/ tshong bas tshong brgyab chog pa/ dgon pas chos 'don chog pa/ ser mo sogs rig gnas can la bkur sti byed pa/ rgyal 'bangs la khral mi bsdu ba/ 'khrug pa rgyag par dmag mi bsdu ba/ nyes pa ca na la khrims btsan pa bcas byas pas 'bangs mi tshos bde zhing skyid pa'i 'tsho ba rol ba dang bu chung bza' zla gnyis la'ang sras dang sras mo 'khrungs te bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol nas bsdad do/ /(bstan gces skyabs kyis legs bsgrigs byas pa〈〈mgo log godamangs khrod gtam rgyud〉〉las bdams/260

stozhas chen stobs chud /sngon tsa na/ dud khyim zhig 'a/ bza' zla khyo shug zung dang bu chung phu nu gnyica/ yod/ khyo bo ni rang bzhin gyis stobs shus/sa che ba tsam yin pa la mam zhig gi tshe khos sanas ga se/ mo zhig na ming du stobs chen stobs chung du grags/ pa'i mi/ stobs shugs kyis snyems pa zhig yod ces thos/ de nas bzung khos de la rtsal shusas/ 'gran 'dod kyi mos pa bzlog tu med pa zhil yid la ring du brnag mthar nyin zhig rang gi chung ma la ‘ gnas ga ge mo zhig na stobs chen stobs chung du 'bod pa shugs che bas kun tu grags pa zhig yod pa de don dam du mi gcig gam gnyis yin pa'ang cha mi 'tshal na'ang gang ltar kho bo de la stobs shugs 'gran 'dod kyi 'dun pa shin tu che bas/ 'gro bar bya'o ’ zhes smras pa la/ chung mas mang du bshol kyang rngo ma thogs par lam la chas so/ /de nas des kun la 'dri bzhin nub phyogs su song so nga ba na nyin zhig rta rdzi zhig dang phrad/ der dris bas/301

stobs chen stobs chung tshang zer ba lung ba 'di'i phar rgyab na yod la/ kho bo ni de tshang gi rta rdzi yin zhes lan btab cing / khyod su yin/ 'di ru ci la 'ong zhes dris/ kho bo shar phyogs nas 'ongs shing stobs chen stobs chung la shugs 'gran du 'dir yong ba yin zer/ lan du 'o na kho bo'i rta khyu na lha rta ngang ba gser mgo zer ba zhig yod khyod kyis de bsad nas sha zos shing pags pa mnyed nus na stobs chen stobs chung la dpung 'dzing tsam nus kyi ga(zun du dka' zhes bshad/ der khos bltas pa na rta gzhan las 'phags pa'i rta mchog khyad par can zhig 'dug pa la nye bar gzas pas bcar tsam yang ma nus/ de nas so nga ba na nor rdzi zhig dang phrad pas gtam gleng gong bzhim byung zhing / kho bo'i nor khyu 'di na lha g.yag kham pa rwa ring zhes pa zhig yod/ khyod kyis de bsad nas sha za zhing pags pa mnyed bzhin 'gro nus na/ de la dpung 'dzing tsam nus pa red/ gzhan du na mi nus pas 'ji nas phyir log pa dga' zhes bshad/ lha g.yag gi rnga ma/ra 'jus pas pha tshad cig tu bskyur nas 'drob/sa song / yang song bas lug rdzi zhig dang phrad pas snga ma bzhin bshad mthar kho bo'i lug khyu na lha lug kwa ba dung mgo zhes pa zhig yod pa 362

khyod kyis de bsad de sha za zhing pags pa mnyed kyin 'gro nus na dpung 'dzing tsam nus/ de bzhin ma nus tshe bcar tsam yang mi nus pas phyir log na bzang zer/ der lug thu zhig mi thub na mi min bsams te sgyid par 'jus pas bal nyag 'ga' lag tu 'ong ba tsam las ci yang ma nus/ de nas de rnams kyis bstan pa'i lam bzhin song bas zam phran zhig gi pha rol na mkhar rdzong chen po zhig yod pa der song bas stag khyi gzig khyi mang bo yod pa mthong bas 'jigs te re zhig der lus/de'i tshe na stobs chen stobs chung la ma rgan mo zhig yod pa des shes te ma na' ma la sgor blta ru bcug pas/6 pha gi zam kha na mi zhig 'ong gin 'dug ces zhus/ 66stag khyi gzig khyi dag kha phar 'khor nas zug gin 'dug gam tshur 'khor nas zug gin 'dug ’ ces slar dris pas/ 6 kha phar 'khor nas zug gin 'dug ’’ces lan byin/ ‘ 'o na da lan yang dgra phar thub yin pas khyi rnams ma bod la/ khro chu'i pha long blangs nas mkhar sgo phyes la zhog ’’ces bsgo bas des de bzhin byas/ de nas kho khyim du phyin pa na ma rgan mos khyod ci'i phyir 'ong ’zhes dris pas/ ru stobs chen stobs chung la shugs 363

'gran du 'ong ’ zhes smras par/ 66stobs chen stobs chung zhes pa nga'i bu yin la/ de ring ri dwags rngon du phyin pas dgong mo phyir 'ong mod khyod lta bus lan byed dka'/ yin gcig min gnyis 'gran dgos na sgo drung na yod pa'i glang ngu 'di la kho phyir ma 'ongs par sus kyang chu ldud mi nus pas khyod kyis e nus ’nyaltos zhes bshad/ khos glang ngu de la chu ldud par brtsam mod glang ngus sna sgra 'jigs su rung ba zhig bton pas nye bar btud ma phod/ de nas rgan mos bshad rgyur/ 66de ltar na khyod 'ong ba 'chugs 'dug ches bzang pa ni da lta phyir la song / da dung cis kyang 'gran dgos na nga'i nu ma 'di lan gcig nus dang nu zho cung tsam khar song na nga'i bu dang khyod gnyis ma gcig gi nu zhor bsten pa yin pas rten 'brel gyi dbang gis khyod la chag nyes cher mi 'ong ’ zhes smras kyang de yang ma nus/de nas dgong mo nyi grib shod du lhung ba'i dus tsam na mi chen po 'jigs su rung ba phrag pa g.yas g.yon la 'brong ro re bshal 'drud byas pa zhig gis a ma lags/ de ring mi dri zhig bro ba 'a di ci yin zhes 'dri bzhin ga shed nas glo bur du lhags pa na/ mas mi zhig khyod la shugs 'gran du 'ong 'dug mod mi chung nus med rang ga ba zhig yin pas/364

khyod kyis de la brnyas bcos byed mi 'os zhes ’nyabashad par /des kho bos 'gran zla zhig btsal nas ring du song yang da lta'i bar ma phrad pas de ring ga nas thon/ skyid pa la/ zhes smra zhing khyim du lhags pa dang de mthong bas dar cig la mtshar nyams sngar byung ma myong ba zhig skyes te tshur lag mthil du blangs nas zhib tu lta zhing phu zhig btab pas de sa la lhung ste brla rus dum bur bcad cing / de nas yang ring bor ma thogs par tshe las 'das/nam zhig tsa na/ sngar gyi bu gnyis kyang lag chags te stobs dang lang tsho rab tu rgyas par gyur/ de'i tshe na rang gi ma la 64gzhan su la'ang a pha zer ba yod pa la nged gnyis kho na la a pha med don ci yin zhes dris pas/6 khyod gnyis la gdod nas pha zer ba med mi’ces lan byin/nyin zhig zhogs pa'i mtshams sprin dmar ser ldang ba las phyi dro drag char 'bab par dpogs nas phu nu gnyis bgros te ma la gsol ba/ 66de ring bar nged gnyis kho nas rdzi bo byas nas de ring rtsed 'jo 'dod pas ma khyod rdzi bor nyin gcig phebs na chog gam zhes par/ de la ma yis 4los chog ’zer nas song / phyi dro mo skyin thang drag tu babs pas bdas te/ sgo drung du slebs nas sgo glegs rdung ba na phu nu 365

gnyis kus sgo mi 'byed par nang nas sgo gligs gtan te 'dug de la ci nyen dris pas kho bo gnyis la pha med don ci yin da lta shod cig ma bshad na mi 'byed ces bshad/ma yis ma srom par 'di skad bshad/ 6 khyod gnyis kyi pha ni stobs chen stobs chung zhes par shugs 'gran du song bas phyir log rgyu med par gyur/ thos tshor du stobs chen stobs chung zhes pa des rtsed spyad byas te bsad btang zer ’ zhes gsong por bshad pas/ de gnyis nas pha sha rtsod pa'i dam bcas/ nyin 'ga' 'gor rjes ma yis bshol btab kyang ma phan par phu nu spun gnyis pha yi sha lan slon du lam la chas/de gnyis kyang nub phyogs su song song ba las dang bo stobs chen stobs chung tshang gi rta rdzi dang phrad par gyur/gang du 'gro zhes pas stobs chen stobs chung la pha sha rtsod du 'gro zhes par/ 'o na nga'i rta khyu 'di na lha rta ngang ba gser mgo zer ba zhig yod pa bshas te sha zos shing pags pa nyed bzhin 'gro nus na/ de la dpung 'dzing nus kyi gzhan mi nus zhes pas/ phu bo de mchong rgyug gcig gis rta de'i rngog ma la 'jus te sa la brdabs nas bsad cing sha za zhing pags pa nyed kyin lam du chas/ de nas lha g.yag 366

dang lha lug kyang de bzhin byas te mkhar drung du bde blag ngang thon/de'i tshe de chang gi ma rgan mos mna' mar blta ru bcug pas stag khyi gzig khyi rnams kha phyir 'khor nas zug pa mthong ba bzhin smras pa na ma rgan mos bshad rgyur/ ‘6de ring dgra phar thub min par rang tshur thub yin 'dug pas/stag khyi gzig khyi rnams bod la/ khro chu'i pha long gis mkhar sgo chod cig ces bsgo bas/ de bzhin bgyis kyang khyi rnams ni bsad/ pha long yang sil mar gtor de khyim du brtol/yang glang ngur chu ldud du bcug pas chu ma blud par rwa nas bzung ste sa la brdabs nas bsad/ nu zho nu ba ni phar zhog ma rgan mo de yang de kor bsad/ phyi dror slebs tshe stobs chen stobs chung sngar bzhin 'jigs su rung ba'i nyams kyis lhags kyang nu bo'i res la babs pas stobs chen stobs chung la kho bo ni pha yi sha lan slon du 'ong / khyod kyang grags tshod de bden na de ring 'u cag gnyis sngon mo mtshon la mi rtse bar shugs chen dpung ba 'gran/ su zhig shi yang las yin pas phyis sor gleng med yin zhes bshad pas/ des kyang 'dzum nyams dang bcas lags so zer zhing dpung shugs 'gran pa na dang bo 'dra tsam pa la yud 367

tsam nas stobs chen stobs chung klad la bskor te sa la brdabs pas de nyid du bkums so/ /de nas phu nu spun gnyis stobs chen stobs chung las rnam par rgyal ba'i gtam de kun gyis thos pas mngon par bstod cing / ming de yang phu nu gnyis la chags te phu bo la stobs chen dang nu bo la stobs chung du 'bod par grags/de ltar skyid be'u dkar pos gar rtsed bgyid cing /sdug lo ma nag po chur 'phangs so/ /('ju skal bzang gis legs bsgrigs byas pa〈〈mgo log gi dmangs khrod gtam rgyud〉〉las bdams/ ) 368

bde bde zhadan zhadan/gna' snga mo sa cha zhig na/ rgyal bo zhig yod pa la sras mo gcig las rgyal sa skyong mkhan gyi sras ma 'khrungs/rgyal bo lo re las lo rer rgas kyin yod pa dang sras mo'ang lo re las lo rer nar son gyin yod pas mi ga 'dra zhig mag par btsal nas rgyal sa skyong du 'jug rgyu de rgyal blon tshos sems khur byed bzhin pa'i don bya gal chen zhig tu gyur/nyin zhig la rgyal bos rang gi blon chen rnams zur du bos nas na re/smyo de ring rnam pa 'dir bsdus don//don chen 'di 'dra gleng rgyu 'dug /rgyal bo nga yi lo rgas kyang //rgyal sa/ skyong mkhan sras ma 'khrungs//sras mor blo rig ldan na ya nga / /bu mos rgyal bo ga la rung //blon tshogs rnams kyis gros mo/la byos//369

mag pa ga 'dra btsal na bzang //7zhes brjod ma thag tu/ blon po rnams 'ur chil ler song nas rang rang gi bsam tshul phan tshun la brjod do/ /blon po la las dbul phyug mchog dman ci la'ang ma bltas par phyogs phyogs la brda yig sbyar nas skyes bu gang la blo rig pa dang dpa' mdzangs rtul phod ldan pa zhig yin na rgyal bo'i mag pa la 'dems nas rgyal sa skyong du bcug na rgyal sa 'dzin thub thag chod yin zer/blon po la las de ltar byed mi rung / dbul phyug mchog dman la mi blta bar mag pa btsal na gal te mag pa ni dbul bo zhig yin tshe 'bangs mi rnams kho la mi dga' ba dang dpon phyug po'i khongs su mi brtsi ba red/ de bas rgyal sa'ang 'dzin dka'/ nga tsho'i rgyal bo'i sras mo ni kha phar 'khor rjes nas bltas na gzugs mdzes po smyug ma tshigs drug 'dra/ kha tshur 'khor sdun nas bltas na gdong dkar bo bco lnga'i zla ba 'dra/ mig khra ril char shul me tog 'dra/ blo rig pa gnam 'og 'gran zla med/ kha mkhas pa sus kyang rtsod zla med pa zhig yin pas stobs 'byor ldan la skyes gzugs mdzes shing pho sgo'ang yod pa zhig btsal ba las dbul bo dman pa zhig gtan nas 370

btsal mi rung zer ro / /yang blon po la las stobs 'byor dang pho sgo la bltas nas mag pa btsal na don dngos thog blo rig pa dang dpa' mdzangs rtul phod yod med mi shes pas/ cha rkyen nges can zhig bton nas mag pa btsal ba'i brda yig sbyar na bzang zer ro/ /mthar rgyal bos mang kha nyung len byas/ nas mag pa btsal ba'i brda yig sbyor rgyur 'thad pa yin mod cha rkyen ga 'dra zhig bton na bzang zer ba la/ la las rang rgyal gyi dgra bo bde bde 'jam 'jam gnyis la 'thab tu bcug nas dpa' e yod dang blo e yod bltas na bzang zer/ la las rang rgyal du nang rkun mang bas blo bkod pa ci zhig 'then nas rkun ma de dag med par gtong thub par bltas na bzang zer yang la las mi res nam mkha'i bya la mda' gsum 'phangs nas rmas phog par ma zad bya des mda' khur te rgyal bo'i pho brang du 'phur zhing / de nas shi na rgyal bo'i don du rang srog shor yang 'gyod pa med pa zhig la brtag rgyu yod stabs/ dpa' yod med mda' la blta ba dang blo yod med bya la bltas nas thes thub pas de ltar byas na bzang zer/rgyal bos mo ba la mo 'debs su bcug pa dang rtsis pa la rtsis rgyag tu bcug pa/ bla ma la lung bstan zhu ba sogs 371

byas rjes/ bod kha ba can ni rten 'brel gyi bdag po yin stabs/ bya la mda' phog kyang sanas gzhan du mi shi bar phyir rang khyim la 'phur 'ongs pa de blo dkar ba'i rten 'brel yin zer nas dpyad pa btang bar rgyal pos kyang bden pa red bsams te sa cha so sor mag pa btsal ba'i brda yig sbyor rgyu'i bka' gnang ngo / /brda yig sbyar nas dus ma 'gyang bar sa cha so so nas dbang btsan shed che ba'i dpon po'i bu dang stobs 'byor ba ldan pa'i phyug po'i bu khri stong ma nga bo rgyal sa la thon 'ongs nas thabs gang yod kyis bya byi'u la mda' 'phangs/de'i nang na 'dab chags la mdas phog mkhan yod la/mdas ma phog par ngu kha shor mkhan yang yod/ de ltar nyin mang bor brtsad kyang btsan shed can gyi dpon po'i bu dang stobs 'byor can gyi phyug po'i bu gang yin yang gcig gis kyang bya la mdas brgyab nas rgyal bo'i pho brang la lhung du 'jug ma thub/skabs der blon po sger sems can la las rang don 'grub ched lkog nas rgyal bo'i sras mo ni lo drug gsum bco brgyad yin pas/ gal te lo mang bo sgug na sras mo go rgas mar gyur tshe dpon 'bangs kyis 'phya smod byed nges 372

yin/ de bas stabs bde byas na dga' zhes bshad 'dug rgyal bos kyang skad cha de dag thos na'ang rang gi snying lta bu'i sras mo la mag pa glen pa sems ngan zhig 'jog mi 'dod par sngon gyi cha rkyen rgyun 'khyongs byas nas bsdad/sa de na pha ma gnyis snga mo nas shi song ba'i dwa phrug gcig yod pa de chung dus nas mda' 'phen par shin tu dga' bas nar son rjes mda' ba ming grags can zhig tu gyur mod/ 'on kyang rta la zhon ma myong bas rta zhon par shin tu skrag pa yin/ yin na'ang kho rang stobs che ba dang gshis bzang ba/ blo rig can zhig kyang yin stabs 'bangs mi rnams kyis khyod song nas tshod lta zhig byos zer yang khos chod lta byed du 'ongs mkhan tshang ma ni dbang btsan shed che ba'i dpon po'i bu dang stobs mnga' thang ldan pa'i phyug po'i bu las dbul bo'i bu med pa 4 /thong nas 'gro ma phod/ blon po ngan pa zhig yod pa de ni mi rnams la 'phya smod dang tshig rgyag byed mkhas po zhig yin pas/dbul bo rnams kyis kho la smra ra kha tsha zhes mtshang ming btags/ nyin zhig la smra ra kha tshas dwa phrug de mthong nas ya/ dwa phrug byi'u bda'/ khyod rgyal bo tshang gi mag pa byed e thub lta ru mi 'gro'am/ ’’zhes 'phya smod kyis dris/373

dwa phrug bu chung gis rang la 'phya smod byed pa mthong nas khong khros ‘nga rgyal bo'i mag par 'dug e thub lta ru mi 'gro/gal te song yang khyod tsho phyug po dang dpon po'i bu ltar ming mi rdzob/ ’ces nga rgyal gyi gtam lab/ blon po smra ra kha tshas khong dgod cig byas nas ngas rgyal 'jog thub/ khyod 'dra ba zhig rgyal bo'i mag par 'dug thub na nga blon por mi 'dug par ma zad nga'i rgyu 'khor ba/ khyim chung ma dang bcas pa khyod la ster/ gal te rgyal bo'i mag par 'dug ma thub na/ ci byed rgyu/ ’’zhes 'chal gtam skyug bro ba zhig bshad pa na/ dwa phrug la mag par 'dug pa'i bsam pa dang yang na 'dug thub pa'i re ba med mod/ 'on kyang la rgya rtsod pa'i ched duyagal te rgyal bo'i mag par 'dug ma thub na/ nga la dpon sa dang rgyu nor/ chung ma bcas med kyang rang lus 'dom gang yod pas khyed tshang la tshe g.yog byed ’zer nas rgyal bzhag go/blon po smra ra kha tshas bu chung dwa phrug rang gi tshe g.yog byed pa'i ched du skad char sgro btags nas rgyal bor yar zhu byas par/ dang thog rgyal bo 'thad pa ma byung la blon po smra ra kha tshas skad cha ya yog mang bo bshad rjes tshod lta zhig byed par 'thad pa byung / phyi nyin rgyal sa'i mi rnams kyis 374

skad de thos nas snga mor rgyal bo tshang gi pho brang yod sar bu chung dwa phrug gis 'dab chags la mda' 'phen par lta bar song / blon po smra ra kha tshas bu chung dwa phrug khrid nas rgyal bo'i pho brang gi mdun phyogs kyi rtswa thang thog tu song ste mda' 'phen sa'i dmigs sa btsal nas bsdad do/ /dus der rgyal bo dang blon po/ 'bangs bcas kyi sems shin tu ma bde bar yod/ rgyal bos gal te bu chung dwa phrug rang gi mag pa byas tshe rgyal sa non mi non la sems khur byed bzhin yod pa dang / blon pos dwa phrug des rgyal sa bzung na rang gi dpon sa shor e 'gro bsam nas sems khur byed pa/ 'bangs mis dwa phrug rgyal bo'i mag pa byed ma thub na blon po smra ra kha tsha tshang la tshe g.yog byed dgos par sems khur byed bzhin yod pa red/ mi rnams brel bas yar lta mar lta byed bzhin pa'i dus der/ rgyal bo tshang gi gsos bya phug ron kha shas sa gzhan nas phyir 'phur 'ongs pa bu chung dwa phrug gis mthong ma thag tu mda' gang 'then nas brgyab pas phug ron gcig la phogs nas rgyal bo'i pho brang gi klad la lhung song ngo/ /bu chung dwa phrug gis mda' 'phangs pa ni glog 'gyu ba ltar mgyogs pas blon po rnams la 'gog khom ma byung / la la 375

rgyal bos bka' skyon gnang bar skrag nas ci bya ma shes par gcig gis gcig la bltas nas bsdad/ blon po sems bzang la las bu chung dwa phrug rgyal bo'i mag par 'dug pa phar zhog rgyal bo'i gsos bya bsad pas tshe srog la nyen kha yod par sems khur byed bzhin 'dug ltad mo ba'i nang na 'bangs mi dbul bo rnams dang lhag par du bu chung dwa phrug gi grogs po tsho dga' spros yar rgyug mar rgyug byas nas bu chung dwa phrug gis bya la ci ltar brgyab tshul mi rnams la bshad bzhin yod/ blon po smra ra kha tshas bu chung dwa phrug gi phrag mgo nas bzung ste ‘rgyal bo'i gso bya la mda' rgyob zer mkhan su yin 〉zer nas gshe gshe gtong zhor du rgyal bo'i sku mdun du khrid song / 6 rgyal bo lags/ gte ngan 'dis gzhan pa'i 'dab chags brgya stong la mdas mi rgyag par khyed kyi gso bya la brgyab nas bsad pa yin pas chad pa ci zhig gcod rgyunya’zhes zer nas yar zhu byas/ bu chung dwa phrug sa nas yar langs te na re‘ gsung gcig can gye rgyal bo lags/ khyed kyi brda yig thog tu dbul phyug mchog dman la ma ltos par nam mkha'i 'dab chags la mdas brgyab cing sa gzhan du ma shi bar de khyed tshang gi pho brang la lhung song na rgyal bo'i mag pa yin zhes bris yod pa 376

las/ khyed tshang gi gsos bya phug ron gras la mi brtsi zhes bris med pa min nam/ gzhan yang khyed kyis blon po nged gnyis kyis rgyal 'jog skabs kyang khyed tshang gi phug ron la rgyag mi chog zer nas bshad med pas da lta'i gnas tshul 'di la pho rab tshig thog dang 'phar ba rjes thog zer ba'i dpe ltar khyed kyis sngon gsung tshig la brtsi bkur gnang nas drang bden gyis thag gcod gnang rgyu'i bka' drin mi chung ba zhu lags’’zhes yar zhu byas/rgyal bos dbu mar sgur nas bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis btang rjes sems la tshig bshad don la ma gnas na rjes phyogs ci zhig bshad kyang 'bangs mi dang dpon blon tshos blos mi khel ba red/ de las gzhan bu chung 'di ni mda' ba zhig yin la snying stobs can zhig kyang yin pa red/ gal te snying stobs can zhig min na nga'i gsos bya la mdas rgyag mi phod pa dang nga'i mdun nas kyang 'di 'dra'i tshig btsan po brjod mi phod pa red/ kho ni blo rig ldan la kha yang mkhas pa zhig yin pa red/ gal te blo rig mi ldan na glo bur du phug ron de nga'i pho brang la 'phur ram mi 'phur mi the/sa bsam nas bka' ngag brjod dgos snyam ste dbu yar bkyag pa na blon po smra ra kha tsha mthong nas 377

yang sems la rang gis ci bshad kha len nam mi len tshod lta zhig byed dgos bsam nas yang bu chung dwa phrug lamakhyod kyis nga'i blon po smra ra kha tsha'i lag gi rgyal len nam mi len7zhes dris par/ bu chung dwa phrug gis myur dupha rgyal po lags/khyed kyis ci gsung de yin’’zhes lan btab/ rgyal bo'i thugs tshim nas skad gzengs mthon pos de ring gi 'dab chags la mda' 'phen pa 'di ma gzhi blon po smra ra kha tsha dang bu chung dwa phrug gnyis kyis rgyal bzhag pa yin mod/'on kyang nga'i brda yig gi don dang mthun stabs mag par 'dems pa yin/ ’’ zhes yongs bsgrags byas par ma zad ‘da nas bzung nga'i mag pa'i ming la kun dga' zhes btags pa yin’’zhes gsungs brjod pa la blon po ngan pa dang gnas gzhan nas 'ongs pa'i dpon po dang phyug po'i bu tshos phrag dog gis rgyal bo'i gsos bya la sus mi rgyob7ces smre sngags 'don bzhin pa dang / blon po sems bzang rnams kyis dwa phrug kun 'dra ba zhig gis rgyal sa non nam/blon po ngan pa'i lkog g.yo mtshang rtol byed thub bam zhes sems khrel byed/ 'bangs mi dbul bo rnams dga' ba'i bro gar 'khrab ste dga' ston rten 'brel zhu 'o/ /blon po smra ra kha tsha'i chung ma ma gtogs rgyu nor yod 378

tshad bu chung dwa phrug la shor bas kho bu chung dwa phrug thog la snying nad chen po langs te sems la gyi ling e yin rgyug nas lta/ mkhas pa e yin bshad nas 'gran bsam ste sems sdug gi ngo shor zhing phyir rang khyim la song ngo / /mag pa kun dga' pho brang la gdan 'dren byas shing ston mo rgya chen po nyin zhag bdun la byas te bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol ba'i 'go brtsams/blon po smra ra kha tsha'i rgyu nor yod tshad rgyal bo'i mag pa kun dga' la rgyal shor bas khog nas snying nad kyi me lce drag tu 'bar bzhin yod na'ang / thad kur khon lan slog mi thub pas rgyal bo'i sku mdun du song nas na re‘‘rgyal bo lags/ blon chung nga la don bya 'di 'dra zhig zhu rgyu yod/nga tsho'i rgyal sa na rkun ma shin tu mang bas/ da lta'i bar 'dzin bzung byas pa'i rkun ma la nyes chad drag po bcad kyang gtan 'gog byed ma thub pa ni blon po nged rnams la blo rig pa med pa'i rkyen gyis red/ da lta rgyal bo khyed la blo rig ldan la dpa' rtul yang yod pa'i mag pa zhig yod stabs rkun ma de dag gtan nas med par 'gog pa'i thabs shig btsal rgyu'i bka' drin zhu lags/ ’zhes yar zhu byas/ rgyal bos de ni phrag dog byed bzhin pa shes na'ang 379

don de mag pa la bsgrub tsu bcug kyang dka' ngal med snyam nas mag pa kun dga' rgyal bo'i sku mdun du shog zer nas bka' gnang / mag pa kun dga' rgyal bo'i sku mdun du song ba na/ rgyal bos kho la blo bkod pas rgyal sa'i rkun ma gtan nas med par 'gog dgos pa'i bka' bstsal/ zhang bo rgyal bo'i bka' de mi brtsi mi zer bar phyir rang gi khang ba'i nang du slebs rjes/ sras mos rang gi zla bo byugs ma bde bar yod pa mthong nas ci yin dris dus/ rgyal bos bka' bstsal ba'i gnas tshul brjod pa la/ sras mos de ni sgrub sla ba'i don zhig red/ blon po smra ra kha tshas rang la rkun ma 'gog pa'i blo dang nus pa med pas de ni don bya dka' mo zhig red bsam nas khyod kyis kho'i rgyu nor rgyal du blangs pa der snying nad rtsod bsam pa red/ ngas bltas na sang nyin nam gsal dus rgyal sa'i khyim tshang re re'i sgo khar rku byed mkhan yod na rang gi yong do la mda' phog par mnyam 'jog byos zer nas brda yig sbyar tshe/ mi rnams kyis khyed ni mda' pa zhig yin pa shes pas rku byed mi phod thag chod yin/ khyed kyis bltas na ci 'dra red/ ces zer bar/ mag pa kun dgas kyang bden pa red snyam ste 'thad pa byung nas dpon blon rnams la de lta bu'i brda 380

yig sbyor rgyu'i bka' babs pas phyi nyin nam gsal rag tu khyim tshang re re'i sgo khar brda yig sbyar/kun ma ming grags can gnyis kyis kyang brda yig de mthong bas rkun ma gcig gis gcig la‘‘rgyal bo'i mag pa mda' pa yin pa bden mod/ mda' 'phang 'phang tshang ma ong do'i thog yin don ci ’zhes dris par/ gzhan gcig gis yong do thog la rgyag don ngas bltas na shi mi shi zhing na ba tsha ba yod ni zhig byed bsam ni red 'dod ’ces zer/yang gcig gis de ltar yin na do dgong nged gnyis kyis ong do'i thog la thong lcags shig btags nas tshod lta zhig byed du 'gro ’zhes zer bar rkun ma gzhan pa de yang 'thad pa byung nas dgong mo yong do'i thog tu thong lcags shig btags nas rgyal bo tshang la rku byed du song / dus der rgyal bo tshang gi mag pa bza' zla gnyis kyis rang gi gzims khang nang du gcig gis gcig gi kha nang la sil tog kha sur gcig 'phangs nas rtsed mo rtse bzhin yod/ sras mos rang gi zla bo'i kha nang la sil tog kha sur gcig 'phangs nas dgod zhor du gcig nang la 'dzul song’ zhes bshad par/ rkun ma gcig khyim la 'ong ma thag tu skad cha de thos pas kho rang mthong ste bshad kyin yod pa red bsams nas 381

sbas skong byas te bsdad/khyo gas sil tog gcig chung ma'i kha nang du 'phangs pa kha nang la 'dzul song bas khyo ga dga' spro skyes nas yang gcig nang la 'dzul song’’zhes bshad par rkun ma gzhan gcig po de khyim la 'dzul 'ong tshe skad cha de thos te skad dma' mos rang gi rkun rogs la a rogs/ nga rig thal/ ’’zhes zer/ kun ma gzhan gcig pos kyang‘ nga yang rig thal/ 'bro'am’’zhes dris pa la/ 6‘'bro ’zer nas bros ma thag tu rgyal bo'i mag pa bza' zla gnyis kyis grags 'gul yod pa thos nas myur du ‘rkun ma la mda' yis rgyob’’zer nas ku co brgyab par/ rkun ma de gnyis bros byol byed ched pho brang ltag rgyab kyi tse bo'i zhing nang la rgyug tse bo'i snye mas ong do thog tu btags yod pa'i thong lcags la brgyab nas thag thag sang sang’’zhes sgra sgrog pa la rkun ma gnyis kyis rgyal bo'i mag pas mda' brgyab pa red bsams te lhag par du skrag nas bros/ zhing nang nas phar bud rjes grags 'gul ci yang med pas ngal cung tsam gsos nas rkun ma gcig gis dbugs 'tshang zhor du 6‘grogs po/ de ring thong lcags 'di med na nged gnyis kyi song do'i thog tu mda' ci tsam zug yod pa mi shes/ gal 382

te ong do'i thog tu mda' zug song na sde ba'i nang la ci dzoltar 'gro/ mi gzhan par ci ltar bshad/ mi rnams kyis rkun ma yin pa'ang shes 'gro bas ong do thog tu mda' zug pa las rku ma byas na bzang’ zer ba la/ kho'i grogs po mi 'thad par‘ dngos gnas deng thog nged gnyis mthong ngam ma mthong ba dang mdas rgyab bam ma brgyab pa mi shes pas sang nyin yang song nas tshod lta zhig byas na bzang bsam/ ’ zhes bshad de phyi nyin kho gnyis kyis sil tog kha sur sle bo do khur nas bsam bzhin du rgyal bo tshang gi sgo khar btsong du song bar/ mag pa kun dga' bza' zla gnyis kyang sgo khar phebs shing sil btsong mkhan de gnyis mthong ma thag tu sras mos snga dgong zos pa'i sil de sems la dran te kha nas 'di mdang dgong gi de ma yin nam ’zhes zer ba la/ skyes pas kyang 6 red/ ’zer nas mar sgur te sil tog la bltas/ sil tog btsong mkhan gyi rkun ma de gnyis kyis rkun ma yin pa ngo mas shes song ba red snyam nas gcig gis gcig la mig brda btang ste sil tog bzhag nas bros song / mag pa kun dgas sems la mdang dgong gi gams tshul dran pa dang de ring mi de gnyis kyi spyod pa mthong bas rkun ma yin pa thag chod de srung dmag 383

'dzin du bcug rkun ma gnyis po skrag nas byas tshul rnams gcig re gcig re byas nas drang mor bshad par ma zad chad pa ljid mo mi gcod pa'i re ba yang yang zhus/ ca/ga pa kun dgas skad cha de dag thos nas dgod shor bar rkun ma gnyis lhag par du skrag ste khyed kyis nged gnyis la chad pa ljid mo ma bcad na nged gnyis kyis ci zhig bsgrub dgos kyang chog zer bar/ rgyal bo'i mag pas de dag shese yod khul byas nas gong du bshad pa de dag khyod gnyis kyis ma bshad kyang ngas shes 'dug da lta gtso bo ni khyod gnyis kyis 'gyod bshags byed dam mi byed pa de yin/ gal te khyod gnyis kyis don dngos thog 'gyod bshags byed bsam na rgyal khams yongs la rku byed du 'gro mi rung / rgyal bo'i mag pa ni ngo mas mda' pa zhig yin pas mda' gang la rgyag bsam na de la phog pa yin/ nged gnyis kyis brda tho'i thog tu bris yod pa bden nam mi bden bsam nas tshod lta byed du song ba la/ cung min na yong do thur la g.yug nas yong dgos par thug ces zer nas shod dang khyed gnyis la chad pa mi gcod’ zer zhing kho gnyis phyir btang / rkun ma de gnyis phyir song nas phyogs phyogs su rgyal bo'i mag pa kun dga' blon po gzhan dang mi mthun par bshad pa ltar 384

sgrub thub stabs/ rgyal sa nas rku byed mi nyan thag chod yin zhes bshad de rgyal khams yongs la bsgrags/ de nas bzung rgyal bo tshang la rku byed pa mtshams/ chad do/ /rgyal bo'i mag pa kum dgas rkum ma bkag pas go sa je mthor song ba dang blon po rnams kyis kyang kho la mthong chen byed/ yin na'ang bde 'jags kyi dus ma 'gyang par rgyal bo gzhan zhig gis btsan 'dzul gyi dmag 'khrug bslangs/ mag pa kun dga'i zhang bo dmag 'khrug la shin tu skrag na'ang 'gog rgol gagi byed thabs med par mag pa gtso byas pa'i blon po rnams bsdus nas ci ltar 'gog rgol byed rgyu dang dmag dpon su byed rgyu la sogs pa gros byas/de dus blon po smra ra kha tshas rgyal po'i mag pa la ngan byed pa'i dus la slebs byung ba red bsam nas rgyal bo la rgyal bo lags/ mag pa kun dga' ni mda' pa yin la blo rig yang yod pas/ khong las gzhan blon po su yis dmag dpon byas kyang dgra bo bde bde 'jam 'jam gnyis 'gog mi thub pas/ mi ngan ngas bltas na mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba bde skyid yong ba'i ched dang rgyal khams kyi bde 'jags ched du mag pa kun dgas dmag sne khrid nas dgra 'gog tu phebs na bzang bsam/ ’ zer nas rgyal bo'i mag pa nyen 385

kha yod sar ded/ khos bsam par dgra bde bde 'jama'ajam gnyis ni thabs ngan sna tshogs yod par ma zad kho /nyis dang kho gnyis kyis khrid pa'i dmag la dpa' rtsal yang rgod pas/ mag pa kun dga' kho gnyis kyi lag tu shi thag chod yin/ shi song na rgyal la shor ba'i rgyu nor yang rang gi yin pa red snyam ste yid tshim pa'i dga' nyams bstan/rgyal bos rang gi mag pa la dmag sne khrid du 'gro ru 'jug mi 'dod bsam na'ang blon po mang che bas mag pa kun dgas dmag sne khrid par 'thad pa yin stabs 'gro ru mi 'jug ga med byung nas mag pa kun dgas dmag sne khrid de dgra 'gog tu 'gro rgyu'i thag bcad do/ /mag pa kun dgas dmag spyi byas te g.yul 'gyed byed pa phar zhog g.yul ngo yang thon ma myong bas sems shin tu 'khrugs shing ci bya thabs med par gyur/ yin na'ang rgyal bo'i gsung gcig ces pa'i dpe ltar rgol ba med par pho brang gi phyi rol du sems g.yeng bar song nas yar 'gro mar 'gro byas/ khong gi dmag dpon dang drung yig bcas kyis dmag la 'gro ba'i dus tshod dang g.yul 'gyed byed pa'i thabs jus bcas ci gsung bar bsgugs 386

nas yun ring bo 'gor yang gsung mi brjod pas zas kyang za khom ma byung / dus der zhing kha zhig na kun dong zhig skyes yod pa mthong ste ya mtshar ba'i snang bas rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gsum/ lus po skya/ zos na kha tsha ba'i ya mtshar can/ya mtshar can/ ’’zhes bshad par/ drung yig tshos mgyogs por zin bris btab/ 'on kyang tshig de gcig po las gzhan gang yang mi brjod pas/ dpon blon rnams kyis myur du tshig der dpyad pa btang / brgya yis brgya bshad/stong gis stong bshad kyang mi rnams kyis khas len 'dug pa zhig ma mthong / de nas blon po gcig gis zunga'i lta tshul yin na/ rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gsum zer ba de ni mdung yu ba gcig pa rtse mo gsum can zhig dgos pa yin zer ba dang lus po skya zer ba ni rta ra ra ston pa yin/ zos zer ba de bzung gi sgra 'gyur bar ngos 'dzin rgyu dang / kha tsha ba zhes pa ni ya mtshar ba dang don gcig yin pa red/mdor bshad na/ rta ra ra bzung na thub rgyu med pa'i ya mtshar can zhig dang mdung rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gsum can zhig dgos pa yin zer ba red ces bshad par/ dpon blon tshang mas bden pa red snyam nas dpe mi srid pa'i mdung rtse mo gsum can zhig dang rta gyi ling ra ra zhig 387

btsal tu dmag lam la chas so/ /btsan 'dzul byed du 'ongs pa'i dmag dpon ni rgyal khab de'i rgyal bo'i sras bu spun gnyis ka yin/ gcig gi ming la bde bde zer zhing gcig gi ming la 'jam 'jam zer/ kho gnyis ni dpa' rgod la blo mang ba zhig yin pas nga rgyal gyi snang ba sna mgo na yod cing btsan 'dzul byed sa'i rgyal khab na kho gnyis la ngo ya 'dzin thub pa'i bu dpa' bo dang rta rgod po med bsam nas rgyal kha lon par khas blangs nas 'ongs pa yin stabs/ rgyal bo'i mag pa kun dga'i mi rta mig nang du mi 'jog par rtsis med du bzhag nas g.yul sa'i dmag sgar nang du bdud rtsi bzhes kyin 'dug mag pa kun dga' rta rgod po de 'dra zhig la sngon nas zhon ma myong pas rta'i zur la thon dus skrag nas 'dar bzhin yod na'ang bde bde 'jam 'jam gnyis kyis rtsis med du 'jog pa mthong nas phyi'i dgra bo'i thog la khong khro dang nang blon po ngan par la rgya mi shor ba'i ched srung dmag la bka' babs nas btsan po rgod po'i rta gyi ling der zhon pa dang dpe mi srid pa'i mdung rtse mo gsum can de lag tu bzung nas rgyug dus/ rta des bde bde 'jam 'jam 'anyis kyi dmag ta spe/thong pa na bya 'phur ba ltar du 388

gyu4/ mag pa kun dga' rtas sar rgyag par skrag nas rta'i sngog ma'i nang la dam por 'chang bsdad pas rtas brdzis nas bsad pa dang mdung gis thug pa tsam gyis btsan 'dzul byed mkhan gyi dmag rta mang bo bsad par ma zad/'gog ma thub par dam/ga gur dkyil nas yar rgyug mar kyug byas pas bde bde 'jam 'jam gnyis kyi gur yang rdzogs shing kho gnyis chang gis bzi yod pas 'bro ma thub par rtaca/ brdzis nas bsad do/ /rtas khur nas yar rgyug mar gyug byed skabs mag pa kun dga'i kha nas bde sa 'jam sa zhig la rgyob zer ba bde bde 'jam 'jam gyi dmag gis thos naca/ra bde bde 'jam 'jam la rgyobanya’zer bar go tsha/ga ste dmag 'thab na rgyal kha mi lon thag chod red bsam nas dmag phyir la 'then/ mag pa kun dga' ya nga rtas la lung ba gnyis la khur nas phyir rang gi dmag sur yod sar thon dus/ da rung kha nas bde bde 'jam 'jam zer gyin 'dug srung dmag rnams kyis khong mgyogs por gur nang la khur yang lag gi mdung de len ma thub par mdzub gu gcig re gcig re byas nas spar kha phyes te blangs pa la chang mas dpa' 'ching la song ba red zer nas kragaca/ song / de nas bde bde 'jam 'jam gyi 389

dmag phyir la 'then rjes dam/ga 'thab ma dgos par khos kyang dmag khrid de rgyal kha'i ngang phyir slebs so/ /rgyal bos rang la 'di 'dra'i dpa' yid la blo rigo kyang ldan pa'i mag pa zhig yod pa mthong nas dga' spro tshad med skyes te rang gi rgyal sa byin nas rgyal bor bzhag mag pa kun dga' rgyal bor bsdad rjes rgyal nang na rkun ma med la phyi ru btsan 'dzul mkhan med pas 'bangs mis bde sdod las brtson byas nas rgyal khab stobs 'byor gnyis ldan du gyur la 'bangs mi'i 'tsho ba yang bde zhing skyid por gyur to/ /(gangs dpal gyis legs bsgrigs byas pa〈〈mgo log gi dmangs khrod gtam rgyud〉〉las bdams/ ) 390

dpe tshogs jus 'god pa/ sangs4ོ phro/rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ dab mo/mdun shog ma/dzes ris tshegomadun shog gzigs byang / grags pa/par sgrig 'char 'ged/ la ha'e yun/ sa / /gna' gtam mthong ba dga' skyed/kurma mkha' 'bum gyis bdams te bsgrigs//de—mtshosngon mirigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun/ (zi ling grong khyer thun rin lam sgo ang10)mtsho sngon zhing chen zhin hwa dpe khang gis bkram/mtsho sngon mi ri sa par khang gis dpar/deb tshad/ ho smis787ma960 1732dpar 'og 12 625 yig grangs/ khri171097lo'i zla4bar par gzhi ngadang po bsgrigs/1997lo'i zla4bar par thengapa/ dang po dang/ra/dpar grangs/ 0 001—/de3 000132sa7/de5420/de0642/de871 89 rin gong / sgor11 50
